name: NIST 800-53 Revision 5 (Moderate)
description: A catalog of security and privacy controls for federal information systems, published by NIST and used government-wide under FISMA; the Moderate baseline is the tier most commonly required for FedRAMP Moderate and federal agency systems where loss of confidentiality, integrity, or availability would have a serious adverse effect.
notes: Presented at the 20 control-family level. PM (Program Management) controls are organization-wide and not tiered by baseline like the other 19 families, but are included here because RMF/FedRAMP programs track them alongside the Moderate baseline.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Limits information system access to authorized users, processes, and devices, and to the types of transactions and functions they are permitted to exercise, through account management, least privilege, remote access, and session controls.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a documented access control policy exists, accounts are provisioned per least privilege, and periodic access reviews are performed and evidenced.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, account management procedures, access review/recertification records, system access control lists.

controls.title: Awareness and Training
controls.description: Requires security awareness training for all personnel and specialized role-based training for personnel with significant security responsibilities, delivered at onboarding and periodically thereafter.
controls.test_criteria: Verify training completion records exist for all personnel within required timeframes and role-based training is tracked for privileged users.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training completion logs, training curriculum, role-based training records for privileged/security personnel.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.description: Requires creation, protection, and retention of audit records sufficient to enable monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized system activity.
controls.test_criteria: Verify audit logging is enabled on in-scope systems, logs capture required event types, and logs are protected from unauthorized modification and retained per policy.
controls.evidence_requirement: Audit logging policy, sample audit logs, log retention configuration, SIEM alerting rules.

controls.title: Assessment, Authorization, and Monitoring
controls.description: Requires periodic security control assessments, plans of action and milestones (POA&Ms) for identified weaknesses, formal authorization to operate, and continuous monitoring of control effectiveness.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a current security assessment report, authorization decision/ATO, and an active POA&M with tracked remediation exist.
controls.evidence_requirement: Security assessment report, authorization package/ATO letter, POA&M tracker, continuous monitoring plan and reports.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.description: Establishes and maintains baseline configurations and inventories of organizational systems, and controls changes through a formal change management process including security impact analysis.
controls.test_criteria: Verify baseline configurations exist, are compared against current state (drift detection), and changes go through documented approval and testing.
controls.evidence_requirement: Configuration baseline documents, CMDB/asset inventory, change management tickets, configuration scan reports.

controls.title: Contingency Planning
controls.description: Requires contingency plans, backup strategies, and alternate processing/storage arrangements to ensure the availability of critical information systems and recovery following a disruption.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a contingency/disaster recovery plan exists, has been tested within the required period, and backups are performed and periodically tested for restorability.
controls.evidence_requirement: Contingency plan document, DR/tabletop test results, backup logs, backup restoration test records.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.description: Requires unique identification and authentication of users, devices, and processes before allowing access, including multi-factor authentication for network and privileged access.
controls.test_criteria: Verify unique user IDs are enforced, MFA is required for remote/privileged access, and authenticator management meets requirements.
controls.evidence_requirement: Authentication policy, MFA configuration evidence, identity management system records, password policy settings.

controls.title: Incident Response
controls.description: Requires an incident response capability including training, testing, detection, analysis, containment, and reporting of security incidents.
controls.test_criteria: Verify an incident response plan exists, has been tested (tabletop/simulation), and incidents are tracked from detection through resolution with lessons learned.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, IR test/tabletop records, incident tickets/logs, post-incident review reports.

controls.title: Maintenance
controls.description: Controls the performance of system maintenance, including tools, personnel, and remote maintenance activities, to prevent unauthorized access during maintenance.
controls.test_criteria: Verify maintenance activities are logged, remote maintenance sessions are authorized and monitored, and maintenance personnel are vetted.
controls.evidence_requirement: Maintenance logs, remote maintenance approval records, maintenance tool inventory.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.description: Requires protection of digital and non-digital media containing sensitive information, including access restriction, marking, storage, transport, and sanitization/destruction before reuse or disposal.
controls.test_criteria: Verify media handling procedures are followed, sanitization/destruction is performed per NIST SP 800-88, and records of destruction exist.
controls.evidence_requirement: Media protection policy, media sanitization/destruction certificates, media inventory and transport logs.

controls.title: Physical and Environmental Protection
controls.description: Requires physical access controls, monitoring, and environmental safeguards (fire, power, temperature/humidity) to protect facilities housing information systems.
controls.test_criteria: Verify physical access to facilities/data centers is controlled and logged, visitor access is managed, and environmental controls are monitored and maintained.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access logs, badge system records, visitor logs, environmental monitoring/maintenance records.

controls.title: Planning
controls.description: Requires development, documentation, and periodic update of security and privacy plans describing the controls in place or planned for the system.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a current system security plan (SSP) exists, is reviewed/updated on schedule, and aligns with actual implemented controls.
controls.evidence_requirement: System security plan, privacy plan, plan review/approval records.

controls.title: Program Management
controls.description: Establishes organization-wide information security program activities, including a security program plan, risk management strategy, enterprise architecture, and resource allocation, independent of any single system.
controls.test_criteria: Verify an organization-wide information security program plan exists, with assigned roles (e.g., CISO), a risk management strategy, and resource planning.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security program plan, risk management strategy document, organizational charts, budget/resource allocation records.

controls.title: Personnel Security
controls.description: Requires screening of individuals prior to authorizing access, termination and transfer procedures, and sanctions for personnel security policy violations.
controls.test_criteria: Verify background screening is performed commensurate with risk, and access is promptly revoked upon termination/transfer.
controls.evidence_requirement: Background check records, onboarding/offboarding checklists, access termination logs.

controls.title: PII Processing and Transparency
controls.description: Requires organizations to identify the legal authority for PII processing, provide privacy notices, obtain consent where applicable, and conduct privacy impact assessments.
controls.test_criteria: Verify privacy notices are published, consent mechanisms are implemented where required, and privacy impact assessments exist for systems processing PII.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy notices, consent records, privacy impact assessment (PIA) documents, PII inventory.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: Requires periodic assessment of risk to organizational operations, assets, and individuals resulting from system operation, including vulnerability scanning and risk categorization.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a current risk assessment exists, vulnerability scans are performed on a defined cadence, and identified risks are tracked to remediation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk assessment report, vulnerability scan reports, risk register, FIPS 199 categorization.

controls.title: System and Services Acquisition
controls.description: Requires security requirements to be incorporated into the system development life cycle and acquisition/contracting processes, including supply chain and third-party software security.
controls.test_criteria: Verify security requirements are included in acquisition contracts/SDLC gates, and third-party components undergo security review.
controls.evidence_requirement: SDLC security requirements documentation, acquisition contract security clauses, secure code review/testing records.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.description: Requires protection of system boundaries, transmission confidentiality/integrity (encryption), and network segmentation to prevent unauthorized information flow.
controls.test_criteria: Verify network boundaries are protected (firewalls/segmentation), data in transit is encrypted, and cryptographic key management is implemented per policy.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network diagrams, firewall rule sets, encryption configuration evidence, key management procedures.

controls.title: System and Information Integrity
controls.description: Requires flaw remediation (patching), malicious code protection, system monitoring, and information input/output validation to maintain system and data integrity.
controls.test_criteria: Verify patches are applied within defined timeframes, anti-malware is deployed and updated, and security alerts/advisories are monitored and acted upon.
controls.evidence_requirement: Patch management records, anti-malware deployment/update logs, vulnerability remediation tracker.

controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Management
controls.description: Requires development of a supply chain risk management plan and processes to identify, assess, and mitigate risks from suppliers, developers, and system integrators throughout the system life cycle.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a supply chain risk management plan exists and critical suppliers/components undergo risk assessment and monitoring.
controls.evidence_requirement: Supply chain risk management plan, supplier risk assessments, component provenance/SBOM records.

name: HIPAA
description: A U.S. federal law enforced by the HHS Office for Civil Rights that sets national standards for protecting the privacy and security of individually identifiable health information (PHI) held by covered entities and their business associates, through the Security Rule, Privacy Rule, and Breach Notification Rule.
notes: Combines the Security Rule's 18 implementation standards (Administrative, Physical, Technical Safeguards) with core Privacy Rule and Breach Notification Rule provisions at the standard level, not every addressable implementation specification.

controls.title: Security Management Process
controls.description: Requires covered entities and business associates to conduct a risk analysis, implement risk management measures, apply a sanction policy for workforce violations, and regularly review system activity records.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a documented risk analysis has been conducted and risk management measures implemented; confirm a sanction policy exists for workforce violations.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk analysis report, risk management plan, sanction policy, information system activity review logs.

controls.title: Assigned Security Responsibility
controls.description: Requires designation of a single security official responsible for developing and implementing the organization's security policies and procedures.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a named individual is formally designated as Security Official in policy documentation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Security official designation memo/policy, organizational chart.

controls.title: Workforce Security
controls.description: Requires procedures for authorizing and supervising workforce members who access ePHI, clearance procedures, and termination procedures to remove access.
controls.test_criteria: Verify workforce clearance, authorization, and termination procedures are documented and followed.
controls.evidence_requirement: Workforce security policy, access authorization records, termination checklist records.

controls.title: Information Access Management
controls.description: Requires policies and procedures for authorizing access to ePHI consistent with the Privacy Rule, including establishment and modification of access.
controls.test_criteria: Verify access to ePHI is granted based on role and documented authorization procedures.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access authorization policy, access request/approval records, role-based access matrix.

controls.title: Security Awareness and Training
controls.description: Requires a security awareness and training program for all workforce members, including periodic security reminders, malware protection guidance, login monitoring, and password management.
controls.test_criteria: Verify periodic security awareness training, including malware and password management reminders, is delivered to the workforce.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training records, security reminder communications, training curriculum.

controls.title: Security Incident Procedures
controls.description: Requires procedures to identify, respond to, mitigate, and document suspected or known security incidents affecting ePHI.
controls.test_criteria: Verify procedures exist to identify, respond to, and document security incidents affecting ePHI.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response policy, incident log/tickets, post-incident reports.

controls.title: Contingency Plan
controls.description: Requires a data backup plan, disaster recovery plan, and emergency mode operation plan to ensure availability of ePHI during an emergency.
controls.test_criteria: Verify data backup, disaster recovery, and emergency mode operation plans exist and have been tested.
controls.evidence_requirement: Contingency plan document, backup logs, DR test results.

controls.title: Evaluation
controls.description: Requires periodic technical and non-technical evaluation of security safeguards, including after significant environmental or operational changes.
controls.test_criteria: Verify periodic technical and non-technical evaluations of security safeguards are performed, including after environmental/operational changes.
controls.evidence_requirement: Evaluation reports, gap assessment records.

controls.title: Business Associate Contracts and Other Arrangements
controls.description: Requires satisfactory written assurances (Business Associate Agreements) that any business associate handling ePHI will appropriately safeguard it.
controls.test_criteria: Verify business associate agreements (BAAs) are in place with all vendors handling ePHI, containing required contractual provisions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Executed BAAs, vendor inventory/register.

controls.title: Facility Access Controls
controls.description: Requires policies limiting physical access to facilities while ensuring authorized access is allowed, including contingency operations procedures.
controls.test_criteria: Verify physical access to facilities housing ePHI systems is restricted and monitored, with contingency operations procedures documented.
controls.evidence_requirement: Facility access policy, badge/access logs, visitor logs.

controls.title: Workstation Use
controls.description: Requires policies specifying the proper functions, manner of performance, and physical surroundings for workstations that access ePHI.
controls.test_criteria: Verify policies specify proper functions and manner of use for workstations accessing ePHI.
controls.evidence_requirement: Workstation use policy, workstation configuration standards.

controls.title: Workstation Security
controls.description: Requires physical safeguards restricting access to workstations capable of accessing ePHI to authorized users only.
controls.test_criteria: Verify physical safeguards restrict access to workstations that can access ePHI.
controls.evidence_requirement: Workstation placement/security documentation, physical inspection records.

controls.title: Device and Media Controls
controls.description: Requires procedures governing receipt, removal, disposal, and reuse of hardware and electronic media containing ePHI, including sanitization before disposal.
controls.test_criteria: Verify procedures govern receipt, removal, disposal, and reuse of hardware/media containing ePHI, including sanitization.
controls.evidence_requirement: Media disposal/sanitization records, media inventory and tracking logs.

controls.title: Access Control (Technical)
controls.description: Requires technical policies and procedures for electronic systems that maintain ePHI, including unique user identification, emergency access, automatic logoff, and encryption/decryption.
controls.test_criteria: Verify unique user IDs, emergency access procedures, automatic logoff, and encryption are implemented for systems storing/transmitting ePHI.
controls.evidence_requirement: System access configuration, unique ID assignment records, encryption configuration evidence.

controls.title: Audit Controls
controls.description: Requires hardware, software, and/or procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in systems containing or using ePHI.
controls.test_criteria: Verify hardware/software mechanisms record and examine activity in systems containing ePHI.
controls.evidence_requirement: Audit log configuration, sample audit logs, log review records.

controls.title: Integrity
controls.description: Requires mechanisms to authenticate ePHI and confirm it has not been improperly altered or destroyed.
controls.test_criteria: Verify mechanisms (e.g., checksums, version control) confirm ePHI has not been improperly altered or destroyed.
controls.evidence_requirement: Integrity control configuration, data validation/checksum records.

controls.title: Person or Entity Authentication
controls.description: Requires procedures to verify that a person or entity seeking access to ePHI is the one claimed.
controls.test_criteria: Verify procedures confirm a person/entity seeking access to ePHI is the one claimed.
controls.evidence_requirement: Authentication policy, MFA/password configuration evidence.

controls.title: Transmission Security
controls.description: Requires technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to ePHI transmitted over an electronic communications network.
controls.test_criteria: Verify integrity controls and encryption are used to guard ePHI transmitted over electronic networks.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network transmission encryption configuration, VPN/TLS certificates.

controls.title: Notice of Privacy Practices
controls.description: Requires covered entities to provide individuals with a notice describing how PHI may be used and disclosed and the individual's rights regarding their PHI.
controls.test_criteria: Verify the covered entity's Notice of Privacy Practices is current, distributed to patients, and posted/acknowledged per policy.
controls.evidence_requirement: Notice of Privacy Practices document, acknowledgment records.

controls.title: Minimum Necessary Standard
controls.description: Requires covered entities and business associates to make reasonable efforts to limit use, disclosure, and requests of PHI to the minimum necessary to accomplish the intended purpose.
controls.test_criteria: Verify policies and role-based access limit use/disclosure of PHI to the minimum necessary for the intended purpose.
controls.evidence_requirement: Minimum necessary policy, role-based access configuration, disclosure logs.

controls.title: Uses and Disclosures Permitted and Required
controls.description: Governs the circumstances under which PHI may or must be used or disclosed, including for treatment, payment, and health care operations, or pursuant to valid authorization.
controls.test_criteria: Verify PHI uses/disclosures are limited to permitted categories or authorized by valid patient authorization.
controls.evidence_requirement: Authorization forms, disclosure accounting log, uses/disclosures policy.

controls.title: Individual Rights
controls.description: Grants individuals the right to access, request amendment of, and receive an accounting of disclosures of their PHI, within defined response timeframes.
controls.test_criteria: Verify processes exist for individuals to request access, amendment, and an accounting of disclosures of their PHI within required timeframes.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access/amendment request logs, accounting of disclosures records, response time tracking.

controls.title: Breach Notification Rule
controls.description: Requires covered entities and business associates to notify affected individuals, HHS, and in some cases the media, following discovery of a breach of unsecured PHI within required timeframes.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a breach risk assessment process exists and notifications to affected individuals, HHS, and media (if applicable) occur within required timeframes.
controls.evidence_requirement: Breach risk assessment documentation, breach notification letters, HHS breach portal submission records.

name: ISO 27018:2019
description: An ISO/IEC code of practice providing guidance for public cloud service providers acting as processors of personally identifiable information (PII), extending ISO/IEC 27002 with cloud-specific controls aimed at protecting PII in public cloud environments.
notes: Annex A's 11 categories mirror the ISO/IEC 29100 privacy framework principles. Exact Annex A clause wording should be verified against the licensed ISO text, as official control text is not freely published; category structure and intent are well-established but specific sub-control numbering may vary.

controls.title: Consent and Choice
controls.description: Requires the cloud service provider to enable and assist customers in exercising PII principals' consent and choice regarding use and disclosure of their PII, and to not use PII for marketing or advertising without explicit consent.
controls.test_criteria: Verify contractual terms and service configuration allow the customer to control consent-related processing and confirm PII is not used for marketing without explicit opt-in consent.
controls.evidence_requirement: Customer agreement/DPA terms, consent configuration settings, marketing opt-in records.

controls.title: Purpose Legitimacy and Specification
controls.description: Requires PII to be processed only for the purposes specified in the cloud customer's instructions, with no processing for the provider's own independent purposes.
controls.test_criteria: Verify processing activities are limited to documented customer instructions, with no evidence of independent use of PII by the provider.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data processing agreement, purpose limitation clauses, processing activity logs.

controls.title: Collection Limitation
controls.description: Requires collection of PII by the cloud service provider to be limited to what is necessary for the identified purposes of the cloud service agreement.
controls.test_criteria: Verify the provider collects only the PII necessary to deliver the contracted service, confirmed through data flow mapping.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data collection inventory/data flow diagram, service specification documents.

controls.title: Data Minimization
controls.description: Requires the provider to minimize the PII processed, offering options for use of the service with less identifying data, and to delete temporary files containing PII.
controls.test_criteria: Verify configuration options exist to minimize identifying data and that temporary files containing PII are deleted after use.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data minimization configuration settings, temporary file deletion/retention logs.

controls.title: Use, Retention and Disclosure Limitation
controls.description: Requires PII to be used, retained, and disclosed only in accordance with customer instructions and applicable law, with defined retention periods and secure return/deletion at contract end.
controls.test_criteria: Verify retention schedules are enforced and PII is returned or securely deleted at contract termination per customer instruction.
controls.evidence_requirement: Retention policy, contract termination data deletion certificates, retention schedule configuration.

controls.title: Accuracy and Quality
controls.description: Requires the provider to support the customer's ability to ensure PII remains accurate, complete, and up to date as instructed.
controls.test_criteria: Verify mechanisms exist allowing the customer to correct or update PII, and that such changes propagate through the provider's systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data correction/update logs, API documentation for record updates.

controls.title: Openness, Transparency and Notice
controls.description: Requires the provider to disclose to customers the countries where PII may be stored or processed, the sub-processors used, and its policies on PII handling.
controls.test_criteria: Verify the provider discloses storage/processing locations and sub-processor lists to customers and keeps this information current.
controls.evidence_requirement: Sub-processor list, data location disclosure documentation, transparency reports.

controls.title: Individual Participation and Access
controls.description: Requires the provider to assist cloud customers in responding to PII principals' requests for access, correction, or deletion of their PII.
controls.test_criteria: Verify the provider has a documented process and tooling to support customer handling of data subject access/correction/deletion requests.
controls.evidence_requirement: DSAR support procedure, API/tooling documentation for data export and deletion.

controls.title: Accountability
controls.description: Requires the provider to notify the customer of any data breach affecting their PII without undue delay and to maintain records demonstrating compliance.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a breach notification process exists with defined timeframes for notifying the customer, and compliance records are maintained.
controls.evidence_requirement: Breach notification procedure and SLA, notification records, compliance audit records.

controls.title: Information Security
controls.description: Requires the provider to implement security controls (encryption, confidentiality of sub-processor agreements, restricted administrator access) specific to PII protection in a multi-tenant environment.
controls.test_criteria: Verify technical security controls (encryption, tenant isolation, restricted admin access) specific to PII protection are implemented and tested.
controls.evidence_requirement: Encryption configuration, access control logs for administrators, penetration test reports.

controls.title: Privacy Compliance
controls.description: Requires the provider to support independent review/audit of its PII processing and to provide information necessary for the customer to demonstrate compliance to regulators.
controls.test_criteria: Verify the provider undergoes independent audits/certifications covering PII processing and makes audit results available to customers.
controls.evidence_requirement: Third-party audit reports/certificates (e.g., ISO 27018 certification), audit rights clause in contracts.

name: ISO 27017:2015
description: An ISO/IEC code of practice providing cloud-specific information security controls and implementation guidance for both cloud service providers and cloud service customers, extending the ISO/IEC 27002 control set with additional cloud-focused controls.
notes: Modeled on the 14 ISO/IEC 27002:2013 control domains (each receives cloud-specific guidance) plus the 7 new CLD-prefixed controls unique to 27017. The CLD control identifiers reflect commonly cited industry summaries; exact enhanced guidance text for the ~37 'modified' base controls should be verified against the licensed standard.

controls.title: Information Security Policies (Cloud)
controls.description: Requires information security policies to explicitly address cloud service use, including customer and provider responsibilities under the shared responsibility model.
controls.test_criteria: Verify published security policies reference cloud-specific risks and shared responsibility boundaries.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cloud security policy, shared responsibility matrix.

controls.title: Organization of Information Security (Cloud)
controls.description: Requires clear definition of security roles between cloud provider and customer, including for teleworking and remote access to cloud-hosted systems.
controls.test_criteria: Verify roles/responsibilities for cloud security are documented and assigned for both provider and customer.
controls.evidence_requirement: RACI matrix for cloud roles, contracts defining responsibilities.

controls.title: Human Resource Security (Cloud)
controls.description: Requires provider personnel with access to customer cloud environments to be screened and trained specifically on multi-tenant data handling.
controls.test_criteria: Verify provider personnel with privileged cloud access are screened and trained on tenant data segregation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Background check records, cloud-specific security training records.

controls.title: Asset Management (Cloud)
controls.description: Requires an inventory of cloud assets (virtual machines, storage, data) with clear ownership distinguishing provider-owned from customer-owned assets.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a cloud asset inventory exists with ownership and classification noted.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cloud asset inventory, classification labels/tags in cloud console.

controls.title: Access Control (Cloud)
controls.description: Requires access control supporting multi-tenancy, including customer-managed identity federation and restrictions on provider administrator access to customer data.
controls.test_criteria: Verify tenant-level access segregation and restricted provider admin access to customer data.
controls.evidence_requirement: IAM configuration, admin access logs, tenant isolation test results.

controls.title: Cryptography (Cloud)
controls.description: Requires encryption of data at rest and in transit in the cloud environment, with key management responsibilities clearly allocated between provider and customer.
controls.test_criteria: Verify encryption is enabled by default and key management roles are documented.
controls.evidence_requirement: Encryption configuration, key management policy/KMS access logs.

controls.title: Physical and Environmental Security (Cloud)
controls.description: Requires the cloud provider to maintain physical security of data centers hosting customer data, with assurance provided to customers who typically cannot inspect directly.
controls.test_criteria: Verify data center physical security controls via third-party audit reports since direct customer inspection is typically not permitted.
controls.evidence_requirement: SOC 2/ISO 27001 data center audit reports, physical security attestations.

controls.title: Operations Security (Cloud)
controls.description: Requires operational procedures covering change management, capacity management, and malware protection specific to the cloud environment, including logging of administrator actions.
controls.test_criteria: Verify operational procedures address cloud-specific operations and administrator activity is logged.
controls.evidence_requirement: Operations runbooks, administrator activity logs, capacity monitoring reports.

controls.title: Communications Security (Cloud)
controls.description: Requires network security management addressing virtual network segmentation between tenants and secure information transfer to and from the cloud.
controls.test_criteria: Verify network segmentation between tenants is tested and information transfer is encrypted.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network segmentation test results, data transfer encryption configuration.

controls.title: System Acquisition, Development and Maintenance (Cloud)
controls.description: Requires secure development practices for cloud-native applications, including protection of test data in cloud environments.
controls.test_criteria: Verify secure SDLC practices are applied to cloud application development and test data is protected/anonymized.
controls.evidence_requirement: SDLC policy, test data handling records, code review/SAST results.

controls.title: Supplier Relationships (Cloud)
controls.description: Requires the cloud provider to manage the security of its own sub-processors and suppliers and disclose the supply chain to customers.
controls.test_criteria: Verify sub-processor agreements include security requirements and are disclosed to customers.
controls.evidence_requirement: Sub-processor list, supplier security agreements.

controls.title: Information Security Incident Management (Cloud)
controls.description: Requires incident management procedures that include timely notification of affected cloud customers.
controls.test_criteria: Verify incident response procedures define customer notification timeframes and methods.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, customer notification templates/SLA, incident history records.

controls.title: Business Continuity (Cloud)
controls.description: Requires continuity planning that accounts for cloud provider dependencies, including the customer's ability to recover from shared cloud infrastructure.
controls.test_criteria: Verify business continuity plans address cloud-specific dependencies and provider resilience is validated.
controls.evidence_requirement: BCP/DR plan, provider resilience/uptime SLA documentation, DR test results.

controls.title: Compliance (Cloud)
controls.description: Requires identification of jurisdiction-specific legal and regulatory requirements applicable to data stored in the cloud, including data residency.
controls.test_criteria: Verify data residency and applicable regulatory requirements are documented and mapped to cloud deployment regions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data residency documentation, compliance mapping register.

controls.title: Shared Roles and Responsibilities within a Cloud Computing Environment
controls.description: Requires the cloud service provider and customer to document and allocate security roles and responsibilities (shared responsibility model) in the service agreement.
controls.test_criteria: Verify the service agreement documents which security responsibilities belong to the provider versus the customer.
controls.evidence_requirement: Shared responsibility matrix in contract/service description.

controls.title: Removal of Cloud Service Customer Assets
controls.description: Requires assets belonging to the cloud customer to be removed from the provider's environment and returned or deleted upon contract termination.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a documented process removes/returns/deletes customer assets and data upon service termination within a defined timeframe.
controls.evidence_requirement: Offboarding/termination procedure, data deletion certificates.

controls.title: Segregation in Virtual Computing Environments
controls.description: Requires the provider to ensure a customer's virtual environment is segregated from other customers' environments and from the provider's own.
controls.test_criteria: Verify technical testing confirms tenant environments are logically segregated (e.g., penetration test for tenant isolation).
controls.evidence_requirement: Tenant isolation test reports, network/hypervisor segregation configuration.

controls.title: Virtual Machine Hardening
controls.description: Requires virtual machines to be hardened to meet business needs, with unnecessary functionality removed or disabled.
controls.test_criteria: Verify VM images are hardened per a documented baseline with unnecessary services disabled before deployment.
controls.evidence_requirement: VM hardening baseline/checklist, image build pipeline configuration.

controls.title: Administrator's Operational Security
controls.description: Requires documented procedures for administrators to manage and operate the cloud service's security-relevant functions.
controls.test_criteria: Verify documented operational procedures exist for administrators performing security-relevant actions in the cloud environment.
controls.evidence_requirement: Administrator operations runbook, privileged access logs.

controls.title: Monitoring of Cloud Services
controls.description: Requires the cloud customer to have the capability to monitor relevant aspects of the cloud service's operation.
controls.test_criteria: Verify customers are provided monitoring capability or data (dashboards, logs, APIs) to observe the operation of the cloud service.
controls.evidence_requirement: Monitoring dashboard/API documentation, sample monitoring reports provided to customers.

controls.title: Alignment of Security Management for Virtual and Physical Networks
controls.description: Requires consistency between the security configuration of virtual networks and the underlying physical network infrastructure.
controls.test_criteria: Verify security configuration standards are consistently applied across virtual and physical network components (e.g., consistent firewall rules/segmentation policy).
controls.evidence_requirement: Network security standard document, configuration comparison/audit results for virtual vs. physical network.

name: NIST 800-171A
description: NIST Special Publication 800-171A defines the assessment procedures and methodology (examine, interview, test) used to determine whether a non-federal system protecting Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) satisfies the 110 security requirements of NIST SP 800-171; it underpins DoD CMMC Level 2 assessments.
notes: Presented at the 14 requirement-family level matching NIST 800-171 structure; 800-171A defines assessment objectives/procedures per requirement rather than introducing new requirements.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Assesses whether access to CUI is limited to authorized users, processes, and devices and to the types of transactions and functions those users are permitted to execute.
controls.test_criteria: Examine access control policy and system configurations; interview system administrators; test that unauthorized accounts cannot access CUI.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, system access configuration exports, interview notes, test results.

controls.title: Awareness and Training
controls.description: Assesses whether personnel are made aware of security risks and trained to carry out their security-related duties and responsibilities.
controls.test_criteria: Examine training records and curriculum; interview personnel on awareness of security responsibilities.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training completion records, training materials, interview notes.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.description: Assesses whether audit logs are created, protected, and reviewed to support incident investigation and accountability for actions taken on the system.
controls.test_criteria: Examine audit log configuration and sample logs; test that required events are captured and logs are protected from tampering.
controls.evidence_requirement: Audit policy, sample audit logs, log integrity configuration, test results.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.description: Assesses whether baseline configurations are established and system changes are controlled throughout the system life cycle.
controls.test_criteria: Examine configuration baselines and change records; test current system configuration against the approved baseline.
controls.evidence_requirement: Configuration baseline documents, change tickets, configuration scan/comparison reports.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.description: Assesses whether users, processes, and devices are uniquely identified and authenticated before being granted access to organizational systems.
controls.test_criteria: Examine authentication configuration; test enforcement of unique IDs and MFA for network/privileged access.
controls.evidence_requirement: Authentication policy, IAM configuration, MFA enforcement test results.

controls.title: Incident Response
controls.description: Assesses whether an operational incident-handling capability exists, covering preparation, detection, analysis, containment, recovery, and reporting.
controls.test_criteria: Examine incident response plan and test/exercise records; interview incident response team members.
controls.evidence_requirement: IR plan, tabletop exercise reports, interview notes.

controls.title: Maintenance
controls.description: Assesses whether system maintenance is performed and controlled, including the use of remote maintenance and vetted maintenance personnel/tools.
controls.test_criteria: Examine maintenance logs and remote maintenance procedures; test controls over remote maintenance sessions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Maintenance records, remote access session logs, remote maintenance approval records.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.description: Assesses whether media containing CUI is protected, controlled, marked, stored, and sanitized or destroyed appropriately.
controls.test_criteria: Examine media protection procedures and sanitization records; test media marking and storage controls.
controls.evidence_requirement: Media protection policy, sanitization/destruction certificates, media inventory.

controls.title: Personnel Security
controls.description: Assesses whether individuals are screened prior to being granted access to CUI and that CUI is protected during and after personnel actions such as transfer or termination.
controls.test_criteria: Examine personnel screening and termination records; interview HR on the offboarding process.
controls.evidence_requirement: Screening records, termination checklists, interview notes.

controls.title: Physical Protection
controls.description: Assesses whether physical access to systems, equipment, and operating environments is limited to authorized individuals.
controls.test_criteria: Examine physical access control configuration and logs; test physical entry controls at the facility.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access policy, badge access logs, physical walkthrough/test results.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: Assesses whether organizational risk from operations and the use of systems processing CUI is periodically identified and evaluated.
controls.test_criteria: Examine risk assessment reports and vulnerability scan results; interview risk management personnel.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk assessment report, vulnerability scan reports, interview notes.

controls.title: Security Assessment
controls.description: Assesses whether security controls are periodically evaluated for effectiveness and plans of action are developed to correct identified deficiencies.
controls.test_criteria: Examine security assessment reports and POA&Ms; interview assessors; test that identified deficiencies are tracked to closure.
controls.evidence_requirement: Assessment report, POA&M tracker, remediation evidence.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.description: Assesses whether communications are monitored, controlled, and protected at the external boundaries and key internal boundaries of organizational systems.
controls.test_criteria: Examine network architecture and boundary protection configuration; test encryption of data in transit and network segmentation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network diagrams, firewall/boundary device configuration, encryption test results.

controls.title: System and Information Integrity
controls.description: Assesses whether system flaws are identified, reported, and corrected in a timely manner and malicious code protection mechanisms are implemented.
controls.test_criteria: Examine patch management and anti-malware deployment records; test that known vulnerabilities are remediated within policy timeframes.
controls.evidence_requirement: Patch management logs, anti-malware configuration/update records, vulnerability remediation tracker.

name: ISO 27001:2013
description: The international standard for information security management systems (ISMS), published by ISO/IEC. The 2013 edition's Annex A contains 114 controls across 14 domains that organizations select from based on a risk assessment to support ISMS certification; it was superseded by the 93-control 2022 edition but remains referenced by organizations not yet transitioned.
notes: Presented at the 14 Annex A domain level (not all 114 individual controls), consistent with the requested top-level granularity.

controls.title: Information Security Policies
controls.description: Requires management to define, approve, publish, and communicate a set of information security policies, reviewed at planned intervals or upon significant change.
controls.test_criteria: Verify information security policies are approved by management, published, communicated, and reviewed at planned intervals or upon significant change.
controls.evidence_requirement: Approved policy documents with version history, review/approval records.

controls.title: Organization of Information Security
controls.description: Establishes internal organization (roles, segregation of duties, contact with authorities) and addresses mobile device and teleworking security.
controls.test_criteria: Verify security roles and responsibilities are defined, segregation of duties is implemented where required, and mobile device/teleworking policies exist.
controls.evidence_requirement: Roles and responsibilities matrix, segregation of duties documentation, mobile device/teleworking policy.

controls.title: Human Resource Security
controls.description: Covers security screening prior to employment, terms and conditions of employment, security responsibilities during employment, and termination/change of employment responsibilities.
controls.test_criteria: Verify background checks are performed before employment, employment contracts include confidentiality terms, and termination procedures revoke access.
controls.evidence_requirement: Background check records, signed employment/confidentiality agreements, termination checklists.

controls.title: Asset Management
controls.description: Requires an inventory of information assets, defined ownership, acceptable use rules, and information classification and handling/labelling procedures.
controls.test_criteria: Verify an asset inventory exists with assigned owners, acceptable use rules are documented, and information is classified and labeled.
controls.evidence_requirement: Asset inventory/register, acceptable use policy, data classification scheme and labeling examples.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Establishes business requirements for access control, user access management (provisioning/de-provisioning), user responsibilities, and system/application access control.
controls.test_criteria: Verify access is granted based on business need, user access is provisioned/reviewed/revoked per procedure, and privileged access is restricted.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, user access review records, privileged access logs.

controls.title: Cryptography
controls.description: Requires a policy on the use of cryptographic controls and key management to protect the confidentiality, authenticity, and integrity of information.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a cryptography policy exists and encryption/key management controls are implemented where required by risk assessment.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cryptography policy, key management procedures, encryption configuration evidence.

controls.title: Physical and Environmental Security
controls.description: Covers secure areas (perimeters, entry controls) and equipment security (siting, power, cabling, maintenance, secure disposal).
controls.test_criteria: Verify physical entry controls, secure areas, and equipment protection (power, cabling, maintenance, disposal) are implemented.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access logs, secure area access lists, equipment maintenance/disposal records.

controls.title: Operations Security
controls.description: Covers operational procedures and responsibilities, malware protection, backup, logging and monitoring, control of operational software, technical vulnerability management, and audit considerations.
controls.test_criteria: Verify documented operating procedures, malware protection, backup processes, logging/monitoring, and vulnerability management are implemented.
controls.evidence_requirement: Operating procedures, anti-malware deployment records, backup logs, audit logs, vulnerability scan reports.

controls.title: Communications Security
controls.description: Covers network security management and information transfer policies/agreements, including electronic messaging and confidentiality agreements.
controls.test_criteria: Verify network security controls are implemented and information transfer agreements/policies govern data exchange with third parties.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network security configuration, information transfer agreements, confidentiality agreements.

controls.title: System Acquisition, Development and Maintenance
controls.description: Requires security requirements analysis, a secure development policy, system change control procedures, and protection of test data.
controls.test_criteria: Verify security requirements are defined during system acquisition/development, a secure development policy exists, and change control is applied to production systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Security requirements specifications, SDLC policy, change control records, test data protection evidence.

controls.title: Supplier Relationships
controls.description: Requires an information security policy for supplier relationships, addressing security within supplier agreements and monitoring/review of supplier service delivery.
controls.test_criteria: Verify supplier agreements include information security requirements and supplier performance/security is monitored and reviewed.
controls.evidence_requirement: Supplier security policy, signed supplier agreements with security clauses, supplier review records.

controls.title: Information Security Incident Management
controls.description: Requires responsibilities and procedures for managing information security incidents, reporting events and weaknesses, and collecting evidence.
controls.test_criteria: Verify incident management procedures are documented, incidents and weaknesses are reported and logged, and evidence is collected per procedure.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident management policy, incident log, evidence collection records.

controls.title: Information Security Aspects of Business Continuity Management
controls.description: Requires planning for information security continuity during adverse situations, and verification, review, and evaluation of continuity plans.
controls.test_criteria: Verify business continuity plans incorporate information security continuity requirements and are tested/verified periodically.
controls.evidence_requirement: Business continuity plan, continuity test/exercise reports.

controls.title: Compliance
controls.description: Covers identification of applicable legislation and contractual requirements, intellectual property rights, protection of records, privacy, and independent review of information security.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a register of applicable legal/regulatory/contractual requirements is maintained, and independent reviews of the ISMS are performed.
controls.evidence_requirement: Legal/regulatory compliance register, internal/external audit reports.

name: Law 25
description: Quebec's Act to modernize legislative provisions as regards the protection of personal information (formerly Bill 64), which substantially amended the province's private-sector and public-sector privacy statutes; it is enforced by the Commission d'accès à l'information (CAI) and introduces GDPR-influenced obligations including privacy governance, breach notification, consent, and expanded data subject rights.
notes: Obligations were phased in from September 2022 through September 2024. Thematic groupings below are derived from secondary legal-compliance sources (law firm bulletins, CAI guidance summaries) rather than a verified clause-by-clause reading of the consolidated statute; verify specific section numbers against the official Act before relying on this for formal legal interpretation.

controls.title: Privacy Governance Policies
controls.description: Organizations must establish and publish governance policies and practices regarding personal information, approved by the person with the highest authority or the designated privacy officer, and evaluate them periodically.
controls.test_criteria: Verify written governance policies exist, are approved by the designated authority, and are reviewed periodically.
controls.evidence_requirement: Governance policy document, approval records, policy review log.

controls.title: Designation of Person in Charge of Protection of Personal Information
controls.description: Organizations must designate a privacy officer (by default the person with highest authority, delegable in writing), and publish their title and contact information on the organization's website.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a privacy officer is designated and their title/contact information is published on the organization's publicly accessible website.
controls.evidence_requirement: Designation/delegation record, website screenshot showing published contact information.

controls.title: Privacy Impact Assessments
controls.description: Requires a privacy impact assessment before any project to acquire, develop, or overhaul an information system or electronic service delivery involving personal information, and before communicating personal information outside Quebec.
controls.test_criteria: Verify PIAs are conducted and documented prior to new information system projects or cross-border information transfers.
controls.evidence_requirement: Completed PIA reports, PIA policy/procedure, project intake checklist referencing the PIA requirement.

controls.title: Consent Requirements
controls.description: Requires consent for the collection, use, or disclosure of personal information to be clear, free, informed, and given for specific purposes, with separate consent required for sensitive information.
controls.test_criteria: Verify consent capture mechanisms clearly state purpose, are separate for sensitive information, and consent records are retained.
controls.evidence_requirement: Consent forms/UI screenshots, consent logs, sensitive-data consent records.

controls.title: Transparency and Privacy Notices
controls.description: Requires organizations to inform individuals, at or before collection, of the purposes of collection, the means used, their rights, and other prescribed information.
controls.test_criteria: Verify privacy notices are provided at or before collection and contain all legally required elements.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy notice/policy text, collection point screenshots showing notice delivery.

controls.title: Confidentiality Incident (Breach) Notification
controls.description: Requires notification to the CAI and affected individuals of any confidentiality incident presenting a risk of serious injury, and maintenance of an incident register.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a process exists to assess incidents for risk of serious injury and notify the CAI and affected individuals without undue delay when the threshold is met.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response/breach notification procedure, sample CAI notification, individual notification letters, incident register.

controls.title: Cross-Border Data Transfer Assessment
controls.description: Requires a privacy impact assessment before transferring personal information outside Quebec, evaluating whether the information will receive protection equivalent to Quebec law.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a transfer impact assessment is completed before personal information is sent outside Quebec, evaluating the receiving jurisdiction's protections.
controls.evidence_requirement: Transfer impact assessment records, data processing/transfer agreements with adequacy analysis.

controls.title: Right to De-indexing and Re-indexing
controls.description: Grants individuals a qualified right to request that a business cease disseminating their personal information or de-index a hyperlink giving access to it, under specified conditions.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a documented process exists to receive, evaluate, and respond to de-indexing/re-indexing requests within required timeframes.
controls.evidence_requirement: De-indexing request log, response procedure, sample responses.

controls.title: Right to Data Portability
controls.description: Grants individuals the right to receive computerized personal information they provided in a structured, commonly used technological format, or to have it transferred to a third party.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a mechanism exists to export personal information in a structured, commonly used format upon request.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data export tooling/procedure, sample export file, portability request log.

controls.title: Automated Decision-Making Transparency
controls.description: Requires organizations to inform individuals when a decision is made exclusively through automated processing and to provide information on the factors/parameters used and the right to have the decision reviewed.
controls.test_criteria: Verify individuals subject to automated decisions are notified and provided information on factors used and the right to request human review.
controls.evidence_requirement: Automated decision notice template, decision logic documentation, review request log.

controls.title: Biometric Information Disclosure
controls.description: Requires organizations to disclose to the CAI, before use, any creation of a database of biometric characteristics or measurements used to verify or confirm identity.
controls.test_criteria: Verify any biometric database used for identity verification was disclosed to the CAI before being brought into service.
controls.evidence_requirement: CAI disclosure filing/confirmation, biometric database inventory.

controls.title: Data Minimization and Destruction/Anonymization
controls.description: Requires personal information to be destroyed or anonymized once the purposes for which it was collected are fulfilled, subject to applicable retention rules.
controls.test_criteria: Verify retention schedules trigger destruction or anonymization of personal information once purposes are fulfilled.
controls.evidence_requirement: Retention and destruction policy, destruction/anonymization logs.

controls.title: Privacy by Default
controls.description: Requires technological products or services offered to the public that allow the collection of personal information to be configured with the highest level of privacy settings by default.
controls.test_criteria: Verify consumer-facing products/services default to the highest privacy settings without requiring user action.
controls.evidence_requirement: Default configuration settings documentation, product privacy settings screenshots.

controls.title: Individual Rights of Access and Rectification
controls.description: Grants individuals the right to access and request rectification of personal information held about them, with defined response timelines.
controls.test_criteria: Verify access and rectification requests are logged, verified, and responded to within the statutory timeframe (generally 30 days).
controls.evidence_requirement: Access/rectification request log, response time tracking, sample response letters.

controls.title: Administrative Monetary Penalties and Offences
controls.description: Establishes administrative monetary penalties (up to CAD 10 million or 2% of worldwide turnover) and penal fines (up to CAD 25 million or 4% of worldwide turnover) for violations, enforced by the CAI.
controls.test_criteria: Verify the organization tracks regulatory exposure and compliance status relative to CAI enforcement risk through governance reporting.
controls.evidence_requirement: Compliance risk register, legal/regulatory tracking records, board/management reporting on Law 25 compliance status.

controls.title: Mandatory Confidentiality Incident Register
controls.description: Requires organizations to maintain a register of all confidentiality incidents, whether or not they meet the reporting threshold, available to the CAI upon request.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a register of all confidentiality incidents (reportable or not) is maintained and available for CAI inspection.
controls.evidence_requirement: Confidentiality incident register, sample register entries.

name: CSA STAR
description: The Cloud Security Alliance's STAR (Security, Trust, Assurance and Risk) program is a publicly available registry and assurance framework for cloud providers, built on the Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM) v4 — a controls framework of 17 domains purpose-built for cloud security — supporting self-assessment (Level 1), third-party certification/attestation (Level 2, often paired with ISO 27001 or SOC 2), and continuous monitoring (Level 3).
notes: Based on CCM v4 (17 domains, approximately 197 control statements); presented here at the 17-domain level per the requested top-level granularity.

controls.title: Audit and Assurance
controls.description: Requires independent audits/assessments of the cloud environment to be planned, performed, and reported, with audit findings tracked to resolution.
controls.test_criteria: Verify an audit plan exists, independent assessments are performed on schedule, and findings are tracked to remediation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Audit plan/schedule, audit reports, findings remediation tracker.

controls.title: Application & Interface Security
controls.description: Requires secure application design, development, and testing practices, including baseline security requirements and customer access to application interface documentation.
controls.test_criteria: Verify secure SDLC requirements are documented and applied, and application security testing is performed before release.
controls.evidence_requirement: SDLC/security requirements documentation, SAST/DAST test reports, API documentation shared with customers.

controls.title: Business Continuity Management and Operational Resilience
controls.description: Requires business continuity and disaster recovery plans to be documented, tested, and communicated, with defined RTO/RPO targets.
controls.test_criteria: Verify BC/DR plans define RTO/RPO, are documented, and have been tested within the past year.
controls.evidence_requirement: BC/DR plan, RTO/RPO definitions, test/exercise reports.

controls.title: Change Control and Configuration Management
controls.description: Requires formal change management processes including risk assessment, testing, and unauthorized change detection across the cloud environment.
controls.test_criteria: Verify changes follow a documented approval and testing process and unauthorized changes are detected via configuration monitoring.
controls.evidence_requirement: Change management policy, change tickets, configuration drift/monitoring reports.

controls.title: Cryptography, Encryption & Key Management
controls.description: Requires a documented encryption and key management policy covering key generation, storage, rotation, and destruction, with encryption of data at rest and in transit.
controls.test_criteria: Verify an encryption and key management policy is implemented, data at rest/in transit is encrypted, and key rotation occurs per schedule.
controls.evidence_requirement: Encryption/key management policy, encryption configuration evidence, key rotation logs.

controls.title: Datacenter Security
controls.description: Requires physical security controls for data center facilities, including layered perimeter protection, environmental controls, and asset management.
controls.test_criteria: Verify physical security controls at data centers (access control, CCTV, environmental monitoring) are implemented and documented, typically via third-party audit.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data center physical security audit reports, access control/CCTV evidence.

controls.title: Data Security and Privacy Lifecycle Management
controls.description: Requires data classification, data flow documentation, and controls covering the full data lifecycle from creation through secure disposal, aligned to privacy regulations.
controls.test_criteria: Verify data classification and data flow documentation exist and lifecycle controls (secure disposal, retention) are applied.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data classification scheme, data flow diagrams, data disposal/retention records.

controls.title: Governance, Risk and Compliance
controls.description: Requires an information security governance program, risk management program, and processes to track compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and contractual obligations.
controls.test_criteria: Verify an information security governance program and risk management process are documented, with compliance tracked against applicable laws/regulations.
controls.evidence_requirement: Governance charter, risk register, compliance tracking/regulatory mapping register.

controls.title: Human Resources Security
controls.description: Covers background screening, employment agreements with security/confidentiality terms, security training, and termination procedures for the provider's workforce.
controls.test_criteria: Verify background checks, signed confidentiality agreements, and security training are completed for all workforce members.
controls.evidence_requirement: Background check records, signed agreements, training completion logs.

controls.title: Identity & Access Management
controls.description: Requires identity lifecycle management, strong authentication (MFA), least-privilege access provisioning, and periodic access reviews across cloud infrastructure.
controls.test_criteria: Verify identity lifecycle management, MFA enforcement, least-privilege provisioning, and periodic access reviews are implemented.
controls.evidence_requirement: IAM policy, MFA configuration, access review records.

controls.title: Interoperability & Portability
controls.description: Requires documented APIs and data formats to support customer data portability and application interoperability, including at contract termination.
controls.test_criteria: Verify documented APIs/data export formats exist supporting customer portability, including at contract termination.
controls.evidence_requirement: API documentation, data export format specifications, termination data return procedure.

controls.title: Infrastructure & Virtualization Security
controls.description: Requires hardening of hypervisors and virtual machines, network segmentation between tenants, and capacity/availability planning for virtualized infrastructure.
controls.test_criteria: Verify hypervisor/VM hardening standards are applied and network segmentation between tenants is tested.
controls.evidence_requirement: Hardening baseline/checklist, tenant segregation test results, capacity planning records.

controls.title: Logging and Monitoring
controls.description: Requires centralized logging of security-relevant events, log protection and retention, and monitoring/alerting capability provided to customers for visibility into their environment.
controls.test_criteria: Verify centralized logging captures security-relevant events, logs are protected/retained per policy, and customers have access to relevant monitoring data.
controls.evidence_requirement: Logging policy, log retention configuration, customer-facing monitoring dashboard/API documentation.

controls.title: Security Incident Management, E-Discovery, & Cloud Forensics
controls.description: Requires a documented incident response plan, customer notification procedures for incidents affecting their data, and forensic evidence-handling capability.
controls.test_criteria: Verify an incident response plan exists, customer notification procedures are defined, and forensic evidence handling capability is documented.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, customer notification SLA/templates, forensic procedure documentation.

controls.title: Supply Chain Management, Transparency, and Accountability
controls.description: Requires assessment and ongoing monitoring of supply chain and sub-processor risk, with contractual flow-down of security requirements and transparency to customers.
controls.test_criteria: Verify sub-processors undergo risk assessment, security requirements flow down contractually, and the supply chain is disclosed to customers.
controls.evidence_requirement: Sub-processor risk assessments, vendor contracts with security clauses, sub-processor disclosure list.

controls.title: Threat & Vulnerability Management
controls.description: Requires vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and timely patching/remediation based on risk, along with threat intelligence monitoring.
controls.test_criteria: Verify vulnerability scans and penetration tests are performed on a defined schedule and findings are remediated based on risk rating.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vulnerability scan reports, penetration test reports, remediation tracking records.

controls.title: Universal Endpoint Management
controls.description: Requires management and security controls (encryption, remote wipe, patching) for endpoint devices used to access or administer the cloud environment.
controls.test_criteria: Verify endpoint devices used to access/administer the cloud environment are enrolled in management with encryption, patching, and remote wipe capability enforced.
controls.evidence_requirement: MDM/UEM enrollment records, endpoint encryption configuration, patch compliance reports.

name: Essential Eight Level 3
description: The Australian Cyber Security Centre's (ACSC/ASD) Essential Eight is a prioritized set of eight mitigation strategies to protect internet-connected networks from cyber threats. Maturity Level 3, the highest of four levels, represents mitigation against adversaries who invest more time and use advanced tradecraft, and is the target for organizations facing sophisticated, targeted threats.
notes: Essential Eight ML3 requirements are periodically updated by ASD/ACSC (most recently November 2023). Descriptions reflect the general ML3 intent and commonly cited requirements; exact current wording should be verified against the official ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model publication before use in a formal assessment.

controls.title: Application Control
controls.description: At Maturity Level 3, application control is enforced on workstations and internet-facing servers for executables, software libraries, scripts, and installers, restricted to an approved set, with allowed and blocked execution events centrally logged and rule-sets validated at least annually.
controls.test_criteria: Verify application control technology is deployed to workstations/servers, confirm the allow-list is restricted to approved executables/scripts/libraries, and verify execution events are logged and reviewed.
controls.evidence_requirement: Application control policy/configuration export, allow-list rule-set, execution event logs, annual rule-set review records.

controls.title: Patch Applications
controls.description: At Maturity Level 3, vulnerability scanning for internet-facing services runs at least weekly, critical patches are applied within 48 hours of release, and applications no longer supported by vendors are removed.
controls.test_criteria: Verify vulnerability scans run at least weekly, critical patches for internet-facing services are applied within 48 hours, and unsupported applications are identified and removed.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vulnerability scan reports, patch deployment records with timestamps, software inventory showing no unsupported applications.

controls.title: Configure Microsoft Office Macro Settings
controls.description: At Maturity Level 3, Office macros are only allowed to execute in documents from trusted locations with restricted write access or that are digitally signed, macro execution is logged, and macro security settings cannot be changed by users.
controls.test_criteria: Verify macro execution is restricted to trusted/signed documents, settings cannot be altered by standard users, and macro execution events are logged.
controls.evidence_requirement: Group Policy/macro configuration export, administrative rights restriction evidence, macro execution logs.

controls.title: User Application Hardening
controls.description: At Maturity Level 3, web browsers and other internet-facing applications are hardened to block or restrict high-risk content, hardening settings are centrally enforced and cannot be modified by users, and hardening events are logged.
controls.test_criteria: Verify browser/application hardening settings block high-risk content, settings are centrally enforced and cannot be changed by users, and hardening events are logged.
controls.evidence_requirement: Browser hardening policy/configuration export, centralized management console settings, hardening event logs.

controls.title: Restrict Administrative Privileges
controls.description: At Maturity Level 3, privileged access requests are validated when first requested and revalidated annually, privileged users operate from separate privileged and unprivileged accounts/environments restricted from internet and email access, and admin activity is centrally logged and monitored.
controls.test_criteria: Verify privileged access requests are validated and re-validated annually, privileged users operate from separate accounts/environments restricted from internet/email, and admin activity is centrally logged.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privileged access request/approval records, separate account provisioning evidence, admin activity logs.

controls.title: Patch Operating Systems
controls.description: At Maturity Level 3, critical vulnerabilities in internet-facing and non-internet-facing operating systems are patched within 48 hours of a patch or mitigation becoming available, automated asset discovery supports vulnerability scanning, and unsupported OS versions are not used.
controls.test_criteria: Verify critical OS vulnerabilities are patched within 48 hours across internet-facing and internal systems, asset discovery supports scanning coverage, and unsupported OS versions are absent.
controls.evidence_requirement: OS patch deployment records, vulnerability scan coverage reports, asset inventory/OS version report.

controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
controls.description: At Maturity Level 3, MFA is enforced for all users accessing important data repositories and when authenticating to third-party/customer-facing services, phishing-resistant methods are used for privileged users, and MFA events are centrally logged.
controls.test_criteria: Verify MFA is enforced for all users accessing important data repositories and customer-facing services, phishing-resistant MFA is used for privileged users, and authentication events are logged.
controls.evidence_requirement: MFA enforcement configuration, phishing-resistant MFA (e.g., FIDO2) deployment evidence for privileged accounts, authentication logs.

controls.title: Regular Backups
controls.description: At Maturity Level 3, backups of important data, software, and configuration settings are performed, retained in a coordinated and resilient manner including offline/immutable copies, access is restricted to break-glass-only accounts, and full restoration is tested at least annually.
controls.test_criteria: Verify backups of important data/software/configurations run on schedule, offline/immutable copies exist, access is restricted to break-glass accounts, and full restoration is tested at least annually.
controls.evidence_requirement: Backup job logs, offline/immutable backup configuration, break-glass account access records, restoration test reports.

name: Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act (GLBA)
description: A 1999 US federal law enforced primarily by the FTC (via the Safeguards Rule, 16 CFR Part 314) and federal/state financial regulators that requires financial institutions to protect the privacy and security of consumers' nonpublic personal information (NPI) and to disclose their information-sharing practices.
notes: Structure reflects the FTC Safeguards Rule (16 CFR 314.4, as amended 2021) and the GLBA Privacy Rule (16 CFR Part 313). Scope here covers both the information security program requirements and the core privacy/disclosure obligations.

controls.title: Qualified Individual
controls.description: The institution must designate a single Qualified Individual responsible for overseeing, implementing, and enforcing its information security program.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm a named individual (internal or outsourced with executive oversight) is formally designated with documented responsibility and reporting authority.
controls.evidence_requirement: Designation memo/org chart, job description, reporting lines to senior management or board.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: The institution must perform a periodic written risk assessment that identifies reasonably foreseeable internal and external risks to customer information and assesses the sufficiency of safeguards in place.
