controls.test_criteria: Review the written risk assessment for criteria used to evaluate risk, identified threats/vulnerabilities, and evidence of periodic re-performance.
controls.evidence_requirement: Documented risk assessment reports, risk register, assessment methodology.

controls.title: Access Controls
controls.description: Implement and periodically review technical and physical access controls to limit access to customer information to authorized users only, based on need.
controls.test_criteria: Sample user access lists against job roles/need-to-know; verify periodic access recertification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, access review logs, IAM system exports.

controls.title: Data Inventory and Classification
controls.description: Identify and manage the data, personnel, devices, systems, and facilities that enable the organization to achieve business purposes, including an inventory of where customer information is collected, stored, and transmitted.
controls.test_criteria: Review the data flow map/inventory for completeness against known systems that process customer information.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data inventory, system/data flow diagrams, asset register.

controls.title: Encryption of Customer Information
controls.description: Encrypt customer information both at rest and in transit, or implement an approved compensating control reviewed by the Qualified Individual if encryption is infeasible.
controls.test_criteria: Verify encryption configuration on storage systems and transmission channels; review documented exceptions/compensating controls.
controls.evidence_requirement: Encryption standards documentation, configuration screenshots, exception approvals.

controls.title: Secure Development Practices
controls.description: Adopt secure development practices for in-house developed applications and procedures for evaluating the security of externally developed applications used to transmit, access, or store customer information.
controls.test_criteria: Review SDLC documentation for security gates (code review, testing) and third-party application vetting procedures.
controls.evidence_requirement: SDLC policy, code review records, vendor application security questionnaires.

controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
controls.description: Implement MFA for any individual accessing customer information or internal networks, unless an alternative equivalent control has been approved in writing by the Qualified Individual.
controls.test_criteria: Verify MFA enforcement on remote access, admin accounts, and customer information systems; review documented exceptions.
controls.evidence_requirement: MFA policy, IAM configuration exports, exception approval records.

controls.title: Data Disposal Procedures
controls.description: Develop, implement, and maintain procedures for secure disposal of customer information no later than two years after last use, unless retention is required by law or business need.
controls.test_criteria: Review data retention/disposal schedule and sample disposal records or certificates of destruction.
controls.evidence_requirement: Retention/disposal policy, destruction logs, data minimization reviews.

controls.title: Change Management
controls.description: Implement procedures for change management covering additions, removals, and modifications to information systems, network, and applications that affect customer information security.
controls.test_criteria: Sample change tickets for approval workflow, security impact review, and rollback plans.
controls.evidence_requirement: Change management policy, change tickets/CAB minutes.

controls.title: Monitoring and Logging of Authorized User Activity
controls.description: Implement policies, procedures, and controls designed to monitor and log the activity of authorized users and detect unauthorized access or use of, or tampering with, customer information.
controls.test_criteria: Review logging configuration and SIEM alerting rules covering access to systems holding customer information.
controls.evidence_requirement: Logging/monitoring architecture, SIEM alert rules, sample audit logs.

controls.title: Monitoring and Testing of Safeguards
controls.description: Regularly test or otherwise monitor the effectiveness of safeguards; institutions without continuous monitoring must conduct annual penetration testing and biannual vulnerability assessments.
controls.test_criteria: Review continuous monitoring tooling output or, absent that, annual pen test reports and semi-annual vulnerability scan reports with remediation tracking.
controls.evidence_requirement: Penetration test reports, vulnerability scan reports, remediation tickets.

controls.title: Security Awareness Training
controls.description: Provide personnel with security awareness training that is updated to reflect risks identified by the risk assessment, and train security personnel on relevant threats.
controls.test_criteria: Review training curriculum, completion records, and evidence of updates tied to risk assessment findings.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training materials, LMS completion reports, specialized training records for security staff.

controls.title: Service Provider Oversight
controls.description: Select and retain service providers capable of maintaining appropriate safeguards, require those safeguards by contract, and periodically assess service providers based on risk.
controls.test_criteria: Review vendor contracts for security clauses and evidence of periodic vendor risk reassessment.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vendor contracts/DPAs, vendor risk assessment reports, SOC 2/audit reports collected from vendors.

controls.title: Program Evaluation and Adjustment
controls.description: Evaluate and adjust the information security program in light of the results of testing/monitoring, material changes to operations, or other circumstances known to have a material impact on the program.
controls.test_criteria: Review evidence of program updates following incidents, audits, or business changes.
controls.evidence_requirement: Program revision history, change log tied to risk assessment or incident findings.

controls.title: Incident Response Plan
controls.description: Establish a written incident response plan covering internal processes, roles, communication, remediation, and post-incident review for responding to a security event.
controls.test_criteria: Review the written IR plan for required elements and evidence of tabletop exercises or real invocations.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan document, tabletop exercise records, post-incident review reports.

controls.title: Board/Senior Officer Reporting
controls.description: The Qualified Individual must report in writing, at least annually, to the board of directors or equivalent governing body on the overall status of the information security program and material matters.
controls.test_criteria: Review board/committee minutes and the written annual report for required content (risk assessment results, testing results, incidents, recommendations).
controls.evidence_requirement: Annual board report, board/committee meeting minutes.

controls.title: Privacy Notice to Customers
controls.description: Provide clear, conspicuous initial and annual privacy notices describing information collection, use, and sharing practices with nonaffiliated third parties.
controls.test_criteria: Review sample privacy notices for required disclosures and verify delivery timing (at account opening and annually where required).
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy notice templates, distribution/mailing records, customer acknowledgments.

controls.title: Opt-Out Rights for Information Sharing
controls.description: Provide consumers a reasonable opportunity and means to opt out of having their nonpublic personal information shared with certain nonaffiliated third parties before such sharing occurs.
controls.test_criteria: Test the opt-out mechanism end-to-end and verify sharing is suppressed for opted-out consumers.
controls.evidence_requirement: Opt-out form/process documentation, suppression list exports, consumer request logs.

controls.title: Pretexting Protections
controls.description: Implement safeguards against pretexting (social engineering to fraudulently obtain customer financial information), including staff training on verifying identity before disclosing information.
controls.test_criteria: Review call-center/branch identity verification procedures and staff training on pretexting red flags.
controls.evidence_requirement: Identity verification procedures, staff training records, pretexting incident logs.

name: RBI DPSC
description: The Reserve Bank of India's 'Digital Payment Security Controls' Directions, 2021 — a master direction issued by the RBI setting minimum baseline security controls for Scheduled Commercial Banks, Small Finance Banks, Payments Banks, and credit-card-issuing NBFCs for their digital payment products (internet banking, mobile apps, cards).
notes: Based on the RBI (Digital Payment Security Controls) Directions, 2021 (18 Feb 2021), effective 18 Aug 2021, structured as Chapter II (General Controls), Chapter III (Internet Banking), Chapter IV (Mobile Payments Applications), and Chapter V (Card Payments). Exact clause numbering was reconstructed from secondary legal summaries, not the primary RBI PDF text, so sub-clause references may be approximate; core chapter structure and themes are well corroborated.

controls.title: Governance and Management of Security Risks
controls.description: Regulated entities (REs) must formulate a Board-approved policy for digital payment products and services covering security risk governance, roles, and responsibilities.
controls.test_criteria: Verify existence of a Board-approved digital payment security policy, reviewed periodically, with defined ownership.
controls.evidence_requirement: Board-approved policy document, board/IT strategy committee minutes.

controls.title: Other Generic Security Controls
controls.description: Implement baseline generic controls including network segmentation, database security, secure configuration, and anti-malware protection across digital payment infrastructure.
controls.test_criteria: Review network diagrams for segmentation, server hardening baselines, and anti-malware deployment coverage reports.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network architecture diagrams, hardening checklists, anti-malware console reports.

controls.title: Application Security Life Cycle (ASLC)
controls.description: Design digital payment applications using a secure multi-tier architecture separating presentation, application, and database layers, with security built into each phase of the development life cycle.
controls.test_criteria: Review architecture documentation confirming tier separation and SDLC artifacts showing security requirements, design review, and secure coding checkpoints.
controls.evidence_requirement: Architecture diagrams, SDLC security checklist, design review sign-offs.

controls.title: Security Testing of Payment Applications
controls.description: Conduct source code review, vulnerability assessment, and penetration testing of digital payment applications prior to launch and periodically thereafter.
controls.test_criteria: Review VA/PT and source code review reports for recency and remediation closure evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: VA/PT reports, source code review reports, remediation tracker.

controls.title: Authentication Framework
controls.description: Implement a risk-based, layered authentication framework (including multi-factor/strong customer authentication) proportionate to the risk associated with the digital payment transaction.
controls.test_criteria: Review authentication method mapping to transaction risk tiers and test enforcement of step-up authentication for high-risk transactions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Authentication policy, risk-tiering matrix, transaction testing evidence.

controls.title: Fraud Risk Management
controls.description: Establish risk-based transaction monitoring and fraud risk management systems to detect and prevent fraudulent digital payment transactions in near real time.
controls.test_criteria: Review fraud monitoring rule sets, alert volumes, and case disposition records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Fraud monitoring system configuration, alert/case logs, fraud loss reporting.

controls.title: Reconciliation Mechanism
controls.description: Maintain a robust reconciliation mechanism for digital payment transactions to promptly identify and resolve discrepancies.
controls.test_criteria: Review reconciliation reports and timelines for discrepancy identification and resolution.
controls.evidence_requirement: Reconciliation SOP, reconciliation reports, exception logs.

controls.title: Customer Protection, Awareness and Grievance Redressal
controls.description: Establish customer awareness programs and a grievance redressal mechanism for digital payment-related complaints, including liability protections for unauthorized transactions.
controls.test_criteria: Review grievance redressal turnaround times and sample resolved complaints against RBI liability guidelines.
controls.evidence_requirement: Grievance redressal policy, complaint register, turnaround-time reports.

controls.title: Incident Reporting
controls.description: Report cyber security incidents related to digital payment products to RBI/CERT-In within prescribed timelines.
controls.test_criteria: Review incident log for timely reporting against regulatory deadlines.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident reports filed with RBI/CERT-In, internal incident log.

controls.title: Internet Banking Security Controls
controls.description: Implement specific controls for internet banking channels including secure session management, transaction signing, and anti-phishing measures.
controls.test_criteria: Review session timeout configuration, transaction signing implementation, and anti-phishing/anti-malware controls on the internet banking platform.
controls.evidence_requirement: Internet banking security configuration, session management settings, anti-phishing monitoring reports.

controls.title: Mobile Payments Application Security Controls
controls.description: Secure mobile payment applications in line with standards such as OWASP MASVS/ASVS, including root/jailbreak detection, secure local data storage, and certificate pinning.
controls.test_criteria: Review mobile app security test reports against OWASP MASVS criteria and verify root detection and secure storage implementation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Mobile app security assessment report, OWASP MASVS checklist, app store compliance records.

controls.title: Card Payments Security
controls.description: Implement card payment security controls including tokenization, EMV/chip standards, and alignment with PCI-DSS/PA-DSS for card data handling.
controls.test_criteria: Review tokenization implementation and current PCI-DSS attestation of compliance for card data environments.
controls.evidence_requirement: PCI-DSS AOC, tokenization architecture documentation, card scheme compliance certificates.

controls.title: Access Control for Payment Systems
controls.description: Restrict access to digital payment system infrastructure and data on a least-privilege, need-to-know basis with periodic access review.
controls.test_criteria: Sample privileged access accounts against role justification and periodic recertification records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, access recertification logs, privileged access inventory.

controls.title: Patch and Vulnerability Management
controls.description: Maintain a documented patch management process for digital payment systems, prioritized by criticality, with defined remediation SLAs.
controls.test_criteria: Review patch compliance dashboards and SLA adherence for critical/high vulnerabilities.
controls.evidence_requirement: Patch management policy, patch compliance reports, vulnerability remediation tracker.

controls.title: Audit Trail Maintenance
controls.description: Maintain comprehensive, tamper-evident audit trails of digital payment transactions and system access sufficient for forensic investigation.
controls.test_criteria: Review log retention settings and sample logs for completeness and integrity controls.
controls.evidence_requirement: Logging architecture, log retention policy, sample audit trail extracts.

controls.title: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
controls.description: Establish BCP/DR arrangements for digital payment systems to ensure continuity of service, including periodic DR testing.
controls.test_criteria: Review BCP/DR plan and most recent DR test results, including RTO/RPO achievement.
controls.evidence_requirement: BCP/DR plan, DR test reports, RTO/RPO metrics.

controls.title: Third-Party/Vendor Risk Management
controls.description: Assess and monitor security risks posed by third-party vendors and payment service providers involved in digital payment product delivery.
controls.test_criteria: Review vendor due-diligence records and contractual security clauses for digital payment vendors.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vendor risk assessments, vendor contracts/SLAs, vendor audit reports.

name: RBI CSF
description: The Reserve Bank of India's Cyber Security Framework for Banks (circular DBS.CO/CSITE/BC.11/33.01.001/2015-16, dated 2 June 2016), which mandates a Board-approved cyber security policy and a set of baseline cyber security and resilience controls for banks and urban cooperative banks, distinct from broader IT risk governance directions.
notes: The 2016 circular's indicative Annex-I baseline control list is widely paraphrased across secondary sources with inconsistent counts (vendor sources cite anywhere from ~9 to ~24 control areas); this list consolidates the commonly-cited baseline domains plus the circular's named programmatic requirements (C-SOC, Cyber Crisis Management Plan, incident reporting). Verify exact baseline control wording against the RBI's original circular and subsequent amendments (e.g., UCB-specific CSF, 2024 IT Governance Master Direction) before use in a live audit.

controls.title: Board-Approved Cyber Security Policy
controls.description: Banks must put in place a distinct, Board-approved cyber security policy (separate from the broader IT/IS security policy) that is commensurate with the bank's risk profile.
controls.test_criteria: Verify the existence of a standalone Board-approved cyber security policy, reviewed at least annually.
controls.evidence_requirement: Board-approved cyber security policy, board meeting minutes approving/reviewing the policy.

controls.title: IT/Cyber Risk Governance and Organization
controls.description: Establish clear governance structures, including a CISO function and IT Strategy/Steering Committee, with defined roles and reporting lines for cyber risk oversight.
controls.test_criteria: Review the governance structure, CISO reporting line, and committee charters/meeting minutes.
controls.evidence_requirement: Org chart, committee charters, CISO appointment letter, committee minutes.

controls.title: IT Asset Inventory Management
controls.description: Maintain an up-to-date inventory of business IT assets (hardware, software, information, and people) with assigned ownership and criticality classification.
controls.test_criteria: Sample the asset inventory and reconcile against network discovery scans for completeness.
controls.evidence_requirement: IT asset register, asset classification scheme, discovery scan results.

controls.title: Preventing Execution of Unauthorized Software
controls.description: Implement application whitelisting and controls to prevent the execution of unauthorized or malicious software on critical systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review application control/whitelisting configuration and test for unauthorized execution attempts blocked.
controls.evidence_requirement: Application whitelisting policy, endpoint protection configuration, blocked-execution logs.

controls.title: Environmental Controls
controls.description: Implement physical and environmental controls (fire suppression, power redundancy, temperature/humidity control) to protect data centers and critical IT infrastructure.
controls.test_criteria: Inspect data center environmental control systems and maintenance/test logs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data center environmental control documentation, maintenance logs, physical access logs.

controls.title: Network Management and Security
controls.description: Implement network segmentation, perimeter defenses (firewalls, IDS/IPS), and secure network architecture to limit lateral movement and exposure of critical systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review network segmentation diagrams, firewall rule reviews, and IDS/IPS alert handling.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network architecture diagrams, firewall rule review records, IDS/IPS logs.

controls.title: Secure Configuration
controls.description: Harden systems, applications, and network devices according to documented secure configuration baselines before deployment.
controls.test_criteria: Sample server/device configurations against the baseline and review exception approvals.
controls.evidence_requirement: Secure configuration baselines/benchmarks, configuration audit reports.

controls.title: Patch and Change Management
controls.description: Maintain a formal patch management process and change management controls for all IT systems, prioritized by criticality of vulnerabilities.
controls.test_criteria: Review patch compliance reports and change advisory board records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Patch management policy, patch compliance dashboards, change tickets.

controls.title: User Access Control
controls.description: Implement least-privilege, role-based access control with periodic recertification for all users, including privileged and third-party accounts.
controls.test_criteria: Sample privileged and standard user access against role justification and recertification records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, periodic access review records, privileged access management logs.

controls.title: Customer Authentication Framework
controls.description: Implement strong, multi-factor authentication mechanisms for customer-facing digital banking channels proportionate to transaction risk.
controls.test_criteria: Review authentication configuration for digital channels and test step-up authentication for high-risk transactions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Authentication policy, channel configuration evidence, testing records.

controls.title: Secure Mail and Messaging Systems
controls.description: Secure email and messaging systems against phishing, spoofing, and malware with appropriate filtering and anti-spoofing controls (e.g., SPF/DKIM/DMARC).
controls.test_criteria: Review email security gateway configuration and anti-spoofing record (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) configuration.
controls.evidence_requirement: Email security gateway configuration, DNS records for SPF/DKIM/DMARC, phishing simulation results.

controls.title: Removable Media Controls
controls.description: Restrict and control the use of removable media (USB, external drives) on systems processing sensitive or critical data.
controls.test_criteria: Review removable media control configuration (device control/DLP) and exception approval records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Removable media policy, DLP/device control configuration, exception logs.

controls.title: Advanced Real-Time Threat Detection and Management
controls.description: Deploy advanced threat detection capabilities (e.g., EDR, network threat analytics, anomaly detection) to identify and respond to sophisticated threats in real time.
controls.test_criteria: Review EDR/threat analytics deployment coverage and sample detection-to-response time metrics.
controls.evidence_requirement: EDR/threat detection tool deployment records, detection and response time metrics.

controls.title: Vendor and Outsourcing Risk Management
controls.description: Assess and manage cyber security risks arising from outsourcing arrangements and third-party vendors with access to bank systems or data.
controls.test_criteria: Review vendor risk assessment records and contractual security obligations for outsourced IT services.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vendor due diligence reports, outsourcing contracts with security clauses, vendor audit reports.

controls.title: Audit Log Maintenance, Monitoring and Analysis
controls.description: Maintain comprehensive audit logs across critical systems, actively monitor and analyze them for anomalies, and retain logs for a prescribed minimum period.
controls.test_criteria: Review log retention configuration against minimum retention requirements and sample SIEM alert analysis records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Logging and retention policy, SIEM configuration, log analysis/alert review records.

controls.title: Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing
controls.description: Conduct periodic VAPT, including red-team exercises for critical infrastructure, and remediate identified findings within defined timelines.
controls.test_criteria: Review VAPT reports for recency, scope, and remediation closure evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: VAPT reports, red team exercise reports, remediation tracker.

controls.title: Cyber Crisis Management Plan (CCMP) and Incident Response
controls.description: Maintain a Board-approved Cyber Crisis Management Plan addressing detection, response, containment, and recovery from cyber incidents, tested periodically.
controls.test_criteria: Review the CCMP document and evidence of periodic testing (tabletop/simulation exercises).
controls.evidence_requirement: CCMP document, tabletop exercise reports, incident post-mortems.

controls.title: Cyber Security Operations Centre (C-SOC)
controls.description: Establish (directly or via managed service) a Cyber Security Operations Centre for continuous monitoring, detection, and response to cyber threats.
controls.test_criteria: Review C-SOC operating model, staffing/coverage hours, and sample detection-to-containment metrics.
controls.evidence_requirement: C-SOC charter/SLA, shift schedules, SOC incident handling records.

controls.title: Cyber Security Incident Reporting to RBI
controls.description: Report unusual cyber security incidents to RBI within the prescribed timeline (historically within 2-6 hours of detection for critical incidents) using the prescribed reporting format.
controls.test_criteria: Review incident log and sample incident reports for timeliness against the regulatory deadline.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident reports submitted to RBI, internal incident log with detection/reporting timestamps.

controls.title: User, Employee and Management Awareness and Training
controls.description: Conduct periodic cyber security awareness training for employees, management, and the Board, tailored to role and risk exposure.
controls.test_criteria: Review training curriculum and completion records across staff levels including Board-level briefings.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training materials, completion records, Board briefing minutes.

controls.title: Backup and Recovery
controls.description: Maintain regular, tested backups of critical data and systems with offline/immutable copies to support recovery from destructive cyber events such as ransomware.
controls.test_criteria: Review backup schedules, offline/immutable backup configuration, and most recent restoration test results.
controls.evidence_requirement: Backup policy, backup job logs, restoration test reports.

controls.title: Cyber Resilience Metrics and Reporting
controls.description: Define and track cyber security metrics (e.g., patch compliance, incident counts, phishing click rates) and report them to senior management/Board periodically.
controls.test_criteria: Review the metrics dashboard/report and evidence of periodic presentation to senior management or the Board.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cyber security metrics dashboard, management/Board reporting packs.

name: UAE PDPL
description: The United Arab Emirates Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data, the UAE's principal federal data protection law (supplemented by Cabinet/Executive Resolution No. 21 of 2024), enforced by the UAE Data Office and applicable to controllers/processors processing personal data of individuals inside the UAE, outside the mainland financial/health free zones which have their own regimes (e.g., DIFC, ADGM).
notes: Grounded in Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 and its 2024 Executive Regulation. The UAE Data Office continues to issue implementing guidance; some procedural details (e.g., exact DPIA thresholds, breach notification timelines) should be re-verified against the latest Executive Regulation text at assessment time.

controls.title: Lawful Basis for Processing
controls.description: Personal data must be processed on a valid legal basis, primarily data subject consent, or one of the statutory exceptions (e.g., legal obligation, vital interests, public interest, contract performance).
controls.test_criteria: Review processing activities and confirm each has a documented lawful basis, with consent records where consent is relied upon.
controls.evidence_requirement: Lawful basis register, consent capture mechanism records, legal basis assessments.

controls.title: Transparency and Right to Information
controls.description: Controllers must provide data subjects with clear information about the purpose, scope, and manner of data processing, including third-party disclosures.
controls.test_criteria: Review privacy notices for required disclosure elements and verify they are provided at or before data collection.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy notice/policy documents, data collection point audit.

controls.title: Right to Access
controls.description: Data subjects have the right to obtain confirmation of whether their data is being processed and to access that data and related processing details.
controls.test_criteria: Test the access request process end-to-end for timely, complete fulfillment.
controls.evidence_requirement: DSAR procedure, DSAR request log with response timestamps.

controls.title: Right to Data Portability
controls.description: Data subjects have the right to receive their personal data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format and transmit it to another controller where technically feasible.
controls.test_criteria: Test the portability request process and verify exported data format meets machine-readability requirements.
controls.evidence_requirement: Portability request procedure, sample data export, request log.

controls.title: Right to Correction/Rectification
controls.description: Data subjects have the right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data held by the controller.
controls.test_criteria: Sample correction requests and verify timely update across all systems/copies of the data.
controls.evidence_requirement: Correction request log, system update confirmations.

controls.title: Right to Erasure
controls.description: Data subjects have the right to request deletion of their personal data where processing is no longer necessary, consent is withdrawn, or processing is otherwise unlawful.
controls.test_criteria: Test the erasure request process, including propagation of deletion to backups/processors within committed timelines.
controls.evidence_requirement: Erasure request procedure, deletion confirmation logs, processor deletion attestations.

controls.title: Right to Restriction of Processing
controls.description: Data subjects may request that processing of their data be restricted (e.g., while accuracy is disputed) without full erasure.
controls.test_criteria: Verify technical capability exists to flag/restrict processing of specific data subject records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Restriction request log, system configuration demonstrating restriction capability.

controls.title: Right to Object to Processing
controls.description: Data subjects have the right to object to processing conducted for direct marketing or other purposes, requiring the controller to cease such processing upon valid objection.
controls.test_criteria: Test the objection/opt-out mechanism, particularly for direct marketing, and confirm suppression.
controls.evidence_requirement: Objection/opt-out log, marketing suppression list.

controls.title: Rights Related to Automated Decision-Making
controls.description: Data subjects have the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing, including profiling, that produces legal or similarly significant effects, subject to exceptions.
controls.test_criteria: Identify automated decision-making systems and verify human review/intervention options are available.
controls.evidence_requirement: Inventory of automated decision-making systems, human review procedure documentation.

controls.title: Controller Accountability Obligations
controls.description: Controllers must implement appropriate governance measures demonstrating compliance, including policies, training, and accountability for processing activities.
controls.test_criteria: Review internal data protection policies, training records, and accountability documentation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data protection policy, training completion records, compliance program documentation.

controls.title: Processor Obligations and Contracts
controls.description: Processors must process data only on documented controller instructions and under a binding contract specifying processing scope, security, and sub-processing terms.
controls.test_criteria: Review processor contracts for required data processing clauses and sub-processor approval mechanisms.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data processing agreements, sub-processor registers/approvals.

controls.title: Record of Processing Activities
controls.description: Controllers and processors must maintain records of processing activities, including purposes, categories of data, recipients, and retention periods.
controls.test_criteria: Review the record of processing activities for completeness and currency.
controls.evidence_requirement: ROPA document, update history/change log.

controls.title: Security of Processing
controls.description: Implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction, proportionate to risk.
controls.test_criteria: Review technical and organizational security controls (encryption, access control, monitoring) applied to personal data systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Security policy, control implementation evidence, risk assessment.

controls.title: Personal Data Breach Notification
controls.description: Controllers must notify the UAE Data Office of personal data breaches that pose a risk to data subjects, and notify affected data subjects where the breach poses a high risk.
controls.test_criteria: Review breach response procedure and sample breach notifications for timeliness and content completeness.
controls.evidence_requirement: Breach response plan, breach notification records sent to the Data Office and data subjects.

controls.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment
controls.description: Conduct a DPIA prior to processing operations likely to result in high risk to data subjects' rights, particularly for new technologies or large-scale sensitive data processing.
controls.test_criteria: Review DPIA records for high-risk processing activities and verify mitigation actions were implemented.
controls.evidence_requirement: DPIA reports, mitigation action tracker.

controls.title: Data Protection Officer Appointment
controls.description: Appoint a Data Protection Officer where processing involves large-scale sensitive data, large-scale regular monitoring, or as otherwise required, and make their contact details available.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm DPO appointment, independence, and published contact details where required.
controls.evidence_requirement: DPO appointment record, published DPO contact information.

controls.title: Cross-Border Data Transfer Restrictions
controls.description: Transfers of personal data outside the UAE are restricted unless the destination country has an adequate level of protection or appropriate safeguards (e.g., standard contractual clauses, consent) are in place.
controls.test_criteria: Review the transfer impact assessment and transfer mechanism (adequacy, contractual clauses, consent) for each cross-border data flow.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cross-border transfer register, transfer mechanism documentation (SCCs, consent records, adequacy determinations).

controls.title: Processing of Sensitive Personal Data
controls.description: Processing of sensitive personal data (health, biometric, genetic, religious, criminal record data, etc.) is prohibited unless explicit consent or a statutory exception applies, with heightened safeguards.
controls.test_criteria: Identify sensitive data processing activities and verify explicit consent capture or applicable exception, plus enhanced controls.
controls.evidence_requirement: Sensitive data inventory, explicit consent records, enhanced control documentation.

controls.title: Children's Data Processing
controls.description: Processing of children's personal data requires consent from a parent or legal guardian, with age-verification mechanisms appropriate to the service.
controls.test_criteria: Review age-verification and parental consent mechanisms for services directed at or accessible to children.
controls.evidence_requirement: Age-verification process documentation, parental consent records.

controls.title: UAE Data Office Oversight and Enforcement
controls.description: Controllers/processors must cooperate with the UAE Data Office, respond to regulatory inquiries, and comply with enforcement actions and administrative penalties.
controls.test_criteria: Review any history of regulator correspondence/inquiries and evidence of timely, complete responses.
controls.evidence_requirement: Regulator correspondence log, enforcement action responses (if any).

name: NIST 800-171 (Revision 2)
description: NIST Special Publication 800-171 Rev. 2, 'Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations,' issued by the US National Institute of Standards and Technology and required by DoD and other federal agencies (via DFARS 252.204-7012 and similar clauses) for contractors handling CUI.
notes: The 14 families and 110 requirements structure of Rev 2 is well established and stable; this entry lists the 14 top-level requirement families as the control-family granularity requested.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Limit information system access to authorized users, processes, and devices, and to the types of transactions and functions authorized users are permitted to exercise.
controls.test_criteria: Review account provisioning/deprovisioning records, least-privilege role assignments, and session control configuration (e.g., lock, timeout) across the CUI environment.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, account management logs, system security plan (SSP) access control section.

controls.title: Awareness and Training
controls.description: Ensure managers, systems administrators, and users are made aware of security risks and trained on applicable policies, standards, and procedures for protecting CUI.
controls.test_criteria: Review training curriculum coverage of CUI handling and completion records for all personnel with CUI access.
controls.evidence_requirement: Security training materials, training completion logs.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.description: Create, protect, and retain system audit logs to enable monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized system activity.
controls.test_criteria: Review audit log generation coverage, retention period, and evidence of periodic log review.
controls.evidence_requirement: Audit logging configuration, log retention policy, log review records.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.description: Establish and maintain baseline configurations and inventories of systems, and enforce security configuration settings throughout the system development life cycle.
controls.test_criteria: Compare system configurations against documented baselines and review change control records for configuration changes.
controls.evidence_requirement: Configuration baseline documents, system inventory, change management records.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.description: Identify system users, processes, and devices, and authenticate (or verify) their identities before allowing access to organizational systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review authentication mechanisms (including MFA for privileged/remote access) and identifier management procedures.
controls.evidence_requirement: Identity and authentication policy, MFA configuration evidence, identifier assignment records.

controls.title: Incident Response
controls.description: Establish an operational incident-handling capability including adequate preparation, detection, analysis, containment, recovery, and user response activities.
controls.test_criteria: Review the incident response plan, tested procedures, and records of past incident handling or exercises.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, incident log, after-action/tabletop exercise reports.

controls.title: Maintenance
controls.description: Perform periodic and timely maintenance on organizational systems and provide effective controls on the tools, techniques, mechanisms, and personnel used for maintenance.
controls.test_criteria: Review maintenance logs and controls over maintenance personnel/tools, including remote maintenance session controls.
controls.evidence_requirement: Maintenance policy, maintenance logs, remote maintenance session records.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.description: Protect system media containing CUI, both paper and digital, including controls for marking, access, storage, transport, and sanitization/destruction.
controls.test_criteria: Review media handling procedures and sample sanitization/destruction records for media containing CUI.
controls.evidence_requirement: Media protection policy, media inventory/tracking, sanitization/destruction certificates.

controls.title: Personnel Security
controls.description: Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to systems containing CUI and ensure CUI and systems are protected during and after personnel actions such as terminations and transfers.
controls.test_criteria: Review pre-access screening records and timely access revocation records tied to termination/transfer events.
controls.evidence_requirement: Personnel screening records, offboarding/access revocation logs.

controls.title: Physical Protection
controls.description: Limit physical access to systems, equipment, and operating environments to authorized individuals, and protect the physical facility and support infrastructure.
controls.test_criteria: Review physical access control logs and visitor management records for facilities housing CUI systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access control policy, badge/access logs, visitor logs.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: Periodically assess the risk to organizational operations, assets, and individuals resulting from the operation of systems and the associated processing, storage, or transmission of CUI.
controls.test_criteria: Review the risk assessment methodology and most recent risk assessment report, including vulnerability scan integration.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk assessment report, vulnerability scan reports, risk register.

controls.title: Security Assessment
controls.description: Periodically assess security controls to determine effectiveness, develop and implement plans of action (POA&Ms) to correct deficiencies, and monitor control effectiveness on an ongoing basis.
controls.test_criteria: Review the System Security Plan (SSP), POA&M, and evidence of periodic self-assessment (e.g., NIST SP 800-171A based).
controls.evidence_requirement: SSP, POA&M, self-assessment/SPRS score documentation.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.description: Monitor, control, and protect organizational communications at external and key internal boundaries, including network segmentation and encryption of CUI in transit.
controls.test_criteria: Review boundary protection device configuration (firewalls, VPNs) and verify encryption of CUI in transit.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network architecture diagram, boundary protection configuration, encryption-in-transit evidence.

controls.title: System and Information Integrity
controls.description: Identify, report, and correct system flaws in a timely manner, and protect against malicious code and monitor systems for security alerts and advisories.
controls.test_criteria: Review flaw remediation (patching) timelines, anti-malware deployment, and security alert monitoring processes.
controls.evidence_requirement: Patch management records, anti-malware deployment reports, security monitoring/alerting logs.

name: NIS 2 Directive
description: EU Directive (EU) 2022/2555 on measures for a high common level of cybersecurity across the Union, repealing the original NIS Directive. It is transposed into national law by EU Member States and imposes cybersecurity risk-management and incident-reporting obligations on 'essential' and 'important' entities across expanded critical sectors.
notes: Structure is grounded in Article 21(2)(a)-(j) minimum measures plus governance (Art 20), incident reporting (Art 23), scope (Art 2-3), and oversight (Art 32-34) provisions of the official directive text. Specific national transposition details (penalties, exact timelines for some Member States) vary by country and should be checked against local implementing legislation.

controls.title: Risk Analysis and Information System Security Policies
controls.description: Entities must adopt policies on risk analysis and information system security, based on an all-hazards approach proportionate to their risk exposure.
controls.test_criteria: Review the documented risk analysis methodology and information security policy for board/management approval and periodic review.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk analysis documentation, information security policy, approval records.

controls.title: Incident Handling
controls.description: Establish policies and procedures for detecting, analyzing, containing, and responding to cybersecurity incidents.
controls.test_criteria: Review the incident handling procedure and evidence of its application to past incidents or exercises.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident handling procedure, incident log, exercise records.

controls.title: Business Continuity and Crisis Management
controls.description: Maintain business continuity measures such as backup management, disaster recovery, and crisis management plans to ensure resilience during and after incidents.
controls.test_criteria: Review BCP/DR plans and crisis management procedures, and evidence of testing (e.g., tabletop/DR failover exercises).
controls.evidence_requirement: BCP/DR plan, backup policy, crisis management plan, test reports.

controls.title: Supply Chain Security
controls.description: Address cybersecurity risks in the supply chain and supplier relationships, including vulnerabilities specific to each direct supplier and service provider.
controls.test_criteria: Review supplier risk assessments and evidence of supplier-specific vulnerability consideration in procurement decisions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Supplier risk assessment records, procurement security requirements, supplier contracts.

controls.title: Security in System Acquisition, Development and Maintenance
controls.description: Implement security measures in the acquisition, development, and maintenance of network and information systems, including vulnerability handling and disclosure procedures.
controls.test_criteria: Review secure SDLC documentation and the vulnerability handling/disclosure policy.
controls.evidence_requirement: Secure development policy, vulnerability disclosure policy, procurement security clauses.

controls.title: Effectiveness Assessment of Risk-Management Measures
controls.description: Establish policies and procedures to assess the effectiveness of the cybersecurity risk-management measures implemented.
controls.test_criteria: Review evidence of periodic effectiveness assessments (audits, metrics, testing) and resulting improvement actions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Internal/external audit reports, effectiveness metrics, improvement action tracker.

controls.title: Basic Cyber Hygiene and Security Training
controls.description: Implement basic cyber hygiene practices and provide cybersecurity training to staff, tailored to roles and risk exposure.
controls.test_criteria: Review cyber hygiene baseline controls (patching, password policy) and training completion records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cyber hygiene policy, training materials and completion logs.

controls.title: Cryptography and Encryption Policies
controls.description: Adopt policies and procedures regarding the use of cryptography and, where appropriate, encryption to protect the confidentiality and integrity of data.
controls.test_criteria: Review the cryptography policy and sample encryption configuration for data at rest and in transit.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cryptography policy, encryption configuration evidence, key management procedures.

controls.title: Human Resources Security, Access Control and Asset Management
controls.description: Implement human resources security measures (screening, onboarding/offboarding), access control policies, and asset management practices.
controls.test_criteria: Review HR security procedures, access control policy enforcement, and asset inventory completeness.
controls.evidence_requirement: HR security procedures, access control policy, asset inventory/register.

controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication and Secured Communications
controls.description: Use multi-factor authentication or continuous authentication solutions, secured voice/video/text communications, and secured emergency communication systems where appropriate.
controls.test_criteria: Review MFA deployment coverage and secure communication channel configuration for sensitive and emergency communications.
controls.evidence_requirement: MFA deployment records, secure communications architecture documentation.

controls.title: Management Body Accountability and Training
controls.description: Management bodies of essential and important entities must approve cybersecurity risk-management measures, oversee their implementation, and undergo cybersecurity training; they can be held liable for infringements.
controls.test_criteria: Review board/management approval records for the cybersecurity program and training records for management body members.
controls.evidence_requirement: Board approval minutes, management cybersecurity training records.

controls.title: Incident Reporting Obligations
controls.description: Report significant incidents to the competent CSIRT/authority: an early warning within 24 hours, an incident notification within 72 hours, and a final report within one month.
controls.test_criteria: Review the incident reporting procedure against the 24h/72h/1-month timeline and sample actual incident reports for compliance.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident reporting procedure, submitted incident notifications with timestamps.

controls.title: Scope Determination (Essential vs. Important Entities)
controls.description: Entities must determine whether they qualify as 'essential' or 'important' entities based on sector, size thresholds, and criticality, which determines applicable supervisory regime.
controls.test_criteria: Review the entity's documented self-assessment of sector classification and size-threshold calculation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Scoping/applicability assessment, registration confirmation with national authority.

controls.title: Registration with National Competent Authority
controls.description: In-scope entities must register with the relevant national competent authority or CSIRT, providing required organizational and contact details.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm registration was completed and is kept current with the national authority.
controls.evidence_requirement: Registration confirmation, updated contact/organizational details on file with the authority.

controls.title: Information Sharing Arrangements
controls.description: Entities are encouraged/enabled to participate in voluntary cybersecurity information-sharing arrangements covering threats, vulnerabilities, and incidents.
controls.test_criteria: Review participation records in sector-specific or national information-sharing arrangements (e.g., ISACs).
controls.evidence_requirement: Information-sharing agreement/participation records.

controls.title: Supervisory and Enforcement Measures
controls.description: Essential and important entities are subject to supervisory measures (audits, inspections, binding instructions) and administrative fines for non-compliance.
controls.test_criteria: Review any history of supervisory audits/inspections and evidence of timely remediation of findings.
controls.evidence_requirement: Supervisory audit reports, remediation plans and completion evidence.

name: ISR V2
description: Treated here as the German automotive industry's 'Information Security Requirements' catalog underlying the TISAX assessment scheme — operationally, this is the VDA Information Security Assessment (VDA ISA), published by the German Association of the Automotive Industry (VDA) and administered via the ENX Association's TISAX program; several OEMs (e.g., Volkswagen Group) additionally issue their own supplier-facing 'Information Security Requirements (ISR)' documents that mirror the VDA ISA control domains.
notes: IMPORTANT CAVEAT: a standalone, universally-recognized standard literally named 'ISR V2' could not be verified via available research. The most plausible and verifiable real-world referent is the VDA ISA catalog (the control catalog TISAX assessments are scored against), which is undergoing a version transition (ISA 6.0.x being superseded by the renamed 'ISA2027' from 1 Jan 2027). Some OEMs (notably Volkswagen Group) separately publish supplier documents titled 'Information Security Requirements (ISR)' built on the same ISO 27001/VDA ISA control domains, and a 'V2' revision of such an OEM-specific document is plausible but not independently confirmed in this research. The control list below uses the verifiable, stable VDA ISA domain structure (Information Security module) as the best available proxy. Confirm the specific document version intended (VDA ISA edition vs. a specific OEM's ISR document) against the live VDA/ENX publication or the relevant OEM supplier portal before relying on this for certification scoping.

controls.title: Information Security Policies
controls.description: The organization must define, approve, and communicate an information security policy aligned with business requirements and relevant regulations.
controls.test_criteria: Review the approved information security policy and evidence of communication to staff and periodic review.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security policy document, approval and review records.

controls.title: Organization of Information Security
controls.description: Establish a management framework with defined roles, responsibilities, and reporting lines to initiate and control information security across the organization.
controls.test_criteria: Review the information security organizational structure, including a designated Information Security Officer/CISO role.
controls.evidence_requirement: Org chart, role/responsibility matrix (RACI), ISO/CISO appointment record.

controls.title: Human Resources Security
controls.description: Implement screening, confidentiality agreements, security training, and defined termination/role-change procedures for personnel.
controls.test_criteria: Sample personnel files for screening, NDA/confidentiality agreement signature, and offboarding checklist completion.
controls.evidence_requirement: Screening records, signed confidentiality agreements, onboarding/offboarding checklists.

controls.title: Asset Management
controls.description: Identify, classify, and assign ownership to information assets (including OEM prototype and project data) and handle them according to classification.
controls.test_criteria: Review the asset inventory and classification scheme and sample handling procedures for classified data.
controls.evidence_requirement: Asset register, data classification policy, handling procedure documentation.

controls.title: Physical and Environmental Security
controls.description: Protect facilities, secure areas, and equipment (including areas handling prototype vehicles/parts) from unauthorized physical access and environmental hazards.
controls.test_criteria: Inspect physical access control measures at secure areas and review visitor/access logs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical security policy, access control logs, CCTV/visitor logs.

controls.title: Operations Security
controls.description: Implement operational procedures for malware protection, backup, logging, and capacity management to ensure correct and secure operation of IT facilities.
controls.test_criteria: Review backup job logs, anti-malware deployment coverage, and operational logging configuration.
controls.evidence_requirement: Operations security procedures, backup logs, anti-malware console reports.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Restrict logical access to information and systems based on business need and least privilege, with formal user registration/de-registration and privileged access management.
controls.test_criteria: Sample user access accounts against role justification and review privileged access management controls.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, user access reviews, privileged access management logs.

controls.title: Cryptography
controls.description: Define and apply rules on the use of cryptographic controls for protection of confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity of information, including key management.
controls.test_criteria: Review cryptography policy and sample implementation (e.g., disk encryption, TLS configuration, key management procedures).
controls.evidence_requirement: Cryptography policy, encryption configuration evidence, key management procedures.

controls.title: Communications and Network Security
controls.description: Protect information in networks through segmentation, secure transfer agreements, and controls over information exchange with external parties, including OEM/supplier data connections.
controls.test_criteria: Review network segmentation design and data transfer agreements covering connections with OEM/supplier partners.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network architecture diagram, data transfer agreements, firewall/segmentation configuration.

controls.title: System Acquisition, Development and Maintenance
controls.description: Incorporate information security requirements into the acquisition, development, and maintenance of systems, including secure coding and change control.
controls.test_criteria: Review SDLC security requirements documentation and change management/testing records.
controls.evidence_requirement: SDLC security policy, secure coding guidelines, change management records.

controls.title: Supplier Relationships
controls.description: Define and apply information security requirements for mitigating risks associated with suppliers' and sub-suppliers' access to the organization's or OEM's data.
controls.test_criteria: Review supplier security requirement clauses in contracts and sub-supplier oversight/cascading requirement evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Supplier contracts with security clauses, sub-supplier assessment records.

controls.title: Information Security Incident Management
controls.description: Establish consistent, effective procedures for reporting, assessing, and responding to information security events and weaknesses, including notification to affected OEM customers where contractually required.
controls.test_criteria: Review the incident management procedure and sample past incident records, including customer notification timelines.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident management procedure, incident log, customer notification records.

controls.title: Business Continuity Management
controls.description: Plan and implement business continuity measures to ensure information security is maintained during disruptive events and resumed through documented recovery procedures.
controls.test_criteria: Review the BCP and evidence of periodic testing/exercises.
controls.evidence_requirement: Business continuity plan, test/exercise reports.

controls.title: Compliance
controls.description: Identify and comply with applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual information security requirements, and conduct independent reviews of the information security program.
controls.test_criteria: Review the compliance obligations register and evidence of independent internal/external security reviews.
controls.evidence_requirement: Legal/regulatory compliance register, internal audit/review reports.

controls.title: Mobile Devices and Teleworking
controls.description: Implement a policy and supporting controls to manage the risks introduced by mobile device use and teleworking arrangements.
controls.test_criteria: Review mobile device management (MDM) configuration and teleworking security requirements.
controls.evidence_requirement: Mobile device/teleworking policy, MDM configuration evidence.

controls.title: Cloud and Data Protection in Third-Party Environments
controls.description: Apply additional controls when storing or processing OEM/project data in cloud or other third-party hosted environments, including provider due diligence.
controls.test_criteria: Review cloud provider due-diligence assessments and data handling agreements for third-party hosted environments.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cloud provider risk assessments, data processing/hosting agreements.

controls.title: Prototype Protection
controls.description: Additional module (for entities handling vehicle prototypes/components) requiring physical, organizational, and procedural controls to prevent unauthorized disclosure of prototype parts, vehicles, or information prior to market launch.
controls.test_criteria: Review prototype handling procedures, secure storage/transport controls, and need-to-know access restrictions for prototype information.
controls.evidence_requirement: Prototype protection concept/policy, secure area access logs, camouflage/transport procedures.

controls.title: Connection and Data Transmission to Third Parties
controls.description: Control and secure the establishment of data connections and transmission channels to OEMs, customers, and other third parties, including authorization and monitoring of such connections.
controls.test_criteria: Review the inventory of third-party connections and authorization/approval records for establishing new connections.
controls.evidence_requirement: Third-party connection inventory, connection authorization records, monitoring logs.

name: New Jersey Data Privacy Law
description: The New Jersey Data Privacy Act (NJDPA, Senate Bill 332), signed into law 16 January 2024 and effective 15 January 2025, a comprehensive state consumer privacy law enforced by the New Jersey Division of Consumer Affairs under the Attorney General, granting consumers rights over their personal data and imposing obligations on controllers and processors.
notes: Core structure (consumer rights, opt-out, sensitive data consent, DPIAs, processor contracts, universal opt-out mechanism, enforcement/cure period) is consistent across multiple law-firm summaries. Some procedural specifics (exact applicability thresholds, precise rulemaking details from the Division of Consumer Affairs' 2025 proposed regulations, and whether/when the cure period sunsets) are still being finalized via rulemaking and should be re-verified against the current statute and regulations text.

controls.title: Applicability Thresholds
controls.description: The law applies to controllers conducting business in New Jersey or targeting NJ residents that control/process personal data of a threshold number of consumers (approximately 100,000, or 25,000 if deriving revenue from the sale of personal data), subject to statutory exemptions.
controls.test_criteria: Review the organization's documented applicability assessment against the statutory thresholds and exemption criteria.
controls.evidence_requirement: Applicability/scoping assessment, consumer count methodology documentation.

controls.title: Consumer Right to Access
controls.description: Consumers have the right to confirm whether a controller is processing their personal data and to access that data.
controls.test_criteria: Test the access request process for timely, verified fulfillment within statutory deadlines.
controls.evidence_requirement: Consumer rights request procedure, access request log with response timestamps.

controls.title: Consumer Right to Correction
controls.description: Consumers have the right to correct inaccuracies in their personal data held by a controller.
controls.test_criteria: Sample correction requests and verify data was corrected across relevant systems within statutory timelines.
controls.evidence_requirement: Correction request log, system update confirmations.

controls.title: Consumer Right to Deletion
controls.description: Consumers have the right to request deletion of personal data provided by or obtained about them.
controls.test_criteria: Test the deletion request process, including propagation to processors and backups within committed timelines.
controls.evidence_requirement: Deletion request procedure, deletion confirmation logs, processor deletion attestations.

controls.title: Consumer Right to Data Portability
controls.description: Consumers have the right to obtain a copy of their personal data in a portable, readily usable format to transmit to another controller.
controls.test_criteria: Test the portability request process and verify export format usability.
controls.evidence_requirement: Portability request procedure, sample export file.

controls.title: Right to Opt Out of Targeted Advertising, Sale, and Profiling
controls.description: Consumers have the right to opt out of the processing of their personal data for targeted advertising, the sale of personal data, and profiling in furtherance of decisions producing legal or similarly significant effects.
controls.test_criteria: Test the opt-out mechanism for each of the three categories (ads, sale, profiling) and verify effective suppression.
controls.evidence_requirement: Opt-out mechanism documentation, suppression list records, consumer request log.

controls.title: Universal Opt-Out Mechanism Recognition
controls.description: Controllers must recognize and honor universal opt-out preference signals (e.g., Global Privacy Control) sent by a consumer's browser or device as a valid opt-out of sale/targeted advertising.
controls.test_criteria: Test the website/app for recognition and honoring of a universal opt-out signal.
controls.evidence_requirement: Universal opt-out signal handling implementation evidence, testing records.

controls.title: Opt-In Consent for Sensitive Data Processing
controls.description: Controllers must obtain prior opt-in consent before processing a consumer's sensitive personal data (health, genetic, biometric, sexual orientation, citizenship/immigration status, religious belief, and certain financial account data).
controls.test_criteria: Review the consent capture mechanism for sensitive data processing and sample consent records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Consent capture UI/mechanism, consent records log.

controls.title: Data Protection Assessments
controls.description: Controllers must conduct and document data protection assessments for processing activities that present a heightened risk of harm to consumers, such as targeted advertising, sale, profiling, and sensitive data processing.
controls.test_criteria: Review DPIA records for in-scope high-risk processing activities and confirm they weigh benefits against risks.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data protection assessment reports, processing activity inventory tied to assessments.

controls.title: Purpose and Data Minimization Limitation
controls.description: Controllers must limit the collection of personal data to what is adequate, relevant, and reasonably necessary for the disclosed purposes of processing.
controls.test_criteria: Review data collection forms/flows against stated processing purposes for evidence of minimization.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data minimization policy, data collection inventory mapped to purposes.

controls.title: Processor Contractual Obligations
controls.description: Controllers must enter into binding contracts with processors specifying processing instructions, data types, duration, and the rights/obligations of both parties.
controls.test_criteria: Review processor contracts for required data processing terms.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data processing agreements with processors.

controls.title: Duty of Confidentiality for Processor Personnel
controls.description: Processors must ensure each person processing personal data is subject to a duty of confidentiality with respect to that data.
controls.test_criteria: Review confidentiality agreement templates and sample signed agreements for processor personnel.
controls.evidence_requirement: Confidentiality agreement templates, signed agreement records.

controls.title: Non-Discrimination for Exercising Rights
controls.description: Controllers must not discriminate against a consumer for exercising their privacy rights, including denial of goods/services or charging different prices.
controls.test_criteria: Review pricing/service policies for evidence of differential treatment tied to rights exercise.
controls.evidence_requirement: Pricing/service policy documentation, consumer complaint records related to rights exercise.

controls.title: Children's Data Protections
controls.description: Controllers must obtain opt-in consent before processing personal data of consumers known to be between 13 and 17 years old for targeted advertising, sale, or profiling purposes.
controls.test_criteria: Review age-screening and consent capture mechanisms applicable to users identified as minors.
controls.evidence_requirement: Age-screening process documentation, minor consent records.

controls.title: Consumer Appeal Process for Rights Denials
controls.description: Controllers must establish an internal appeals process allowing consumers to challenge a controller's refusal to act on a rights request, with a right to contact the Attorney General if the appeal is denied.
controls.test_criteria: Review the appeals process documentation and sample appeal case handling records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Appeals process procedure, appeal request log.

controls.title: Reasonable Security Safeguards
controls.description: Controllers must establish, implement, and maintain reasonable administrative, technical, and physical data security practices appropriate to the volume and nature of personal data.
controls.test_criteria: Review the information security program documentation and controls proportionate to data volume/sensitivity.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security policy, risk assessment, security control implementation evidence.

controls.title: Statutory Exemptions
controls.description: The law exempts certain entities and data types already regulated elsewhere, including GLBA-covered financial institutions, HIPAA-covered protected health information, and FCRA-governed consumer report data.
controls.test_criteria: Review the exemption analysis documenting which data/entities are claimed as exempt and the legal basis.
controls.evidence_requirement: Exemption analysis memo, mapping of exempt data categories to applicable federal law.

controls.title: Attorney General Enforcement and Cure Period
controls.description: The NJ Attorney General's Division of Consumer Affairs has exclusive enforcement authority; the law provided for a time-limited cure period for violations before enforcement action, subject to sunset per statutory schedule.
controls.test_criteria: Review any regulator correspondence and evidence of timely remediation within an applicable cure period, if invoked.
controls.evidence_requirement: Regulator correspondence log, remediation records for any notified violations.

name: RBI PA/PG
description: The Reserve Bank of India's regulatory framework for Payment Aggregators and Payment Gateways, originating from the 'Guidelines on Regulation of Payment Aggregators and Payment Gateways' (17 March 2020) and subsequently consolidated and updated via further RBI circulars and master directions, governing non-bank entities that facilitate online merchant payment acceptance in India.
notes: Grounded primarily in the original March 2020 PA/PG guidelines (authorization, net worth, escrow, merchant onboarding, security/PCI-DSS, baseline technology, grievance redressal) plus well-documented subsequent updates (PA-Cross Border framework, 2023-2025 amendments consolidating toward a Master Direction). Exact current net-worth figures, timelines, and the final consolidated Master Direction's clause numbering should be re-verified against the latest RBI notification, as this area has seen multiple amendments since 2020.

controls.title: Authorization Requirement for Non-Bank PAs
controls.description: Non-bank entities providing payment aggregation services must obtain authorization from RBI under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act before commencing or continuing operations.
controls.test_criteria: Verify current, valid RBI authorization certificate and confirm scope of authorized activities matches actual operations.
controls.evidence_requirement: RBI authorization/in-principle approval letter, certificate of authorization.

controls.title: Net Worth Requirements
controls.description: Payment Aggregators must meet and maintain minimum net worth requirements prescribed by RBI, demonstrated through audited financial statements.
controls.test_criteria: Review audited financial statements and net worth certificates against the prescribed minimum threshold.
controls.evidence_requirement: Audited financial statements, net worth certificate from statutory auditor.

controls.title: Governance - Board-Approved Policies
controls.description: Establish Board-approved policies covering merchant onboarding, risk management, data security, customer grievance redressal, and other operational aspects.
controls.test_criteria: Review Board-approved policy documents for completeness and evidence of periodic review.
controls.evidence_requirement: Board meeting minutes approving policies, policy documents.

controls.title: Merchant Onboarding and KYC Due Diligence
controls.description: Conduct background and KYC/due-diligence checks on merchants prior to onboarding to ensure they do not deal in fraudulent, prohibited, or illegal goods/services.
controls.test_criteria: Sample merchant onboarding files for completed KYC/due-diligence documentation and screening against prohibited categories.
controls.evidence_requirement: Merchant onboarding policy, KYC documentation samples, prohibited merchant category list and screening records.

controls.title: Escrow Account Management
controls.description: Maintain a nodal/escrow account with a scheduled commercial bank for merchant settlement funds, ensuring funds are not used for purposes other than intended settlement.
controls.test_criteria: Review escrow account agreements and sample reconciliations confirming funds are held and disbursed per escrow rules.
controls.evidence_requirement: Escrow account agreement, bank statements, reconciliation reports.

controls.title: Settlement Timelines
controls.description: Settle funds to merchants within the prescribed timelines from the date of transaction/confirmation, as specified in RBI guidelines.
controls.test_criteria: Sample merchant settlement transactions and verify settlement occurred within prescribed timelines.
controls.evidence_requirement: Settlement cycle reports, merchant settlement logs.

controls.title: Security and PCI-DSS Compliance
controls.description: Implement data security standards for storage and processing of card and payment data, including compliance with PCI-DSS and PA-DSS where applicable, and prohibit storage of sensitive card data unless certified.
controls.test_criteria: Review the current PCI-DSS Attestation of Compliance and verify no prohibited storage of full card data (PAN, CVV) by non-certified entities.
controls.evidence_requirement: PCI-DSS AOC/ROC, data flow diagrams showing card data handling, data storage audit.

controls.title: Baseline Technology Recommendations
controls.description: Implement baseline technology and information security recommendations prescribed by RBI, including secure network architecture, encryption, and periodic security testing.
controls.test_criteria: Review implementation of RBI's baseline technology recommendations and periodic security testing reports.
controls.evidence_requirement: Technology security policy, VA/PT reports, network architecture documentation.

controls.title: Fraud and Risk Management Framework
controls.description: Establish a fraud and risk monitoring framework to detect and prevent fraudulent transactions across the payment aggregation flow.
controls.test_criteria: Review fraud monitoring rules, alert handling, and fraud loss reporting records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Fraud monitoring system configuration, fraud case logs, fraud loss reports.

controls.title: Customer Grievance Redressal Mechanism
controls.description: Establish a formal grievance redressal mechanism, including a nodal grievance officer, for merchants and customers, with defined resolution timelines.
controls.test_criteria: Review grievance redressal policy and sample complaint resolution records against defined SLAs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Grievance redressal policy, complaint register, nodal officer appointment record.

controls.title: Data Storage and Localization
controls.description: Store the entire payment transaction data end-to-end within systems located in India, in compliance with RBI's data localization requirements.
controls.test_criteria: Review data flow and hosting architecture to confirm all payment transaction data is stored exclusively within India.
