controls.evidence_requirement: Data localization compliance certificate/report, hosting infrastructure documentation.

controls.title: Reporting to RBI
controls.description: Submit periodic returns and incident reports to RBI as prescribed, including System Audit Reports and net-worth certificates.
controls.test_criteria: Review the regulatory reporting calendar and evidence of timely submission of required returns/reports.
controls.evidence_requirement: Submitted regulatory returns, System Audit Report, acknowledgment receipts from RBI.

controls.title: Disclosure of Merchant Discount Rate and Charges
controls.description: Disclose merchant discount rate (MDR) and other applicable charges transparently to merchants in onboarding agreements.
controls.test_criteria: Review merchant agreements for clear MDR/charge disclosure.
controls.evidence_requirement: Merchant agreement templates with fee disclosure clauses.

controls.title: Annual System/Cybersecurity Audit
controls.description: Conduct an annual system audit, including a cybersecurity audit by CERT-In empaneled auditors, and submit the audit report to RBI.
controls.test_criteria: Review the most recent annual system/cybersecurity audit report and confirm the auditor is CERT-In empaneled.
controls.evidence_requirement: System Audit Report, auditor empanelment confirmation, audit submission acknowledgment.

controls.title: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
controls.description: Maintain business continuity and disaster recovery arrangements to ensure uninterrupted payment aggregation services.
controls.test_criteria: Review BCP/DR plan and most recent DR test results.
controls.evidence_requirement: BCP/DR plan, DR test reports.

controls.title: Cross-Border Payment Aggregator (PA-CB) Requirements
controls.description: Entities facilitating cross-border payment transactions (import/export) must comply with the specific PA-Cross Border framework, including additional authorization and FEMA compliance.
controls.test_criteria: Review PA-CB specific authorization and FEMA compliance documentation for entities handling cross-border transactions.
controls.evidence_requirement: PA-CB authorization, FEMA compliance records, cross-border transaction reporting.

controls.title: Payment Application Security (PA-DSS/Secure SDLC)
controls.description: Ensure payment applications used in the aggregation flow are developed and maintained per secure software development standards, aligned with PA-DSS principles where applicable.
controls.test_criteria: Review secure SDLC documentation and application security testing records for payment applications.
controls.evidence_requirement: Secure SDLC policy, application security test reports.

controls.title: Oversight of Sub-Merchant and Payment Gateway Relationships
controls.description: Maintain oversight and contractual controls over sub-merchant aggregation arrangements and third-party payment gateway integrations to ensure end-to-end compliance.
controls.test_criteria: Review sub-merchant/payment gateway contracts for compliance flow-down clauses and periodic oversight activity records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Sub-merchant/gateway agreements, oversight/audit records of downstream relationships.

name: NIST 800-53 Rev5 (Privacy Baseline)
description: The privacy control baseline defined in NIST SP 800-53B, drawn from the NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control catalog. Issued by the U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology, it is mandatory for U.S. federal information systems (via FISMA/OMB policy) and widely adopted voluntarily by private organizations to manage privacy risk arising from PII processing.
notes: Rev 5 integrated privacy into the main catalog via the new PT (PII Processing and Transparency) family and expanded PM (Program Management) family, rather than keeping a separate privacy appendix as in Rev 4. SP 800-53B's privacy baseline is cross-cutting: it selects specific controls/enhancements from all 20 Rev 5 families (triggered by 'this system processes PII', not by impact level), so it is NOT identical to the Low/Moderate/High security baselines. For GRC tracking at family-level granularity, this entry lists all 20 Rev 5 control families with descriptions scoped to their privacy-baseline relevance; PT and PM carry the heaviest privacy weighting. Exact control-by-control privacy baseline allocation should be verified against the official SP 800-53B tables (Table D-1/D-2) for sub-control-level work.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Limits information system access to authorized users, processes, and devices, and restricts the types of transactions and functions permitted; privacy-relevant enhancements govern access to PII and consent-based restrictions.
controls.test_criteria: Review access control policy, account provisioning/de-provisioning records, and role-based access mappings for systems processing PII; test least-privilege enforcement.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, account management logs, periodic access review records, role/permission matrices.

controls.title: Awareness and Training
controls.description: Ensures personnel who handle PII or manage privacy-impacting systems receive role-based privacy and security awareness training.
controls.test_criteria: Verify training completion records for personnel with PII access and confirm training content covers privacy obligations.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training curricula, completion logs, role-based training assignments.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.description: Creates, protects, and retains system audit logs sufficient to enable monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized PII processing activity.
controls.test_criteria: Sample audit logs for PII-processing systems to confirm required events are captured, protected from tampering, and retained per policy.
controls.evidence_requirement: Audit log configuration standards, sample log extracts, log retention schedule.

controls.title: Assessment, Authorization, and Monitoring
controls.description: Requires periodic security and privacy control assessments, system authorization decisions, and continuous monitoring of control effectiveness for PII-processing systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review authorization packages, assessment reports, and continuous monitoring dashboards for currency and completeness.
controls.evidence_requirement: System security/privacy plans, assessment reports, authorization-to-operate decisions, POA&Ms.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.description: Establishes and maintains baseline configurations and inventories for systems that process PII, and controls changes that could affect privacy posture.
controls.test_criteria: Compare live system configurations to approved baselines; review change-control records for privacy impact assessment steps.
controls.evidence_requirement: Configuration baselines, change request/approval tickets, configuration audit reports.

controls.title: Contingency Planning
controls.description: Establishes plans for emergency response, backup operations, and post-disaster recovery to maintain availability and integrity of systems containing PII.
controls.test_criteria: Review contingency plan test results and confirm PII-handling systems are included in recovery procedures and backup protections.
controls.evidence_requirement: Contingency/DR plan, test/exercise after-action reports, backup logs.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.description: Verifies the identities of users, processes, and devices before granting access to systems processing PII.
controls.test_criteria: Test authentication mechanisms (e.g., MFA) on PII-processing systems and review identity-proofing procedures.
controls.evidence_requirement: Authentication policy, MFA configuration evidence, identity-proofing records.

controls.title: Incident Response
controls.description: Establishes capability to detect, report, and respond to privacy incidents and breaches involving PII, including notification obligations.
controls.test_criteria: Review incident response plan and sample incident tickets to confirm privacy breach handling and notification timelines were followed.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, incident tickets/logs, breach notification records, tabletop exercise reports.

controls.title: Maintenance
controls.description: Controls system maintenance activities, including remote maintenance, to prevent unauthorized exposure of PII during repair or servicing.
controls.test_criteria: Review maintenance logs and remote maintenance session records for PII-processing systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Maintenance logs, remote access approval records, sanitization records for serviced media.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.description: Protects digital and physical media containing PII, including access restriction, marking, storage, transport, and sanitization/destruction at end of life.
controls.test_criteria: Inspect media handling and destruction records; verify sanitization standards used for media that held PII.
controls.evidence_requirement: Media protection policy, destruction/sanitization certificates, media inventory.

controls.title: Physical and Environmental Protection
controls.description: Limits physical access to facilities and equipment housing systems that process PII and protects against environmental hazards.
controls.test_criteria: Review physical access logs, badge/visitor records, and environmental control monitoring for data centers hosting PII systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access logs, badge system reports, environmental monitoring records.

controls.title: Planning
controls.description: Requires development, documentation, and periodic update of system security and privacy plans describing how PII is protected.
controls.test_criteria: Review the privacy plan/system security plan for currency, completeness, and alignment with actual system behavior.
controls.evidence_requirement: System privacy plan, privacy architecture documentation, plan review/approval records.

controls.title: Program Management
controls.description: Establishes organization-wide privacy governance, including a designated Senior Agency/Chief Privacy Official, privacy program plan, privacy risk management strategy, and workforce privacy roles — the organizational backbone of the privacy baseline.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm existence of a documented privacy program plan, designated privacy official, and evidence of privacy risk management activities at the organizational level.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy program plan, privacy official appointment records, enterprise privacy risk register.

controls.title: Personnel Security
controls.description: Screens, manages, and terminates personnel access to PII-processing systems in a manner that reduces insider risk to privacy.
controls.test_criteria: Review personnel screening records and termination/transfer access-revocation timeliness for staff with PII access.
controls.evidence_requirement: Background check records, access termination logs, personnel security policy.

controls.title: PII Processing and Transparency
controls.description: The dedicated privacy family: governs the authority to collect PII, purpose specification, consent, data minimization, use limitation, and public transparency (privacy notices) regarding PII processing.
controls.test_criteria: Review privacy notices, consent records, and data inventories to confirm PII is collected and used only for stated, authorized purposes.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy notices, consent logs, PII inventory/data mapping, purpose-specification documentation.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: Requires periodic risk assessments, including Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), to identify and evaluate privacy risks arising from PII processing.
controls.test_criteria: Review PIA documentation and risk assessment reports for systems processing PII; verify risk treatment decisions are tracked.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy Impact Assessments, risk assessment reports, risk register entries.

controls.title: System and Services Acquisition
controls.description: Embeds privacy requirements into system development life cycle processes and third-party acquisition/contracting activities.
controls.test_criteria: Review SDLC privacy-by-design checkpoints and vendor contract language requiring PII protection obligations.
controls.evidence_requirement: SDLC privacy checklists, acquisition/contract privacy clauses, vendor due-diligence records.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.description: Protects the confidentiality of PII in transit and at rest through boundary protection, encryption, and secure communications architecture.
controls.test_criteria: Test encryption-in-transit and at-rest configurations for systems storing or transmitting PII; review network segmentation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Encryption configuration evidence, network architecture diagrams, TLS/cipher audit results.

controls.title: System and Information Integrity
controls.description: Identifies, reports, and corrects system flaws and monitors for malicious activity that could compromise the integrity or confidentiality of PII.
controls.test_criteria: Review flaw remediation (patching) records and malware/intrusion detection alerts for PII-processing systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Patch management logs, vulnerability scan reports, malware/IDS alert records.

controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Management
controls.description: Manages privacy and security risk introduced by suppliers, vendors, and the broader supply chain for systems and components that process PII.
controls.test_criteria: Review supply chain risk assessments and vendor privacy due-diligence records for critical suppliers of PII-processing components or services.
controls.evidence_requirement: Supply chain risk management plan, vendor risk assessments, third-party privacy agreements.

name: CIS
description: The CIS Critical Security Controls (version 8), published by the Center for Internet Security, is a prioritized, prescriptive set of cybersecurity best practices and defensive actions used globally by organizations of all sizes to prevent and mitigate the most common cyberattacks. It is a voluntary industry framework, not a regulatory mandate.
notes: CIS Controls v8 (2021) is the current major version and consolidated the prior v7.1's 20 controls down to 18 by merging several (e.g., prior Controls 9 and 16 concepts were redistributed). v8.1 (2024) made minor safeguard refinements but kept the same 18 top-level controls, so this list remains accurate as 'the current major version's 18 controls'.

controls.title: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
controls.description: Actively manage all enterprise assets (end-user devices, network devices, IoT, servers) connected to the infrastructure so only authorized assets are given access.
controls.test_criteria: Compare discovered network assets (via active/passive scanning) against the documented asset inventory and investigate discrepancies.
controls.evidence_requirement: Asset inventory database/CMDB, network discovery scan results, DHCP logs.

controls.title: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
controls.description: Actively manage all software on the network so only authorized software is installed and executable, and unauthorized/unmanaged software is found and removed.
controls.test_criteria: Reconcile software inventory/allowlisting tool output against approved software list; sample endpoints for unauthorized software.
controls.evidence_requirement: Software inventory reports, application allowlisting configuration, unauthorized software remediation tickets.

controls.title: Data Protection
controls.description: Develop processes and technical controls to identify, classify, securely handle, retain, and dispose of data.
controls.test_criteria: Review data classification scheme application and sample data stores for appropriate encryption/access controls matching classification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data classification policy, data inventory, encryption configuration evidence, data retention/disposal records.

controls.title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
controls.description: Establish and maintain secure configurations for enterprise assets and software using hardening benchmarks.
controls.test_criteria: Compare asset configurations against CIS Benchmarks or equivalent hardening standard using automated configuration scanning.
controls.evidence_requirement: Hardening standards/benchmarks used, configuration scan reports, remediation tickets.

controls.title: Account Management
controls.description: Use processes and tools to assign and manage authorization for user, administrator, and service accounts.
controls.test_criteria: Review account creation/termination workflows and sample active accounts for valid business justification and timely de-provisioning.
controls.evidence_requirement: Account lifecycle management records, periodic account review/attestation logs.

controls.title: Access Control Management
controls.description: Use processes and tools to create, assign, manage, and revoke access credentials and privileges following least privilege.
controls.test_criteria: Test MFA enforcement and review privileged access assignments against least-privilege and need-to-know criteria.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, MFA configuration evidence, privileged access review records.

controls.title: Continuous Vulnerability Management
controls.description: Develop a plan to continuously assess and track vulnerabilities on all enterprise assets to remediate and minimize the window of opportunity for attackers.
controls.test_criteria: Review vulnerability scan frequency, scan results, and remediation timelines against defined SLAs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vulnerability scan reports, remediation tracking records, patch SLAs.

controls.title: Audit Log Management
controls.description: Collect, alert, review, and retain audit logs that could help detect, understand, or recover from an attack.
controls.test_criteria: Verify logging is enabled on critical systems, logs are centrally aggregated, and retention meets policy requirements.
controls.evidence_requirement: Logging configuration standards, SIEM/log aggregation evidence, log retention records.

controls.title: Email and Web Browser Protections
controls.description: Improve protections and detections of threats from email and web vectors, which attackers commonly exploit for social engineering.
controls.test_criteria: Review email filtering/DMARC configuration and browser security policy enforcement across endpoints.
controls.evidence_requirement: Email security gateway configuration, DMARC/SPF/DKIM records, browser policy settings.

controls.title: Malware Defenses
controls.description: Prevent or control the installation, spread, and execution of malicious applications, code, or scripts on enterprise assets.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm anti-malware/EDR deployment coverage across endpoints and review detection/response alert handling.
controls.evidence_requirement: EDR/anti-malware deployment reports, alert and incident handling logs.

controls.title: Data Recovery
controls.description: Establish and maintain data recovery practices sufficient to restore in-scope enterprise assets to a pre-incident, trusted state.
controls.test_criteria: Review backup schedules and perform/verify periodic restoration test results.
controls.evidence_requirement: Backup policy, backup job logs, restoration test reports.

controls.title: Network Infrastructure Management
controls.description: Establish, implement, and actively manage network devices to prevent attackers from exploiting vulnerable network services and access points.
controls.test_criteria: Review network device configuration management, firmware update cadence, and network diagram accuracy.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network architecture diagrams, device configuration backups, firmware patch records.

controls.title: Network Monitoring and Defense
controls.description: Operate processes and tooling to establish and maintain comprehensive network monitoring and defense against security threats.
controls.test_criteria: Review network IDS/IPS and NDR coverage, alert triage process, and sample detected-event response records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network monitoring tool configuration, alert/incident records, SOC runbooks.

controls.title: Security Awareness and Skills Training
controls.description: Establish and maintain a security awareness program to influence behavior among the workforce to be security conscious.
controls.test_criteria: Review training completion rates, phishing simulation results, and role-specific training content.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training program materials, completion records, phishing simulation reports.

controls.title: Service Provider Management
controls.description: Develop a process to evaluate service providers that hold sensitive data or are responsible for critical IT platforms/processes to ensure they are protecting those platforms adequately.
controls.test_criteria: Review vendor risk assessment records and contract clauses requiring security controls for critical service providers.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vendor inventory, vendor risk assessments, contractual security requirements.

controls.title: Application Software Security
controls.description: Manage the security life cycle of in-house developed, hosted, or acquired software to prevent, detect, and remediate security weaknesses.
controls.test_criteria: Review SDLC security gates (SAST/DAST/dependency scanning) and sample remediation of identified application vulnerabilities.
controls.evidence_requirement: Secure SDLC policy, SAST/DAST scan results, code review records.

controls.title: Incident Response Management
controls.description: Establish a program to develop and maintain an incident response capability to prepare, detect, and quickly respond to attacks.
controls.test_criteria: Review incident response plan, roles/responsibilities, and results of tabletop exercises or real incidents.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, exercise after-action reports, incident tickets.

controls.title: Penetration Testing
controls.description: Test the effectiveness and resilience of enterprise assets by identifying and exploiting weaknesses in controls and simulating the objectives of an attacker.
controls.test_criteria: Review penetration test scope, findings, and remediation tracking for the most recent assessment cycle.
controls.evidence_requirement: Penetration test reports, remediation plans, retest results.

name: SEBI CSCRF
description: India's Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework, issued 20 August 2024 to consolidate and supersede prior sector-specific SEBI cyber circulars. It applies to SEBI-regulated entities (stock exchanges, depositories, brokers, mutual funds, KRAs, RTAs, etc.) and is enforced by SEBI, structured around cybersecurity functions and cyber resilience goals.
notes: SEBI's CSCRF circular (Aug 2024) is organized around six cybersecurity functions (Governance, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, Recover) and five cyber resilience goals (Anticipate, Withstand, Contain, Recover, Evolve), closely modeled on NIST CSF 2.0 (the Governance category even reuses NIST CSF 2.0 subcategory codes GV.OC/GV.RR/GV.PO/GV.OV/GV.RM). Rollout is phased across entity categories (MIIs, qualified REs, mid/small REs) with effective dates from Jan-Apr 2025. The control list below reflects the publicly confirmed structure and named components (Cyber Capability Index, SOC monitoring, VAPT, data localization, API/mobile app security guidelines) but exact annexure numbering was not independently verified against the full circular text; verify against the official SEBI circular (Aug 20, 2024) and subsequent FAQs/amendments for sub-control-level work.

controls.title: Cybersecurity Governance Structure
controls.description: Requires a Board-approved cybersecurity policy and a dedicated cybersecurity committee with defined roles, including a CISO, overseeing the entity's cyber posture.
controls.test_criteria: Review board-approved policy, committee charter, and meeting minutes evidencing oversight cadence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Board-approved cybersecurity policy, committee charter, CISO appointment letter, meeting minutes.

controls.title: Cyber Capability Index (CCI) Self-Assessment
controls.description: Mandates periodic self-assessment and reporting of cyber maturity using SEBI's prescribed Cyber Capability Index methodology.
controls.test_criteria: Review CCI self-assessment submission and underlying scoring worksheet for completeness and timeliness.
controls.evidence_requirement: CCI self-assessment report, scoring evidence, submission acknowledgment to SEBI/designated agency.

controls.title: Risk Management & Regulatory Compliance
controls.description: Requires identification, assessment, and treatment of cyber risk, and compliance with applicable SEBI and CERT-In regulatory requirements.
controls.test_criteria: Review enterprise cyber risk register and evidence of regulatory compliance tracking.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk register, risk treatment plans, regulatory compliance tracker.

controls.title: Asset & Data Classification
controls.description: Requires identification and classification of IT assets, applications, and data (including critical/sensitive data) supporting the entity's operations.
controls.test_criteria: Reconcile asset/data inventory against classification policy and sample assets for correct classification labeling.
controls.evidence_requirement: Asset inventory, data classification register.

controls.title: Third-Party & Supply Chain Risk Assessment
controls.description: Requires assessment of cyber risk posed by vendors, intermediaries, and cloud/outsourced service providers.
controls.test_criteria: Review vendor risk assessment records and due-diligence documentation for critical third parties.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vendor risk assessments, third-party contracts with security clauses.

controls.title: Access Control & Identity Management
controls.description: Requires role-based access control, multi-factor authentication, and periodic access reviews for systems and applications.
controls.test_criteria: Test MFA enforcement on critical systems and review periodic access certification records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, MFA configuration evidence, access review logs.

controls.title: Network & System Security
controls.description: Requires network segmentation, firewalls, secure configuration, and patch management across IT infrastructure.
controls.test_criteria: Review network architecture and patch compliance reports for critical systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network diagrams, firewall rule reviews, patch management records.

controls.title: Data Security & Localization
controls.description: Requires encryption of sensitive data and compliance with data localization requirements applicable to regulated entities' data.
controls.test_criteria: Verify encryption configuration for data at rest/in transit and confirm data residency controls for in-scope data.
controls.evidence_requirement: Encryption configuration evidence, data residency/localization attestation.

controls.title: API and Mobile Application Security
controls.description: Requires security controls (authentication, rate limiting, secure coding) for APIs and mobile applications exposed to customers.
controls.test_criteria: Review API/mobile app security testing (VAPT) results and remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
controls.evidence_requirement: API/mobile app VAPT reports, secure coding guideline evidence.

controls.title: Cloud Security Controls
controls.description: Requires security controls and due diligence for workloads hosted with cloud service providers used by the regulated entity.
controls.test_criteria: Review cloud configuration baselines and cloud provider due-diligence/compliance certifications.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cloud security configuration evidence, CSP compliance certificates (e.g., ISO 27001/SOC 2).

controls.title: Security Operations Centre (SOC) Monitoring
controls.description: Requires continuous security monitoring through a SOC (own, group, market, or third-party managed), with periodic efficacy measurement.
controls.test_criteria: Review SOC monitoring coverage, alert handling metrics, and half-yearly SOC efficacy assessment reports.
controls.evidence_requirement: SOC service agreement/charter, SOC efficacy assessment reports, alert/incident logs.

controls.title: Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT)
controls.description: Requires periodic VAPT of critical systems and applications to identify exploitable security weaknesses.
controls.test_criteria: Review VAPT scope, reports, and closure evidence for identified findings within required timelines.
controls.evidence_requirement: VAPT reports, remediation tracker, closure/retest evidence.

controls.title: Incident Reporting & Response
controls.description: Requires timely detection, internal escalation, and reporting of cyber incidents to SEBI/CERT-In/designated agencies within prescribed timelines.
controls.test_criteria: Sample incident records and verify reporting timelines to regulators were met.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, incident log, regulatory incident notification records.

controls.title: Crisis Management & Communication
controls.description: Requires a documented crisis management plan covering internal and external (customer, regulator, media) communication during a cyber crisis.
controls.test_criteria: Review crisis management plan and evidence of its invocation/testing.
controls.evidence_requirement: Crisis management plan, communication templates, tabletop exercise records.

controls.title: Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery
controls.description: Requires BCP/DR arrangements, including recovery time objectives, to maintain critical operations during and after a cyber event.
controls.test_criteria: Review BCP/DR plan, RTO/RPO definitions, and results of periodic DR drills.
controls.evidence_requirement: BCP/DR plan, DR drill reports, RTO/RPO documentation.

controls.title: Periodic Cyber Audit
controls.description: Requires an independent periodic cybersecurity audit by a CERT-In empanelled auditor, with findings reported to SEBI.
controls.test_criteria: Review the independent cyber audit report, management responses, and closure of audit findings.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cyber audit report, auditor empanelment confirmation, finding closure evidence.

name: Australia ISM (Dec 2024)
description: The Australian Government Information Security Manual, published by the Australian Signals Directorate's Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC/ASD), is the Australian Government's primary cybersecurity framework providing principles and controls to protect government and critical systems; it is also widely adopted by Australian private-sector organizations.
notes: The ISM is released on a recurring update cycle (quarterly-ish) with the same stable set of 'Guidelines' chapters updated/amended at each release rather than restructured. Official ACSC records confirm a December 2024 release (ISM December 2024 Changes PDF) updating at least 8 chapters (Cyber Security Terminology, Communications Infrastructure, Media, System Hardening, Physical Security, Communications Systems, Evaluated Products, Procurement & Outsourcing). The full 22-chapter guideline list below reflects the ISM's standard structure compiled from a third-party aggregator rather than directly reading the official Dec 2024 PDF line-by-line; confirm exact chapter boundaries against the authoritative cyber.gov.au ISM page/PDF for that release if sub-control precision is required. Confidence is medium accordingly.

controls.title: Guidelines for Cyber Security Roles
controls.description: Defines roles and responsibilities for cybersecurity governance, including CISO, system owners, and ITSM roles within an organization.
controls.test_criteria: Review role definitions and appointment records for key cybersecurity positions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Role charters, appointment letters, organizational chart.

controls.title: Guidelines for Cyber Security Incidents
controls.description: Covers incident management policy, detection, reporting (including to ASD), and response procedures for cybersecurity incidents.
controls.test_criteria: Review incident response plan and sample incident records for compliance with reporting obligations.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, incident register, ASD reporting records.

controls.title: Guidelines for Procurement and Outsourcing
controls.description: Addresses security considerations when procuring ICT products/services and outsourcing arrangements, including supply chain risk.
controls.test_criteria: Review procurement security requirements and vendor due-diligence records for outsourced ICT services.
controls.evidence_requirement: Procurement security checklist, vendor assessment records, contracts.

controls.title: Guidelines for Cyber Security Documentation
controls.description: Requires maintenance of system security plans, policies, and standard operating procedures documenting the security posture of systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review currency and completeness of system security documentation against actual system state.
controls.evidence_requirement: System security plan, security documentation register, review/approval records.

controls.title: Guidelines for Physical Security
controls.description: Specifies controls for securing facilities, server rooms, and equipment against unauthorized physical access, theft, and damage.
controls.test_criteria: Review physical access logs and inspect physical security controls at facilities hosting sensitive systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access logs, facility security assessment, visitor logs.

controls.title: Guidelines for Personnel Security
controls.description: Covers security vetting/clearance requirements, employment screening, and ongoing suitability assessment for personnel accessing sensitive systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review personnel vetting records and clearance levels against system access requirements.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vetting/clearance records, employment screening documentation.

controls.title: Guidelines for Communications Infrastructure
controls.description: Addresses security of cabling, data centers, and telecommunications infrastructure supporting ICT systems.
controls.test_criteria: Inspect infrastructure security measures and review compliance with facility cabling/zoning standards.
controls.evidence_requirement: Infrastructure security standards, facility inspection reports.

controls.title: Guidelines for Communications Systems
controls.description: Covers security of telephony, video conferencing, fax, and other communications systems, including protection against eavesdropping.
controls.test_criteria: Review configuration of communications systems against ISM hardening guidance.
controls.evidence_requirement: Communications system configuration records, security assessment.

controls.title: Guidelines for Enterprise Mobility
controls.description: Addresses secure use of mobile devices, BYOD, and mobile device management for accessing organizational systems and data.
controls.test_criteria: Review MDM policy enforcement and sample mobile device compliance status.
controls.evidence_requirement: Mobile device management policy, MDM compliance reports.

controls.title: Guidelines for Evaluated Products
controls.description: Requires preference for, and correct configuration of, security-evaluated products (e.g., Common Criteria certified) for sensitive functions.
controls.test_criteria: Review product selection records to confirm use of evaluated products where required and correct configuration per certification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Evaluated Products List references, product configuration evidence.

controls.title: Guidelines for ICT Equipment
controls.description: Covers secure handling, sanitization, and disposal of ICT equipment, including removable media, throughout its lifecycle.
controls.test_criteria: Review equipment disposal/sanitization records and asset lifecycle tracking.
controls.evidence_requirement: Equipment disposal certificates, sanitization records, asset register.

controls.title: Guidelines for Media
controls.description: Addresses the labeling, handling, storage, transfer, and destruction of media (physical and electronic) based on sensitivity classification.
controls.test_criteria: Review media handling procedures and sample media destruction records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Media handling policy, destruction certificates, media register.

controls.title: Guidelines for System Hardening
controls.description: Specifies baseline hardening configurations for operating systems, applications, and devices, including application control and patching.
controls.test_criteria: Compare system configurations against ISM hardening baselines using automated scanning tools.
controls.evidence_requirement: Hardening standards, configuration scan reports, patch compliance records.

controls.title: Guidelines for System Management
controls.description: Covers system administration practices, privileged access management, and change management for ICT systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review privileged access logs and change management records for system administration activities.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privileged access management records, change management logs.

controls.title: Guidelines for System Monitoring
controls.description: Requires implementation of event logging, log analysis, and monitoring capabilities to detect malicious or anomalous activity.
controls.test_criteria: Review logging configuration and sample monitoring/alerting outputs for coverage completeness.
controls.evidence_requirement: Logging policy, SIEM configuration, monitoring alert records.

controls.title: Guidelines for Software Development
controls.description: Addresses secure software development practices, including security testing and code review throughout the SDLC.
controls.test_criteria: Review SDLC security gates and sample code review/security testing records for developed applications.
controls.evidence_requirement: Secure SDLC policy, code review records, security testing reports.

controls.title: Guidelines for Database Systems
controls.description: Covers secure configuration, access control, and management of database management systems storing sensitive data.
controls.test_criteria: Review database hardening configuration and access control lists for databases holding sensitive data.
controls.evidence_requirement: Database configuration standards, access control records.

controls.title: Guidelines for Email
controls.description: Addresses email system security, including anti-spoofing (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), content filtering, and protection against phishing.
controls.test_criteria: Review email security gateway configuration and SPF/DKIM/DMARC record configuration.
controls.evidence_requirement: Email security configuration, DMARC/SPF/DKIM records, phishing simulation results.

controls.title: Guidelines for Networking
controls.description: Covers network design, segmentation, firewalls, and secure configuration of network infrastructure devices.
controls.test_criteria: Review network architecture diagrams and firewall rule-base reviews for segmentation and least-access enforcement.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network architecture diagrams, firewall rule review records.

controls.title: Guidelines for Cryptography
controls.description: Specifies approved cryptographic algorithms, key management practices, and encryption requirements for data at rest and in transit.
controls.test_criteria: Review cryptographic configuration against the ISM's approved cryptographic algorithms list and key management practices.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cryptographic standards, key management procedures, encryption configuration evidence.

controls.title: Guidelines for Gateways
controls.description: Addresses security of network gateways and boundary defenses that connect internal networks to external/untrusted networks.
controls.test_criteria: Review gateway architecture and security control configuration (firewalls, proxies, content filtering) at network boundaries.
controls.evidence_requirement: Gateway architecture documentation, boundary device configuration records.

controls.title: Guidelines for Data Transfers
controls.description: Covers security controls for transferring data between systems or security domains, including content/format checking and cross-domain solutions.
controls.test_criteria: Review data transfer procedures and cross-domain solution configuration for transfers between differing sensitivity domains.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data transfer policy, cross-domain solution configuration, transfer approval records.

name: UK GDPR
description: The United Kingdom's post-Brexit data protection regime, comprising the retained/assimilated UK GDPR (as amended) read together with the Data Protection Act 2018, enforced by the UK Information Commissioner's Office (ICO). It governs the lawful processing of personal data by controllers and processors operating in or targeting the UK.
notes: The UK GDPR largely mirrors the EU GDPR's substantive requirements (same Article numbering was retained on EU Exit) but is a distinct legal instrument enforced solely by the ICO, with UK-specific adequacy/transfer mechanisms (IDTA/UK Addendum to EU SCCs) and DPA 2018-specific provisions (Part 2 general processing exemptions, Part 3 law enforcement processing, Part 4 intelligence services processing). The Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 has also made targeted amendments; this entry reflects the core structure as of the framework's mainstream application.

controls.title: Principles of Processing
controls.description: Personal data must be processed lawfully, fairly, and transparently; collected for specified purposes; minimized; accurate; stored no longer than necessary; and secured — with the controller accountable for demonstrating compliance.
controls.test_criteria: Review data processing records against each principle; verify an accountability framework (policies, records) demonstrates compliance.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data protection policy, records of processing activities (ROPA), data minimization/retention evidence.

controls.title: Lawful Basis for Processing
controls.description: Requires identification of a valid lawful basis (consent, contract, legal obligation, vital interests, public task, or legitimate interests) before processing personal data.
controls.test_criteria: Sample processing activities and confirm each has a documented, justified lawful basis.
controls.evidence_requirement: Lawful basis assessments, legitimate interests assessments (LIAs), consent records.

controls.title: Special Category Data
controls.description: Imposes stricter conditions on processing special category data (health, biometric, genetic, racial/ethnic origin, religious belief, sexual orientation, etc.).
controls.test_criteria: Review processing activities involving special category data for an applicable Article 9 condition plus DPA 2018 Schedule 1 condition where required.
controls.evidence_requirement: Special category data processing register, Schedule 1 condition documentation.

controls.title: Conditions for Consent
controls.description: Where consent is relied upon, it must be freely given, specific, informed, unambiguous, and as easy to withdraw as to give.
controls.test_criteria: Review consent capture mechanisms and withdrawal process for compliance with validity requirements.
controls.evidence_requirement: Consent capture records, consent management tool configuration, withdrawal logs.

controls.title: Right of Access & Transparency
controls.description: Data subjects have the right to transparent information about processing and to obtain confirmation and a copy of their personal data (Subject Access Request).
controls.test_criteria: Sample SAR responses for completeness and adherence to the one-month statutory response timeline.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy notices, SAR log, SAR response records.

controls.title: Right to Rectification and Erasure
controls.description: Data subjects can request correction of inaccurate data and, in specified circumstances, erasure of their personal data ('right to be forgotten').
controls.test_criteria: Sample rectification/erasure requests and verify timely, complete fulfilment including downstream processor notification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Rights request log, rectification/erasure fulfillment records.

controls.title: Right to Restriction of Processing
controls.description: Data subjects can request restriction of processing under specified conditions (e.g., while accuracy is contested).
controls.test_criteria: Review handling of restriction requests and confirm processing was appropriately limited during restriction periods.
controls.evidence_requirement: Restriction request log, system flags/controls evidencing restricted processing.

controls.title: Right to Data Portability
controls.description: Data subjects can receive their personal data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format and transmit it to another controller.
controls.test_criteria: Sample portability requests and verify data was provided in a compliant portable format within statutory timelines.
controls.evidence_requirement: Portability request log, exported data format samples.

controls.title: Right to Object & Automated Decision-Making
controls.description: Data subjects can object to processing (including direct marketing) and have rights regarding solely automated decision-making/profiling with legal or similarly significant effects.
controls.test_criteria: Review objection-handling process and safeguards (human review, right to contest) for automated decision-making systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Objection request log, automated decision-making impact assessment/safeguards documentation.

controls.title: Accountability & Data Protection by Design/Default
controls.description: Controllers must implement appropriate technical and organizational measures and embed privacy by design and by default into processing activities and systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review evidence that privacy-by-design assessments are performed during new system/project design.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy-by-design checklists, project intake privacy review records.

controls.title: Processor Obligations & Contracts
controls.description: Processors must only act on documented controller instructions and controllers must have Article 28-compliant data processing agreements in place with processors.
controls.test_criteria: Sample vendor/processor contracts for required Article 28 clauses.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data processing agreements, vendor contract register.

controls.title: Records of Processing Activities
controls.description: Controllers and processors (with limited exemptions) must maintain records describing categories of processing, purposes, data subjects, recipients, and retention.
controls.test_criteria: Review the ROPA for completeness and currency against actual processing activities.
controls.evidence_requirement: Records of processing activities (ROPA).

controls.title: Security of Processing
controls.description: Requires appropriate technical and organizational measures (e.g., encryption, pseudonymization, resilience, testing) proportionate to risk.
controls.test_criteria: Review security control implementation and periodic testing/evaluation of effectiveness.
controls.evidence_requirement: Security policy, encryption/pseudonymization evidence, penetration test results.

controls.title: Personal Data Breach Notification
controls.description: Controllers must notify the ICO of a qualifying personal data breach within 72 hours and notify affected data subjects without undue delay where high risk exists.
controls.test_criteria: Sample breach records and verify ICO/data subject notifications met statutory timelines where required.
controls.evidence_requirement: Breach register, ICO notification records, data subject notification records.

controls.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment
controls.description: Requires a DPIA before processing likely to result in high risk to individuals' rights and freedoms.
controls.test_criteria: Review DPIA screening and completed DPIAs for high-risk processing activities.
controls.evidence_requirement: DPIA screening records, completed DPIAs, mitigation action trackers.

controls.title: Data Protection Officer
controls.description: Requires designation of a DPO where mandated (e.g., large-scale monitoring or special category processing), with independence and direct reporting to top management.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm DPO appointment, independence, and resourcing where required.
controls.evidence_requirement: DPO appointment record, DPO reporting line documentation.

controls.title: International Data Transfers
controls.description: Restricts transfers of personal data outside the UK unless an adequacy decision, appropriate safeguard (IDTA, UK Addendum to EU SCCs, BCRs), or derogation applies.
controls.test_criteria: Review transfer mechanism documentation for each cross-border data flow outside the UK.
controls.evidence_requirement: Transfer risk assessments, IDTA/SCC addendum agreements, transfer mapping register.

controls.title: DPA 2018 Part 2 — General Processing Exemptions
controls.description: Supplements the UK GDPR with UK-specific derogations and exemptions (e.g., for journalism, research, legal professional privilege, immigration).
controls.test_criteria: Where an exemption is relied upon, verify documented justification against the specific Schedule 2 exemption criteria.
controls.evidence_requirement: Exemption justification records.

controls.title: DPA 2018 Part 3 — Law Enforcement Processing
controls.description: Sets a separate regime for processing by competent authorities for law enforcement purposes, with its own principles and rights.
controls.test_criteria: For in-scope law enforcement processing, review compliance with Part 3-specific principles and logging requirements.
controls.evidence_requirement: Law enforcement processing policy, Part 3 compliance records.

controls.title: Enforcement & Penalties
controls.description: Grants the ICO powers to investigate, issue enforcement/information notices, and impose administrative fines up to the higher of £17.5m or 4% of global annual turnover.
controls.test_criteria: Review history of ICO engagement, audits, or enforcement action and remediation status.
controls.evidence_requirement: ICO correspondence, enforcement notice responses, remediation plans.

name: HITRUST i1
description: The HITRUST Implemented, 1-Year (i1) Assessment is a moderate-assurance certification from HITRUST Alliance, built on a curated subset of the HITRUST CSF organized into 19 control domains. It targets organizations (especially in healthcare and their vendors/cloud providers) wanting stronger assurance than a readiness-level assessment but a lighter, faster process than the comprehensive r2 (2-year) certification.
notes: The HITRUST CSF's 19-domain structure is well-established and consistently reported across sources; i1 draws a fixed, curated set of controls from across these domains assessed at the 'Implemented' maturity level only (unlike r2, which also scores Policy/Process/Measured/Managed maturity and allows tailoring). Sources disagree on the exact i1 control count (commonly cited figures range from ~182 to 187 controls depending on CSF version), so exact control counts should be verified against the current HITRUST CSF version and Assessment Handbook rather than treated as fixed. This entry lists the 19 domains at control-family granularity, which is stable across CSF/i1 versions.

controls.title: Information Protection Program
controls.description: Establishes an overarching information security management program, including policies, risk management, and governance oversight.
controls.test_criteria: Review the information security program charter and governance committee records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security policy, program charter, governance meeting minutes.

controls.title: Endpoint Protection
controls.description: Requires anti-malware, host-based controls, and configuration management on endpoint devices.
controls.test_criteria: Review endpoint protection deployment coverage and alert handling records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Endpoint protection deployment reports, configuration standards.

controls.title: Portable Media Security
controls.description: Controls the use, encryption, and tracking of portable media (USB drives, removable storage) containing sensitive data.
controls.test_criteria: Review portable media policy enforcement and encryption status of approved devices.
controls.evidence_requirement: Portable media policy, device encryption evidence, approved device inventory.

controls.title: Mobile Device Security
controls.description: Requires security controls (MDM, encryption, remote wipe) for mobile devices accessing organizational data.
controls.test_criteria: Review MDM enrollment and policy compliance for mobile devices with access to sensitive data.
controls.evidence_requirement: MDM policy, enrollment/compliance reports.

controls.title: Wireless Protection
controls.description: Secures wireless network access points and communications against unauthorized access and interception.
controls.test_criteria: Review wireless network configuration (encryption standard, authentication) and conduct/review wireless security assessments.
controls.evidence_requirement: Wireless network configuration standards, wireless security assessment reports.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.description: Establishes secure baseline configurations and change control for systems and infrastructure.
controls.test_criteria: Compare live configurations against approved baselines and review change management records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Configuration baselines, change management tickets.

controls.title: Vulnerability Management
controls.description: Requires regular vulnerability scanning, patch management, and remediation tracking for systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review vulnerability scan reports and remediation timelines against defined SLAs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vulnerability scan reports, patch management logs.

controls.title: Network Protection
controls.description: Implements network segmentation, firewalls, and boundary protection controls to safeguard sensitive data flows.
controls.test_criteria: Review network architecture diagrams and firewall rule reviews for appropriate segmentation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network architecture diagrams, firewall rule review records.

controls.title: Transmission Protection
controls.description: Requires encryption and secure protocols for data transmitted across networks, including PHI/PII.
controls.test_criteria: Review encryption-in-transit configuration (e.g., TLS versions) for systems transmitting sensitive data.
controls.evidence_requirement: Encryption configuration evidence, TLS/cipher audit results.

controls.title: Password Management
controls.description: Establishes password complexity, rotation, and management requirements for system and application authentication.
controls.test_criteria: Review password policy enforcement settings across in-scope systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Password policy, system authentication configuration evidence.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Governs provisioning, authentication, authorization, and periodic review of user access to systems and sensitive data.
controls.test_criteria: Review access provisioning/de-provisioning records and periodic access recertification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, access review/certification records.

controls.title: Audit Logging & Monitoring
controls.description: Requires logging of security-relevant events and monitoring for anomalous or unauthorized activity.
controls.test_criteria: Review logging configuration and sample log monitoring/alert handling for in-scope systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Logging standards, SIEM configuration, monitoring alert records.

controls.title: Education, Training and Awareness
controls.description: Requires security and privacy awareness training for workforce members, including role-based training for privileged roles.
controls.test_criteria: Review training completion records and training content for coverage of security/privacy topics.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training program materials, completion logs.

controls.title: Third-Party Assurance
controls.description: Requires due diligence, contractual safeguards, and ongoing monitoring of third parties/business associates handling sensitive data.
controls.test_criteria: Review vendor risk assessments and business associate agreements for in-scope third parties.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vendor risk assessments, BAAs/contracts, third-party audit reports.

controls.title: Incident Management
controls.description: Establishes processes to detect, report, respond to, and learn from security incidents and breaches.
controls.test_criteria: Review incident response plan and sample incident tickets for timely handling and closure.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, incident log, post-incident review records.

controls.title: Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery
controls.description: Requires continuity and disaster recovery planning, including backup and restoration capabilities for critical systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review BCP/DR plans and results of recovery testing exercises.
controls.evidence_requirement: BCP/DR plan, DR test reports, backup logs.

controls.title: Risk Management
controls.description: Requires a formal process to identify, assess, treat, and monitor information security and privacy risks.
controls.test_criteria: Review the risk register and evidence of periodic risk assessment cycles.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk management policy, risk register, risk assessment reports.

controls.title: Physical & Environmental Security
controls.description: Controls physical access to facilities and protects systems against environmental hazards.
controls.test_criteria: Review physical access logs and environmental control monitoring for facilities hosting sensitive systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access logs, environmental monitoring records.

controls.title: Data Protection & Privacy
controls.description: Addresses privacy-specific requirements including data classification, minimization, consent, and handling of sensitive health/personal information.
controls.test_criteria: Review data classification and privacy handling procedures for PHI/PII, including minimization and retention practices.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data classification policy, privacy procedures, data retention/disposal records.

name: ISO 27018:2025
description: ISO/IEC 27018:2025 is the current (third) edition of the international code of practice for protecting personally identifiable information (PII) in public cloud services acting as PII processors, published by ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 27 in August 2025, replacing the 2019 edition. It extends ISO/IEC 27002 controls with PII-specific guidance for cloud service providers.
notes: Verified via ISO's own publication records: ISO/IEC 27018:2025 is confirmed published/approved (approx. 26 Aug 2025), replacing ISO/IEC 27018:2019, and realigned to the updated ISO/IEC 27002:2022 control structure with a new Annex B offering extended implementation guidance. So, contrary to the prompt's caveat scenario, a real 2025 edition does exist and this entry is built on it. The Annex A PII-specific control categories listed below (based on the ISO/IEC 29100 privacy framework principles) are the structural element unique to 27018 across its editions; exact clause numbering in the 2025 text was not independently re-verified word-for-word against the purchased standard text (ISO text is paywalled), so treat sub-clause-level detail as indicative pending direct review of the official document.

controls.title: Consent and Choice
controls.description: Requires the cloud PII processor to enable the cloud customer to determine the appropriate basis for processing PII and to not process PII for purposes beyond the customer's documented instructions, including marketing/advertising use.
controls.test_criteria: Review processing agreements and system configuration to confirm PII is not used for undisclosed secondary purposes (e.g., advertising).
controls.evidence_requirement: Cloud service agreement, data processing addendum, configuration evidence restricting secondary use.

controls.title: Purpose Legitimacy and Specification
controls.description: Ensures PII processed by the cloud provider is used only for the purposes specified by the cloud customer's instructions.
controls.test_criteria: Review documented processing purposes against actual system behavior/data flows.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data processing agreement, purpose specification documentation, data flow diagrams.

controls.title: Collection Limitation
controls.description: Limits the collection of PII to that which is within the bounds of applicable law and strictly necessary for the specified purposes.
controls.test_criteria: Review data intake/collection points for evidence of necessity justification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data collection inventory, necessity/justification records.

controls.title: Data Minimization
controls.description: Requires the cloud provider to minimize the PII processed, including through pseudonymization, deletion of temporary files, and restricting administrative access to the minimum necessary.
controls.test_criteria: Review data minimization techniques applied (e.g., pseudonymization) and temporary file deletion procedures.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data minimization procedures, pseudonymization configuration evidence, temp file cleanup logs.

controls.title: Use, Retention and Disclosure Limitation
controls.description: Restricts use, retention, and disclosure of PII to what is instructed by the customer and legally required, including notification of legally binding disclosure requests where permitted.
controls.test_criteria: Review retention schedules and sample any third-party disclosure requests for proper handling/notification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Retention policy, disclosure request log, customer notification records.

controls.title: Accuracy and Quality
controls.description: Requires the cloud provider to support the customer's obligation to ensure PII is accurate and kept up to date, including facilitating correction/deletion requests.
controls.test_criteria: Review mechanisms enabling the customer to correct or delete PII processed on its behalf.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data correction/deletion workflow documentation.

controls.title: Openness, Transparency and Notice
controls.description: Requires the cloud provider to disclose to the customer the countries where PII may be stored/processed and subcontractor arrangements, to support customer transparency obligations.
controls.test_criteria: Review disclosed processing locations and subcontractor lists provided to customers.
controls.evidence_requirement: Sub-processor list, data location disclosures, transparency reports.

controls.title: Individual Participation and Access
controls.description: Requires the cloud provider to assist the customer in providing data subjects access to, and correction/deletion of, their PII, and to return or securely dispose of PII at contract termination.
controls.test_criteria: Review data subject request support procedures and end-of-contract data return/destruction evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data subject request support procedures, contract termination data handling records, destruction certificates.

controls.title: Accountability
controls.description: Requires the cloud provider to designate accountable staff, notify customers of data breaches, and maintain documented policies for PII protection.
controls.test_criteria: Review breach notification procedures and accountable role assignments for PII protection.
controls.evidence_requirement: Breach notification policy/records, PII protection accountability charter.

controls.title: Information Security (PII-Specific)
controls.description: Applies ISO/IEC 27002 information security controls with PII-specific guidance, including restricting the ability to combine/match PII and controlling temporary files containing PII.
controls.test_criteria: Review technical controls restricting unauthorized PII combination/matching and temp-file handling.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control configuration, temporary file handling procedures, security control mapping to ISO 27002.

controls.title: Privacy Compliance
controls.description: Requires the cloud provider to support independent review/certification of its PII protection practices and to cooperate with customer compliance and audit requirements.
controls.test_criteria: Review evidence of independent audits/certifications (e.g., this ISO 27018 certification itself) and customer audit cooperation records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Certification audit reports, customer audit request logs and responses.

name: DPA Seychelles
description: The Seychelles Data Protection Act 2023 (Act 24 of 2023), in force since 22 December 2023, is Seychelles' operative, GDPR-inspired data protection law, enforced by the Information Commission (headed by the Information Commissioner). It governs the processing of personal data by controllers and processors with a nexus to Seychelles.
notes: IMPORTANT: Seychelles' original Data Protection Act 2003 (Act 9 of 2003) was passed but NEVER brought into force and has now been formally repealed/superseded. The actual operative law — and the one a GRC platform should track for real compliance obligations — is the Data Protection Act 2023 (Act 24 of 2023, in force 22 Dec 2023), modeled closely on the EU/UK GDPR. This entry is built on the 2023 Act. The full enacted text's exact Part/section numbering was not independently confirmed line-by-line (official Gazette PDF text was only partially retrievable via search); the control list below reflects the well-corroborated substantive obligations (principles, rights, DPIA, breach notification, Information Commission oversight) reported consistently across secondary legal sources (DataGuidance, Appleby, Chambers, TechHive Advisory). Verify exact section numbers against the Gazette-published Act 24 of 2023 for citation-level precision.

controls.title: Data Protection Principles
controls.description: Requires personal data to be processed lawfully, fairly, and transparently, and in accordance with principles of purpose limitation, data minimization, accuracy, storage limitation, security/confidentiality, and accountability.
controls.test_criteria: Review data processing practices against each principle and confirm an accountability framework demonstrates compliance.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data protection policy, processing inventory, accountability documentation.

controls.title: Lawful Basis for Processing
controls.description: Requires identification of a valid legal basis for processing personal data, analogous to GDPR Article 6 grounds.
controls.test_criteria: Sample processing activities for documented lawful basis justification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Lawful basis assessments, processing records.

controls.title: Special/Sensitive Personal Data Protections
controls.description: Imposes heightened conditions on processing sensitive categories of personal data (health, race, religion, sexual life, criminal records, etc.).
controls.test_criteria: Review processing of sensitive data categories for applicable heightened safeguards/conditions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Sensitive data processing register, condition documentation.

controls.title: Data Subject Rights
controls.description: Grants data subjects the right to be informed, access, rectification, deletion, objection to processing, data portability, and compensation for contraventions.
controls.test_criteria: Sample data subject requests and verify timely, complete fulfilment across all recognized rights.
controls.evidence_requirement: Rights request log, request fulfillment records, privacy notices.

controls.title: Privacy by Design and Default
controls.description: Requires controllers to implement appropriate technical and organizational measures embedding data protection into processing activities from the outset.
controls.test_criteria: Review evidence of privacy-by-design assessments during system/project design phases.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy-by-design checklists, project privacy review records.

controls.title: Records of Processing Activities
controls.description: Requires controllers and processors to maintain records describing categories of processing, purposes, and data flows.
controls.test_criteria: Review the processing records for completeness and currency.
controls.evidence_requirement: Records of processing activities (ROPA).

controls.title: Data Processor Obligations
controls.description: Requires written agreements with processors specifying processing instructions, confidentiality, and security obligations; processors may not sub-contract without authorization.
controls.test_criteria: Sample processor contracts for required data protection clauses and sub-processor authorization controls.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data processing agreements, sub-processor authorization records.

controls.title: Security Safeguards
controls.description: Requires appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect personal data against unauthorized or unlawful processing, accidental loss, destruction, or damage.
controls.test_criteria: Review security control implementation (encryption, access control) proportionate to the risk of the data processed.
controls.evidence_requirement: Security policy, encryption/access control evidence, risk assessment records.

controls.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment
controls.description: Requires controllers to carry out a DPIA where processing is likely to result in high risk to data subjects' rights.
controls.test_criteria: Review DPIA screening criteria and completed DPIAs for high-risk processing activities.
controls.evidence_requirement: DPIA screening records, completed DPIAs.

controls.title: Personal Data Breach Notification
controls.description: Requires notification of qualifying data breaches to the Information Commission and, where high risk exists, to affected data subjects without undue delay.
controls.test_criteria: Sample breach records and verify notification timelines to the Information Commission and data subjects were met.
controls.evidence_requirement: Breach register, Information Commission notification records, data subject notifications.

controls.title: Cross-Border Data Transfer Restrictions
controls.description: Restricts transfers of personal data outside Seychelles unless an adequate level of protection or appropriate safeguard applies.
controls.test_criteria: Review transfer mechanism documentation for cross-border data flows originating from Seychelles.
controls.evidence_requirement: Transfer risk assessments, transfer safeguard agreements, transfer register.

controls.title: Information Commission Oversight & Registration
controls.description: Establishes the Information Commission (led by the Information Commissioner, supported by Commissioners) to oversee compliance, investigate complaints, and support best practice; may require controller/processor registration.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm registration status (if applicable) and review history of engagement/correspondence with the Information Commission.
controls.evidence_requirement: Registration records, Information Commission correspondence.

controls.title: Enforcement & Administrative Fines
controls.description: Grants the Information Commission powers to investigate contraventions and impose administrative fines/sanctions for non-compliance.
controls.test_criteria: Review history of enforcement action, if any, and remediation of identified contraventions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Enforcement notices, remediation plans.

controls.title: Logging and Data Access Controls
controls.description: Requires controllers/processors to maintain logging of access to personal data and implement controls to block or restrict data where necessary (e.g., on erasure/restriction requests).
controls.test_criteria: Review access logging configuration and sample logs for personal data access events.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access log configuration, sample log extracts.

controls.title: Direct Marketing Restrictions
controls.description: Restricts use of personal data for direct marketing purposes absent consent or an applicable legal basis, and requires an easy opt-out mechanism.
controls.test_criteria: Review marketing consent records and opt-out mechanism functionality.
controls.evidence_requirement: Marketing consent records, opt-out request log.

name: Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC-1:2018)
description: The Essential Cybersecurity Controls, issued by Saudi Arabia's National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) in 2018, is the baseline, mandatory cybersecurity framework for Saudi government organizations and their subsidiaries, as well as organizations owning/operating Critical National Infrastructure. It is organized as 5 main domains, 29 subdomains, and 114 main controls.
notes: ECC-1:2018's 5-domain structure (Cybersecurity Governance, Cybersecurity Defense, Cybersecurity Resilience, Third-Party and Cloud Computing Cybersecurity, Industrial Control Systems Cybersecurity) and 29-subdomain/114-control counts are consistently reported across industry sources (CyberArrow, Secure.com, SmartSuite, NIIConsulting) and align with the control's well-documented structure. Note that ECC-1:2018 was superseded by ECC-2:2024 in October 2024, but ECC-1:2018 remains the version explicitly requested and is still referenced by many existing compliance programs transitioning to v2. The subdomain list below is reconstructed from the well-established public structure of ECC-1:2018; verify exact subdomain wording against the NCA's official ECC-1:2018 PDF (freely downloadable from nca.gov.sa) for citation-level precision.

controls.title: Cybersecurity Strategy
controls.description: Requires a documented cybersecurity strategy aligned with the organization's mission and national cybersecurity objectives, approved by senior management.
controls.test_criteria: Review the approved cybersecurity strategy document and alignment with organizational objectives.
controls.evidence_requirement: Approved cybersecurity strategy, management approval record.

controls.title: Cybersecurity Management
controls.description: Establishes a dedicated cybersecurity function/department with defined authority and resources, reporting appropriately within the organization.
controls.test_criteria: Review the cybersecurity function's organizational placement and resourcing.
controls.evidence_requirement: Organizational chart, cybersecurity function charter.

controls.title: Cybersecurity Policies and Procedures
controls.description: Requires development, approval, and periodic review of cybersecurity policies and procedures covering all control domains.
controls.test_criteria: Review policy set for completeness, approval, and review currency.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cybersecurity policy set, approval and review records.

controls.title: Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities
controls.description: Defines and assigns cybersecurity roles and responsibilities across the organization, including a CISO.
controls.test_criteria: Review role definitions and appointment records, including CISO designation.
controls.evidence_requirement: RACI matrix, CISO appointment letter.

controls.title: Cybersecurity Risk Management
controls.description: Requires a formal risk management methodology to identify, assess, treat, and monitor cybersecurity risks.
controls.test_criteria: Review the risk register and periodic risk assessment cycle evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk management methodology, risk register, assessment reports.

controls.title: Cybersecurity in IT Project Management
controls.description: Requires cybersecurity requirements to be integrated into IT/project management processes from initiation through closure.
controls.test_criteria: Sample IT projects for evidence of cybersecurity requirement gates throughout the project lifecycle.
controls.evidence_requirement: Project management methodology, security gate checklists, sampled project records.

controls.title: Cybersecurity Regulatory Compliance
controls.description: Requires tracking and compliance with applicable national cybersecurity laws, regulations, and NCA directives.
controls.test_criteria: Review the regulatory compliance tracker and evidence of compliance with applicable NCA requirements.
controls.evidence_requirement: Regulatory compliance tracker, NCA correspondence.

controls.title: Periodical Cybersecurity Review and Audit
controls.description: Requires periodic internal and independent audits/reviews of the cybersecurity program's compliance and effectiveness.
controls.test_criteria: Review the latest internal/independent cybersecurity audit report and remediation status of findings.
controls.evidence_requirement: Audit reports, remediation tracking records.

controls.title: Cybersecurity in Human Resources
controls.description: Integrates cybersecurity requirements into HR processes, including pre-employment screening, confidentiality agreements, and termination procedures.
controls.test_criteria: Review HR onboarding/offboarding checklists for cybersecurity-related steps.
controls.evidence_requirement: HR security checklist, confidentiality agreements, termination access-revocation records.

controls.title: Cybersecurity Awareness and Training Program
controls.description: Requires an ongoing awareness and training program covering all personnel, tailored by role.
controls.test_criteria: Review training completion records and training content coverage.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training program materials, completion logs.

controls.title: Asset Management
controls.description: Requires an inventory and classification scheme for information and technology assets.
controls.test_criteria: Reconcile the asset inventory against discovered assets and classification labels.
