controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: Covered entities must conduct periodic, at least annual, risk assessments of information systems sufficient to inform the design of the cybersecurity program, and update them as needed for material changes.
controls.test_criteria: Review risk assessment methodology, frequency, and use of output to inform program design.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk assessment reports; risk assessment policy.

controls.title: Cybersecurity Personnel and Intelligence
controls.description: Covered entities must employ qualified cybersecurity personnel, whether internal, affiliate, or third-party, provide updates and training on emerging threats, and verify that personnel maintain current knowledge.
controls.test_criteria: Review staffing adequacy and the ongoing training/threat intelligence program.
controls.evidence_requirement: Staffing plan; training records; threat intelligence subscriptions.

controls.title: Third-Party Service Provider Security Policy
controls.description: Covered entities must implement written policies and procedures for third-party service providers accessing nonpublic information, including risk-based due diligence, minimum security requirements, and periodic reassessment.
controls.test_criteria: Review the TPSP policy and sample vendor due diligence/contract records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Third-party security policy; vendor risk assessments; contract security clauses.

controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
controls.description: Covered entities must implement MFA for all individuals accessing the entity's network from an external network, and, per the Second Amendment effective November 1, 2025, for all privileged accounts and remote access, with limited compensating-control exceptions requiring CISO approval.
controls.test_criteria: Review MFA deployment coverage across remote access and privileged accounts.
controls.evidence_requirement: MFA configuration reports; exception approvals with compensating controls documented.

controls.title: Asset Management and Data Retention
controls.description: Covered entities must maintain a complete, risk-ranked asset inventory of hardware, software, and systems, and implement policies for secure disposal of nonpublic information no longer needed for business purposes, subject to retention requirements.
controls.test_criteria: Review asset inventory completeness and currency, and data disposal records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Asset inventory; data disposal/destruction log; retention schedule.

controls.title: Training and Monitoring
controls.description: Covered entities must implement controls, such as endpoint detection and logging, to monitor authorized user activity and detect unauthorized access, and must provide regular cybersecurity awareness training including social engineering (e.g., phishing) exercises.
controls.test_criteria: Review monitoring tool deployment and training/phishing simulation records.
controls.evidence_requirement: EDR/monitoring deployment evidence; phishing simulation reports; training records.

controls.title: Encryption of Nonpublic Information
controls.description: Covered entities must encrypt nonpublic information held or transmitted, both in transit over external networks and at rest, with documented compensating controls if encryption is infeasible, subject to at least annual CISO review.
controls.test_criteria: Review encryption implementation for data at rest and in transit, and any compensating-control justifications.
controls.evidence_requirement: Encryption configuration evidence; compensating control documentation with CISO sign-off.

controls.title: Incident Response and Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery Plans
controls.description: Covered entities must establish a written incident response plan and a business continuity/disaster recovery (BCDR) plan, including backup procedures, and test these plans at least annually.
controls.test_criteria: Review the IR/BCDR plans and annual test/tabletop exercise records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan; BCDR plan; tabletop exercise after-action reports.

controls.title: Notification of Cybersecurity Incidents
controls.description: Covered entities must notify the Superintendent as promptly as possible and within 72 hours of determining a cybersecurity event meeting notification criteria, including ransomware deployment and extortion payments, which also require separate disclosure within prescribed timeframes.
controls.test_criteria: Review the incident notification procedure and the timeliness of any notifications filed.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident notification procedure; DFS notification filings.

controls.title: Annual Certification of Compliance
controls.description: Covered entities must annually certify compliance, or file an acknowledgment of partial noncompliance identifying a remediation plan, with the Superintendent by April 15, signed by the highest-ranking executive and the CISO.
controls.test_criteria: Review the submitted certification/acknowledgment and the underlying compliance evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Filed annual certification; supporting compliance documentation.

controls.title: Exemptions
controls.description: Certain small entities meeting defined thresholds for employees, revenue, or assets qualify for limited exemptions from specific sections; covered entities must document their eligibility and file for applicable exemptions.
controls.test_criteria: Review the exemption eligibility analysis and the filed exemption notice.
controls.evidence_requirement: Exemption eligibility assessment; filed Notice of Exemption.

controls.title: Class A Company Enhanced Requirements
controls.description: Large 'Class A' companies, defined as those with over 2,000 employees or more than $1 billion in gross annual revenue (among other thresholds), must implement additional controls including an independent audit of the cybersecurity program, endpoint detection and response, and a privileged access management solution.
controls.test_criteria: Review the implementation of Class A-specific controls, including the independent audit report and EDR/PAM deployment.
controls.evidence_requirement: Independent audit report; EDR/PAM deployment evidence.

controls.title: Enforcement and Penalties
controls.description: DFS may investigate and take enforcement action, including civil penalties, for violations of Part 500; covered entities should maintain documentation demonstrating good-faith compliance efforts to support any enforcement engagement.
controls.test_criteria: Review internal enforcement-readiness documentation and any prior DFS examination findings/remediation.
controls.evidence_requirement: DFS examination correspondence; remediation tracking records.

name: PDPA Singapore
description: Singapore's Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (as amended by the Personal Data Protection (Amendment) Act 2020) is the principal data protection law enforced by the Personal Data Protection Commission (PDPC); it governs the collection, use, disclosure, and care of personal data by organizations, and includes the Do Not Call (DNC) Registry provisions.
notes: Based on the PDPA 2012 as amended in 2020, which added mandatory data breach notification and the Accountability Obligation. PDPC Advisory Guidelines provide interpretive detail below this control-family level.

controls.title: Consent Obligation
controls.description: Organizations must obtain valid consent (or rely on a recognized exception or deemed consent) before collecting, using, or disclosing personal data, and must provide a means to withdraw consent.
controls.test_criteria: Review consent capture mechanisms, consent language, and withdrawal-of-consent handling records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Consent forms/UI screenshots, consent management system logs, withdrawal request records.

controls.title: Purpose Limitation Obligation
controls.description: Organizations may collect, use, or disclose personal data only for purposes a reasonable person would consider appropriate and that have been notified to the individual.
controls.test_criteria: Sample processing activities and compare actual use of data against the notified/stated purpose.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data inventory/ROPA with documented purposes, internal data-use policy.

controls.title: Notification Obligation
controls.description: Organizations must notify individuals of the purposes for which personal data is being collected, used, or disclosed, on or before such collection.
controls.test_criteria: Review privacy notices and collection statements for completeness, accuracy, and timing relative to collection.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy policy, point-of-collection notices, website/app/form screenshots.

controls.title: Access and Correction Obligation
controls.description: Upon request, organizations must provide individuals access to their personal data and the ways it has been used/disclosed in the past year, and correct inaccuracies within prescribed timeframes.
controls.test_criteria: Sample access/correction requests and verify timely, complete, and accurate responses.
controls.evidence_requirement: Request intake log, response records, SLA tracking reports.

controls.title: Accuracy Obligation
controls.description: Organizations must make reasonable effort to ensure personal data is accurate and complete, particularly where it is likely to be used to make a decision affecting the individual or disclosed to another organization.
controls.test_criteria: Review data validation and update procedures for accuracy-critical data categories.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data validation procedure, correction/update logs.

controls.title: Protection Obligation
controls.description: Organizations must implement reasonable security arrangements to protect personal data in their possession or control against unauthorized access, collection, use, disclosure, copying, modification, disposal, or similar risks.
controls.test_criteria: Review technical and organizational security controls (access control, encryption, monitoring) applied to personal data stores.
controls.evidence_requirement: Security policy, access control lists, encryption configuration, risk assessment records.

controls.title: Retention Limitation Obligation
controls.description: Organizations must cease to retain personal data, or anonymize it, as soon as it is reasonable to assume the purpose for collection is no longer served by retention and retention is no longer necessary for legal or business purposes.
controls.test_criteria: Review the retention schedule and sample deletion/anonymization records against it.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data retention policy/schedule, disposal or anonymization logs.

controls.title: Transfer Limitation Obligation
controls.description: Personal data transferred outside Singapore must be afforded a standard of protection comparable to the PDPA, through mechanisms such as contractual clauses, binding corporate rules, or recognized certifications.
controls.test_criteria: Review cross-border transfer mechanisms and data flow mapping for overseas recipients.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data transfer agreements/SCCs, data flow diagrams, overseas recipient due diligence records.

controls.title: Data Breach Notification Obligation
controls.description: Organizations must assess suspected data breaches and, where the breach is notifiable (significant harm or scale thresholds), notify the PDPC within 3 calendar days of making that assessment and notify affected individuals.
controls.test_criteria: Review the breach register and sample incidents for timeliness of assessment and notification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident/breach log, PDPC notification correspondence, breach risk assessment records.

controls.title: Accountability Obligation
controls.description: Organizations must appoint a Data Protection Officer, develop and implement data protection policies and practices, and make information about these policies and practices publicly available.
controls.test_criteria: Verify DPO appointment and published contact details; review internal data protection policies and staff training.
controls.evidence_requirement: DPO appointment record, published DPO contact information, internal data protection policy, training completion records.

controls.title: Do Not Call (DNC) Registry Provisions
controls.description: Organizations sending marketing messages to Singapore telephone numbers must check the DNC Registry before sending and must honor opt-out/withdrawal requests for specified messages.
controls.test_criteria: Review DNC registry check logs prior to marketing campaigns and the opt-out handling process.
controls.evidence_requirement: DNC checker results, marketing campaign dispatch logs, opt-out request records.

controls.title: Data Inventory and Privacy by Design
controls.description: Organizations are expected to maintain a data inventory/record of processing and embed data protection considerations into new systems and processes as part of demonstrating accountability.
controls.test_criteria: Review data inventory completeness and evidence that privacy was considered during design of new projects/systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data inventory/ROPA, privacy impact assessment records for new initiatives.

name: CMMC 2.0 Level 1
description: Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Level 1 (Foundational), issued by the US Department of Defense, protects Federal Contract Information (FCI); it requires annual self-assessment and senior official affirmation against 17 practices drawn directly from the 15 basic safeguarding requirements in FAR clause 52.204-21.
notes: Level 1 practices map one-to-one to the FAR 52.204-21 basic safeguarding requirements. No maturity processes are assessed at Level 1, only practice implementation, and it is self-assessed annually (not third-party certified).

controls.title: Authorized Access Control
controls.description: Limit information system access to authorized users, processes acting on behalf of authorized users, and devices (including other information systems).
controls.test_criteria: Review account provisioning records and current system access lists against a roster of authorized users and devices.
controls.evidence_requirement: User access list, account provisioning/termination records, system configuration showing access restrictions.

controls.title: Transaction and Function Control
controls.description: Limit information system access to the types of transactions and functions that authorized users are permitted to execute.
controls.test_criteria: Review role-based permission configurations against documented job functions.
controls.evidence_requirement: RBAC matrix, system permission configuration exports.

controls.title: External Connections
controls.description: Verify and control/limit connections to, and use of, external information systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review firewall/VPN rules and the approved list of external connections.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network diagram, external connection approval records, firewall ruleset.

controls.title: Control Public Information
controls.description: Control information posted or processed on publicly accessible information systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review the approval process for public-facing content and sample published material for FCI exposure.
controls.evidence_requirement: Public content approval workflow records, website/portal review logs.

controls.title: Identification
controls.description: Identify information system users, processes acting on behalf of users, or devices.
controls.test_criteria: Review unique user ID assignment and the inventory of system accounts.
controls.evidence_requirement: User/account inventory, identity provisioning records.

controls.title: Authentication
controls.description: Authenticate (or verify) the identities of users, processes, or devices as a prerequisite to allowing access to organizational information systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review authentication mechanism configuration (passwords/MFA) for in-scope systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Authentication policy, system configuration screenshots, password policy settings.

controls.title: Media Disposal
controls.description: Sanitize or destroy information system media containing Federal Contract Information before disposal or release for reuse.
controls.test_criteria: Review media sanitization/destruction logs and verify method used matches policy.
controls.evidence_requirement: Media destruction certificates, sanitization procedure documentation.

controls.title: Limit Physical Access
controls.description: Limit physical access to organizational information systems, equipment, and the respective operating environments to authorized individuals.
controls.test_criteria: Review the physical access control list and badge/key records for facilities housing FCI systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access control list, badge system logs, facility access policy.

controls.title: Escort Visitors
controls.description: Escort visitors and monitor visitor activity.
controls.test_criteria: Review visitor logs and verify escort procedures are followed.
controls.evidence_requirement: Visitor sign-in/escort log, visitor management policy.

controls.title: Physical Access Logs
controls.description: Maintain audit logs of physical access to facilities housing in-scope systems.
controls.test_criteria: Sample physical access logs for completeness and verify retention period.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access log exports, log retention schedule.

controls.title: Manage Physical Access Devices
controls.description: Control and manage physical access devices such as keys, badges, and combinations.
controls.test_criteria: Review inventory and issuance/revocation records for physical access devices.
controls.evidence_requirement: Key/badge inventory, issuance and return logs.

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.description: Monitor, control, and protect organizational communications (information transmitted or received) at the external boundaries and key internal boundaries of organizational information systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review firewall/boundary device configuration and monitoring/alert records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network architecture diagram, firewall configuration, boundary monitoring logs.

controls.title: Public-Access System Separation
controls.description: Implement subnetworks for publicly accessible system components that are physically or logically separated from internal networks.
controls.test_criteria: Review network segmentation (DMZ) configuration separating public-facing systems from internal networks.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network diagram showing DMZ, segmentation/firewall rules.

controls.title: Flaw Remediation
controls.description: Identify, report, and correct information and information system flaws in a timely manner.
controls.test_criteria: Review patch management records and remediation timelines against policy.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vulnerability/patch management log, patch deployment reports.

controls.title: Malicious Code Protection
controls.description: Provide protection from malicious code at appropriate locations within organizational information systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review anti-malware deployment and coverage across endpoints and servers.
controls.evidence_requirement: Anti-malware console reports, endpoint deployment coverage list.

controls.title: Update Malicious Code Protection
controls.description: Update malicious code protection mechanisms when new releases are available.
controls.test_criteria: Review anti-malware signature/engine update logs and auto-update configuration.
controls.evidence_requirement: Anti-malware update logs, configuration showing auto-update enabled.

controls.title: System and File Scanning
controls.description: Perform periodic scans of organizational information systems and real-time scans of files from external sources as files are downloaded, opened, or executed.
controls.test_criteria: Review scan schedule configuration and scan result logs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Scan schedule configuration, scan completion/result reports.

name: Essential Eight Level 1
description: The Essential Eight is a baseline set of mitigation strategies published by the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC, part of the Australian Signals Directorate) to help organizations protect against cyber threats; Maturity Level 1 targets stopping unsophisticated, opportunistic adversaries using commodity tradecraft.
notes: Reflects the ACSC's published Essential Eight Maturity Model. Precise technical thresholds (e.g., exact patch timeframes, which internet-facing vs. non-internet-facing criteria apply) differ across ML1-ML3 per strategy and are condensed here to top-level control intent per the requested granularity.

controls.title: Application Control
controls.description: Implement application control on workstations and servers to prevent execution of unapproved or malicious executables, software libraries, scripts, installers, compiled HTML, HTA files, and control panel applets.
controls.test_criteria: Review application control (allow-listing) policy configuration and attempt execution of a non-approved executable in a test environment.
controls.evidence_requirement: Application control policy/ruleset export, test execution logs, exception approval records.

controls.title: Patch Applications
controls.description: Patch or mitigate security vulnerabilities in internet-facing services, office productivity suites, PDF software, browsers and their extensions within required timeframes based on criticality, and retire unsupported applications.
controls.test_criteria: Review patch management reports and vulnerability scan results against the required patching SLA.
controls.evidence_requirement: Patch compliance report, vulnerability scan results, application version/support-status inventory.

controls.title: Configure Microsoft Office Macro Settings
controls.description: Restrict Microsoft Office macros to only those from trusted locations or that are digitally signed, and block macros from the internet and from files originating from untrusted sources.
controls.test_criteria: Review macro security configuration deployed via Group Policy or MDM.
controls.evidence_requirement: GPO/MDM configuration export, macro security policy documentation.

controls.title: User Application Hardening
controls.description: Configure web browsers and office applications to block or disable risky features (e.g., Flash content, ads, unsigned Java, untrusted browser extensions) and enforce hardened configuration settings.
controls.test_criteria: Review the browser/office application hardening configuration baseline against deployed settings.
controls.evidence_requirement: Hardening configuration baseline, configuration audit report.

controls.title: Restrict Administrative Privileges
controls.description: Restrict administrative privileges to users who require them to perform their duties, regularly validate the ongoing need for such access, and prevent administrative accounts from accessing email, web browsing, and general internet services.
controls.test_criteria: Review the privileged account inventory and the most recent periodic access recertification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privileged account list, access review/recertification records, configuration restricting admin accounts from internet/email use.

controls.title: Patch Operating Systems
controls.description: Patch or mitigate security vulnerabilities in operating systems of internet-facing and workstation/server systems within required timeframes based on criticality, and retire unsupported OS versions.
controls.test_criteria: Review OS patch compliance reports and vulnerability scan results against the required SLA.
controls.evidence_requirement: OS patch compliance dashboard, vulnerability scan report, OS version/support-status inventory.

controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
controls.description: Implement multi-factor authentication for users accessing important data repositories, and for remote access and privileged actions.
controls.test_criteria: Review MFA enforcement configuration for all in-scope access paths and sample authentication logs.
controls.evidence_requirement: MFA policy configuration, authentication system logs showing MFA challenge, exception list.

controls.title: Regular Backups
controls.description: Perform and test regular backups of important data, software, and configuration settings, and store backups securely (e.g., offline or immutable) in accordance with business continuity requirements.
controls.test_criteria: Review backup schedules, job success logs, and the most recent restoration test results.
controls.evidence_requirement: Backup job logs, restore test reports, backup retention/storage configuration.

name: Saudi Arabia PDPL
description: The Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), issued by Royal Decree M/19 (2021, amended March 2023) with Implementing Regulations effective 14 September 2023, is Saudi Arabia's comprehensive data protection law; it is supervised by the Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA) and governs the processing of personal data relating to individuals in the Kingdom.
notes: Structure is reconstructed from the PDPL, its September 2023 Implementing Regulations, and the Regulation on Personal Data Transfer outside the Kingdom, as summarized in multiple law-firm and consultancy analyses (the official text is in Arabic and was not directly retrieved in this research session). SDAIA's role as supervisory authority has been reported as transitioning to a dedicated national data office in some analyses -- confirm the current designated regulator before relying on this for a live engagement.

controls.title: Lawful Basis for Processing
controls.description: Processing of personal data requires the explicit consent of the data subject or another lawful basis recognized under the PDPL, such as legal obligation, vital interest, or a defined legitimate interest.
controls.test_criteria: Sample processing activities and verify a documented lawful basis exists for each.
controls.evidence_requirement: Consent records, lawful basis assessments/ROPA, legitimate interest assessments.

controls.title: Notice to Data Subjects
controls.description: Controllers must provide a privacy notice before or at the time of collecting personal data, including the purpose of collection, categories of data, and other prescribed information.
controls.test_criteria: Review privacy notice content and its placement/timing at points of collection.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy notice text, collection point screenshots/forms.

controls.title: Purpose Limitation
controls.description: Personal data may only be processed for the purpose for which it was collected or a compatible purpose, unless further consent or an alternative legal basis is obtained.
controls.test_criteria: Review processing purposes recorded in the data inventory against the original collection purpose.
controls.evidence_requirement: ROPA with purpose field populated, purpose-change consent records.

controls.title: Data Minimization
controls.description: Controllers must ensure personal data collected and processed is adequate, relevant, and limited to what is necessary for the stated purpose.
controls.test_criteria: Review data collection forms/fields against the stated processing purpose.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data collection forms, data minimization review records.

controls.title: Data Accuracy
controls.description: Controllers must take reasonable steps to ensure personal data is accurate, complete, and kept up to date.
controls.test_criteria: Review data accuracy and update processes and sample correction-handling records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data quality procedure, correction request log.

controls.title: Data Subject Rights
controls.description: Data subjects have the right to be informed, to access their data, to request correction, to request destruction/deletion, and to withdraw consent; controllers must action requests within statutory timeframes.
controls.test_criteria: Sample data subject request records for timely, complete fulfillment and proper requester identity verification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data subject request intake log, response records, identity verification procedure.

controls.title: Sensitive Data Processing
controls.description: Processing of sensitive data (health, genetic, biometric, criminal record, credit data, or data revealing ethnic/religious/political affiliation) is subject to stricter conditions and, in some cases, prior authorization.
controls.test_criteria: Review additional controls and approvals applied to sensitive data processing activities.
controls.evidence_requirement: Sensitive data inventory, risk assessment/approval records for sensitive processing.

controls.title: Direct Marketing Controls
controls.description: Processing personal data for direct marketing purposes requires explicit consent and a clear mechanism for the data subject to opt out.
controls.test_criteria: Review marketing consent capture and opt-out handling processes.
controls.evidence_requirement: Marketing consent records, opt-out/unsubscribe logs.

controls.title: Security Safeguards
controls.description: Controllers and processors must implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against loss, unauthorized access, or disclosure.
controls.test_criteria: Review technical/organizational security controls (encryption, access control) applied to personal data stores.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security policy, access control configuration, encryption evidence.

controls.title: Personal Data Breach Notification
controls.description: Controllers must notify the competent authority upon becoming aware of a breach that causes harm to personal data or conflicts with data subjects' rights, and notify affected data subjects where the breach poses a risk, within prescribed timeframes.
controls.test_criteria: Review the breach register and sample incidents for timeliness of notification to the authority and data subjects.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident/breach log, notification correspondence to regulator and data subjects.

controls.title: Cross-Border Data Transfer
controls.description: Transfers of personal data outside Saudi Arabia require an adequacy determination, appropriate contractual safeguards, or a specific statutory exception, per the Regulation on Personal Data Transfer outside the Kingdom.
controls.test_criteria: Review the transfer mechanism documentation and destination-country risk assessment for each transfer.
controls.evidence_requirement: Transfer impact assessment, standard contractual clauses/data transfer agreements.

controls.title: Data Protection Officer Appointment
controls.description: Controllers meeting prescribed thresholds (e.g., large-scale or sensitive data processing) must appoint a Data Protection Officer.
controls.test_criteria: Verify DPO appointment and independent reporting line where threshold criteria are met.
controls.evidence_requirement: DPO appointment record, DPO job description and reporting structure.

controls.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment
controls.description: Controllers must conduct a Data Protection Impact Assessment for processing activities likely to result in high risk to data subjects before commencing that processing.
controls.test_criteria: Review DPIA records for high-risk processing activities and verify they precede go-live.
controls.evidence_requirement: DPIA templates and completed assessments.

controls.title: Records of Processing Activities
controls.description: Controllers must maintain records documenting their personal data processing activities.
controls.test_criteria: Review the completeness and currency of the processing activity record.
controls.evidence_requirement: Record of Processing Activities (ROPA) register.

controls.title: Processor Obligations and Contracts
controls.description: Processing carried out on behalf of a controller must be governed by a binding contract specifying the processor's obligations, and processors may only process personal data per the controller's documented instructions.
controls.test_criteria: Review data processing agreements with third-party processors for required contractual terms.
controls.evidence_requirement: Signed data processing agreements, processor due diligence records.

controls.title: Retention and Destruction
controls.description: Personal data must not be retained longer than necessary for the purpose of collection or processing and must be securely destroyed or anonymized once that purpose has been fulfilled.
controls.test_criteria: Review the retention schedule and sample destruction/anonymization records against it.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data retention policy/schedule, secure destruction/disposal logs.

name: SAMA Cyber Resilience Fundamental Requirements (CRFR)
description: Issued by the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA), the Cyber Resilience Fundamental Requirements set a condensed, foundational cyber resilience baseline intended for less complex or newly licensed SAMA-regulated entities (e.g., smaller finance companies, newly licensed fintechs) that are not yet expected to meet the full Cyber Security Framework maturity model.
notes: This research session could not locate a single, widely-circulated English-language CRFR document with an independently confirmed control list. This entry scales down SAMA's confirmed four-domain Cyber Security Framework structure (Leadership & Governance, Risk Management & Compliance, Operations & Technology, Third-Party) to the fundamental/baseline control set described for smaller or newly licensed entities in secondary compliance-industry sources. Verify the exact control list against SAMA's official CRFR circular/rulebook entry before use in an actual audit engagement.

controls.title: Cyber Security Governance Structure
controls.description: Establish a baseline cyber security governance structure with defined board/senior management accountability appropriate to the entity's size and risk profile.
controls.test_criteria: Review the governance charter and evidence of senior management review of cyber security matters.
controls.evidence_requirement: Governance structure document, meeting minutes referencing cyber security.

controls.title: Cyber Security Policy
controls.description: Maintain an approved, baseline cyber security policy covering key risk areas and communicate it to all staff.
controls.test_criteria: Review policy approval and distribution/acknowledgment records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Approved policy document, distribution/acknowledgment records.

controls.title: Roles and Responsibilities
controls.description: Define and assign fundamental cyber security roles and responsibilities, including an accountable owner for the cyber security program.
controls.test_criteria: Review the organizational chart and role descriptions for cyber security accountability.
controls.evidence_requirement: Organizational chart, role/responsibility matrix.

controls.title: Baseline Risk Assessment
controls.description: Perform a baseline cyber security risk assessment covering key systems and data.
controls.test_criteria: Review the risk assessment methodology and the most recent assessment output.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk assessment report, risk register.

controls.title: Regulatory Compliance Monitoring
controls.description: Maintain a process to track applicable SAMA cyber security circulars and requirements and confirm compliance status.
controls.test_criteria: Review the compliance tracking log against applicable SAMA issuances.
controls.evidence_requirement: Regulatory compliance tracker, self-assessment submissions to SAMA.

controls.title: Asset Management
controls.description: Maintain an inventory of critical information assets and systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review asset inventory completeness and update frequency.
controls.evidence_requirement: Asset register/CMDB export.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Implement baseline identity and access management controls, including unique user IDs, least privilege, and periodic access review.
controls.test_criteria: Review the user access list and the most recent access recertification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, access review records.

controls.title: Awareness and Training
controls.description: Provide baseline cyber security awareness training to staff.
controls.test_criteria: Review training completion records against the staff roster.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training content, completion/attendance logs.

controls.title: Secure Configuration and Patch Management
controls.description: Apply baseline secure configuration standards to systems and patch critical vulnerabilities in a timely manner.
controls.test_criteria: Review the configuration baseline and patch compliance reports.
controls.evidence_requirement: Configuration standard document, patch management reports.

controls.title: Logging and Monitoring
controls.description: Enable logging on critical systems and monitor for security events.
controls.test_criteria: Review logging configuration and sample monitoring/alert records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Logging configuration, SIEM/monitoring alert logs.

controls.title: Incident Management
controls.description: Maintain a baseline cyber security incident response process, including escalation and notification to SAMA where required.
controls.test_criteria: Review the incident response procedure and sample incident records for timely handling and notification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, incident log, SAMA notification records.

controls.title: Business Continuity and Resilience Testing
controls.description: Maintain and periodically test business continuity and disaster recovery arrangements for critical systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review the BCP/DR plan and the most recent test exercise results.
controls.evidence_requirement: BCP/DR plan, test exercise report.

controls.title: Data Protection
controls.description: Apply baseline controls, such as encryption and backup, to protect sensitive and customer data.
controls.test_criteria: Review data protection control configuration for critical data stores.
controls.evidence_requirement: Encryption/backup configuration evidence, data classification policy.

controls.title: Third-Party Risk Management
controls.description: Assess and manage cyber security risk arising from critical third-party and outsourced service providers.
controls.test_criteria: Review third-party risk assessments and contractual security requirements for critical vendors.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vendor risk assessment records, outsourcing/vendor contracts with security clauses.

name: SAMA Minimum Verification Controls (MVC)
description: Issued by the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA), the Minimum Verification Controls set out mandatory customer identity verification, authentication, and transaction-alerting requirements for electronic banking, payment, and e-wallet channels, aimed specifically at preventing account takeover and payment fraud rather than broad information-security governance.
notes: Content is reconstructed from secondary references to SAMA's Minimum Verification Controls circular (references include a September 2021 document and a 2022 circular, TA'M/245/202204, that superseded related E-Wallet Security Controls). The official rulebook text at rulebook.sama.gov.sa should be checked for the current, authoritative control wording and version number.

controls.title: Customer Identity Verification at Onboarding
controls.description: Verify customer identity using approved methods (e.g., national ID/Absher verification, biometric check) before activating electronic banking or e-wallet services.
controls.test_criteria: Sample new account openings and verify identity verification evidence was captured before activation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Onboarding verification logs, ID verification system records.

controls.title: Registered Mobile Number Verification
controls.description: Require verification of a customer's mobile number against a trusted source before linking it for authentication and alerting purposes.
controls.test_criteria: Review the mobile number verification process and sample verification records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Mobile verification logs, telecom cross-check records.

controls.title: One-Time Password (OTP) Controls
controls.description: Send one-time passwords only to the verified registered mobile number or device for sensitive actions such as login, registration, and high-risk transactions, with defined expiry and attempt limits.
controls.test_criteria: Review OTP configuration for expiry time and maximum retry attempts.
controls.evidence_requirement: OTP system configuration, sample OTP transaction logs.

controls.title: Session Timeout and Re-authentication
controls.description: Enforce automatic session timeout after a defined period of inactivity and require re-authentication to resume a session.
controls.test_criteria: Review session timeout configuration on digital banking channels and test enforcement.
controls.evidence_requirement: Application/session configuration settings, test session-timeout results.

controls.title: Device Binding and Recognition
controls.description: Bind customer accounts to registered devices and require additional verification for access attempts from new or unrecognized devices.
controls.test_criteria: Review device registration logic and new-device anomaly flagging rules.
controls.evidence_requirement: Device registration records, new-device verification logs.

controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication for High-Risk Transactions
controls.description: Require a second authentication factor for high-risk actions such as adding a new payee, high-value transfers, or changing registered contact details.
controls.test_criteria: Review MFA enforcement configuration for designated high-risk transaction types.
controls.evidence_requirement: MFA policy/configuration, transaction logs showing MFA challenge.

controls.title: Real-Time Transaction Alerts
controls.description: Send SMS or push notifications to the customer's verified channel for registration events and defined transaction types/thresholds.
controls.test_criteria: Review the alert trigger configuration and sample alert delivery logs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Alert configuration rules, alert delivery logs.

controls.title: Transaction Velocity and Limit Controls
controls.description: Apply daily and per-transaction limits and velocity checks to detect abnormal transaction patterns.
controls.test_criteria: Review configured limits and velocity rule logic against the institution's risk policy.
controls.evidence_requirement: Limit configuration settings, velocity rule documentation.

controls.title: Card-Not-Present Transaction Controls
controls.description: Apply additional verification, such as 3-D Secure or OTP, for card-not-present and e-commerce transactions.
controls.test_criteria: Review 3DS/OTP enforcement configuration for card-not-present transaction flows.
controls.evidence_requirement: Payment gateway configuration, sample CNP transaction authentication logs.

controls.title: Secure Credential Reset Process
controls.description: Require strong identity re-verification before resetting passwords, PINs, or registered devices.
controls.test_criteria: Review the password/PIN/device reset workflow and the verification steps it enforces.
controls.evidence_requirement: Credential reset procedure, sample reset request logs.

controls.title: Fraud Monitoring and Flagging
controls.description: Maintain automated fraud monitoring to detect and flag unusual account or transaction behavior, with a process to proactively contact affected customers.
controls.test_criteria: Review the fraud monitoring rule set and sample flagged-case handling records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Fraud monitoring system rules, case management records.

controls.title: E-Wallet Registration Verification
controls.description: Apply tiered identity verification requirements for e-wallet account registration, with transaction/balance limits scaled to the verification level achieved.
controls.test_criteria: Review the e-wallet tiering/verification configuration against the limits applied per tier.
controls.evidence_requirement: E-wallet tier configuration, verification level records.

controls.title: Customer Dispute and Liability Notification
controls.description: Provide customers a clear channel to report unauthorized transactions and inform them of their rights and the timelines for dispute resolution.
controls.test_criteria: Review the dispute handling procedure and sample case turnaround times against stated SLAs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Dispute/complaint log, customer communication templates.

name: Cyber Security Framework – SAMA
description: SAMA's Cyber Security Framework (first issued May 2017, Version 1.0) is the Saudi Central Bank's foundational, comprehensive cyber security regulation applying to all regulated financial institutions (banks, insurance/reinsurance companies, and finance companies); it is organized into four domains and roughly 32 subdomains and is assessed against a six-level (0-5) cyber security maturity model. It differs from the CRFR (a condensed baseline aimed at smaller or newly licensed entities) and the MVC (a narrow set of customer-authentication/fraud controls limited to electronic channels) by being the broad, principal information-security governance and controls framework against which SAMA expects most regulated institutions to achieve at least maturity level 3.
notes: The four-domain structure (Leadership & Governance, Risk Management & Compliance, Operations & Technology, Third Party), the approximate 32-subdomain count, and the six-level (0-5) maturity model are corroborated by SAMA's public rulebook (rulebook.sama.gov.sa) and multiple compliance-industry sources. The specific subdomain names listed below are reconstructed from general industry references to the framework; the complete, authoritative list of all subdomains and underlying ~249 controls should be confirmed against the official SAMA Cyber Security Framework PDF/rulebook before use in a live audit.

controls.title: Cyber Security Strategy
controls.description: Define and approve a cyber security strategy aligned to the institution's overall business strategy and risk appetite.
controls.test_criteria: Review the approved strategy document and evidence of board/senior management approval.
controls.evidence_requirement: Approved cyber security strategy, governance committee minutes.

controls.title: Cyber Security Policy
controls.description: Establish, approve, and periodically review a comprehensive cyber security policy framework.
controls.test_criteria: Review policy approval dates and verify the periodic review cycle has been followed.
controls.evidence_requirement: Policy document set, approval/review records.

controls.title: Organization and Roles
controls.description: Establish a cyber security organizational structure with a designated CISO function and clearly defined roles and responsibilities.
controls.test_criteria: Review the organizational chart, CISO appointment, and reporting line.
controls.evidence_requirement: Organizational chart, CISO appointment letter.

controls.title: Cyber Security Awareness and Training
controls.description: Operate an ongoing security awareness and role-based training program for staff and management.
controls.test_criteria: Review the training plan and completion records across the organization.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training curriculum, completion logs.

controls.title: Cyber Security Architecture
controls.description: Define a target cyber security architecture that is integrated into enterprise and solution architecture processes.
controls.test_criteria: Review architecture artifacts and evidence of security-by-design integration into the project lifecycle.
controls.evidence_requirement: Architecture documentation, security architecture review records.

controls.title: Cyber Security Risk Management
controls.description: Operate a formal cyber risk management process covering identification, assessment, treatment, and monitoring, integrated with enterprise risk management.
controls.test_criteria: Review the risk register and the risk assessment methodology for currency and completeness.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cyber risk register, risk assessment reports.

controls.title: Compliance Management
controls.description: Maintain a process to identify and track compliance with applicable cyber security laws, regulations, and SAMA circulars.
controls.test_criteria: Review the compliance obligation register and supporting compliance evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Compliance tracker, self-assessment submissions to SAMA.

controls.title: Cyber Security Review (Independent Audit)
controls.description: Conduct independent reviews or audits of the cyber security program on a periodic basis.
controls.test_criteria: Review the internal/external audit plan and verify findings are tracked to closure.
controls.evidence_requirement: Audit reports, findings remediation tracker.

controls.title: Cyber Security Maturity Self-Assessment
controls.description: Perform the SAMA maturity model self-assessment across all domains/subdomains and report results as required.
controls.test_criteria: Review the self-assessment documentation and evidence supporting each claimed maturity level per subdomain.
controls.evidence_requirement: Maturity self-assessment workbook, supporting evidence repository.

controls.title: Human Resources Security
controls.description: Apply security screening, confidentiality agreements, and termination/role-change controls for personnel.
controls.test_criteria: Review HR security procedures and sample employee files for required controls.
controls.evidence_requirement: Background check records, confidentiality agreements, termination checklist.

controls.title: Physical Security
controls.description: Protect data centers and facilities housing critical systems with physical access controls and monitoring.
controls.test_criteria: Review physical access control configuration and surveillance/retention records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access logs, CCTV retention policy.

controls.title: Asset Management
controls.description: Maintain an inventory and classification scheme for information and technology assets.
controls.test_criteria: Review asset inventory completeness and classification labeling.
controls.evidence_requirement: Asset register, data classification policy.

controls.title: Identity and Access Management
controls.description: Implement least-privilege access, unique identification, and periodic access recertification across systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review access provisioning/de-provisioning records and periodic recertification evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: IAM policy, access review logs.

controls.title: Application Security
controls.description: Embed secure coding practices and security testing into the application development lifecycle.
controls.test_criteria: Review SDLC security gates and sample application security testing results.
controls.evidence_requirement: SDLC policy, SAST/DAST/penetration test reports.

controls.title: Change Management
controls.description: Operate a controlled change management process for IT and security-relevant changes.
controls.test_criteria: Review change request records for approval and testing evidence prior to deployment.
controls.evidence_requirement: Change management tickets, CAB approval records.

controls.title: Infrastructure Security
controls.description: Harden and protect network and system infrastructure, including servers and network devices, using defined security baselines.
controls.test_criteria: Review infrastructure hardening baseline compliance via configuration scans.
controls.evidence_requirement: Configuration baseline standards, compliance scan reports.

controls.title: Cryptography
controls.description: Define and apply standards for encryption and key management for data at rest and in transit.
controls.test_criteria: Review the cryptographic standard and key management procedure against deployed configuration.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cryptography policy, key management records.

controls.title: Bring Your Own Device (BYOD)
controls.description: Apply security controls, such as MDM and containerization, to personally-owned devices accessing corporate data.
controls.test_criteria: Review MDM enrollment and policy enforcement for BYOD devices.
controls.evidence_requirement: MDM policy configuration, enrolled device list.

controls.title: Secure Disposal of Information Assets
controls.description: Securely sanitize or destroy media and assets containing sensitive information before disposal or reuse.
controls.test_criteria: Review disposal and destruction records for sampled assets.
controls.evidence_requirement: Media sanitization/destruction certificates.

controls.title: Payment Systems and Electronic Banking Security
controls.description: Apply specific security controls to payment systems, ATM/POS networks, and electronic/mobile banking channels.
controls.test_criteria: Review security control configuration for payment and e-banking platforms.
controls.evidence_requirement: Payment system security assessment, e-banking channel configuration review.

controls.title: Cyber Security Event and Incident Management
controls.description: Monitor for security events and operate a formal incident response process, including notification to SAMA where required.
controls.test_criteria: Review SOC monitoring coverage and sample incident handling records for timeliness.
controls.evidence_requirement: SOC monitoring logs, incident response plan, SAMA notification records.

controls.title: Threat and Vulnerability Management
controls.description: Conduct threat intelligence gathering and periodic vulnerability assessments/penetration testing with remediation tracking.
controls.test_criteria: Review vulnerability scan schedules and remediation SLA compliance.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vulnerability scan reports, penetration test reports, remediation tracker.

controls.title: Third-Party and Outsourcing Risk Management
controls.description: Assess and contractually manage cyber security risk from vendors, outsourcing arrangements, and service providers.
controls.test_criteria: Review the third-party risk assessment process and contract security clauses for critical vendors.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vendor risk assessments, outsourcing agreements with security requirements.

controls.title: Cloud Computing Security
controls.description: Apply specific due diligence and security requirements before and during use of cloud computing services.
controls.test_criteria: Review the cloud security risk assessment and contractual/configuration controls for cloud services.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cloud risk assessment, cloud service agreement security terms, cloud configuration review.

name: ISO 27701:2019
description: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 is an extension to ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27002 that specifies requirements and guidance for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving a Privacy Information Management System (PIMS); published by ISO/IEC, it is used by organizations to demonstrate compliance with privacy laws such as the GDPR in either or both of the roles of PII controller and PII processor.
notes: Reflects the 2019 edition's structure (Clauses 5-8 plus Annexes A and B, mapped to ISO 27001:2013/ISO 27002:2013 Annex A). A later edition realigned to ISO 27001:2022's restructured Annex A was anticipated in the market, but this entry specifically targets the original 2019 edition as requested.

controls.title: PIMS Requirements (ISO 27001 Extension)
controls.description: Extends the ISO 27001 ISMS requirements (context, leadership, planning, support, operation, performance evaluation, improvement) to explicitly address privacy risk and the organization's role(s) as PII controller and/or PII processor.
controls.test_criteria: Review the PIMS scope statement and evidence that privacy risk assessment is integrated into the ISMS risk process.
controls.evidence_requirement: PIMS scope document, integrated risk assessment records, management review minutes covering privacy.

controls.title: Information Security Policies for Privacy
controls.description: Extend information security policies to explicitly address privacy objectives and PII protection requirements.
controls.test_criteria: Review the policy set for privacy-specific content and approval.
controls.evidence_requirement: Policy documents referencing PII protection.

controls.title: Asset Management for PII
controls.description: Identify and classify information assets that store or process PII.
controls.test_criteria: Review the asset inventory for PII classification tagging.
controls.evidence_requirement: Asset register with PII classification field.

controls.title: Access Control for PII
controls.description: Restrict access to PII based on need-to-know and defined roles.
controls.test_criteria: Review access control lists for systems/repositories holding PII.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control matrix, periodic access review records.

controls.title: Cryptography for PII Protection
controls.description: Apply cryptographic controls to protect PII in storage and transit where appropriate.
controls.test_criteria: Review encryption configuration for PII data stores and transmission paths.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cryptography standard, encryption configuration evidence.

controls.title: Physical and Environmental Security for PII
controls.description: Protect physical locations and media where PII is processed or stored.
controls.test_criteria: Review physical access controls for facilities/media holding PII.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access logs, media handling procedure.

controls.title: Operations Security for PII
controls.description: Apply secure operating procedures, logging, and malware protection to systems that process PII.
controls.test_criteria: Review operational security controls and logging configuration for PII-processing systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Operations security procedures, system logs.

controls.title: Supplier Relationships for PII
controls.description: Manage privacy risk arising from suppliers and processors handling PII, including contractual clauses.
controls.test_criteria: Review supplier contracts for PII processing clauses and supplier risk assessments.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data processing agreements, supplier due diligence records.

controls.title: Incident Management for PII Breaches
controls.description: Extend security incident management to detect, assess, and respond to PII breaches, including notification processes.
controls.test_criteria: Review the incident response procedure for PII-breach-specific steps.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, sample breach incident records.

controls.title: Compliance for Privacy
controls.description: Identify and comply with applicable privacy laws, regulations, and contractual requirements.
controls.test_criteria: Review the legal/regulatory register for privacy obligations and supporting compliance evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy compliance register, legal review records.

controls.title: Conditions for Collection and Processing (Controller)
controls.description: Identify and document the lawful basis, purpose, and conditions for collecting and processing PII as a controller.
controls.category: Additional Guidance for PII Controllers (Annex A)
controls.test_criteria: Review ROPA entries for documented lawful basis.
controls.evidence_requirement: Record of Processing Activities, lawful basis assessments.

controls.title: Obligations to PII Principals (Controller)
controls.description: Provide notice, enable consent and withdrawal, and support data subject rights (access, correction, deletion, objection) as a controller.
controls.category: Additional Guidance for PII Controllers (Annex A)
controls.test_criteria: Sample data subject request handling for timeliness and completeness.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy notices, DSAR log and responses.

controls.title: Privacy by Design and by Default (Controller)
controls.description: Embed privacy considerations and data minimization into system and process design by default.
controls.category: Additional Guidance for PII Controllers (Annex A)
controls.test_criteria: Review the privacy impact assessment process applied to new projects.
controls.evidence_requirement: PIA/DPIA records, privacy-by-design checklist.

controls.title: PII Sharing, Transfer, and Disclosure (Controller)
controls.description: Control and document disclosures or transfers of PII to third parties or across borders.
controls.category: Additional Guidance for PII Controllers (Annex A)
controls.test_criteria: Review the third-party disclosure log and cross-border transfer mechanisms.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data sharing agreements, transfer impact assessments.

controls.title: Conditions for Collection and Processing (Processor)
controls.description: Process PII only per documented instructions from the controller and within the defined contractual scope.
controls.category: Additional Guidance for PII Processors (Annex B)
controls.test_criteria: Review processing activities against controller instructions and the contract scope.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data processing agreement, instruction records.

controls.title: Obligations to PII Principals (Processor)
controls.description: Assist the controller in fulfilling data subject rights requests and provide required information promptly.
controls.category: Additional Guidance for PII Processors (Annex B)
controls.test_criteria: Review the processor's process for supporting controller DSAR fulfillment.
controls.evidence_requirement: DSAR support procedure, sample assistance records.

controls.title: Privacy by Design and by Default (Processor)
controls.description: Apply privacy-protective default configurations and data minimization in services provided to controllers.
controls.category: Additional Guidance for PII Processors (Annex B)
controls.test_criteria: Review the default configuration settings of the processor's systems/services.
controls.evidence_requirement: Default configuration documentation, service specification.

controls.title: PII Sharing, Transfer, and Disclosure (Processor)
controls.description: Only sub-process or transfer PII with controller authorization and maintain a register of sub-processors.
controls.category: Additional Guidance for PII Processors (Annex B)
controls.test_criteria: Review sub-processor authorization records and the sub-processor register.
controls.evidence_requirement: Sub-processor list/register, controller authorization records.

name: TISAX V5.1
description: TISAX (Trusted Information Security Assessment Exchange), version 5.1, is the automotive industry's shared assessment and exchange mechanism, governed by the ENX Association and based on the VDA Information Security Assessment (ISA) questionnaire developed by the German Association of the Automotive Industry (VDA); it allows OEMs and suppliers to assess and share information security, prototype protection, and data protection (GDPR Art. 28) results without repeated individual audits.
notes: VDA ISA 5.1 was the catalog version in force before VDA ISA 6.0 (published October 2023, mandatory for new TISAX assessments from 1 April 2024). The top-level structure below reflects the well-documented VDA ISA pattern -- an ISO 27001/27002-aligned Information Security base catalog plus Prototype Protection and Data Protection modules -- but exact 5.1 question wording and numbering should be confirmed against the archived official ENX/VDA ISA 5.1 PDF, which this research session could not directly retrieve.

controls.title: Information Security Policies
controls.description: Establish, approve, and communicate a set of information security policies covering the organization's security objectives and requirements.
controls.test_criteria: Review policy approval and distribution/acknowledgment evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Approved ISMS policy documents, distribution/acknowledgment records.

controls.title: Organization of Information Security
controls.description: Define information security roles, responsibilities, and governance structure, including segregation of duties.
controls.test_criteria: Review the organizational chart and role/responsibility assignments for security governance.
controls.evidence_requirement: Organizational chart, RACI/responsibility matrix.

controls.title: Human Resources Security
controls.description: Apply security screening, confidentiality agreements, and security training/awareness throughout the employment lifecycle.
controls.test_criteria: Review HR security procedures and training records against the employment lifecycle.
controls.evidence_requirement: Screening records, confidentiality agreements, security awareness training logs.

controls.title: Asset Management
controls.description: Identify, classify, and manage information assets, including those handling OEM-shared or prototype-related information.
controls.test_criteria: Review the asset inventory and classification scheme for completeness.
controls.evidence_requirement: Asset register, information classification policy.

controls.title: Physical and Environmental Security
controls.description: Protect facilities, work areas, and equipment handling sensitive information with physical access controls.
controls.test_criteria: Review physical access control configuration and visitor management records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access logs, visitor log, facility security procedures.

controls.title: IT Security / Operations Security
controls.description: Secure IT systems and networks through hardening, malware protection, backup, and logging.
controls.test_criteria: Review system hardening baselines and backup/logging configuration.
controls.evidence_requirement: Hardening standards, backup logs, system/security logs.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Implement identity and access management with least privilege and periodic access review.
controls.test_criteria: Review access provisioning and recertification records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, access review logs.

controls.title: Cryptography
controls.description: Apply encryption standards to protect confidential information, including shared development and engineering data.
controls.test_criteria: Review the cryptography standard and key management practices against deployed configuration.
controls.evidence_requirement: Encryption policy, key management records.

controls.title: Supplier and Third-Party Relationships
controls.description: Manage information security risk from suppliers and sub-contractors with access to shared information.
controls.test_criteria: Review supplier security requirements and supplier assessment records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Supplier security agreements, supplier risk assessment records.

controls.title: Incident Management
controls.description: Detect, report, and respond to information security incidents, including notifying affected OEM/business partners where required.
controls.test_criteria: Review the incident response procedure and sample incident records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, incident log, partner notification records.

controls.title: Business Continuity Management
controls.description: Maintain and test continuity/disaster recovery plans for critical systems and information.
controls.test_criteria: Review the BCP/DR plan and the most recent test results.
controls.evidence_requirement: BCP/DR documentation, test exercise reports.

controls.title: Compliance
controls.description: Identify and comply with applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual information security obligations.
controls.test_criteria: Review the compliance obligation register and internal/external audit results.
controls.evidence_requirement: Compliance register, internal/external audit reports.

controls.title: Prototype and Component Physical Protection
controls.description: Apply physical security controls (secure storage, camouflage, restricted access) to protect prototype vehicles, components, and pre-release information from unauthorized disclosure.
controls.test_criteria: Review physical security measures at facilities handling prototypes.
controls.evidence_requirement: Prototype storage access logs, camouflage/handling procedures.

controls.title: Protection During Transport, Events, and Media Activities
controls.description: Control exposure of prototypes during transport, test drives, trade shows, and photo/video shoots, including non-disclosure and media release controls.
controls.test_criteria: Review event/transport security procedures and verify NDA coverage for participants.
controls.evidence_requirement: Event security plans, signed NDAs, photo/video release approval records.

controls.title: Secure Handling of Prototype-Related Information
controls.description: Restrict and track access to documentation, digital files, and communications related to prototype vehicles and components.
controls.test_criteria: Review access controls and distribution tracking for prototype-related information repositories.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control lists for prototype data repositories, distribution/tracking logs.

controls.title: Data Protection Management (Processor Obligations)
controls.description: Implement data protection management measures addressing GDPR Article 28 processor obligations when processing personal data on behalf of an OEM or business partner, including a designated data protection contact and documented processing procedures.
controls.test_criteria: Review data processing agreement compliance and the designated privacy contact assignment.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data processing agreement, privacy/data protection procedure documentation, designated contact record.

name: CIS V8.1
description: CIS Critical Security Controls version 8.1, published by the Center for Internet Security (CIS), is a prioritized set of 18 safeguard groupings (controls) distilling real-world attack data into defensive actions for enterprise cybersecurity programs. It is a voluntary best-practice framework, widely used as a baseline for assessments, cyber insurance, and mappings to other standards (NIST CSF 2.0, ISO 27001).
notes: v8.1 (released June 2024) keeps the same 18 Controls and 153 Safeguards as v8.0 (no renumbering or safeguard count change); the update adds explicit Governance-themed safeguards/recommendations per control, revises asset-type classifications, clarifies some safeguard wording, and adds mapping to NIST CSF 2.0 (including the new GOVERN function). Implementation Group (IG1/IG2/IG3) tiering is unchanged.

controls.title: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
controls.description: Actively manage (inventory, track, and correct) all end-user devices, network devices, IoT devices, and servers connected to the infrastructure, physically or remotely, to know what needs to be monitored and protected.
controls.test_criteria: Verify an authoritative, current asset inventory exists, is reconciled against active DHCP/network discovery scans, and unauthorized assets are detected and remediated or removed within a defined SLA.
controls.evidence_requirement: Asset inventory export, network discovery/scan logs, DHCP logs, unauthorized-asset remediation tickets.

controls.title: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
controls.description: Actively manage all software (operating systems and applications) on the network so that only authorized software is installed and executed, and unauthorized/unmanaged software is found and prevented or removed.
controls.test_criteria: Review software inventory tooling output and allowlisting/denylisting configuration; confirm unauthorized software is flagged and removed within SLA.
controls.evidence_requirement: Software inventory reports, application allowlist policy and logs, removal/remediation tickets.

controls.title: Data Protection
controls.description: Develop processes and technical controls to identify, classify, securely handle, retain, and dispose of data based on sensitivity, including encryption of data at rest and in transit.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm a data classification scheme exists, sensitive data flows are mapped, encryption is enforced on identified data stores, and retention/disposal schedules are followed with evidence of destruction.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data classification policy, data flow diagrams, encryption configuration exports, data retention/disposal logs.

controls.title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
controls.description: Establish and maintain secure configuration baselines (hardening standards) for enterprise assets and software, and manage configuration change control to prevent drift.
controls.test_criteria: Compare a sample of production assets against the documented hardening baseline (e.g., CIS Benchmarks) using automated configuration scanning; verify deviations are tracked and remediated.
controls.evidence_requirement: Hardening baseline documents, configuration scan/compliance reports, change-control tickets for exceptions.

controls.title: Account Management
controls.description: Use processes and tools to assign and manage authorization for user, administrator, and service accounts, including creation, use, and timely deactivation.
controls.test_criteria: Sample account creation/termination tickets against HR events; verify joiner/mover/leaver timeliness and periodic account review evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Account provisioning/deprovisioning tickets, access review attestations, service account inventory.

controls.title: Access Control Management
controls.description: Use processes and tools to create, assign, manage, and revoke access credentials and privileges for users, administrators, and service accounts based on least privilege and MFA requirements.
controls.test_criteria: Verify MFA enforcement on remote/administrative access, review role-based access assignments, and confirm access revocation upon role change or termination.
controls.evidence_requirement: MFA enforcement configuration, RBAC matrix, access revocation logs/tickets.

controls.title: Continuous Vulnerability Management
controls.description: Develop a plan to continuously assess and track vulnerabilities on all enterprise assets to remediate and minimize the window of opportunity for attackers.
controls.test_criteria: Review vulnerability scan cadence and coverage, and sample critical/high findings to confirm remediation within defined SLAs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vulnerability scan reports, remediation SLA policy, patch/remediation tickets.

controls.title: Audit Log Management
controls.description: Collect, alert, review, and retain audit logs of events that could help detect, understand, or recover from an attack.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm logging is enabled on in-scope systems, logs are centrally aggregated, retained per policy, and reviewed/alerted on a defined cadence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Log source inventory, SIEM configuration, log retention settings, log review/alert records.

controls.title: Email and Web Browser Protections
controls.description: Improve protections and detections of threats from email and web vectors, which attackers exploit to manipulate user behavior through direct engagement.
controls.test_criteria: Verify email filtering/anti-phishing controls (DMARC/SPF/DKIM, attachment sandboxing) and browser security controls (DNS filtering, extension restrictions) are enabled and monitored.
controls.evidence_requirement: Email security gateway configuration, DMARC/SPF/DKIM records, browser policy configuration, phishing simulation results.

controls.title: Malware Defenses
controls.description: Prevent or control the installation, spread, and execution of malicious applications, code, or scripts on enterprise assets.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm anti-malware/EDR deployment coverage across endpoints and servers, signature/behavioral update currency, and alert response evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: EDR/AV deployment and coverage reports, update logs, malware incident tickets.

controls.title: Data Recovery
controls.description: Establish and maintain data recovery practices sufficient to restore in-scope enterprise assets to a pre-incident, trusted state.
controls.test_criteria: Review backup schedules, scope, and encryption, and verify periodic restoration/recovery tests are performed and documented.
controls.evidence_requirement: Backup policy and job logs, restoration test reports, backup encryption configuration.

controls.title: Network Infrastructure Management
controls.description: Establish, implement, and actively manage network devices to prevent attackers from exploiting vulnerable network services and access points.
controls.test_criteria: Review network device inventory, secure configuration baselines, firmware patch status, and network segmentation evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network diagrams, device configuration backups, firmware patch records, segmentation/firewall rule reviews.

controls.title: Network Monitoring and Defense
controls.description: Operate processes and tooling to establish and maintain comprehensive network monitoring and defense against security threats across the enterprise's network infrastructure and user base.
controls.test_criteria: Verify IDS/IPS and network traffic monitoring coverage, alert triage process, and evidence of escalation for anomalous activity.
controls.evidence_requirement: NDR/IDS-IPS configuration and alert logs, SOC triage/escalation records.

controls.title: Security Awareness and Skills Training
controls.description: Establish and maintain a security awareness program to influence behavior among the workforce to be security conscious and properly skilled to reduce risk.
controls.test_criteria: Review training completion records for all personnel (including role-specific training for privileged users/developers) against defined frequency.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training curriculum, completion/attestation records, phishing simulation training follow-up.

controls.title: Service Provider Management
controls.description: Develop a process to evaluate service providers that hold sensitive data or are responsible for critical IT platforms or processes, to ensure they are protecting those platforms and data appropriately.
