controls.test_criteria: Review vendor inventory and risk classification, due-diligence/security assessment evidence, and contractual security requirements.
controls.evidence_requirement: Third-party inventory, vendor risk assessments, signed contracts/DPAs with security clauses.

controls.title: Application Software Security
controls.description: Manage the security life cycle of in-house developed, hosted, or acquired software to prevent, detect, and remediate security weaknesses before they can impact the enterprise.
controls.test_criteria: Review secure SDLC documentation, SAST/DAST scan results on in-scope applications, and remediation tracking for identified vulnerabilities.
controls.evidence_requirement: SDLC policy, SAST/DAST/dependency scan reports, vulnerability remediation tickets.

controls.title: Incident Response Management
controls.description: Establish a program to develop and maintain an incident response capability (policies, plans, procedures, roles) to prepare, detect, and quickly respond to attacks.
controls.test_criteria: Review the incident response plan, confirm defined roles/contacts, and verify evidence of at least annual tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews.
controls.evidence_requirement: IR plan, tabletop exercise reports, incident tickets and post-mortems.

controls.title: Penetration Testing
controls.description: Test the effectiveness and resiliency of enterprise assets through identifying and exploiting weaknesses in controls (people, processes, technology) and simulating an attacker's actions.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm penetration testing is performed at a defined cadence by qualified testers, and findings are tracked to remediation with retesting.
controls.evidence_requirement: Penetration test reports, remediation tracking, retest confirmation.

name: PCI DSS V4.0.1
description: The Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard, version 4.0.1, is maintained by the PCI Security Standards Council (founded by the major card brands) and sets mandatory technical and operational requirements for any entity that stores, processes, or transmits cardholder data or sensitive authentication data.
notes: v4.0.1 (June 2024) is a limited errata/clarification release of v4.0 (March 2022) — no new or renumbered requirements. v4.0 retired Dec 31, 2024, making v4.0.1 the only currently supported version. Many v4.0 requirements have a future-dated effective date of March 31, 2025, for new requirements that were previously 'best practice'.

controls.title: Install and Maintain Network Security Controls
controls.description: Define and implement network security controls (firewalls and equivalent) that restrict inbound and outbound traffic to only that which is necessary, and maintain accurate network diagrams.
controls.test_criteria: Inspect NSC rulesets against documented business justification, review network/data-flow diagrams for accuracy, and confirm quarterly rule reviews.
controls.evidence_requirement: Firewall/NSC rule configurations, network and data-flow diagrams, rule review records.

controls.title: Apply Secure Configurations to All System Components
controls.description: Change vendor defaults (passwords, SNMP strings, accounts) and develop configuration standards for all system components to reduce the attack surface.
controls.test_criteria: Sample system components to confirm vendor defaults are changed and configuration matches documented hardening standards.
controls.evidence_requirement: Configuration standards, build/hardening checklists, sampled system configuration exports.

controls.title: Protect Stored Account Data
controls.description: Keep cardholder data storage to a minimum, mask PAN when displayed, and render stored account data unreadable (e.g., strong cryptography, truncation, tokenization) with documented key management.
controls.test_criteria: Review data retention/disposal policy and PAN storage locations via discovery tooling, and inspect encryption/key management procedures.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data retention policy, PAN discovery/scan results, encryption and key management documentation.

controls.title: Protect Cardholder Data with Strong Cryptography During Transmission Over Open, Public Networks
controls.description: Use strong cryptography and security protocols to safeguard cardholder data during transmission over open, public networks.
controls.test_criteria: Review TLS configuration on transmission channels, confirm deprecated protocols/ciphers are disabled, and inspect certificate management.
controls.evidence_requirement: TLS/cipher-suite configuration scans, certificate inventory, network diagrams showing transmission paths.

controls.title: Protect All Systems and Networks from Malicious Software
controls.description: Deploy anti-malware solutions on all systems commonly affected by malware and keep them current, actively running, and generating audit logs.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm anti-malware deployment coverage, update frequency, and periodic evaluation of systems not traditionally considered at risk.
controls.evidence_requirement: Anti-malware deployment/coverage reports, update logs, periodic risk evaluation records.

controls.title: Develop and Maintain Secure Systems and Software
controls.description: Identify and manage vulnerabilities through patching, follow secure software development practices, and protect public-facing web applications (e.g., WAF or equivalent).
controls.test_criteria: Review patch management records against vendor-published critical patch timelines and inspect secure SDLC/code review evidence and WAF configuration.
controls.evidence_requirement: Patch management logs, secure coding/SDLC policy, code review records, WAF logs/configuration.

controls.title: Restrict Access to System Components and Cardholder Data by Business Need to Know
controls.description: Limit access to system components and cardholder data to only those individuals whose job requires such access, based on least privilege and role-based access control.
controls.test_criteria: Sample user access to CDE systems and compare to documented job role and least-privilege access control lists.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control matrix/RBAC documentation, access review records, sampled user access listings.

controls.title: Identify Users and Authenticate Access to System Components
controls.description: Assign unique IDs to each person with access, implement strong authentication (including MFA for all access into the CDE), and manage credential lifecycle.
controls.test_criteria: Verify unique user IDs (no shared accounts), MFA enforcement for CDE and remote access, and password/credential policy compliance.
controls.evidence_requirement: User ID listing, MFA configuration evidence, password policy settings, account lifecycle records.

controls.title: Restrict Physical Access to Cardholder Data
controls.description: Implement physical security controls to limit and monitor physical access to systems, media, and facilities that house cardholder data.
controls.test_criteria: Observe physical access controls at facilities/data centers, review visitor logs and badge access records, and inspect media handling/destruction procedures.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access logs, visitor logs, media inventory and destruction certificates.

controls.title: Log and Monitor All Access to System Components and Cardholder Data
controls.description: Implement audit logging mechanisms for all system components and track and monitor all access to CDE systems and cardholder data.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm audit logging is enabled per requirement on all in-scope components, logs are reviewed daily (or via automated mechanism), and retained for at least 12 months.
controls.evidence_requirement: Audit log configuration, daily log review records, log retention evidence (12 months, 3 immediately available).

controls.title: Test Security of Systems and Networks Regularly
controls.description: Regularly test security systems and processes, including wireless access point scans, internal/external vulnerability scans, and penetration testing (segmentation testing where applicable).
controls.test_criteria: Review quarterly ASV scan results (passing), internal scan results, and annual (or more frequent) penetration test reports including segmentation testing.
controls.evidence_requirement: ASV scan reports, internal vulnerability scan reports, penetration test reports, segmentation test results.

controls.title: Support Information Security with Organizational Policies and Programs
controls.description: Maintain an organization-wide information security policy, formal risk assessment process, incident response plan, and third-party service provider management program.
controls.test_criteria: Review the published information security policy, annual risk assessment, incident response plan with test evidence, and TPSP due-diligence/monitoring records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security policy, risk assessment documentation, IR plan and test records, TPSP (service provider) agreements and PCI compliance attestations.

name: NIST 800-171 (Revision 3)
description: NIST Special Publication 800-171, Revision 3 (final, May 2024), issued by the U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology, specifies security requirements for protecting the confidentiality of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) when it resides in nonfederal systems and organizations, such as government contractors.
notes: Rev 3 restructured from 14 to 17 control families by adding Planning (PL), System and Services Acquisition (SA), and Supply Chain Risk Management (SR), and renamed 3.12 'Security Assessment' to 'Security Assessment and Monitoring' (CA). Note: as of this writing, DoD's CMMC program still references Rev 2; organizations should confirm which revision a given contract requires.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Limit system access to authorized users, processes, and devices, and to the types of transactions and functions authorized users are permitted to exercise, enforcing least privilege and session controls.
controls.test_criteria: Review account provisioning records, access control lists, and session lock/termination configuration against least-privilege design.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, account listings, system configuration screenshots, access review logs.

controls.title: Awareness and Training
controls.description: Ensure managers, system administrators, and users are made aware of security risks and trained to carry out assigned information-security duties, including role-based training for insider threat and CUI handling.
controls.test_criteria: Review training curricula and completion records for general and role-based (privileged user) audiences.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training materials, completion/attestation records.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.description: Create, protect, and retain system audit logs and records to enable monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized activity, and ensure individual accountability.
controls.test_criteria: Review audit log content/coverage, log protection (access restrictions), and retention against policy.
controls.evidence_requirement: Audit log policy, log configuration exports, log retention records.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.description: Establish and maintain baseline configurations and inventories of systems, and control changes to systems throughout their lifecycle using change control procedures.
controls.test_criteria: Compare current configurations to approved baselines and sample change requests for authorization/testing evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Configuration baseline documents, change control tickets, configuration audit reports.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.description: Identify system users, processes, and devices, and authenticate (or verify) their identities as a prerequisite to allowing access, including multifactor authentication for privileged and remote access.
controls.test_criteria: Verify unique identifiers are assigned and MFA is enforced for privileged/remote/network access.
controls.evidence_requirement: Identity management policy, MFA configuration evidence, authenticator management records.

controls.title: Incident Response
controls.description: Establish an operational incident-handling capability (preparation, detection, analysis, containment, recovery, and user response activities) and track, document, and report incidents.
controls.test_criteria: Review the incident response plan, sample incident tickets for handling steps, and verify reporting to required authorities occurred where applicable.
controls.evidence_requirement: IR plan, incident logs/tickets, after-action/lessons-learned reports.

controls.title: Maintenance
controls.description: Perform periodic and timely maintenance on systems and provide effective controls on tools, techniques, mechanisms, and personnel used for maintenance, including remote maintenance.
controls.test_criteria: Review maintenance logs and controls over remote maintenance sessions (approval, monitoring, termination).
controls.evidence_requirement: Maintenance records/logs, remote maintenance session logs and approvals.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.description: Protect system media containing CUI, both paper and digital, limit access to authorized users, and sanitize or destroy media before disposal or reuse.
controls.test_criteria: Review media handling procedures, sampled media inventory, and sanitization/destruction certificates.
controls.evidence_requirement: Media protection policy, media inventory, sanitization/destruction logs.

controls.title: Personnel Security
controls.description: Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to systems containing CUI, and ensure CUI and systems are protected during and after personnel actions such as terminations and transfers.
controls.test_criteria: Sample personnel files for screening records and verify timely access revocation upon termination/transfer.
controls.evidence_requirement: Screening records, termination/transfer checklists, access revocation logs.

controls.title: Physical Protection
controls.description: Limit physical access to systems, equipment, and operating environments to authorized individuals, and protect and monitor the physical facility and support infrastructure.
controls.test_criteria: Observe physical access controls, review visitor logs, and verify monitoring of facility access points.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access logs, visitor logs, facility monitoring records.

controls.title: Planning
controls.description: Develop, document, periodically update, and implement system security plans (SSPs) that describe the boundaries, environment, and security requirements implementation for systems processing CUI.
controls.test_criteria: Review the SSP for completeness and currency, and verify it is updated upon significant system changes.
controls.evidence_requirement: System Security Plan (SSP), SSP review/update history.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: Periodically assess the risk to organizational operations, assets, and individuals from the operation of systems and processing of CUI, including vulnerability scanning.
controls.test_criteria: Review the risk assessment methodology, latest assessment results, and vulnerability scanning cadence/remediation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk assessment reports, vulnerability scan results, remediation tracking.

controls.title: Security Assessment and Monitoring
controls.description: Periodically assess security controls to determine effectiveness, develop plans of action to correct deficiencies, and continuously monitor controls to maintain system security authorization.
controls.test_criteria: Review control assessment results, POA&Ms (plans of action and milestones), and continuous monitoring evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Security assessment reports, POA&M tracker, continuous monitoring dashboards/reports.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.description: Monitor, control, and protect communications at external and key internal boundaries, and employ architectural designs and techniques (e.g., encryption, network segmentation) that promote effective information security.
controls.test_criteria: Review network boundary protection devices, segmentation design, and encryption configuration for CUI in transit.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network architecture diagrams, boundary device configurations, encryption configuration evidence.

controls.title: System and Information Integrity
controls.description: Identify, report, and correct system flaws in a timely manner, provide protection from malicious code, and monitor system security alerts and advisories, taking appropriate action.
controls.test_criteria: Review patch management timelines against identified flaws, anti-malware deployment, and monitoring/alerting response records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Patch management records, anti-malware configuration, security alert/advisory response logs.

controls.title: System and Services Acquisition
controls.description: Allocate resources to protect systems as part of the system development life cycle, apply security engineering principles, and ensure third-party developed/acquired systems meet security requirements.
controls.test_criteria: Review SDLC documentation for security integration, and acquisition/contract language requiring security requirements of developers and vendors.
controls.evidence_requirement: SDLC policy, acquisition contracts/security requirements documentation.

controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Management
controls.description: Develop and implement a supply chain risk management plan, including identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks from suppliers and the products/services they provide.
controls.test_criteria: Review the supply chain risk management plan, supplier risk assessments, and evidence of risk mitigation for identified high-risk suppliers.
controls.evidence_requirement: Supply chain risk management plan, supplier risk assessments, mitigation tracking records.

name: ISO 22301:2019
description: ISO 22301:2019, published by the International Organization for Standardization, is a management system standard specifying requirements to plan, establish, implement, operate, monitor, review, maintain, and continually improve a documented Business Continuity Management System (BCMS), and is the basis for third-party BCMS certification.
notes: Top-level structure follows the common ISO management-system High-Level Structure (clauses 4-10); clause 8 (Operation), which carries the substantive BC content (BIA, risk assessment, strategy, plans, exercising), is broken into its named subclauses below for assessable granularity, consistent with how certification bodies audit it.

controls.title: Context of the Organization
controls.description: Determine external and internal issues, interested parties and their requirements, and the scope of the BCMS relevant to the organization's purpose.
controls.test_criteria: Review documented context analysis, interested party register, and BCMS scope statement for completeness and currency.
controls.evidence_requirement: Context/issues register, interested parties analysis, documented BCMS scope.

controls.title: Leadership
controls.description: Top management must demonstrate leadership and commitment to the BCMS, establish a business continuity policy, and assign organizational roles, responsibilities, and authorities.
controls.test_criteria: Review the approved BC policy, leadership commitment evidence (e.g., management review attendance), and roles/responsibilities documentation.
controls.evidence_requirement: BC policy, organization chart/RACI for BCMS roles, management commitment records.

controls.title: Planning
controls.description: Address risks and opportunities affecting the BCMS, establish business continuity objectives and plans to achieve them, and plan for changes to the BCMS.
controls.test_criteria: Review documented BC objectives, action plans to achieve them, and change management records for the BCMS.
controls.evidence_requirement: BC objectives documentation, risk/opportunity register, change management records.

controls.title: Support
controls.description: Provide the resources, competence, awareness, communication, and documented information needed to establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve the BCMS.
controls.test_criteria: Review resource allocation, competence/training records, communication plan, and document control records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training records, communication plan, document control log, resource budget/allocation records.

controls.title: Operational Planning and Control
controls.description: Plan, implement, and control the processes needed to meet BCMS requirements and implement the actions determined in clause 6.
controls.test_criteria: Review operational planning documentation and evidence that planned actions were implemented and controlled.
controls.evidence_requirement: Operational planning records, process documentation.

controls.title: Business Impact Analysis and Risk Assessment
controls.description: Establish, implement, and maintain a formal process for business impact analysis (BIA) and risk assessment to determine priority activities, impact tolerances, recovery time objectives, and risks of disruption.
controls.test_criteria: Review the BIA methodology and latest BIA results, confirming prioritized activities, RTOs/RPOs, and dependency mapping; review risk assessment results.
controls.evidence_requirement: BIA reports, risk assessment reports, RTO/RPO documentation.

controls.title: Business Continuity Strategies and Solutions
controls.description: Determine and select business continuity strategies and solutions based on BIA and risk assessment outputs, considering resource requirements to implement selected strategies.
controls.test_criteria: Review documented strategy options considered, selection rationale, and resource plans supporting selected strategies.
controls.evidence_requirement: BC strategy documentation, resource requirement plans.

controls.title: Business Continuity Plans and Procedures
controls.description: Document business continuity plans and procedures detailing how the organization will manage a disruption and resume/recover prioritized activities, including incident response structure.
controls.test_criteria: Review BC plans for completeness (roles, activation criteria, communication trees, recovery procedures) and currency.
controls.evidence_requirement: Business continuity plans, incident response structure documentation, plan review/update history.

controls.title: Exercising and Testing
controls.description: Exercise and test business continuity plans and procedures periodically to ensure they are consistent with business continuity objectives and validate capability of the organization to respond effectively.
controls.test_criteria: Review exercise schedule, exercise reports, and evidence that identified gaps were tracked to remediation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Exercise/test schedule, exercise reports, post-exercise action trackers.

controls.title: Evaluation of Business Continuity Documentation and Capabilities
controls.description: Evaluate business continuity procedures and capabilities to ensure their continuing suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness.
controls.test_criteria: Review periodic evaluation records of BC documentation and capability assessments against changing business context.
controls.evidence_requirement: Evaluation reports, capability assessment records.

controls.title: Monitoring, Measurement, Analysis and Evaluation
controls.description: Determine what needs to be monitored and measured, and the methods for monitoring, measurement, analysis, and evaluation to ensure valid results of BCMS performance.
controls.test_criteria: Review defined BCMS metrics/KPIs, measurement records, and evaluation of results against objectives.
controls.evidence_requirement: BCMS performance metrics/KPI reports, measurement records.

controls.title: Internal Audit
controls.description: Conduct internal audits at planned intervals to determine whether the BCMS conforms to the organization's own requirements and ISO 22301, and is effectively implemented and maintained.
controls.test_criteria: Review the internal audit program, audit reports, and evidence of nonconformity follow-up.
controls.evidence_requirement: Internal audit schedule/program, audit reports, corrective action records.

controls.title: Management Review
controls.description: Top management must review the BCMS at planned intervals to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness.
controls.test_criteria: Review management review meeting minutes/inputs-outputs against the required agenda items in the standard.
controls.evidence_requirement: Management review minutes, inputs/outputs documentation.

controls.title: Nonconformity and Corrective Action
controls.description: React to nonconformities, evaluate the need for action to eliminate causes, implement corrective actions, and review their effectiveness.
controls.test_criteria: Sample nonconformities and verify root cause analysis, corrective action implementation, and effectiveness review.
controls.evidence_requirement: Nonconformity log, corrective action records, effectiveness review documentation.

controls.title: Continual Improvement
controls.description: Continually improve the suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the BCMS based on audit results, management review, and performance evaluation outputs.
controls.test_criteria: Review evidence linking audit/management review findings to implemented BCMS improvements over time.
controls.evidence_requirement: Continual improvement log/register, trend analysis of BCMS performance.

name: Cyber Resilience Act (CRA)
description: The EU Cyber Resilience Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/2847) is a horizontal EU regulation establishing mandatory cybersecurity requirements for the design, development, production, and lifecycle support of products with digital elements (hardware and software) placed on the EU market, enforced via CE marking, market surveillance authorities, and notified bodies.
notes: Entered into force Dec 2024; main obligations apply from Dec 11, 2027, with the Article 14 reporting obligation (actively exploited vulnerabilities/severe incidents to ENISA/CSIRT) applying earlier (from Sep 11, 2026). Sources disagree on exact sub-point counts within Annex I Part I (cited as 11-13 depending on grouping); the items below group Part I's product-property requirements and Part II's vulnerability-handling requirements at a top level consistent with the Official Journal text, and should be verified against the final Annex I text for sub-point-level detail.

controls.title: Risk-Based Secure Design
controls.description: Products with digital elements must be designed, developed, and produced to ensure an appropriate level of cybersecurity based on the risks, including a documented cybersecurity risk assessment.
controls.test_criteria: Review the product's cybersecurity risk assessment and verify design controls trace to identified risks.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cybersecurity risk assessment documentation, technical design records.

controls.title: No Known Exploitable Vulnerabilities at Placing on Market
controls.description: Products must be placed on the market without known exploitable vulnerabilities.
controls.test_criteria: Review vulnerability scan/pen-test results performed prior to release and confirm no known exploitable vulnerabilities remained open.
controls.evidence_requirement: Pre-release security testing reports, vulnerability remediation records.

controls.title: Secure by Default Configuration
controls.description: Products must be delivered with a secure-by-default configuration, including the possibility to reset the product to its original secure state.
controls.test_criteria: Review default configuration settings and verify a documented reset-to-secure-state capability exists.
controls.evidence_requirement: Default configuration documentation, reset/restore functionality test results.

controls.title: Protection from Unauthorized Access
controls.description: Ensure protection from unauthorized access by appropriate control mechanisms, including authentication and identity/access management, and report unauthorized access.
controls.test_criteria: Review authentication mechanisms implemented and verify unauthorized access detection/reporting capability.
controls.evidence_requirement: Authentication/access control design documentation, access logging evidence.

controls.title: Confidentiality Protection
controls.description: Protect the confidentiality of stored, transmitted, or otherwise processed data (personal or other) by state-of-the-art mechanisms, in particular encryption.
controls.test_criteria: Review encryption mechanisms applied to data at rest and in transit.
controls.evidence_requirement: Encryption design documentation, cryptographic configuration evidence.

controls.title: Integrity Protection
controls.description: Protect the integrity of stored, transmitted, or processed data, commands, programs, and configuration, including protection from unauthorized manipulation.
controls.test_criteria: Review integrity-protection mechanisms (e.g., signing, checksums) applied to data, commands, and configuration.
controls.evidence_requirement: Integrity control design documentation, code/firmware signing evidence.

controls.title: Data Minimization
controls.description: Process only data, personal or other, that is adequate, relevant, and limited to what is necessary for the intended purpose of the product ('appropriate data minimization').
controls.test_criteria: Review data processing inventory and confirm collected/processed data is mapped to a documented necessity for intended product function.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data processing/minimization assessment documentation.

controls.title: Availability Protection
controls.description: Protect the availability of essential functions, including resilience against and mitigation of denial-of-service attacks.
controls.test_criteria: Review DoS resilience testing results and availability design controls for essential functions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Availability/resilience test reports, architecture documentation.

controls.title: Minimize Negative Impact of Own Resource Consumption
controls.description: Minimize the negative impact of products and their components on the availability of services provided by other devices or networks.
controls.test_criteria: Review testing results assessing the product's network/resource footprint and impact on connected devices/networks.
controls.evidence_requirement: Resource consumption/impact test documentation.

controls.title: Attack Surface Minimization
controls.description: Be designed, developed, and produced to limit attack surfaces, including external interfaces.
controls.test_criteria: Review documented attack surface analysis and evidence that unnecessary interfaces/services are disabled by default.
controls.evidence_requirement: Attack surface analysis documentation, interface/service inventory.

controls.title: Exploitation Mitigation Techniques
controls.description: Be designed, developed, and produced to reduce the impact of an incident using appropriate exploitation mitigation mechanisms and techniques (e.g., memory-safe mitigations).
controls.test_criteria: Review implementation of exploitation mitigation techniques applied during development (e.g., ASLR, DEP, memory-safety tooling).
controls.evidence_requirement: Secure development documentation, compiler/toolchain hardening configuration evidence.

controls.title: Security-Relevant Logging
controls.description: Provide security-relevant information by recording and/or monitoring relevant internal activity, including access to data, services, and functions, with an opt-out where appropriate.
controls.test_criteria: Review logging functionality for security-relevant events and verify user controls (opt-out) where applicable.
controls.evidence_requirement: Logging design documentation, sample log output, user control/opt-out documentation.

controls.title: Vulnerability Remediation Mechanism
controls.description: Provide the ability to address vulnerabilities through security updates, including automatic updates where appropriate and user notification of available updates.
controls.test_criteria: Review the update mechanism design and verify automatic update capability and user notification functionality.
controls.evidence_requirement: Update mechanism design documentation, update notification test evidence.

controls.title: Vulnerability Handling Policy (SBOM)
controls.description: Identify and document vulnerabilities and components, including drawing up a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) covering at least top-level dependencies.
controls.test_criteria: Review the SBOM for completeness and currency against the shipped product version.
controls.evidence_requirement: SBOM documentation (e.g., SPDX/CycloneDX format), component inventory.

controls.title: Continuous Vulnerability Handling
controls.description: Address and remediate vulnerabilities without delay, including through security updates, throughout the expected product lifetime or support period.
controls.test_criteria: Review vulnerability handling process and sample remediation timelines against severity-based SLAs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vulnerability handling policy/process documentation, remediation tracking records.

controls.title: Effective and Regular Testing
controls.description: Apply effective and regular tests and reviews of the security of the product with digital elements.
controls.test_criteria: Review evidence of periodic security testing (e.g., scanning, fuzzing, penetration testing) throughout the support period.
controls.evidence_requirement: Security testing schedule and reports.

controls.title: Public Disclosure of Fixed Vulnerabilities
controls.description: Once a security update is available, publicly disclose information about fixed vulnerabilities, including a description, affected products, impact, severity, and remediation guidance.
controls.test_criteria: Review published security advisories against a sample of remediated vulnerabilities for required content and timeliness.
controls.evidence_requirement: Published security advisories/CVE records.

controls.title: Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure Policy
controls.description: Put in place and enforce a coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy.
controls.test_criteria: Review the published CVD policy for required elements (scope, process, timelines, safe-harbor language).
controls.evidence_requirement: Published coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy.

controls.title: Vulnerability Reporting Contact Point
controls.description: Take measures to facilitate the sharing of information about potential vulnerabilities, including providing a contact address for reporting and identifying/documenting vulnerabilities (including in third-party components).
controls.test_criteria: Verify a published, monitored vulnerability-reporting contact exists and intake tickets demonstrate timely acknowledgment.
controls.evidence_requirement: Published contact information, vulnerability intake/acknowledgment records.

controls.title: Secure Distribution of Updates
controls.description: Ensure security updates are disseminated without delay and free of charge, accompanied by advisory messages, and distributed securely (e.g., signed updates).
controls.test_criteria: Review update distribution mechanism for integrity/authenticity controls (signing) and confirm updates are provided free of charge during the support period.
controls.evidence_requirement: Update signing/distribution documentation, release notes/advisory messages.

controls.title: Incident and Vulnerability Reporting to ENISA/CSIRT
controls.description: Manufacturers must notify ENISA and the relevant CSIRT of any actively exploited vulnerability (within 24 hours early warning, 72-hour notification, 14-day final report) and any severe incident impacting the security of the product.
controls.test_criteria: Review incident/vulnerability reporting procedures and sample reporting timelines against the regulatory deadlines.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident/vulnerability reporting procedure, submitted ENISA/CSIRT notifications and timestamps.

controls.title: Conformity Assessment, Technical Documentation and CE Marking
controls.description: Manufacturers must perform the applicable conformity assessment procedure (self-assessment or third-party, based on product criticality class), draw up technical documentation, affix CE marking, and issue an EU declaration of conformity.
controls.test_criteria: Review the conformity assessment procedure followed, technical documentation file, and declaration of conformity for completeness.
controls.evidence_requirement: Technical documentation file, EU declaration of conformity, conformity assessment/certification records.

controls.title: Support Period and End-of-Life Disclosure
controls.description: Determine and disclose to users the support period during which security updates will be provided (minimum 5 years unless shorter expected product lifetime), and provide clear end-of-life information.
controls.test_criteria: Review published support period documentation against product lifecycle and confirm end-of-life notices are issued to users.
controls.evidence_requirement: Published support period/EOL policy, user notification records.

name: MAS TRM 2021
description: The Monetary Authority of Singapore's Technology Risk Management Guidelines (2021 revision) set out MAS's supervisory expectations for financial institutions' management of technology risk, covering governance, systems resilience, access and cryptographic controls, and cybersecurity operations; while not legally binding rules in themselves, non-observance factors into MAS's supervisory risk assessment of the institution.
notes: The guidelines are organized as thematic chapters rather than a numbered control catalog like ISO/NIST; the items below represent the main thematic chapters/domains as commonly referenced by assessors (e.g., Big 4 TRM readiness assessments), reconstructed from secondary analyses since the MAS PDF's own table of contents could not be directly retrieved. Users relying on this for formal MAS submissions should verify section numbering against the authoritative MAS PDF (mas.gov.sg).

controls.title: Technology Risk Governance and Oversight
controls.description: The Board and senior management are expected to oversee technology risk management, approve the technology risk management framework, and ensure adequate resources and a strong risk culture are in place.
controls.test_criteria: Review Board/senior management meeting minutes for technology risk oversight items and approval of the TRM framework.
controls.evidence_requirement: Board/risk committee minutes, approved TRM framework document.

controls.title: Technology Risk Management Framework
controls.description: Establish a sound and robust technology risk management framework comprising risk identification, assessment, treatment, and monitoring processes, including a technology risk appetite.
controls.test_criteria: Review the TRM framework document and sample risk register entries for consistency with the framework's methodology.
controls.evidence_requirement: TRM framework document, technology risk register, risk appetite statement.

controls.title: Management of IT Projects
controls.description: Implement a sound project management framework for IT projects, including project governance, requirements management, and testing prior to implementation.
controls.test_criteria: Sample IT project records for governance approvals, documented requirements, and test/UAT sign-off prior to go-live.
controls.evidence_requirement: Project governance documentation, UAT sign-off records.

controls.title: System Acquisition and Development
controls.description: Implement a secure system development life cycle (SDLC) covering security requirements, secure coding, code review, and security testing for systems developed or acquired.
controls.test_criteria: Review SDLC policy and sample development projects for security requirement documentation and testing evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: SDLC policy, security requirements documentation, code review/security test records.

controls.title: IT Service Management (Change and Problem Management)
controls.description: Implement robust change management and problem management processes to ensure changes to production systems are properly assessed, tested, approved, and implemented without undue risk.
controls.test_criteria: Sample change tickets for impact assessment, approval, testing, and rollback plan documentation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Change management policy, sampled change tickets, problem management records.

controls.title: IT Resilience and System Availability
controls.description: Design systems for high availability and resilience, establish recovery time/point objectives for critical systems, and maintain disaster recovery capabilities with regular testing.
controls.test_criteria: Review defined RTO/RPO for critical systems and evidence of DR test results meeting those objectives.
controls.evidence_requirement: RTO/RPO documentation, DR test reports.

controls.title: Data Centre Resilience and Operations
controls.description: Ensure data centers housing critical systems are designed with resilient power, cooling, and physical security, and are subject to capacity and environmental monitoring.
controls.test_criteria: Review data center design documentation, physical security controls, and environmental monitoring records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data center design/audit reports, physical security and environmental monitoring logs.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Implement strong access controls over systems and data based on the principle of least privilege, including privileged access management and periodic access reviews.
controls.test_criteria: Review privileged access management controls and sample periodic access review records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, PAM tool configuration, access review records.

controls.title: Cryptography
controls.description: Implement sound cryptographic key management practices and use industry-accepted cryptographic algorithms and key lengths to protect confidentiality and integrity of sensitive data.
controls.test_criteria: Review cryptographic standards adopted, key management procedures, and sample system configurations for algorithm/key-length compliance.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cryptography policy/standards, key management procedure documentation.

controls.title: Data Loss Prevention
controls.description: Implement measures to detect and prevent unauthorized exfiltration of sensitive data, including monitoring of data transfers and endpoint controls.
controls.test_criteria: Review DLP tool coverage, policy rules, and sample alert handling/incident records.
controls.evidence_requirement: DLP policy and tool configuration, DLP alert/incident records.

controls.title: Security Testing (Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing)
controls.description: Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing, including for internet-facing systems, with scenario-based testing (e.g., red teaming) for critical systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review VA/PT scope, cadence, and remediation tracking for identified findings.
controls.evidence_requirement: VA/PT reports, remediation tracking records.

controls.title: Cyber Security Operations and Incident Response
controls.description: Establish cyber security operations capability (monitoring, threat intelligence, SOC) and an incident response plan to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber incidents, with timely regulatory notification to MAS.
controls.test_criteria: Review SOC monitoring coverage, incident response plan, and sample incident records including MAS notification timelines.
controls.evidence_requirement: SOC monitoring/alert records, incident response plan, MAS incident notification records.

controls.title: Online Financial Services Security
controls.description: Implement security controls for internet banking and other online financial services, including transaction authentication, fraud monitoring, and customer security awareness measures.
controls.test_criteria: Review online banking authentication mechanisms, transaction monitoring rules, and customer awareness communications.
controls.evidence_requirement: Online services security design documentation, fraud monitoring alert records.

controls.title: IT Audit
controls.description: Establish an independent IT audit function to assess the adequacy of technology risk management, controls, and compliance with policies and the TRM framework.
controls.test_criteria: Review IT audit plan/scope, audit reports, and tracking of findings to remediation.
controls.evidence_requirement: IT audit plan, audit reports, finding remediation tracker.

controls.title: IT Outsourcing
controls.description: Conduct due diligence and ongoing oversight of outsourced technology service providers, including contractual security requirements and the right to audit.
controls.test_criteria: Review outsourcing risk assessments, contracts for required security/audit clauses, and ongoing vendor monitoring records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Outsourcing risk assessments, vendor contracts, vendor oversight/monitoring reports.

name: TISAX V6.0.3
description: TISAX (Trusted Information Security Assessment Exchange), governed by the ENX Association on behalf of the German Automotive Industry Association (VDA), is an assessment and exchange mechanism for information security in the automotive industry, based on the VDA Information Security Assessment (ISA) catalog, version 6.0.3.
notes: VDA ISA 6.0 (and maintenance release 6.0.3) replaced ISA 5.1 for TISAX assessments on contracts signed from April 1, 2024 (assessments on earlier contracts may still use 5.1). Key changes vs. 5.1: the 'Information Security' assessment objective/label is split into two separate labels — 'Confidentiality' and 'Availability' (the latter extending into production/OT, aligned with IEC 62443) — several controls were split and renumbered (e.g., legacy 1.6.1 divided into new 6.1.6/1.1.6; legacy 3.1.2 divided into 1.6.3/5.2.8/5.2.9), and the Data Protection module expanded from 4 to 12 controls. A documented control-by-control 6.0 to 6.0.3 changelog (vs. the 5.1-to-6.0 change) could not be independently verified in this research; TISAX is also scheduled to transition to a new 'ISA2027' catalog from January 1, 2027. Verify exact current clause numbering against the official ENX-published ISA 6.0.3 catalog before use in a live assessment.

controls.title: Information Security Policies and Organization
controls.description: Establish, approve, and communicate information security policies, and define an organizational structure with assigned information security roles and responsibilities, including segregation of duties.
controls.test_criteria: Review the published information security policy and organizational chart showing assigned security roles and segregation of duties.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security policy, organizational/RACI chart for security roles.

controls.title: Information Security Risk Management
controls.description: Establish a risk management process to identify, assess, and treat information security risks relevant to the organization and the information it processes on behalf of OEM/supplier partners.
controls.test_criteria: Review the risk management methodology and sample risk assessment/treatment records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk management policy, risk register, treatment plans.

controls.title: Human Resources Security
controls.description: Screen personnel prior to employment, ensure contracts include confidentiality/security obligations, and provide security awareness training throughout employment and upon termination.
controls.test_criteria: Sample personnel files for screening and confidentiality agreement evidence, and review training completion records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Screening/background check records, signed confidentiality agreements, training completion records.

controls.title: Asset Management
controls.description: Identify, classify, and manage information assets throughout their lifecycle, including an inventory of assets and acceptable use rules.
controls.test_criteria: Review asset inventory and classification scheme, and sample asset handling against acceptable-use policy.
controls.evidence_requirement: Asset inventory, classification scheme documentation, acceptable use policy.

controls.title: Physical and Environmental Security
controls.description: Implement physical security perimeters, entry controls, and environmental protections for facilities, offices, and secure areas (including prototype storage where applicable).
controls.test_criteria: Observe physical security controls and review access logs for secure areas.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical security policy, facility access logs, environmental control records.

controls.title: IT Security / Operations and Communications Security
controls.description: Implement controls over operational IT systems, networks, and communications, including malware protection, backup, logging, and network segmentation.
controls.test_criteria: Review network/system security configuration, backup schedules, and log management evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network architecture documentation, backup logs, security event logs.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Restrict access to information and systems based on business need and least privilege, including user registration, privileged access management, and periodic access review.
controls.test_criteria: Sample user access provisioning/review records against least-privilege design.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, access provisioning/review records.

controls.title: Cryptography
controls.description: Define and apply rules for the use of cryptographic controls to protect the confidentiality, authenticity, and integrity of information.
controls.test_criteria: Review cryptography policy and sample system configurations for compliant algorithm/key usage.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cryptography policy, key management documentation.

controls.title: Supplier and Third-Party Relationships
controls.description: Manage information security risk in relationships with suppliers and third parties (including sub-suppliers) through due diligence, contractual security requirements, and ongoing monitoring.
controls.test_criteria: Review supplier risk assessments and contracts for required security clauses.
controls.evidence_requirement: Supplier risk assessments, contracts/NDAs with security clauses.

controls.title: Information Security Incident Management
controls.description: Establish processes to detect, report, assess, and respond to information security incidents, including timely notification to affected business partners.
controls.test_criteria: Review the incident management process and sample incident records for timely detection, response, and partner notification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, incident log, partner notification records.

controls.title: Business Continuity Management
controls.description: Plan for and maintain the continuity of information security and critical business processes during disruptive incidents, including periodic plan testing.
controls.test_criteria: Review business continuity plans and evidence of periodic testing/exercising.
controls.evidence_requirement: Business continuity plan, exercise/test reports.

controls.title: Compliance
controls.description: Identify applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual information security requirements and conduct independent reviews/audits of compliance with the ISMS.
controls.test_criteria: Review the legal/regulatory requirements register and internal audit/compliance review records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Compliance requirements register, internal audit reports.

controls.title: Prototype Protection
controls.description: Implement controls specific to protecting automotive prototype vehicles, components, and related information from unauthorized disclosure, including physical camouflage, controlled access to prototype areas, and media/photography restrictions.
controls.test_criteria: Observe prototype handling areas for camouflage/covering practices, access restrictions, and photography/device policy enforcement.
controls.evidence_requirement: Prototype protection policy, access logs for prototype areas, camouflage/handling procedures.

controls.title: Data Protection / Privacy (Expanded Module)
controls.description: Implement controls for the processing of personal data consistent with applicable data protection law (e.g., GDPR), expanded in VDA ISA 6.0 from 4 to 12 controls covering purpose limitation, data subject rights, data protection by design, and processor management.
controls.test_criteria: Review the data protection management system, records of processing activities, and evidence of data subject rights handling.
controls.evidence_requirement: Records of processing activities (ROPA), data protection policy, data subject request handling records.

controls.title: Confidentiality Assessment Objective
controls.description: Assessment objective (replacing the legacy single 'Information Security' label) evaluating controls that protect the confidentiality of information shared with OEM/supplier partners, assessed via one of three maturity-based assessment levels (AL1-AL3).
controls.test_criteria: Review assessment level evidence corresponding to the required confidentiality protection level for the information shared.
controls.evidence_requirement: TISAX assessment report/label showing confidentiality maturity level achieved.

controls.title: Availability Assessment Objective
controls.description: New assessment objective introduced in VDA ISA 6.0 evaluating resilience and availability controls, extended to cover production environments and operational technology (OT), aligned with IEC 62443 concepts.
controls.test_criteria: Review availability/resilience controls for production and OT environments against the applicable assessment level.
controls.evidence_requirement: TISAX assessment report/label showing availability maturity level achieved, OT resilience documentation.

name: NIST CSF V1.1
description: The NIST Cybersecurity Framework, version 1.1 (April 2018), issued by the U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology, is a voluntary risk-based framework of standards, guidelines, and best practices organized around five core functions to help organizations manage and reduce cybersecurity risk.
notes: CSF 1.1 comprises 5 Functions, 23 Categories, and 108 Subcategories; the 23 Categories (listed below, grouped under their Function) represent the standard 'top-level' control granularity used in most CSF-based assessments. CSF 2.0 (Feb 2024, adding a sixth 'Govern' function) has since superseded 1.1, but 1.1 remains in active use in many existing programs and contracts.

controls.title: Asset Management (Identify)
controls.description: The data, personnel, devices, systems, and facilities that enable the organization to achieve business purposes are identified and managed consistent with their relative importance to business objectives and risk strategy.
controls.test_criteria: Review asset inventories (hardware, software, data flows) and verify assets are prioritized based on business value and criticality.
controls.evidence_requirement: Asset inventory, data flow diagrams, asset criticality/prioritization documentation.

controls.title: Business Environment (Identify)
controls.description: The organization's mission, objectives, stakeholders, and activities are understood and prioritized to inform cybersecurity roles, responsibilities, and risk management decisions.
controls.test_criteria: Review documentation of the organization's role in the supply chain, critical function dependencies, and resilience priorities.
controls.evidence_requirement: Business environment/mission documentation, critical function and dependency mapping.

controls.title: Governance (Identify)
controls.description: Policies, procedures, and processes to manage and monitor regulatory, legal, risk, environmental, and operational requirements are understood and inform management of cybersecurity risk.
controls.test_criteria: Review the cybersecurity governance policy and evidence that legal/regulatory requirements are tracked and addressed.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cybersecurity policy, governance structure documentation, legal/regulatory requirements register.

controls.title: Risk Assessment (Identify)
controls.description: The organization understands the cybersecurity risk to operations, assets, and individuals based on identified threats and vulnerabilities.
controls.test_criteria: Review the risk assessment methodology and latest risk assessment results including threat/vulnerability identification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk assessment reports, threat intelligence inputs, vulnerability scan results.

controls.title: Risk Management Strategy (Identify)
controls.description: The organization's priorities, constraints, risk tolerances, and assumptions are established and used to support operational risk decisions.
controls.test_criteria: Review the documented risk management strategy and risk tolerance/appetite statements for leadership approval.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk management strategy document, risk appetite/tolerance statement.

controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Management (Identify)
controls.description: The organization's priorities, constraints, risk tolerances, and processes are established and used to identify, assess, and manage supply chain risk.
controls.test_criteria: Review supply chain risk management processes and sample supplier risk assessments.
controls.evidence_requirement: Supply chain risk management policy, supplier risk assessment records.

controls.title: Identity Management, Authentication and Access Control (Protect)
controls.description: Access to physical and logical assets is limited to authorized users, processes, and devices, and is managed consistent with assessed risk.
controls.test_criteria: Sample access provisioning/deprovisioning records and MFA enforcement against least-privilege design.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, provisioning/deprovisioning logs, MFA configuration evidence.

controls.title: Awareness and Training (Protect)
controls.description: The organization's personnel and partners are provided cybersecurity awareness education and are adequately trained to perform their information-security-related duties.
controls.test_criteria: Review training curricula and completion records for general staff and privileged/specialized roles.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training materials, completion/attestation records.

controls.title: Data Security (Protect)
controls.description: Information and records (data) are managed consistent with the organization's risk strategy to protect confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
controls.test_criteria: Review encryption configuration for data at rest/in transit and data integrity-checking mechanisms.
controls.evidence_requirement: Encryption configuration evidence, data classification and handling policy.

controls.title: Information Protection Processes and Procedures (Protect)
controls.description: Security policies, processes, and procedures are maintained and used to manage protection of information systems and assets, including a secure SDLC and configuration/change management.
controls.test_criteria: Review security policy set, configuration baselines, and change management records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Security policies/procedures, configuration management baselines, change control tickets.

controls.title: Maintenance (Protect)
controls.description: Maintenance and repairs of industrial control and information system components are performed consistent with policies and procedures.
controls.test_criteria: Review maintenance logs and controls over remote maintenance access.
controls.evidence_requirement: Maintenance records/logs, remote access approval records.

controls.title: Protective Technology (Protect)
controls.description: Technical security solutions are managed to ensure the security and resilience of systems and assets, consistent with related policies, procedures, and agreements.
controls.test_criteria: Review logging/audit trail configuration, removable media controls, and network segmentation/least-functionality enforcement.
controls.evidence_requirement: Logging configuration, removable media policy, network segmentation documentation.

controls.title: Anomalies and Events (Detect)
controls.description: Anomalous activity is detected in a timely manner and the potential impact of events is understood.
controls.test_criteria: Review baseline network/system behavior documentation and sample anomaly detection alerts for triage/analysis evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Baseline documentation, anomaly detection alert logs and analysis records.

controls.title: Security Continuous Monitoring (Detect)
controls.description: The information system and assets are monitored at discrete intervals to identify cybersecurity events and verify the effectiveness of protective measures.
controls.test_criteria: Review continuous monitoring tool coverage (network, endpoint, personnel activity, external service providers) and alert records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Monitoring tool configuration/coverage reports, alert and investigation logs.

controls.title: Detection Processes (Detect)
controls.description: Detection processes and procedures are maintained and tested to ensure timely and adequate awareness of anomalous events.
controls.test_criteria: Review detection process documentation (roles, testing) and evidence of periodic detection process testing.
controls.evidence_requirement: Detection process documentation, detection test/exercise records.

controls.title: Response Planning (Respond)
controls.description: Response processes and procedures are executed and maintained to ensure timely response to detected cybersecurity incidents.
controls.test_criteria: Review the incident response plan and verify it is executed consistently during sampled incidents.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, incident execution records.

controls.title: Communications (Respond)
controls.description: Response activities are coordinated with internal and external stakeholders, including law enforcement agencies as appropriate.
controls.test_criteria: Review incident communication plans and sample incident records for stakeholder notification evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident communication plan, stakeholder notification records.

controls.title: Analysis (Respond)
controls.description: Analysis is conducted to ensure effective response and support recovery activities, including forensics and impact determination.
controls.test_criteria: Review incident analysis/forensics records and impact assessments from sampled incidents.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident analysis reports, forensic investigation records.

controls.title: Mitigation (Respond)
controls.description: Activities are performed to prevent expansion of an event, mitigate its effects, and resolve the incident.
controls.test_criteria: Review containment/eradication steps documented in sampled incident tickets.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident containment/mitigation records.

controls.title: Improvements (Respond)
controls.description: Organizational response activities are improved by incorporating lessons learned from current and previous detection/response activities.
controls.test_criteria: Review post-incident review/lessons-learned documentation and evidence of resulting process updates.
controls.evidence_requirement: Post-incident/lessons-learned reports, updated response procedures.

controls.title: Recovery Planning (Recover)
controls.description: Recovery processes and procedures are executed and maintained to ensure timely restoration of systems or assets affected by cybersecurity incidents.
controls.test_criteria: Review the recovery plan and verify its execution during sampled incidents or DR tests.
controls.evidence_requirement: Recovery plan, recovery/DR test execution records.

controls.title: Improvements (Recover)
controls.description: Recovery planning and processes are improved by incorporating lessons learned into future activities.
controls.test_criteria: Review lessons-learned documentation from recovery exercises/incidents and evidence of updated recovery procedures.
controls.evidence_requirement: Recovery lessons-learned reports, updated recovery plans.

controls.title: Communications (Recover)
controls.description: Restoration activities are coordinated with internal and external parties, including coordinating centers, ISPs, owners of attacking systems, victims, and vendors.
controls.test_criteria: Review recovery communication plans and sample stakeholder communications during recovery activities.
controls.evidence_requirement: Recovery communication plan, stakeholder communication records.

name: CCPA
description: The California Consumer Privacy Act (as substantially amended and expanded by the California Privacy Rights Act, CPRA, effective Jan 1, 2023, enforced by the California Privacy Protection Agency and the Attorney General) grants California consumers specific rights over the collection, use, sale, and sharing of their personal information by covered businesses and imposes corresponding obligations on those businesses and their service providers/contractors.
notes: CPRA's implementing regulations continue to evolve (e.g., finalized rules on cybersecurity audits, risk assessments, and automated decision-making technology (ADMT) have been adopted by the CPPA with phased effective/compliance dates through 2027-2028); organizations should confirm current regulatory text and effective dates with the CPPA at time of use.

controls.title: Right to Know / Access
controls.description: Consumers have the right to request that a business disclose the categories and specific pieces of personal information it has collected, the sources, business/commercial purposes, and categories of third parties with whom it is shared.
controls.test_criteria: Review the data subject access request (DSAR) process and sample fulfilled requests for completeness and timeliness (within statutory 45-day window, extendable).
controls.evidence_requirement: DSAR intake/response logs, data inventory/mapping used to fulfill requests.

controls.title: Right to Delete
controls.description: Consumers have the right to request deletion of personal information collected from them, subject to enumerated exceptions, and businesses must direct service providers/contractors to delete the data as well.
controls.test_criteria: Sample deletion requests and verify deletion was completed (including by service providers) within the statutory timeframe and documented exceptions applied correctly.
controls.evidence_requirement: Deletion request logs, service provider deletion confirmation records.

controls.title: Right to Correct
controls.description: Consumers have the right to request correction of inaccurate personal information held by a business, added by the CPRA amendment.
controls.test_criteria: Sample correction requests and verify corrections were applied using commercially reasonable efforts within the statutory timeframe.
controls.evidence_requirement: Correction request logs, record update confirmation.

controls.title: Right to Opt-Out of Sale/Sharing
controls.description: Consumers have the right to direct a business not to sell or share their personal information, including honoring opt-out preference signals such as Global Privacy Control (GPC).
controls.test_criteria: Verify a 'Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information' link/mechanism exists on the website and that GPC signals are detected and honored.
controls.evidence_requirement: Website opt-out mechanism screenshots, GPC signal handling configuration, opt-out request logs.

controls.title: Right to Limit Use of Sensitive Personal Information
controls.description: Consumers have the right to limit a business's use and disclosure of sensitive personal information (e.g., SSN, precise geolocation, health, biometric, or genetic data) to that necessary to perform the service.
controls.test_criteria: Verify a 'Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information' link exists where applicable and sample requests are honored.
controls.evidence_requirement: Website opt-out mechanism for sensitive PI, request handling logs.

controls.title: Right to Non-Discrimination
controls.description: A business must not discriminate against a consumer for exercising any CCPA right, including by denying goods/services, charging different prices, or providing a different level of quality, except for permitted financial incentive programs.
controls.test_criteria: Review pricing/service terms for consumers who exercised rights versus those who did not, and review any financial incentive program disclosures for compliance.
controls.evidence_requirement: Financial incentive program notice/terms, pricing parity records.

controls.title: Right to Data Portability
controls.description: Upon a verifiable access request, businesses must provide personal information in a portable and, to the extent technically feasible, readily usable format that allows transmission to another entity.
controls.test_criteria: Sample fulfilled access requests for delivery in a structured, machine-readable format.
controls.evidence_requirement: Sample data export files/format documentation.

controls.title: Notice at Collection
controls.description: Businesses must inform consumers, at or before the point of collection, of the categories of personal information to be collected and the purposes for which it will be used, including sensitive PI and retention periods.
controls.test_criteria: Review notices at collection displayed at each collection point (website forms, apps, offline) for required content.
controls.evidence_requirement: Notice-at-collection text/screenshots for each collection point.

controls.title: Privacy Policy
controls.description: Businesses must maintain a comprehensive online privacy policy describing consumers' rights, categories of personal information collected/sold/shared/disclosed, retention periods, and how to exercise rights, updated at least annually.
controls.test_criteria: Review the published privacy policy against required statutory disclosures and confirm it has been updated within the last 12 months.
controls.evidence_requirement: Published privacy policy, version history/update log.

controls.title: Service Provider, Contractor, and Third-Party Contracts
controls.description: Businesses must enter into written contracts with service providers, contractors, and third parties that restrict use of personal information to specified business purposes and impose CCPA-equivalent obligations.
controls.test_criteria: Sample vendor contracts to verify required CCPA contractual clauses (purpose limitation, deletion/return obligations, audit rights, no combining of data) are present.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vendor/data processing agreements (DPAs), vendor contract inventory.

controls.title: Data Minimization and Purpose Limitation
controls.description: A business's collection, use, retention, and sharing of personal information must be reasonably necessary and proportionate to the disclosed purpose for which it was collected or processed.
controls.test_criteria: Review data inventory/mapping to confirm collected data elements are tied to a documented, disclosed purpose.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data inventory/mapping, purpose limitation assessment documentation.

controls.title: Data Retention Limitation
controls.description: Personal information must not be retained for longer than reasonably necessary for the disclosed purpose, with defined and disclosed retention periods for each category of data.
controls.test_criteria: Review the data retention schedule and sample data stores for compliance with defined retention periods and deletion evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data retention schedule, deletion/archival logs.

controls.title: Cybersecurity Audits and Risk Assessments
controls.description: Businesses whose processing presents significant risk to consumer privacy/security must conduct annual independent cybersecurity audits and periodic risk assessments of processing activities, per CPPA regulations.
controls.test_criteria: Review the cybersecurity audit scope/report and risk assessment documentation against CPPA regulatory thresholds and timelines.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cybersecurity audit report, risk assessment documentation, submission records to CPPA where required.

controls.title: Automated Decision-Making Technology (ADMT) Governance
controls.description: Businesses using automated decision-making technology for significant decisions affecting consumers must provide pre-use notice, and in-scope cases an opt-out and/or access to information about the logic involved, per CPPA ADMT regulations.
controls.test_criteria: Review ADMT use-case inventory, pre-use notices, and opt-out/appeal mechanisms for covered decisions.
controls.evidence_requirement: ADMT inventory and risk assessments, pre-use notice text, opt-out/appeal process documentation.

controls.title: Authorized Agent Requests
controls.description: Businesses must establish a process to verify and respond to consumer rights requests submitted through an authorized agent, including proof of authorization.
controls.test_criteria: Sample authorized-agent requests for verification steps performed (proof of authorization, consumer confirmation where required).
controls.evidence_requirement: Authorized agent request logs, verification/authorization records.

controls.title: Minors' Personal Information
controls.description: Businesses must not sell or share the personal information of consumers known to be under 16 without opt-in consent (parental consent under 13, consumer opt-in consent 13-15).
controls.test_criteria: Review age-screening and opt-in consent mechanisms for consumers identified as minors prior to any sale/sharing of their data.
controls.evidence_requirement: Age-gate/consent capture mechanism documentation, opt-in consent records.

controls.title: Recordkeeping and Metrics
controls.description: Businesses meeting volume thresholds must maintain records of consumer requests received and responded to, and compile specified metrics (e.g., median response times) as required by regulation.
controls.test_criteria: Review the consumer request log and compiled metrics for completeness against regulatory thresholds requiring disclosure.
controls.evidence_requirement: Consumer request log/tracker, compiled compliance metrics documentation.

controls.title: Data Breach Private Right of Action Safeguards
controls.description: Businesses must implement and maintain reasonable security procedures and practices appropriate to the nature of personal information held, to reduce risk of a data breach that could trigger statutory damages under the CCPA's private right of action.
controls.test_criteria: Review the information security program against reasonableness standards (e.g., alignment to a recognized framework such as CIS Controls) and evidence of implementation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security program documentation, control implementation evidence, breach incident records (if any).

name: NIST CSF 2.0
description: The NIST Cybersecurity Framework version 2.0, published by the U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology in February 2024, is a voluntary risk-based framework organizations use to understand, assess, prioritize, and communicate cybersecurity risk across any sector or size of organization.
notes: CSF 2.0 added the Govern function to the original five (Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, Recover), bringing the total to 6 functions and 22 categories. Controls below are modeled at the category level (e.g., GV.OC, ID.AM), which is the framework's own top-level organizing unit above the ~106 subcategories/outcomes.

controls.title: Organizational Context
controls.description: The organization's mission, stakeholder expectations, and legal, regulatory, and contractual cybersecurity requirements are understood and used to inform risk management decisions.
controls.test_criteria: Review documented mission statements, stakeholder registers, and a legal/regulatory requirements inventory tied explicitly to cybersecurity risk decisions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Business context document, regulatory obligations register, stakeholder analysis, critical dependency mapping.

controls.title: Risk Management Strategy
controls.description: The organization's priorities, constraints, risk tolerance and appetite statements, and assumptions are established, communicated, and used to support operational risk decisions.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm an approved risk management strategy exists, defines risk appetite/tolerance, and is referenced in actual risk decisions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk management strategy document, risk appetite statement, board/executive approval records, risk register entries citing the strategy.

controls.title: Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities
controls.description: Cybersecurity roles, responsibilities, and authorities are established, communicated, and used to foster accountability, performance assessment, and continuous improvement.
controls.test_criteria: Verify RACI or equivalent accountability documentation maps to actual org chart and personnel can describe their cybersecurity responsibilities.
controls.evidence_requirement: RACI matrix, job descriptions with security responsibilities, org chart, signed accountability acknowledgments.

controls.title: Policy
controls.description: Organizational cybersecurity policy is established based on organizational context, strategy, and priorities, and is communicated and enforced.
controls.test_criteria: Review policy approval dates, review cycle evidence, and distribution/attestation records across the workforce.
controls.evidence_requirement: Approved policy set, policy management procedure, version history, employee attestation logs.

controls.title: Oversight
controls.description: Results of organization-wide cybersecurity risk management activities and performance are used by leadership to inform, improve, and adjust the risk management strategy.
