controls.test_criteria: Inspect board/executive meeting minutes or dashboards showing cybersecurity performance metrics reviewed and acted upon.
controls.evidence_requirement: Executive/board reporting packages, risk committee minutes, metrics dashboards, strategy revision history.

controls.title: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management
controls.description: Cyber supply chain risk management processes are identified, established, managed, monitored, and improved by organizational stakeholders.
controls.test_criteria: Sample third-party/vendor risk assessments and confirm supply chain risk criteria are applied consistently pre- and post-contract.
controls.evidence_requirement: Supplier risk management policy, vendor risk assessment reports, contract security clauses, supplier inventory.

controls.title: Asset Management
controls.description: Assets (data, hardware, software, systems, facilities, services, and personnel) that enable the organization to achieve its purposes are identified and managed consistent with their relative importance.
controls.test_criteria: Reconcile the asset inventory against discovery/scan results and confirm criticality ratings are current.
controls.evidence_requirement: Asset inventory/CMDB export, data flow diagrams, asset classification records, discovery scan reports.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: The cybersecurity risk to the organization, assets, and individuals is understood, including threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood, and impact.
controls.test_criteria: Review a completed risk assessment methodology application with documented threats, vulnerabilities, and risk ratings.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk assessment reports, vulnerability scan results, threat intelligence inputs, risk register.

controls.title: Improvement
controls.description: Improvements to organizational cybersecurity risk management processes, procedures, and activities are identified across all six CSF functions and used to inform future iterations.
controls.test_criteria: Trace lessons-learned items from incidents, audits, and exercises through to tracked remediation and process updates.
controls.evidence_requirement: Lessons-learned logs, corrective action plans, internal audit findings tracker, plan updates.

controls.title: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control
controls.description: Access to physical and logical assets is limited to authorized users, services, and hardware, and is managed commensurate with assessed risk.
controls.test_criteria: Sample user access provisioning/deprovisioning tickets and verify least-privilege and MFA enforcement against policy.
controls.evidence_requirement: IAM policy, access review logs, MFA configuration evidence, provisioning/deprovisioning tickets.

controls.title: Awareness and Training
controls.description: The organization's personnel are provided cybersecurity awareness education and are adequately trained to perform their cybersecurity-related duties.
controls.test_criteria: Review completion rates for security awareness training and role-based training records for privileged users.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training curriculum, completion reports, phishing simulation results, role-based training records.

controls.title: Data Security
controls.description: Data is managed consistent with the organization's risk strategy to protect its confidentiality, integrity, and availability throughout its lifecycle.
controls.test_criteria: Verify encryption-at-rest/in-transit configurations and data classification labeling on a sample of systems holding sensitive data.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data classification policy, encryption configuration evidence, data loss prevention logs, key management records.

controls.title: Platform Security
controls.description: The hardware, software, and services of physical and virtual platforms are managed consistent with the organization's risk strategy to protect confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
controls.test_criteria: Review hardening baselines, patch management SLAs, and configuration compliance scan results.
controls.evidence_requirement: Configuration/hardening standards, patch management records, vulnerability remediation evidence.

controls.title: Technology Infrastructure Resilience
controls.description: Security architectures are managed with the organization's risk strategy to protect asset confidentiality, integrity, availability, and organizational resilience.
controls.test_criteria: Review network segmentation diagrams, redundancy design, and resilience testing results for critical infrastructure.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network architecture diagrams, segmentation evidence, capacity/resilience test reports, DR architecture documentation.

controls.title: Continuous Monitoring
controls.description: Assets are monitored to find anomalies, indicators of compromise, and other potentially adverse cybersecurity events.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm logging coverage across critical assets feeds a SIEM/monitoring platform with defined alert thresholds.
controls.evidence_requirement: Monitoring architecture diagram, SIEM alert rules, log source inventory, coverage gap analysis.

controls.title: Adverse Event Analysis
controls.description: Anomalies, indicators of compromise, and other potentially adverse events are analyzed to characterize events and detect cybersecurity incidents.
controls.test_criteria: Sample triaged alerts and confirm analysis, correlation, and escalation decisions are documented and timely.
controls.evidence_requirement: Alert triage logs, correlation rule documentation, escalation records, analyst runbooks.

controls.title: Incident Management
controls.description: Responses to detected cybersecurity incidents are managed according to a documented, tested incident response plan.
controls.test_criteria: Review the incident response plan, confirm it is tested annually, and sample incident tickets for plan adherence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, tabletop exercise reports, incident tickets, severity classification criteria.

controls.title: Incident Analysis
controls.description: Investigations are conducted to ensure effective response and support forensics and recovery activities.
controls.test_criteria: Review a sample incident's root cause analysis and forensic evidence chain of custody.
controls.evidence_requirement: Root cause analysis reports, forensic evidence logs, chain-of-custody records, post-incident reports.

controls.title: Incident Response Reporting and Communication
controls.description: Response activities are coordinated with internal stakeholders and external parties, including regulators, law enforcement, and customers, as required.
controls.test_criteria: Verify breach notification timelines were met against applicable regulatory requirements for a sample incident.
controls.evidence_requirement: Communication plan, regulator/customer notification records, stakeholder contact list, notification timeline logs.

controls.title: Incident Mitigation
controls.description: Activities are performed to prevent expansion of an event, mitigate its effects, and eradicate the incident.
controls.test_criteria: Review containment and eradication actions taken for a sample incident against defined response playbooks.
controls.evidence_requirement: Containment action logs, eradication confirmation records, incident response playbooks.

controls.title: Incident Recovery Plan Execution
controls.description: Restoration activities are performed to ensure operational availability of systems and services affected by cybersecurity incidents.
controls.test_criteria: Review recovery plan execution records and restoration time against recovery time objectives (RTOs).
controls.evidence_requirement: Recovery plan, backup restoration logs, RTO/RPO metrics, post-recovery validation reports.

controls.title: Incident Recovery Communication
controls.description: Restoration activities are coordinated with internal and external parties such as coordinating centers, service providers, and affected customers.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm recovery status communications were issued to stakeholders per the communication plan during a sample incident.
controls.evidence_requirement: Recovery communication logs, public relations/customer notices, stakeholder update records.

name: PIPEDA
description: Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act is federal privacy legislation, enforced by the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada (OPC), that governs how private-sector organizations collect, use, and disclose personal information in the course of commercial activity.
notes: Controls map to the 10 Fair Information Principles in Schedule 1 of PIPEDA (based on the CSA Model Code), which is the Act's own top-level structure and the basis for OPC compliance assessments.

controls.title: Accountability
controls.description: An organization is responsible for personal information under its control and must designate an individual (e.g., a Chief Privacy Officer) accountable for the organization's compliance with PIPEDA's principles.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm a named accountable individual exists, privacy policies are documented, and third-party processors are contractually bound to equivalent protection.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy officer designation, privacy policy, vendor/processor data protection agreements, accountability framework documentation.

controls.title: Identifying Purposes
controls.description: The purposes for which personal information is collected must be identified by the organization at or before the time the information is collected.
controls.test_criteria: Review collection points (forms, web intake, contracts) to verify stated purposes match actual use.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy notices at point of collection, data inventory mapping purpose to data element, consent forms.

controls.title: Consent
controls.description: The knowledge and consent of the individual are required for the collection, use, or disclosure of personal information, except where inappropriate.
controls.test_criteria: Sample consent records and verify opt-in/opt-out mechanisms match the sensitivity of the data and context of collection.
controls.evidence_requirement: Consent capture logs, consent withdrawal mechanism, meaningful consent assessment for sensitive data.

controls.title: Limiting Collection
controls.description: The collection of personal information must be limited to that which is necessary for the purposes identified, and collected by fair and lawful means.
controls.test_criteria: Compare data fields actually collected in systems/forms against documented business purposes to identify over-collection.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data minimization review, data inventory, form/field justification documentation.

controls.title: Limiting Use, Disclosure, and Retention
controls.description: Personal information must not be used or disclosed for purposes other than those for which it was collected, except with consent or as required by law, and must be retained only as long as necessary.
controls.test_criteria: Review retention schedules and confirm automated or procedural deletion occurs at defined triggers; sample disclosures for purpose compatibility.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data retention and disposal schedule, deletion logs, disclosure register, retention policy.

controls.title: Accuracy
controls.description: Personal information must be as accurate, complete, and up-to-date as is necessary for the purposes for which it is to be used.
controls.test_criteria: Review data correction/update workflows and sample records for currency relative to use.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data correction procedure, data quality audit results, individual update request logs.

controls.title: Safeguards
controls.description: Personal information must be protected by security safeguards appropriate to the sensitivity of the information, including physical, organizational, and technological measures.
controls.test_criteria: Review technical and administrative safeguards (encryption, access controls, physical security) proportional to data sensitivity classification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Security policy, encryption/access control configuration evidence, physical security controls documentation, safeguard risk assessment.

controls.title: Openness
controls.description: An organization must make readily available to individuals specific, understandable information about its policies and practices relating to the management of personal information.
controls.test_criteria: Review published privacy policy for completeness (what is collected, how used, how to contact the privacy officer) and accessibility.
controls.evidence_requirement: Published privacy policy, website accessibility confirmation, policy update history.

controls.title: Individual Access
controls.description: Upon request, an individual must be informed of the existence, use, and disclosure of their personal information and given access to it, with the ability to challenge its accuracy and completeness.
controls.test_criteria: Sample access requests and verify response within the statutory timeframe (generally 30 days) with complete information provided.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access request log, response correspondence, identity verification procedure, SLA tracking records.

controls.title: Challenging Compliance
controls.description: An individual must be able to address a challenge concerning compliance with the above principles to the designated accountable individual(s) within the organization.
controls.test_criteria: Review complaint-handling procedure and sample complaint records for investigation and resolution within reasonable timeframes.
controls.evidence_requirement: Complaint-handling procedure, complaint log with resolutions, escalation path to OPC documentation.

name: CMMC 2.0 Level 2
description: The Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification 2.0 Level 2 (Advanced) is a U.S. Department of Defense certification requirement for contractors handling Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), requiring full implementation of all 110 security requirements in NIST SP 800-171 Revision 2, verified via third-party (C3PAO) or self-assessment depending on contract sensitivity.
notes: Controls below are modeled at the 14 NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 domain/family level (the framework's own top-level grouping above its 110 individual requirements). DoD has signaled an eventual transition referencing NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3 content, but Rev 2's 14-domain structure remains the current CMMC 2.0 Level 2 basis as of this writing.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Limit information system access to authorized users, processes, and devices, and to the types of transactions and functions authorized users are permitted to exercise, including least privilege and remote access controls.
controls.test_criteria: Sample user accounts and verify role-based least-privilege assignment, session termination, and remote access encryption.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, account provisioning/review logs, remote access VPN/MFA configuration, system access control lists.

controls.title: Awareness and Training
controls.description: Ensure managers, systems administrators, and users are made aware of security risks and trained to perform assigned information security duties.
controls.test_criteria: Review training completion records for all personnel with CUI access, including role-specific training for privileged users.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training program documentation, completion records, insider threat awareness training materials.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.description: Create, protect, and retain system audit logs sufficient to enable monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized activity.
controls.test_criteria: Verify audit log generation covers required event types, logs are protected from tampering, and reviewed regularly.
controls.evidence_requirement: Audit logging configuration, log review records, log retention policy, SIEM alert configuration.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.description: Establish and maintain baseline configurations and inventories of systems, and control changes to systems throughout their lifecycle.
controls.test_criteria: Compare live system configurations to documented baselines and review change control records for approval workflow.
controls.evidence_requirement: Configuration baseline documents, change management tickets, software inventory, configuration scan reports.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.description: Identify system users, processes, and devices, and authenticate their identities before granting access, including multi-factor authentication for privileged and remote access.
controls.test_criteria: Verify MFA is enforced for privileged/remote access and password/credential policies meet complexity and reuse requirements.
controls.evidence_requirement: Identity and authentication policy, MFA enrollment records, password policy configuration, identity proofing records.

controls.title: Incident Response
controls.description: Establish an operational incident-handling capability including preparation, detection, analysis, containment, recovery, and user response activities, and track and report incidents.
controls.test_criteria: Review the incident response plan and sample incident tickets for detection-to-resolution timeline and DoD reporting compliance.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, incident tickets, DIBNet/DoD incident reporting confirmations, tabletop exercise records.

controls.title: Maintenance
controls.description: Perform periodic and timely maintenance on systems, and provide controls on the tools, techniques, mechanisms, and personnel used to conduct maintenance.
controls.test_criteria: Review maintenance logs for approval, supervision of non-organizational maintenance personnel, and sanitization of media used off-site.
controls.evidence_requirement: Maintenance logs, maintenance personnel authorization records, media sanitization records.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.description: Protect system media containing CUI, both paper and digital, including marking, storage, access limitation, sanitization, and destruction.
controls.test_criteria: Review media inventory and sanitization/destruction certificates for a sample of retired media.
controls.evidence_requirement: Media protection policy, media sanitization/destruction certificates, media inventory and labeling records.

controls.title: Personnel Security
controls.description: Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to systems containing CUI and ensure CUI is protected during and after personnel actions such as termination and transfer.
controls.test_criteria: Sample offboarding records to verify timely access revocation and review pre-employment screening procedures.
controls.evidence_requirement: Personnel screening records, termination/transfer checklists, access revocation logs.

controls.title: Physical Protection
controls.description: Limit physical access to systems, equipment, and operating environments to authorized individuals, and safeguard the physical facility and support infrastructure.
controls.test_criteria: Review physical access logs, badge/visitor control procedures, and facility security assessments.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access control logs, visitor logs, facility security policy, badge system audit trail.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: Periodically assess risk to organizational operations, assets, and individuals from the operation of systems processing, storing, or transmitting CUI, including vulnerability scanning.
controls.test_criteria: Review risk assessment reports and vulnerability scan frequency/remediation timelines against policy.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk assessment reports, vulnerability scan results, remediation tracking, risk register.

controls.title: Security Assessment
controls.description: Periodically assess security controls to determine effectiveness, develop plans of action to correct deficiencies, and monitor controls on an ongoing basis.
controls.test_criteria: Review the System Security Plan (SSP), Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M), and self-assessment/C3PAO assessment results.
controls.evidence_requirement: System Security Plan, POA&M, self-assessment score in SPRS, C3PAO assessment report.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.description: Monitor, control, and protect organizational communications at system boundaries and employ architectural designs and techniques that promote effective information security, including encryption of CUI.
controls.test_criteria: Review network boundary diagrams, encryption configuration for CUI in transit/at rest, and boundary protection device rule sets.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network architecture/boundary diagrams, firewall rule sets, encryption configuration evidence, FIPS-validated cryptography documentation.

controls.title: System and Information Integrity
controls.description: Identify, report, and correct system flaws in a timely manner, provide protection from malicious code, and monitor system security alerts and advisories.
controls.test_criteria: Review patch management SLAs, anti-malware deployment coverage, and system monitoring alert handling.
controls.evidence_requirement: Patch management records, anti-malware deployment/update logs, vulnerability advisory tracking, flaw remediation records.

name: 21 CFR Part 11
description: Title 21 CFR Part 11 is a U.S. Food and Drug Administration regulation establishing the criteria under which electronic records and electronic signatures are considered trustworthy, reliable, and equivalent to paper records and handwritten signatures for FDA-regulated industries (pharmaceuticals, medical devices, biologics, and food).
notes: Controls map to the regulation's own three subparts (A: General Provisions, B: Electronic Records, C: Electronic Signatures) and their numbered sections (11.1-11.300). Section 11.10, the largest closed-system control section, is split into logical sub-groups below for assessable granularity.

controls.title: General Provisions, Scope, and Definitions
controls.description: Defines the scope of applicability for electronic records and signatures used, created, modified, maintained, archived, retrieved, or transmitted under FDA predicate rules, and establishes key definitions.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm a documented scoping/applicability assessment identifies which systems and records fall under Part 11.
controls.evidence_requirement: Part 11 applicability/scoping assessment, system inventory with Part 11 determination, predicate rule mapping.

controls.title: System Validation
controls.description: Closed systems used to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records must be validated to ensure accuracy, reliability, consistent intended performance, and the ability to discern invalid or altered records.
controls.test_criteria: Review computer system validation (CSV/CSA) protocols, test scripts, and validation summary reports for the system.
controls.evidence_requirement: Validation master plan, IQ/OQ/PQ protocols and results, validation summary report, change control re-validation records.

controls.title: Record Generation, Protection, and Retention
controls.description: The system must be able to generate accurate and complete copies of records in human-readable and electronic form, and records must be protected to enable their accurate and ready retrieval throughout the required retention period.
controls.test_criteria: Request a sample record export in both human-readable and electronic format and verify completeness and readability against the retention schedule.
controls.evidence_requirement: Record retention policy, backup/archival procedure, sample record retrieval and export output, retention period documentation.

controls.title: Access Control and Audit Trails
controls.description: System access must be limited to authorized individuals, and computer-generated, time-stamped audit trails must independently record operator entries and actions that create, modify, or delete electronic records.
controls.test_criteria: Review user access provisioning records and sample audit trail entries to confirm they are secure, time-stamped, computer-generated, and cannot be disabled by users.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control configuration, user account list with role mapping, audit trail reports, audit trail review log.

controls.title: Operational and Procedural Controls
controls.description: Includes operational system checks to enforce permitted sequencing of steps, authority checks to ensure only authorized individuals use the system or sign a record, device checks for data input/operational validity, documented training of personnel, written policies holding individuals accountable for actions under their electronic signatures, and adequate controls over systems documentation.
controls.test_criteria: Review training records, signed accountability policies, and documentation change control for system manuals and SOPs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training records, signed Part 11 accountability/responsibility statements, SOP version control records, device qualification records.

controls.title: Controls for Open Systems
controls.description: Where electronic records are transmitted over an open system (one not fully controlled by the record owner), additional measures such as document encryption and appropriate digital signature standards must be employed to ensure authenticity, integrity, and confidentiality.
controls.test_criteria: Review encryption and digital signature mechanisms applied to records transmitted outside the organization's controlled network.
controls.evidence_requirement: Encryption configuration for data in transit, digital signature/PKI certificate documentation, open-system risk assessment.

controls.title: Signature Manifestations
controls.description: Signed electronic records must contain information associated with the signing, including the printed name of the signer, date and time of signing, and the meaning (e.g., review, approval, authorship) associated with the signature.
controls.test_criteria: Sample signed electronic records and verify the signature manifestation includes name, date/time, and meaning, displayed on both human-readable screen and printouts.
controls.evidence_requirement: Sample signed record printouts/screenshots, e-signature system configuration documentation.

controls.title: Signature/Record Linking
controls.description: Electronic signatures and handwritten signatures executed to electronic records must be linked to their respective records to ensure signatures cannot be excised, copied, or otherwise transferred to falsify another record.
controls.test_criteria: Attempt (in a test environment) to copy or detach a signature from its record and confirm the system technically prevents this.
controls.evidence_requirement: System design documentation describing signature-to-record binding mechanism, validation test evidence for this control.

controls.title: General Requirements for Electronic Signatures
controls.description: Each electronic signature must be unique to one individual and not reused or reassigned to anyone else; the organization must verify the identity of an individual before establishing, assigning, certifying, or sanctioning an electronic signature, and must certify to the FDA that electronic signatures are intended to be the legally binding equivalent of handwritten signatures.
controls.test_criteria: Review identity verification records for signature issuance and confirm the FDA certification letter (CFR 11.100(c)) is on file.
controls.evidence_requirement: Identity verification/proofing records, unique user ID assignment records, FDA Part 11 certification letter.

controls.title: Electronic Signature Components and Controls
controls.description: Non-biometric electronic signatures must employ at least two distinct identification components (e.g., ID and password) executed at each signing, with controls preventing use by anyone other than the genuine owner and requiring collaboration of at least two individuals for reuse attempts.
controls.test_criteria: Verify the signing workflow requires re-entry of both identification components at each signature event and confirm controls around delegation/shared credentials.
controls.evidence_requirement: E-signature workflow configuration, test evidence of two-component authentication at signing, policy prohibiting credential sharing.

controls.title: Controls for Identification Codes and Passwords
controls.description: Organizations must maintain the uniqueness of each combined identification code and password, periodically recall or revise passwords, and detect and report attempts at unauthorized use, including deauthorizing lost or compromised credentials.
controls.test_criteria: Review password policy enforcement (expiration, complexity) and incident records for detected unauthorized access attempts.
controls.evidence_requirement: Password policy configuration, credential uniqueness/revocation logs, unauthorized access attempt detection and reporting records.

name: FedRAMP Moderate
description: The Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) Moderate baseline is a U.S. government-wide program, managed by the FedRAMP Program Management Office (GSA) with oversight from the Joint Authorization Board, that standardizes security assessment and authorization for cloud service offerings handling moderate-impact federal data, built on the NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control catalog.
notes: Controls are modeled at the 20 NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control-family level, which is FedRAMP's own top-level grouping above its ~323 individual Moderate-baseline controls/enhancements (sources vary slightly, 322-325, reflecting periodic baseline updates and threat-based additions beyond the core NIST 800-53B Moderate baseline). Exact per-control counts should be verified against the current FedRAMP Security Controls Baseline spreadsheet at fedramp.gov before use in a live assessment.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Policies and mechanisms that limit information system access to authorized users, processes, and devices, and govern the types of transactions and functions permitted.
controls.test_criteria: Review account management procedures, least-privilege enforcement, and remote/privileged access controls across the system boundary.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, account management records, privileged access review logs, System Security Plan (SSP) control narratives.

controls.title: Awareness and Training
controls.description: Security and privacy awareness training for all users and specialized role-based training for personnel with significant security responsibilities.
controls.test_criteria: Review training completion records and role-based training content relevance to assigned duties.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training policy, completion records, role-based training curricula.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.description: Creation, protection, retention, and review of audit records to support monitoring, investigation, and accountability for system actions.
controls.test_criteria: Confirm audit log content, retention period, and protection against unauthorized access/modification meet the control baseline.
controls.evidence_requirement: Audit and accountability policy, log retention configuration, audit review and reporting records.

controls.title: Assessment, Authorization, and Monitoring
controls.description: Processes for security control assessments, authorization decisions (ATO), continuous monitoring, and plans of action and milestones (POA&Ms).
controls.test_criteria: Review the current ATO package, annual assessment results, and POA&M remediation timeliness.
controls.evidence_requirement: System Security Plan, Security Assessment Report (SAR), ATO letter, POA&M tracker, continuous monitoring deliverables.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.description: Establishment and maintenance of baseline configurations, inventories, and change control processes for information systems.
controls.test_criteria: Compare configuration baselines to deployed system state and review change control board approvals.
controls.evidence_requirement: Configuration management plan, baseline configuration documents, change request/approval records.

controls.title: Contingency Planning
controls.description: Planning, backup, and recovery capabilities to ensure continuity of operations during and after a disruption or disaster.
controls.test_criteria: Review the contingency plan, backup testing results, and the most recent disaster recovery/tabletop exercise.
controls.evidence_requirement: Contingency plan, backup test logs, DR exercise after-action report, RTO/RPO documentation.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.description: Verification of the identity of users, processes, and devices as a prerequisite for system access, including multi-factor authentication for federal systems.
controls.test_criteria: Verify PIV/MFA enforcement for all users and devices and review identity proofing procedures.
controls.evidence_requirement: Identity and authentication policy, MFA/PIV configuration evidence, identity proofing records.

controls.title: Incident Response
controls.description: Operational capability to detect, report, analyze, contain, and recover from information security incidents, including US-CERT/CISA reporting obligations.
controls.test_criteria: Review incident response plan testing and sample incident records for US-CERT reporting timeliness.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, tabletop exercise reports, incident tickets, CISA/US-CERT reporting confirmations.

controls.title: Maintenance
controls.description: Controls governing routine and emergency system maintenance, including remote maintenance tools and maintenance personnel authorization.
controls.test_criteria: Review maintenance records for approval, supervision, and sanitization of equipment removed for off-site maintenance.
controls.evidence_requirement: Maintenance policy, maintenance logs, remote maintenance session records.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.description: Controls for marking, handling, storage, transport, sanitization, and destruction of system media containing federal information.
controls.test_criteria: Review media sanitization/destruction records and media access controls for a sample of retired devices.
controls.evidence_requirement: Media protection policy, sanitization/destruction certificates, media inventory records.

controls.title: Physical and Environmental Protection
controls.description: Controls limiting physical access to facilities and equipment, and protecting against environmental hazards such as fire, power loss, and temperature.
controls.test_criteria: Review data center physical access logs, environmental monitoring records, and visitor control procedures.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical security policy, data center access logs, environmental control monitoring logs, visitor logs.

controls.title: Planning
controls.description: Development, documentation, and periodic update of security and privacy plans, including the System Security Plan and rules of behavior.
controls.test_criteria: Review the SSP for completeness and currency, and confirm rules of behavior are signed by all users.
controls.evidence_requirement: System Security Plan, privacy plan, signed rules of behavior, architecture diagrams.

controls.title: Program Management
controls.description: Organization-wide security program activities including a risk management strategy, enterprise architecture alignment, and senior information security officer designation.
controls.test_criteria: Review the organizational information security program plan and confirm program-level risk management activities beyond the system boundary.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security program plan, risk management strategy, CISO/ISSO designation records.

controls.title: Personnel Security
controls.description: Screening of individuals prior to granting system access and procedures for personnel transfer and termination to protect federal information.
controls.test_criteria: Sample personnel screening and offboarding records to verify timely background checks and access revocation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Personnel security policy, background investigation records, termination/transfer access revocation logs.

controls.title: PII Processing and Transparency
controls.description: Controls governing the authority to process personally identifiable information, consent, and transparency obligations such as privacy notices and Privacy Impact Assessments.
controls.test_criteria: Review the Privacy Impact Assessment and privacy notice content against actual PII processing activities.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA), System of Records Notice (if applicable), privacy notices, PII inventory.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: Periodic assessment of risk to organizational operations and assets, including vulnerability scanning and risk categorization under FIPS 199.
controls.test_criteria: Review the risk assessment report, vulnerability scan frequency, and FIPS 199 categorization determination.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk assessment report, vulnerability scan results, FIPS 199 categorization worksheet, POA&M linkage.

controls.title: System and Services Acquisition
controls.description: Security requirements integrated into the system development lifecycle and acquisition processes, including supply chain and third-party service provider controls.
controls.test_criteria: Review SDLC security gate documentation and third-party/subservice provider security assessment records.
controls.evidence_requirement: SDLC security policy, acquisition contract security language, subservice provider assessment (e.g., SOC 2) reports.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.description: Monitoring, control, and protection of organizational communications at system boundaries, including encryption, boundary protection, and network segmentation.
controls.test_criteria: Review boundary protection device configurations, encryption standards (FIPS 140-validated), and network segmentation diagrams.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network architecture diagrams, firewall/boundary protection rule sets, FIPS 140 validation certificates, encryption configuration evidence.

controls.title: System and Information Integrity
controls.description: Timely identification and remediation of system flaws, malicious code protection, and system monitoring for security alerts.
controls.test_criteria: Review patch management SLAs against FedRAMP timelines (e.g., critical vulnerabilities remediated within required windows) and anti-malware deployment coverage.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vulnerability/patch management records, anti-malware deployment logs, system monitoring alert records.

controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Management
controls.description: Processes to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with the supply chain for system components and services, including counterfeit prevention.
controls.test_criteria: Review the supply chain risk management plan and component sourcing/provenance documentation for critical system elements.
controls.evidence_requirement: Supply chain risk management plan, component provenance records, vendor risk assessments.

name: COBIT 2019
description: COBIT 2019 is ISACA's framework for the governance and management of enterprise information and technology, used by organizations to align IT investment and risk with business goals through a structured set of governance and management objectives.
notes: Controls map to COBIT 2019's 40 governance and management objectives, which are the framework's own top-level units (EDM=5, APO=14, BAI=11, DSS=6, MEA=4), each further decomposed in the standard into management practices and detailed activities not reproduced here.

controls.title: Ensured Governance Framework Setting and Maintenance
controls.description: Analyze and articulate requirements for enterprise governance of IT, and put in place and maintain effective enabling structures, principles, processes, and practices.
controls.test_criteria: Review the governance framework charter, decision rights documentation, and evidence of periodic governance framework review.
controls.evidence_requirement: Governance framework charter, board/committee decision records, governance review minutes.

controls.title: Ensured Benefits Delivery
controls.description: Optimize the value contribution to the business from business processes, IT services, and IT assets resulting from investments made at acceptable cost.
controls.test_criteria: Review investment business cases and post-implementation benefits realization tracking.
controls.evidence_requirement: Business case templates, benefits realization reports, investment portfolio review records.

controls.title: Ensured Risk Optimization
controls.description: Ensure the enterprise's risk appetite and tolerance are understood, articulated, and communicated, and that IT-related risk is identified and managed.
controls.test_criteria: Review the IT risk appetite statement and confirm risk reporting to the board aligns with actual risk exposure.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk appetite statement, enterprise risk register, board risk reporting packages.

controls.title: Ensured Resource Optimization
controls.description: Ensure adequate and sufficient IT-related capabilities (people, process, technology) are available to support enterprise objectives at optimal cost.
controls.test_criteria: Review resource allocation decisions against capacity plans and budget-to-actual IT spend reports.
controls.evidence_requirement: Resource/capacity plans, IT budget reports, resource allocation decision records.

controls.title: Ensured Stakeholder Engagement
controls.description: Ensure stakeholders are engaged, their interests considered, and reporting and communication of I&T performance and conformance are effective.
controls.test_criteria: Review stakeholder communication plans and sample IT performance reports distributed to stakeholders.
controls.evidence_requirement: Stakeholder engagement plan, IT performance/conformance reports, communication records.

controls.title: Managed I&T Management Framework
controls.description: Clarify and maintain the governance of the mission and vision of I&T, establishing an organizational structure and clear roles for the IT function.
controls.test_criteria: Review the IT management framework documentation and org structure for clarity of roles and decision rights.
controls.evidence_requirement: IT management framework document, organizational chart, IT policy set.

controls.title: Managed Strategy
controls.description: Provide a holistic view of current business and IT environments, future direction, and initiatives required to migrate to the desired future environment.
controls.test_criteria: Review the IT strategic plan and its alignment with the enterprise strategic plan.
controls.evidence_requirement: IT strategic plan, enterprise strategy alignment documentation, gap analysis.

controls.title: Managed Enterprise Architecture
controls.description: Establish a common architecture consisting of business process, information, data, application, and technology architecture layers to realize enterprise strategy.
controls.test_criteria: Review enterprise architecture documentation currency and its use in major IT investment decisions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Enterprise architecture repository/documents, architecture review board minutes.

controls.title: Managed Innovation
controls.description: Maintain awareness of information and technology trends, identify innovation opportunities, and plan how to benefit from innovation in relation to business needs.
controls.test_criteria: Review innovation program documentation and pilots/proofs of concept tracked to business outcomes.
controls.evidence_requirement: Innovation program charter, proof-of-concept records, technology trend assessments.

controls.title: Managed Portfolio
controls.description: Execute the strategic direction set for investments in line with the enterprise architecture vision and desired characteristics, managing programs and services as a portfolio.
controls.test_criteria: Review the investment portfolio prioritization methodology and sample portfolio review decisions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Portfolio management policy, investment portfolio register, prioritization/approval records.

controls.title: Managed Budget and Costs
controls.description: Manage IT-related financial activities in both business and IT functions, covering budget, cost, and benefit management.
controls.test_criteria: Review IT budget preparation, cost allocation methodology, and budget-to-actual variance reporting.
controls.evidence_requirement: IT budget documents, cost allocation model, variance analysis reports.

controls.title: Managed Human Resources
controls.description: Provide a structured approach to ensure optimal structuring, placement, decision rights, and skills of human resources for IT.
controls.test_criteria: Review IT staffing plans, skills matrices, and succession planning documentation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Staffing plan, skills/competency matrix, performance review records, succession plan.

controls.title: Managed Relationships
controls.description: Manage the relationship between the business and IT in a formalized, transparent way that fosters a trust-based, collaborative culture.
controls.test_criteria: Review business-IT relationship governance structures (e.g., business relationship manager role) and satisfaction survey results.
controls.evidence_requirement: Relationship management charter, business satisfaction survey results, governance meeting minutes.

controls.title: Managed Service Agreements
controls.description: Align IT-enabled services and service levels with enterprise needs and expectations, including identifying, specifying, and monitoring services and SLAs.
controls.test_criteria: Review service catalog and SLA performance reports against agreed targets.
controls.evidence_requirement: Service catalog, SLA documents, SLA performance/compliance reports.

controls.title: Managed Vendors
controls.description: Manage IT-related products and services provided by all types of vendors to meet enterprise requirements, including vendor selection and performance management.
controls.test_criteria: Review vendor selection criteria, contract terms, and periodic vendor performance reviews.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vendor management policy, vendor scorecards, contract register, vendor risk assessments.

controls.title: Managed Quality
controls.description: Define and communicate quality requirements in all processes, procedures, and organizational outcomes, including quality control, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
controls.test_criteria: Review the quality management system documentation and quality metrics tracked over time.
controls.evidence_requirement: Quality management plan/policy, quality metrics dashboards, quality review records.

controls.title: Managed Risk
controls.description: Continually identify, assess, and reduce IT-related risk within levels of tolerance set by enterprise executive management.
controls.test_criteria: Review the IT risk register and verify risk treatment decisions align with the enterprise risk appetite.
controls.evidence_requirement: IT risk register, risk assessment methodology, risk treatment plans.

controls.title: Managed Security
controls.description: Define, operate, and monitor a system for information security management, including establishing and maintaining an information security management system (ISMS).
controls.test_criteria: Review the ISMS scope and policy documentation and confirm periodic management review occurs.
controls.evidence_requirement: ISMS scope document, information security policy, management review minutes.

controls.title: Managed Data
controls.description: Establish and maintain data governance arrangements that define roles, responsibilities, and processes for ensuring data quality, security, and compliance across its lifecycle.
controls.test_criteria: Review the data governance framework and data quality/stewardship reporting.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data governance policy, data stewardship assignments, data quality metrics reports.

controls.title: Managed Programs
controls.description: Manage all programs and projects from the investment portfolio in alignment with enterprise strategy and in a coordinated way, applying standard program management disciplines.
controls.test_criteria: Review program management methodology application and status reporting for a sample active program.
controls.evidence_requirement: Program charter, program management plan, status/milestone reports.

controls.title: Managed Requirements Definition
controls.description: Identify solutions and analyze requirements before acquisition or creation, ensuring they align with enterprise strategic requirements.
controls.test_criteria: Review requirements documentation traceability to approved business cases and stakeholder sign-off.
controls.evidence_requirement: Requirements specification documents, traceability matrix, stakeholder approval records.

controls.title: Managed Solutions Identification and Build
controls.description: Establish and maintain identified solutions in line with enterprise requirements covering design, development, procurement/contracting, and partnering with vendors.
controls.test_criteria: Review design documentation, build/test records, and procurement decisions for a sample solution.
controls.evidence_requirement: Solution design documents, build and test records, procurement/contract records.

controls.title: Managed Availability and Capacity
controls.description: Balance current and future needs for availability, performance, and capacity with cost-effective service provision.
controls.test_criteria: Review capacity planning forecasts against actual utilization and availability performance reports.
controls.evidence_requirement: Capacity management plan, availability performance reports, utilization monitoring data.

controls.title: Managed Organizational Change
controls.description: Maximize the likelihood of successfully implementing sustainable enterprise-wide organizational change, addressing culture and behavior change needs.
controls.test_criteria: Review change management plans and adoption/readiness assessments for a sample major IT change.
controls.evidence_requirement: Organizational change management plan, stakeholder readiness assessments, communication records.

controls.title: Managed IT Changes
controls.description: Manage all IT changes in a controlled manner, including standard, emergency, and urgent changes to production processes and configuration items.
controls.test_criteria: Sample change tickets to verify approval, testing, and rollback plan documentation prior to production deployment.
controls.evidence_requirement: Change management policy, change advisory board records, change tickets with approvals.

controls.title: Managed IT Change Acceptance and Transitioning
controls.description: Formally accept and make operational new solutions, including implementation planning, system conversion, acceptance testing, and post-implementation review.
controls.test_criteria: Review acceptance test results and post-implementation review reports for a sample deployed solution.
controls.evidence_requirement: User acceptance test records, go-live approval, post-implementation review report.

controls.title: Managed Knowledge
controls.description: Maintain the availability of relevant, current, validated, and reliable knowledge to support all process activities and facilitate decision-making.
controls.test_criteria: Review the knowledge management repository for currency and accessibility of key operational documentation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Knowledge management policy, documentation repository access logs, content review/update records.

controls.title: Managed Assets
controls.description: Manage IT assets through their lifecycle to ensure their use delivers value at optimal cost, remain operational, and are accounted for and physically protected.
controls.test_criteria: Reconcile the asset register against physical/discovery inventory and review asset disposal records.
controls.evidence_requirement: IT asset register, asset lifecycle management policy, disposal/decommissioning records.

controls.title: Managed Configuration
controls.description: Define and maintain descriptions and relationships between key resources and capabilities required to deliver IT-enabled services, including maintaining a configuration repository.
controls.test_criteria: Review the configuration management database (CMDB) for accuracy against actual deployed configuration items.
controls.evidence_requirement: CMDB export, configuration baseline records, configuration audit reports.

controls.title: Managed Projects
controls.description: Manage all individual projects to ensure successful outcomes consistent with strategic priorities, applying standard project management disciplines including scope, resources, risk, and quality.
controls.test_criteria: Review project management methodology artifacts (charter, schedule, risk log) for a sample project.
controls.evidence_requirement: Project charter, project plan/schedule, project risk log, project closure report.

controls.title: Managed Operations
controls.description: Coordinate and execute activities and operational procedures required to deliver internal and outsourced IT services, including executing predetermined standard operating procedures.
controls.test_criteria: Review operational runbooks and scheduling/monitoring records for routine IT operations.
controls.evidence_requirement: Operations manual/runbooks, job scheduling logs, operations monitoring reports.

controls.title: Managed Service Requests and Incidents
controls.description: Provide timely and effective response to user requests and resolution of all types of incidents, including restoration of normal service as quickly as possible.
controls.test_criteria: Sample incident and service request tickets to verify resolution within SLA targets and proper categorization.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident management policy, ticketing system records, SLA compliance reports.

controls.title: Managed Problems
controls.description: Identify and classify problems and their root causes, providing timely resolution to prevent recurring incidents and provide recommendations for improvements.
controls.test_criteria: Review problem management records to confirm root cause analysis is performed and linked to related incidents.
controls.evidence_requirement: Problem management log, root cause analysis reports, known error database.

controls.title: Managed Continuity
controls.description: Establish and maintain a plan to enable the business and IT to respond to incidents and disruptions to continue operations and maintain availability of resources at an acceptable level.
controls.test_criteria: Review the business continuity/DR plan and most recent continuity test results.
controls.evidence_requirement: Business continuity plan, DR test reports, backup verification records.

controls.title: Managed Security Services
controls.description: Protect enterprise information to maintain an acceptable level of information security risk in accordance with the security policy, including implementing and monitoring security controls.
controls.test_criteria: Review security monitoring logs, vulnerability management records, and security incident handling for the period.
controls.evidence_requirement: Security operations logs, vulnerability scan/remediation records, security incident reports.

controls.title: Managed Business Process Controls
controls.description: Maintain information integrity and security of information assets handled within business processes in the enterprise or an outsourced operation.
controls.test_criteria: Review business process control documentation and sample transaction records for control effectiveness.
controls.evidence_requirement: Business process control matrix, control testing evidence, segregation-of-duties review records.

controls.title: Managed Performance and Conformance Monitoring
controls.description: Collect, validate, and evaluate business, IT, and process goals and metrics, monitoring that processes are performing against agreed performance and conformance goals and targets.
controls.test_criteria: Review the performance measurement framework and sample dashboards/reports against targets.
controls.evidence_requirement: Performance measurement framework, KPI/metrics dashboards, management reporting records.

controls.title: Managed System of Internal Control
controls.description: Continuously monitor and evaluate the control environment, including self-assessments and independent assurance reviews, to identify control deficiencies and inefficiencies and initiate improvement actions.
controls.test_criteria: Review internal control self-assessment results and remediation tracking for identified deficiencies.
controls.evidence_requirement: Internal control self-assessment reports, control deficiency remediation log, independent assurance reports.

controls.title: Managed Compliance with External Requirements
controls.description: Evaluate compliance with external laws, regulations, and contractual requirements for information and technology processes and processing, and obtain assurance of compliance.
controls.test_criteria: Review the regulatory compliance register and evidence of compliance assessments against applicable external requirements.
controls.evidence_requirement: Compliance obligations register, compliance assessment reports, legal/regulatory tracking log.

controls.title: Managed Assurance
controls.description: Plan, scope, and execute assurance initiatives using a risk-based approach to determine the level of effectiveness of enterprise governance and management of I&T.
controls.test_criteria: Review the assurance program plan and sample completed assurance engagement reports.
controls.evidence_requirement: Assurance program plan, internal/external audit reports, assurance engagement scope documents.

name: NIST AI RMF
description: The NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0), published by the U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology in January 2023, is a voluntary framework to help organizations manage risks associated with the design, development, deployment, and use of AI systems across their lifecycle.
notes: Controls map to the framework's four core functions (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage) and their 19 categories, which are AI RMF's own top-level structure above its more granular subcategories/actions.

controls.title: Policies, Processes, Procedures, and Practices
controls.description: Establish and maintain policies, processes, procedures, and practices across the organization to cultivate a culture of AI risk management that is understood and in place.
controls.test_criteria: Review AI governance policy documentation and confirm it addresses the organization's specific AI risk tolerance and legal/regulatory context.
controls.evidence_requirement: AI governance policy, AI risk management charter, documented risk tolerance statement.

controls.title: Accountability Structures
controls.description: Establish accountability structures so relevant teams and individuals are empowered, responsible, and trained for mapping, measuring, and managing AI risks.
controls.test_criteria: Review the AI accountability RACI or equivalent, and training records for personnel with AI risk responsibilities.
controls.evidence_requirement: AI roles and responsibilities matrix, AI risk training records, escalation path documentation.

controls.title: Workforce Diversity and Risk Culture
controls.description: Ensure decision-making throughout the AI lifecycle incorporates a diverse team, and that organizational practices support a culture that prioritizes identification and management of AI risks.
controls.test_criteria: Review team composition for AI projects and interview records or surveys assessing risk culture.
controls.evidence_requirement: AI project team rosters, diversity/inclusion practice documentation, risk culture survey results.

controls.title: Risk Management Culture
controls.description: Cultivate an organizational culture that considers and communicates AI risk, including organizational commitment to minimizing negative impacts and strengths/limitations of AI systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review internal communications and documentation showing AI risk and system limitations are disclosed to relevant stakeholders.
controls.evidence_requirement: AI system documentation/model cards, internal risk communication records, limitations disclosure statements.

controls.title: Stakeholder Engagement Mechanisms
controls.description: Establish processes for robust engagement with relevant AI actors, including affected individuals and communities, to inform risk management activities.
controls.test_criteria: Review stakeholder engagement records and confirm feedback mechanisms exist for individuals affected by AI system outputs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Stakeholder engagement plan, feedback/complaint intake records, affected-community consultation logs.

controls.title: Third-Party Risk Policies
controls.description: Policies and procedures are in place to address AI risks and benefits arising from third-party software, data, and other supply chain components and resources.
controls.test_criteria: Review third-party AI component risk assessment records (e.g., pretrained models, training datasets, APIs) and vendor contract risk language.
controls.evidence_requirement: Third-party AI risk assessment reports, vendor/supplier inventory for AI components, contract clauses addressing AI risk.

controls.title: Context Established
controls.description: Context is established and understood, including the intended purposes, potentially beneficial uses, and context-specific risks of the AI system.
controls.test_criteria: Review the AI system's documented purpose, intended use cases, and out-of-scope/prohibited uses.
controls.evidence_requirement: AI system purpose statement, intended use documentation, use-case risk assessment.

controls.title: Categorization of AI System
controls.description: The AI system is categorized based on its characteristics, including whether it is a general-purpose system, embedded in a product, or a high-risk application.
controls.test_criteria: Review the AI system categorization documentation against the organization's risk taxonomy.
controls.evidence_requirement: AI system classification/categorization record, risk taxonomy/criteria documentation.

controls.title: AI Capabilities, Benefits, and Costs Characterized
controls.description: AI capabilities, targeted usage, goals, and expected benefits and costs compared with appropriate benchmarks are understood.
controls.test_criteria: Review benchmark comparison results and documented expected benefits versus observed performance.
controls.evidence_requirement: Benchmarking reports, cost-benefit analysis documentation, performance target documentation.

controls.title: Risks and Benefits Mapped for Components
controls.description: Risks and benefits are mapped for all components of the AI system, including third-party software, data, and other supply chain elements.
controls.test_criteria: Review a component-level risk mapping (data sources, model dependencies, third-party libraries) for the AI system.
controls.evidence_requirement: AI system component inventory, data lineage documentation, component risk mapping.

controls.title: Impacts Characterized
controls.description: Impacts to individuals, groups, communities, organizations, and society are characterized, including likelihood and magnitude of both positive and negative impacts.
controls.test_criteria: Review the AI impact assessment documentation covering identified affected groups and potential harms.
controls.evidence_requirement: AI impact assessment report, algorithmic impact assessment, affected-stakeholder analysis.

controls.title: Appropriate Methods and Metrics Identified
controls.description: Appropriate methods and metrics are identified and applied to measure identified AI risks, including validity, reliability, and robustness.
controls.test_criteria: Review documented evaluation metrics and methodology used to assess model performance and risk.
controls.evidence_requirement: Model evaluation methodology, test/validation metric results, metric selection rationale.

controls.title: AI Systems Evaluated for Trustworthy Characteristics
controls.description: AI systems are evaluated for trustworthy characteristics including fairness/bias, explainability, privacy, safety, and security.
controls.test_criteria: Review bias/fairness testing results, explainability documentation, and security/privacy testing reports for the AI system.
controls.evidence_requirement: Bias and fairness testing reports, model explainability documentation, security/privacy test results.

controls.title: Mechanisms for Tracking Identified Risks
controls.description: Mechanisms for tracking identified AI risks over time are in place, and the effectiveness of risk controls is regularly assessed.
controls.test_criteria: Review the AI risk tracking log and evidence of periodic effectiveness review for implemented controls.
controls.evidence_requirement: AI risk register/tracking log, control effectiveness review records, monitoring dashboards.

controls.title: Feedback from Users and Affected Communities
controls.description: Feedback about efficacy of measurement is gathered and assessed from relevant AI actors, including impacted individuals and communities.
controls.test_criteria: Review user/community feedback intake records and evidence the feedback was incorporated into measurement updates.
controls.evidence_requirement: Feedback collection logs, user research/survey results, measurement update records referencing feedback.

controls.title: AI Risks Prioritized and Acted Upon
controls.description: AI risks based on assessments and other analytical output from the Map and Measure functions are prioritized, responded to, and managed.
controls.test_criteria: Review the risk prioritization methodology and confirm high-priority AI risks have documented treatment plans.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk prioritization matrix, risk treatment plans, decision records for accepted/mitigated risks.

controls.title: Benefits and Costs Analyzed for Deployment Decisions
controls.description: Mechanisms are in place and applied to sustain the value of deployed AI systems, including analysis of benefits versus costs for go/no-go decisions.
controls.test_criteria: Review deployment decision records including documented cost-benefit analysis and go/no-go approval.
controls.evidence_requirement: Deployment decision/approval records, cost-benefit analysis documentation, system decommissioning criteria.

controls.title: Third-Party Risks Managed
controls.description: AI risks and benefits from third-party resources are regularly monitored, and response and recovery plans for third-party-sourced risks are in place.
controls.test_criteria: Review ongoing monitoring records for third-party AI components and incident response plans addressing third-party failures.
controls.evidence_requirement: Third-party monitoring reports, supplier incident response plans, contract SLA compliance records.

controls.title: Risk Treatments Monitored and Responded To
controls.description: Risk treatments, including response and recovery, are documented and monitored regularly, and context is updated based on new information or changing conditions.
controls.test_criteria: Review the risk treatment monitoring log and evidence that AI system context/documentation was updated following incidents or drift detection.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk treatment monitoring log, model drift/performance monitoring reports, incident post-mortem and documentation updates.

name: ISO 20000-1:2018
description: ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018 is the international standard for IT Service Management Systems (SMS), published by ISO/IEC and certifiable through accredited certification bodies, specifying requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an organization's capability to plan, design, transition, deliver, and improve IT services.
notes: Controls map to the standard's Annex SL high-level structure, Clauses 4-10, with Clause 8 (Operation) broken into its named sub-clauses for assessable granularity since it is by far the largest, most operationally substantive clause. Exact sub-clause numbering should be verified against the licensed standard text, which cannot be reproduced verbatim here.

controls.title: Context of the Organization
controls.description: Determine internal and external issues relevant to the SMS, identify interested parties and their requirements, and define the scope of the service management system.
controls.test_criteria: Review the documented SMS scope statement and interested-party requirements analysis for completeness and currency.
controls.evidence_requirement: SMS scope document, interested party/requirements register, context analysis documentation.

controls.title: Leadership
controls.description: Top management must demonstrate leadership and commitment to the SMS, establish a service management policy, and assign organizational roles, responsibilities, and authorities.
controls.test_criteria: Review the service management policy approval and evidence of top management involvement (e.g., management review attendance, resource allocation decisions).
controls.evidence_requirement: Service management policy, management review minutes, roles/responsibilities assignment documentation.

controls.title: Planning
controls.description: Address risks and opportunities affecting the SMS, establish service management objectives and plans to achieve them, and plan changes to the SMS.
controls.test_criteria: Review documented SMS objectives, associated plans, and risk/opportunity register linked to the SMS.
controls.evidence_requirement: SMS objectives documentation, SMS risk and opportunity register, change planning records.

controls.title: Support
controls.description: Determine and provide resources, competence, awareness, communication, and documented information needed to establish, implement, and improve the SMS.
controls.test_criteria: Review competence/training records for service management personnel and the document control procedure for SMS documentation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Competence and training records, document control procedure, internal/external communication records, resource allocation evidence.

controls.title: Operational Planning and Control
controls.description: Plan, implement, and control the processes needed to meet service management requirements, including managing planned changes and reviewing consequences of unintended changes.
controls.test_criteria: Review operational planning documentation and evidence of control over outsourced or externally provided processes.
controls.evidence_requirement: Operational plans, process control procedures, outsourcing/external provider control records.

controls.title: Service Portfolio Management
controls.description: Covers service delivery planning, planning and management of new or changed services, control of parties involved in the service lifecycle, service catalogue management, and asset and configuration management.
controls.test_criteria: Review the service catalogue currency, new/changed service transition records, and configuration management database accuracy.
controls.evidence_requirement: Service catalogue, new/changed service plans, configuration management database (CMDB), asset inventory.

controls.title: Relationship and Agreement
controls.description: Covers business relationship management, service level management (including SLA definition and monitoring), and supplier management across the supply chain.
controls.test_criteria: Review SLA documents and performance reports against targets, and supplier performance review records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Service level agreements, SLA performance reports, supplier contracts and performance reviews, customer satisfaction records.

controls.title: Supply and Demand Management
controls.description: Covers budgeting and accounting for services, demand management, and capacity management to ensure services meet current and future demand.
controls.test_criteria: Review service budgets/cost accounting records and capacity plans against actual utilization and demand forecasts.
controls.evidence_requirement: Service budget and cost reports, demand forecasts, capacity management plan and utilization reports.

controls.title: Service Design, Build, and Transition
controls.description: Covers change management, and the design, build, and transition of new or changed services and components, including release and deployment management.
controls.test_criteria: Sample change records for approval/testing evidence and review release/deployment records for a transitioned service.
controls.evidence_requirement: Change management log, service design/transition plans, release and deployment records.

controls.title: Resolution and Fulfilment
controls.description: Covers incident management, service request management, and problem management to restore service and resolve root causes of disruptions.
controls.test_criteria: Sample incident and service request tickets for resolution within target timeframes, and review problem records for root cause closure.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident management log, service request records, problem management log with root cause analysis.

controls.title: Service Assurance
controls.description: Covers service availability management, service continuity management, and information security management to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of services.
controls.test_criteria: Review availability/continuity plans and test results, and information security incident records related to service delivery.
controls.evidence_requirement: Availability management plan and reports, service continuity test records, information security incident log.

controls.title: Performance Evaluation
controls.description: Monitor, measure, analyze, and evaluate the SMS and services, conduct internal audits, and perform management reviews of the SMS.
controls.test_criteria: Review the internal audit program results and management review minutes for evidence of SMS performance evaluation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Internal audit schedule and reports, management review minutes, service performance/KPI reports.

controls.title: Improvement
controls.description: Manage nonconformities and take corrective action, and continually improve the suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the SMS and the services it manages.
controls.test_criteria: Review the nonconformity and corrective action log for root cause analysis and closure verification, and evidence of continual improvement initiatives.
controls.evidence_requirement: Nonconformity/corrective action register, continual improvement register, improvement initiative tracking records.

name: EASA
description: This entry is scoped to EASA Part-IS (Information Security in Aviation) under Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1645 and Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/203, the European Union's cross-domain aviation cybersecurity/ISMS regulation enforced by EASA and national competent authorities, which requires covered aviation organizations (design/production/airworthiness, air operations, aerodromes, ATM/ANS, and related domains) to establish and operate an Information Security Management System.
notes: EASA governs many distinct, highly technical certification codes (e.g., CS-25 airworthiness, Part-ORO operations, Part-145 maintenance), none of which are themselves GRC-trackable 'compliance frameworks' in the SOC2/ISO27001 sense. Part-IS was selected as the best fit because it is an EU-wide, control-based ISMS regulation applicable horizontally across aviation domains, closely modeled on ISO 27001-style risk management. However, exact requirement numbering (IS.OR./IS.I.OR. articles) varies slightly by implementing annex and amending ED Decisions (2023/008-010/R, amended 2025/013-015/R), and could not be independently verified against the primary regulation text in this session beyond secondary-source summaries; treat article codes below as representative/approximate and verify against the current Easy Access Rules for Regulations (EU) 2022/1645 and (EU) 2023/203 on easa.europa.eu before formal use. Applicability dates (16 Oct 2025 for the Delegated Regulation; 22 Feb 2026 for the Implementing Regulation) have both passed as of this writing.

controls.title: Scope and General Requirements
controls.description: Establishes the applicability of Part-IS information security requirements to the organization based on its aviation domain approval(s), and the obligation to comply with information security requirements as a condition of continued certification.
controls.test_criteria: Review the organization's exposition/manual to confirm Part-IS applicability has been determined and documented against its EASA approvals.
controls.evidence_requirement: Organization exposition manual, Part-IS applicability determination, EASA approval certificates.

controls.title: Information Security Management System (ISMS)
controls.description: Requires the organization to establish, implement, and maintain an ISMS appropriate to its size, nature, and complexity, integrated where practicable with existing safety management systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review the ISMS manual/scope and confirm integration points with the organization's Safety Management System (SMS).
controls.evidence_requirement: ISMS manual, ISMS scope statement, SMS-ISMS integration documentation.

controls.title: Information Security Risk Assessment
controls.description: Requires identification of information security risks associated with the organization's activities, systems, and data, including risks that could affect aviation safety, and assessment of their likelihood and severity.
controls.test_criteria: Review the information security risk assessment methodology and sample completed risk assessments for covered systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk assessment methodology document, completed risk assessment reports, risk register.

controls.title: Information Security Risk Treatment
