controls.description: Requires selection and implementation of measures to treat identified information security risks to an acceptable level, consistent with the organization's risk tolerance.
controls.test_criteria: Review risk treatment plans and confirm implemented controls map to identified risks in the risk register.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk treatment plan, control implementation evidence, residual risk acceptance records.

controls.title: Information Security Internal Reporting Scheme
controls.description: Requires an internal reporting scheme enabling personnel to report information security events, vulnerabilities, and incidents for review and action.
controls.test_criteria: Review internal reporting procedure and sample internally reported events for evidence of triage and follow-up.
controls.evidence_requirement: Internal reporting procedure, internal event report log, triage/investigation records.

controls.title: Information Security External Reporting Scheme
controls.description: Requires reporting of information security incidents that affect aviation safety to the competent authority and other relevant stakeholders within defined timeframes.
controls.test_criteria: Sample a reportable incident and verify notification to the competent authority occurred within the required timeframe.
controls.evidence_requirement: External reporting procedure, competent authority notification records, incident timeline documentation.

controls.title: Response to Findings Identified by the Competent Authority
controls.description: Requires the organization to analyze and respond to information security findings and recommendations communicated by the competent authority, implementing corrective actions as agreed.
controls.test_criteria: Review corrective action plans issued in response to competent authority findings and verify closure evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Finding/corrective action correspondence, corrective action plan, closure verification records.

controls.title: Information Security Incident Response Plan
controls.description: Requires a documented, tested plan for detecting, responding to, containing, and recovering from information security incidents affecting the organization's systems and data.
controls.test_criteria: Review the incident response plan and evidence of periodic testing (tabletop exercises or simulations).
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security incident response plan, exercise/test reports, incident response team contact list.

controls.title: Contracting of Information Security Management Tasks
controls.description: Requires that where ISMS tasks or activities are contracted to external parties, the organization retains accountability and ensures contracted parties meet equivalent information security requirements.
controls.test_criteria: Review contracts with outsourced ISMS service providers for information security requirement clauses and oversight mechanisms.
controls.evidence_requirement: Outsourcing contracts with security clauses, third-party oversight/audit records.

controls.title: Personnel Requirements
controls.description: Requires the organization to employ personnel with the necessary competence, knowledge, and authority to perform ISMS-related tasks, and to provide appropriate information security training.
controls.test_criteria: Review competence records and training completion for personnel assigned ISMS responsibilities, including the accountable manager.
controls.evidence_requirement: Personnel competence records, ISMS training records, accountable manager designation.

controls.title: Record-Keeping
controls.description: Requires retention of records demonstrating compliance with Part-IS requirements, including risk assessments, incident reports, and training records, for a defined minimum period.
controls.test_criteria: Review the record retention schedule and sample stored records for completeness and accessibility.
controls.evidence_requirement: Record retention policy, sample retained ISMS records, record storage/access controls.

controls.title: Management System Documentation (ISMS Manual)
controls.description: Requires documentation of the ISMS, including policies, procedures, roles and responsibilities, and how the ISMS meets Part-IS requirements, kept current and available to relevant personnel and the competent authority.
controls.test_criteria: Review the ISMS manual for completeness against Part-IS requirements and confirm version control and distribution to relevant personnel.
controls.evidence_requirement: ISMS manual, document control/version history, distribution and acknowledgment records.

name: RBI DPSC (Digital Payment Security Controls) for NBFCs (2026)
description: The Reserve Bank of India's Digital Payment Security Controls (DPSC) framework mandates baseline technology, cyber-security, and governance controls for digital payment products and services; originally issued for banks in 2021, RBI has progressively extended dedicated DPSC Master Directions to other regulated entities, including a 2026 Direction covering credit-card issuing NBFCs.
notes: RBI's original DPSC Master Direction (2021) applied to banks. Public filings (TaxGuru, Lexplosion) confirm RBI ran a draft consultation (Apr-May 2026) and issued the 'Reserve Bank of India (NBFC - Digital Payment Security Controls) Directions, 2026' specifically scoped to credit-card issuing NBFCs, with a parallel, separately-issued Direction for Small Finance Banks - this is a targeted extension, not a blanket rule for all NBFCs. Secondary sources give conflicting effective dates (31.07.2026 vs 31.07.2027); confirm the exact effective/commencement date against the official RBI notification before using it in an audit timeline. The control set below is modeled on the established DPSC chapter structure (governance, generic controls, ASLC, authentication, fraud risk management, channel-specific controls, SOC) as applied to the credit-card-issuing-NBFC context, since the detailed clause text of the 2026 Direction was not independently verified line-by-line.

controls.title: Board-Approved Governance & IT Steering
controls.description: A board-approved digital payment security policy and governance structure (IT Strategy/Steering Committee, designated CISO) must oversee digital payment risk end to end.
controls.test_criteria: Review board/committee minutes approving the digital payment security policy and verify the CISO's reporting line and mandate.
controls.evidence_requirement: Board-approved policy document, committee charter, meeting minutes, CISO appointment letter.

controls.title: Generic Security Controls
controls.description: Baseline technology controls - patch management, system hardening, anti-malware, data leakage prevention, and DC/DR arrangements - must be applied to all systems supporting digital payment products.
controls.test_criteria: Sample systems supporting payment products and verify patch levels, hardening baselines, and DLP coverage.
controls.evidence_requirement: Patch management records, hardening checklists/baselines, DLP policy and alert logs.

controls.title: Application Security Life Cycle (ASLC)
controls.description: Payment applications must follow a secure SDLC including threat modeling, secure code review, and VA/PT prior to go-live and after major changes.
controls.test_criteria: Trace a sample release through SDLC gates and confirm VA/PT was completed and findings closed before deployment.
controls.evidence_requirement: SDLC policy, code review records, VAPT reports, change/release approval records.

controls.title: Authentication Framework
controls.description: Risk-based/adaptive multi-factor authentication must be enforced for customer digital payment transactions and for privileged/administrative access to payment systems.
controls.test_criteria: Verify MFA configuration and risk-based authentication rules on a sample of transaction and admin-access flows.
controls.evidence_requirement: Authentication system configuration, MFA enrollment records, risk-engine rule documentation.

controls.title: Fraud Risk Management
controls.description: A real-time, rule-based or AI-assisted fraud monitoring capability must flag and act on suspicious digital payment transactions, with defined dispute/chargeback handling.
controls.test_criteria: Review fraud rule configuration and sample alert-to-resolution case files.
controls.evidence_requirement: Fraud monitoring system configuration, alert/case logs, chargeback register.

controls.title: Reconciliation Mechanism
controls.description: Digital payment transactions must be reconciled on a near-real-time basis across core systems, switches, and payment gateways, with exceptions investigated promptly.
controls.test_criteria: Review reconciliation reports and evidence of timely exception resolution for a sample period.
controls.evidence_requirement: Daily/near-real-time reconciliation reports, exception logs and resolution records.

controls.title: Security Operations Centre (SOC)
controls.description: A 24x7 SOC capability with SIEM correlation and threat-intelligence feeds must monitor digital payment infrastructure for anomalies and attacks.
controls.test_criteria: Review SOC staffing/coverage model and sample SIEM alert-to-closure tickets.
controls.evidence_requirement: SOC charter/runbook, SIEM dashboard exports, incident ticket samples.

controls.title: Digital Channel (Web) Security Controls
controls.description: Customer-facing web/net-banking-equivalent digital payment channels must enforce transport encryption, secure session management, and transaction-level controls.
controls.test_criteria: Inspect TLS configuration, session timeout, and transaction signing controls on the web channel.
controls.evidence_requirement: TLS/cipher configuration, session management settings, penetration test results.

controls.title: Mobile Payment Application Security Controls
controls.description: Mobile payment apps must implement app hardening, root/jailbreak and tamper detection, and secure on-device key storage.
controls.test_criteria: Review mobile app security test results against OWASP MASVS-aligned checks.
controls.evidence_requirement: Mobile app security/pen-test report, secure coding checklist, app-store release notes.

controls.title: Card Payment Security Controls
controls.description: Card-present and card-not-present transaction flows must use tokenisation and align with PCI DSS requirements, including controls specific to credit card issuance and usage.
controls.test_criteria: Verify tokenisation vault configuration and review the current PCI DSS Attestation/Report of Compliance.
controls.evidence_requirement: Tokenisation architecture documentation, PCI DSS AOC/ROC, card data flow diagram.

controls.title: Data Localisation & Storage of Payment System Data
controls.description: Payment system data relating to Indian transactions must be stored only in systems located in India per applicable RBI data localisation norms.
controls.test_criteria: Review data flow diagrams and hosting/cloud agreements to confirm in-India storage and processing of payment data.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data flow diagrams, hosting/cloud contracts, storage location attestations.

controls.title: Cyber Security Incident Reporting
controls.description: Digital payment security incidents must be detected, triaged, and reported to RBI and CERT-In within the prescribed regulatory timelines.
controls.test_criteria: Sample a reported incident and verify timeliness and completeness of RBI/CERT-In notification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, incident log, RBI/CERT-In notification records.

controls.title: Third-Party & Payment Aggregator Risk Management
controls.description: Due diligence and contractual security requirements must be applied to payment aggregators, gateways, and other outsourced digital payment service providers.
controls.test_criteria: Review vendor risk assessment files and contract clauses covering security obligations and audit rights.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vendor due-diligence reports, contracts/SLAs with security clauses, periodic vendor review records.

controls.title: Customer Awareness & Grievance Redressal
controls.description: Customers must be educated on safe digital payment practices and provided a defined, time-bound grievance redressal mechanism for payment security issues.
controls.test_criteria: Review customer communication/awareness material and sample grievance tickets for timeliness of resolution.
controls.evidence_requirement: Customer awareness campaign samples, grievance redressal policy, grievance register with resolution timelines.

controls.title: Independent IS Audit & Assurance
controls.description: Digital payment systems must be subject to periodic internal and external information systems audits with tracked closure of findings.
controls.test_criteria: Review the latest IS audit report and the remediation tracker for open findings.
controls.evidence_requirement: IS audit reports, management responses, remediation/closure tracker.

name: NIST 800-53 Rev5 (Low Baseline)
description: NIST Special Publication 800-53 Revision 5 defines a catalog of security and privacy controls for federal information systems and organizations; the Low control baseline (defined in SP 800-53B) selects the minimum base controls, with few or no enhancements, appropriate for systems where a security/privacy breach would have a limited adverse effect.
notes: NIST 800-53 Rev5 and its companion SP 800-53B baselines are well-documented, stable publications. The 20 control families listed (excluding the organization-wide Program Management family, PM, which is included here for completeness since GRC platforms commonly track it regardless of system impact level) reflect the actual Rev5 structure. Exact control/enhancement counts per family at Low baseline should be cross-checked against the current SP 800-53B spreadsheet for precision at the sub-control level, since this framework is tracked here at family/top-level granularity only.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: [Low baseline] Establishes policies and mechanisms for managing accounts, enforcing least privilege and separation of duties, and controlling logical access to systems and information. At Low, only the foundational base controls are selected, appropriate for systems where loss of confidentiality, integrity, or availability would have a limited adverse effect.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews account management procedures, access authorization records, and least-privilege configuration against the SSP to confirm the Low-baseline AC controls are implemented.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, account provisioning/deprovisioning records, access review logs, SSP control narrative.

controls.title: Awareness and Training
controls.description: [Low baseline] Requires security and privacy awareness training for all users and role-based training for personnel with significant security responsibilities, at the minimum frequency and content required for low-impact systems.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor samples training records to confirm completion rates and content coverage match policy.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training policy, completion records/LMS reports, training materials.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.description: [Low baseline] Covers generation, protection, and review of a base set of audit records sufficient to support basic monitoring and after-the-fact investigation for low-impact systems.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor verifies audit log generation, retention period, and periodic review for in-scope systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Audit/logging configuration, log retention settings, log review records.

controls.title: Assessment, Authorization, and Monitoring
controls.description: [Low baseline] Governs periodic control assessments, POA&M management, and an authorization decision, using streamlined assessment procedures appropriate to low-impact systems.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews the most recent assessment report, POA&M status, and the current authorization decision/ATO.
controls.evidence_requirement: Security assessment report, POA&M, authorization memorandum/ATO letter.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.description: [Low baseline] Establishes baseline configurations, a basic change-control process, and component inventory for low-impact systems, without the extensive automation required at higher baselines.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor compares deployed configuration against the documented baseline and reviews a sample of change records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Configuration baseline documents, change management records, component inventory.

controls.title: Contingency Planning
controls.description: [Low baseline] Requires a contingency plan and basic backup procedures sufficient to recover system functionality after a disruption, with reduced testing frequency relative to higher baselines.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews the contingency plan, backup logs, and the most recent test/exercise results.
controls.evidence_requirement: Contingency plan document, backup logs, contingency plan test report.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.description: [Low baseline] Requires unique identification and authentication of users and devices before granting access, using the base authenticator requirements for low-impact systems.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor verifies unique user IDs and authenticator strength/configuration on a sample of accounts.
controls.evidence_requirement: Identity management configuration, authenticator policy, account listing.

controls.title: Incident Response
controls.description: [Low baseline] Covers basic incident response planning, training, and handling/reporting capability appropriate for low-impact systems.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews the incident response plan and evidence of at least one test/exercise or real incident handled per it.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, incident log, after-action/test report.

controls.title: Maintenance
controls.description: [Low baseline] Controls the performance of routine system maintenance, including authorization of maintenance personnel and tools, at the base level required for low-impact systems.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews maintenance records and authorization lists for personnel and tools used.
controls.evidence_requirement: Maintenance logs, authorized personnel/tool list, remote maintenance records.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.description: [Low baseline] Requires basic protection, storage, and sanitization/disposal controls for digital and non-digital media containing low-impact system information.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews media handling and sanitization/disposal records for a sample of media.
controls.evidence_requirement: Media protection policy, sanitization/disposal logs, media inventory.

controls.title: Physical and Environmental Protection
controls.description: [Low baseline] Covers physical access authorization, visitor control, and basic environmental protections for facilities housing low-impact systems.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor tours or reviews evidence of facility access controls and environmental safeguards (fire, power).
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access logs, visitor logs, environmental control maintenance records.

controls.title: Planning
controls.description: [Low baseline] Requires a system security plan, rules of behavior, and basic architecture description sufficient for a low-impact system.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews the SSP for completeness and currency against the actual system.
controls.evidence_requirement: System Security Plan, signed rules of behavior, system architecture diagram.

controls.title: Program Management
controls.description: Establishes organization-wide information security and privacy program activities - risk management strategy, enterprise architecture integration, and resourcing - that support all systems regardless of individual system impact level.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews organization-level program documentation (risk management strategy, security plan) rather than system-specific artifacts.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security program plan, risk management strategy document, workforce/resourcing plan.

controls.title: Personnel Security
controls.description: [Low baseline] Covers basic position risk designation, personnel screening, and termination/transfer procedures for low-impact systems.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor samples personnel files to confirm screening was completed prior to access and that termination procedures were followed for departed staff.
controls.evidence_requirement: Position risk designations, screening/background check records, termination checklist.

controls.title: PII Processing and Transparency
controls.description: [Low baseline] Requires an authority-to-process determination and a basic privacy notice for low-impact systems that process personally identifiable information.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor confirms a documented legal authority to process PII and reviews the published privacy notice.
controls.evidence_requirement: Authority-to-process determination, privacy notice/policy, PII inventory.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: [Low baseline] Requires a risk assessment and vulnerability scanning at the base frequency appropriate for low-impact systems.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews the most recent risk assessment report and vulnerability scan results.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk assessment report, vulnerability scan reports, risk register.

controls.title: System and Services Acquisition
controls.description: [Low baseline] Integrates basic security requirements into acquisition and the system development life cycle for low-impact systems.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews acquisition/contract language and SDLC artifacts for security requirement inclusion.
controls.evidence_requirement: Acquisition security requirements/contract clauses, SDLC documentation.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.description: [Low baseline] Covers basic boundary protection and transmission confidentiality for low-impact systems, without the extensive cryptographic and architectural requirements of higher baselines.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews firewall/boundary device configuration and transmission encryption settings.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network architecture diagram, firewall rule sets, encryption configuration.

controls.title: System and Information Integrity
controls.description: [Low baseline] Requires basic flaw remediation (patching) and malicious code protection appropriate for low-impact systems.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews patch compliance reports and anti-malware deployment/alert status.
controls.evidence_requirement: Patch management reports, anti-malware console status, flaw remediation records.

controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Management
controls.description: [Low baseline] Requires a basic supply chain risk management approach and acquisition strategy addressing component authenticity for low-impact systems.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews the supply chain risk management plan and evidence of component authenticity verification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Supply chain risk management plan, vendor/component sourcing records.

name: NIST 800-53 Rev5 (High Baseline)
description: NIST Special Publication 800-53 Revision 5 defines a catalog of security and privacy controls for federal information systems and organizations; the High control baseline (defined in SP 800-53B) selects the full base control set plus numerous control enhancements, required for systems where a security/privacy breach would have a severe or catastrophic adverse effect.
notes: Same 20 Rev5 control families as the Low and Moderate baselines; the High baseline adds significantly more controls and enhancements per family (e.g., automated enforcement, additional redundancy, more frequent and independent testing) rather than introducing new families. Exact enhancement counts per family should be verified against the current SP 800-53B baseline spreadsheet; this framework is tracked here at family/top-level granularity only.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: [High baseline] Establishes policies and mechanisms for managing accounts, enforcing least privilege and separation of duties, and controlling logical access. At High, the base controls are augmented with enhancements such as automated account management, concurrent session control, and dynamic privilege management, required for severe/catastrophic-impact systems.
controls.test_criteria: Independent assessor tests both base AC controls and required enhancements (e.g., automated account disabling, concurrent session limits) through technical testing and configuration review.
controls.evidence_requirement: SSP control narrative, automated account management tool configuration/output, session control settings, access review logs.

controls.title: Awareness and Training
controls.description: [High baseline] Requires enhanced security/privacy awareness and role-based training, including more frequent refresher training and practical/simulated exercises (e.g., phishing simulations), beyond the Low/Moderate base requirement.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews training frequency, content depth, and results of simulated exercises (e.g., phishing test pass rates).
controls.evidence_requirement: Training records, simulated-exercise results, role-based training curricula.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.description: [High baseline] Requires comprehensive audit record generation, centralized log correlation, audit reduction/report generation capability, and protection against audit log tampering, in addition to base logging requirements.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor verifies centralized log aggregation/SIEM correlation, log integrity protections, and automated alerting on audit failure.
controls.evidence_requirement: SIEM configuration and dashboards, log integrity controls, audit review and alert records.

controls.title: Assessment, Authorization, and Monitoring
controls.description: [High baseline] Requires more rigorous and frequent independent assessments, continuous monitoring with automated tooling, and tighter POA&M remediation timelines than lower baselines.
controls.test_criteria: Independent assessor reviews continuous monitoring dashboards, assessment frequency, and POA&M closure timeliness against High-baseline requirements.
controls.evidence_requirement: Continuous monitoring plan and dashboard exports, independent assessment reports, POA&M with remediation timelines.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.description: [High baseline] Requires automated configuration management and compliance checking, strict least-functionality enforcement, and signed/verified software execution, beyond the base configuration control requirement.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews automated configuration compliance tool output (e.g., SCAP scan results) against the approved baseline.
controls.evidence_requirement: Automated configuration scan reports, approved software/allow-list, change control board records.

controls.title: Contingency Planning
controls.description: [High baseline] Requires alternate processing and storage sites with reduced recovery time/point objectives, more frequent contingency plan testing, and full system backup and reconstitution capability.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews RTO/RPO documentation, alternate site agreements, and results of a full-scale contingency exercise.
controls.evidence_requirement: Alternate site contracts/agreements, RTO/RPO documentation, full-scale test/exercise after-action report.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.description: [High baseline] Requires multi-factor, PKI-based, or equivalent strong authentication for all users (including privileged and remote access), replay-resistant mechanisms, and device authentication, beyond the base identification requirement.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor tests MFA/PKI enforcement for privileged and remote access and verifies replay-resistant authentication mechanisms.
controls.evidence_requirement: MFA/PKI configuration, privileged access authentication logs, device authentication records.

controls.title: Incident Response
controls.description: [High baseline] Requires more frequent and realistic incident response testing (e.g., full-scale simulations), automated incident handling support tools, and integration with organizational and external (e.g., US-CERT) reporting, beyond the base plan requirement.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews results of a full-scale incident response exercise and verifies automated detection/handling tool integration.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response exercise after-action report, SOAR/ticketing tool configuration, external reporting records.

controls.title: Maintenance
controls.description: [High baseline] Requires stricter controls over remote maintenance sessions (e.g., cryptographic protection, two-factor authentication for maintenance personnel) and timely maintenance personnel vetting, beyond base maintenance control.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews remote maintenance session logs and cryptographic/authentication controls applied during maintenance.
controls.evidence_requirement: Remote maintenance session logs, maintenance personnel vetting records, encryption configuration for maintenance channels.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.description: [High baseline] Requires cryptographic protection of media at rest, stricter sanitization verification, and tighter media transport/custody controls than the base requirement.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor verifies encryption-at-rest for media and chain-of-custody records for media transport and sanitization verification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Encryption configuration for media, chain-of-custody logs, sanitization verification/certificates.

controls.title: Physical and Environmental Protection
controls.description: [High baseline] Requires enhanced physical access monitoring (e.g., intrusion detection, video surveillance retention), redundant power/environmental systems, and more stringent visitor control than base requirements.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews intrusion detection/video surveillance logs and redundant power/environmental system test records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical intrusion detection logs, surveillance retention records, redundant power/HVAC maintenance and test logs.

controls.title: Planning
controls.description: [High baseline] Requires a more detailed system security plan including a documented security architecture and concept of operations, plus central management of common controls, beyond the base planning requirement.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews the SSP's security architecture/CONOPS sections and verifies alignment with the actual deployed system.
controls.evidence_requirement: Detailed SSP with security architecture/CONOPS, common control provider documentation.

controls.title: Program Management
controls.description: Establishes organization-wide information security and privacy program activities - risk management strategy, enterprise architecture integration, and resourcing - that support all systems regardless of individual system impact level, with greater executive oversight expected for organizations operating High-impact systems.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews organization-level program documentation and executive risk reporting cadence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security program plan, enterprise risk management strategy, executive/board risk reporting records.

controls.title: Personnel Security
controls.description: [High baseline] Requires more rigorous position risk designations and periodic reinvestigation for personnel with access to High-impact systems, beyond the base screening requirement.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor samples personnel files to confirm periodic reinvestigation is tracked and completed on schedule.
controls.evidence_requirement: Position risk designation records, periodic reinvestigation schedule and completion records.

controls.title: PII Processing and Transparency
controls.description: [High baseline] Requires more rigorous authority-to-process determinations, automated consent/preference management, and tighter data quality controls for PII processed by High-impact systems.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews automated consent management tooling and data quality control results.
controls.evidence_requirement: Authority-to-process determination, consent management system configuration, data quality audit records.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: [High baseline] Requires more frequent risk assessments, continuous automated vulnerability scanning, and formal threat-hunting activity, beyond the base assessment requirement.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews continuous vulnerability scanning tool output and evidence of proactive threat-hunting activity.
controls.evidence_requirement: Continuous vulnerability scan reports, threat-hunting reports, updated risk register.

controls.title: System and Services Acquisition
controls.description: [High baseline] Requires more rigorous security requirements in acquisition, independent developer testing/evaluation, and supply chain integrity verification for components, beyond the base requirement.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews independent developer security testing results and acquisition contract security clauses.
controls.evidence_requirement: Independent security test/evaluation reports, acquisition contracts with security requirements, component integrity verification records.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.description: [High baseline] Requires FIPS-validated cryptography, network segmentation/micro-segmentation, denial-of-service protection, and more extensive boundary protection than the base requirement.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor verifies use of FIPS-validated cryptographic modules and tests network segmentation and DoS protection controls.
controls.evidence_requirement: FIPS validation certificates, network segmentation diagrams, DoS protection configuration and test results.

controls.title: System and Information Integrity
controls.description: [High baseline] Requires automated flaw remediation and centralized malicious code/intrusion detection with real-time alerting, plus integrity verification of software and firmware, beyond the base requirement.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews automated patch deployment metrics, centralized IDS/IPS alerting, and software/firmware integrity verification results.
controls.evidence_requirement: Automated patch management reports, IDS/IPS alert logs, software/firmware integrity verification records.

controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Management
controls.description: [High baseline] Requires a more comprehensive supply chain risk management plan including tamper-resistance and detection, component provenance tracking, and counterfeit prevention, beyond the base requirement.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews component provenance records and tamper-detection/counterfeit-prevention evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Supply chain risk management plan, component provenance/chain-of-custody records, counterfeit prevention procedures.

name: NEN 7510-1:2024
description: NEN 7510-1:2024 is the Dutch national standard specifying information security management system (ISMS) requirements for organizations in the healthcare sector, published by the Dutch standardization body NEN; it adopts the NEN-EN-ISO/IEC 27001:2023 management-system clauses and is paired with NEN 7510-2 for sector-specific controls.
notes: NEN 7510-1:2024 was published 16 December 2024, replacing NEN 7510:2017+A1:2020; the prior version remains usable for certification under accreditation until 20 February 2027. Part 1 carries ISO/IEC 27001:2023 clauses 4-10, while Part 2 (published 1 December 2024) provides the healthcare-specific Annex A control guidance; the standard text itself is paywalled, so the detailed Annex A control wording below is reconstructed from secondary certifier/vendor commentary (Kiwa, DEKRA, Brand Compliance) rather than the primary NEN publication, and several sources note NEN 7510:2024 is explicitly positioned to help healthcare organizations meet NIS2 obligations.

controls.title: Context of the Organization
controls.description: Requires determining internal/external issues, interested parties, and defining the ISMS scope specific to healthcare information systems and patient-safety considerations.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer examines the documented ISMS scope statement and context analysis for completeness relative to the organization's care processes.
controls.evidence_requirement: ISMS scope document, stakeholder/interested-party analysis, context assessment records.

controls.title: Leadership and Commitment
controls.description: Requires top management accountability for the information security policy, defined roles/responsibilities, and a designated information security officer function.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer verifies management review attendance/minutes and the appointment of an information security officer.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security policy signed by top management, role/responsibility matrix, information security officer appointment record.

controls.title: Planning - Risk Assessment and Treatment
controls.description: Requires a systematic information security risk assessment addressing healthcare-specific risks (patient safety, continuity of care) and a risk treatment plan with a Statement of Applicability.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer examines the risk assessment methodology, risk register, and Statement of Applicability for coverage and currency.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk assessment report, risk treatment plan, Statement of Applicability.

controls.title: Support - Resources, Competence, Awareness
controls.description: Requires adequate resourcing, competent personnel, security awareness programs, and controlled documented information for the ISMS.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples competence/training records and document control logs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training records, competence matrix, document control register.

controls.title: Operation
controls.description: Requires operational planning and control of the processes needed to meet ISMS requirements, including management of outsourced processes and supplier relationships in the care chain.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer verifies operational procedures are followed and outsourced process controls are documented and monitored.
controls.evidence_requirement: Operational procedures, supplier/outsourcing contracts, operational planning records.

controls.title: Performance Evaluation
controls.description: Requires monitoring, measurement, internal audit, and management review of ISMS performance, using methods that yield comparable and reproducible results.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer examines internal audit reports, monitoring/measurement results, and management review minutes.
controls.evidence_requirement: Internal audit program and reports, monitoring/measurement records, management review minutes.

controls.title: Improvement
controls.description: Requires a process for handling nonconformities, corrective action, and continual improvement of the ISMS.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples nonconformity records and verifies root-cause analysis and corrective action closure.
controls.evidence_requirement: Nonconformity/corrective action log, root-cause analyses, improvement tracking records.

controls.title: Organizational Controls
controls.description: Covers information security policies, roles, segregation of duties, supplier relationships, and security in project management (NEN 7510-2 / ISO 27002-aligned organizational theme).
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer verifies segregation-of-duties and supplier security requirements are documented and applied.
controls.evidence_requirement: Policy documents, role/duty segregation matrix, supplier security agreements.

controls.title: People Controls
controls.description: Covers personnel screening, terms of employment, confidentiality agreements, disciplinary processes, and remote-working security for healthcare staff.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples personnel files for screening and signed confidentiality agreements.
controls.evidence_requirement: Screening records, confidentiality/NDA agreements, remote-working policy.

controls.title: Physical Controls
controls.description: Covers secure areas, equipment security, clear desk/clear screen, and protection against environmental threats at care locations and data centers.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer inspects or reviews evidence of physical access controls at care facilities and data center locations.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access logs, clear-desk audit results, environmental protection maintenance records.

controls.title: Technological Controls
controls.description: Covers endpoint protection, access control, cryptography, logging/monitoring, network security, and secure development practices.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews endpoint protection deployment, encryption standards, and logging configuration.
controls.evidence_requirement: Endpoint protection console reports, cryptographic standards documentation, logging/monitoring configuration.

controls.title: Access Control to Patient Data
controls.description: Requires role-based access tied to an actual treatment relationship ('behandelrelatie'), need-to-know access to electronic patient records, and documented emergency 'break-glass' access procedures.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples patient record access grants to confirm they map to an active treatment relationship and tests the break-glass procedure.
controls.evidence_requirement: Role-based access control matrix, treatment-relationship verification records, break-glass procedure and usage log.

controls.title: Logging and Auditing of Patient Record Access
controls.description: Requires mandatory logging of all access to electronic patient records and periodic review to detect unauthorized or inappropriate access.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer verifies access logging is enabled on patient record systems and samples periodic access review results.
controls.evidence_requirement: Patient record access logs, access review reports, unauthorized-access investigation records.

controls.title: Availability and Continuity of Care Systems
controls.description: Requires business continuity and disaster recovery planning specifically for systems supporting direct patient care, with availability requirements proportionate to care criticality.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer examines continuity plans for care-critical systems and evidence of recovery testing.
controls.evidence_requirement: Business continuity/disaster recovery plan, recovery test/exercise reports, system criticality classification.

controls.title: Medical Device and Network Segmentation
controls.description: Requires security requirements for networked medical devices/IoT and network segmentation separating medical device networks from general IT networks.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews network segmentation diagrams and medical device inventory/security configuration.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network segmentation diagrams, medical device inventory, device security configuration records.

controls.title: Chain/Sector Secure Data Exchange
controls.description: Requires secure exchange of patient data between healthcare providers, aligning with the related NEN 7512 (trust in electronic exchange) and NEN 7513 (logging of exchange) standards.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer verifies secure exchange protocols and logging are in place for inter-provider data exchange.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data exchange agreements, exchange protocol/encryption documentation, exchange logging records.

controls.title: Incident and Data Breach Management
controls.description: Requires a healthcare-specific incident response and breach notification process aligned with the Dutch GDPR implementation act (UAVG) and Healthcare and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) reporting obligations.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples an incident/breach case to confirm timely internal handling and, where required, notification to the Dutch DPA/IGJ.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, breach notification records, IGJ/DPA correspondence where applicable.

controls.title: NIS2 Alignment
controls.description: Maps NEN 7510:2024 controls to the obligations applicable to in-scope healthcare entities under the EU NIS2 Directive as implemented in Dutch law.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer verifies a documented mapping between NEN 7510 controls and applicable NIS2 requirements for the organization's entity classification.
controls.evidence_requirement: NIS2 applicability assessment, control-to-requirement mapping document.

name: Botswana Data Protection Act (2024)
description: The Botswana Data Protection Act, 2024 (Act No. 18 of 2024) is Botswana's comprehensive data protection law, regulating the collection, processing, and cross-border transfer of personal data and establishing the Information and Data Protection Commission as the national supervisory authority.
notes: The Act was enacted/gazetted as Act No. 18 of 2024 and replaces the never-fully-commenced Data Protection Act, 2018. Sources conflict on commencement: most report the Act came into force on 14 January 2025 under Statutory Instrument 4 of 2025, while at least one legal commentary cites an October 2024 gazette effective date; no evidence of a further 2024 'amendment' to this Act was found. 'Botswana Data Protection Act (2024)' is used here as the common reference to the 2024-enacted Act; confirm the precise commencement date and the Commission's operational status directly with the Botswana government gazette/SI before relying on it for a client audit timeline.

controls.title: Lawful Basis for Processing
controls.description: Personal data processing must rely on the data subject's consent or another recognized lawful ground, such as contractual necessity, legal obligation, vital interest, or legitimate interest.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples processing activities and confirms a documented lawful basis is recorded for each.
controls.evidence_requirement: Record of processing activities with documented lawful basis, consent records where applicable.

controls.title: Data Protection Principles
controls.description: Processing must uphold core principles including minimality, purpose specification, further-processing limitation, information quality, openness, security safeguards, data subject participation, and accountability.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer assesses processing activities against each principle using the data protection policy and processing records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data protection policy, data mapping/processing inventory demonstrating principle adherence.

controls.title: Registration with the Information and Data Protection Commission
controls.description: Controllers and processors engaged in specified categories of processing must register or notify the Commission before commencing processing.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer confirms registration status with the Commission and currency of the registration details.
controls.evidence_requirement: Commission registration certificate/confirmation, registration renewal records.

controls.title: Appointment of Information/Data Protection Officer
controls.description: Organizations must designate a responsible officer accountable for data protection compliance.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer verifies the appointment and reporting line of the designated information officer.
controls.evidence_requirement: Appointment letter/record, information officer job description and reporting structure.

controls.title: Data Subject Rights
controls.description: Data subjects have rights to access, correct, delete/destroy their personal data, object to processing, and lodge complaints with the Commission.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples data subject requests to verify they were logged, actioned, and resolved within statutory timelines.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data subject request log, response records, complaint handling procedure.

controls.title: Special (Sensitive) Personal Data Protections
controls.description: Additional safeguards apply to processing of health, biometric, religious, political opinion, sexual orientation, and criminal record data.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer confirms enhanced controls (e.g., explicit consent, restricted access) apply to sensitive data categories.
controls.evidence_requirement: Sensitive data inventory, enhanced access control records, explicit consent records.

controls.title: Children's Data Protections
controls.description: Processing of a minor's personal data requires verified parental or guardian consent.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples processing of minors' data to confirm parental/guardian consent was obtained and verified.
controls.evidence_requirement: Parental/guardian consent records, age-verification procedure.

controls.title: Direct Marketing Controls
controls.description: Use of personal data for direct marketing requires consent or a clear, honored opt-out mechanism.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews marketing consent/opt-out records and tests the opt-out mechanism.
controls.evidence_requirement: Marketing consent database, opt-out request log, marketing communication samples.

controls.title: Automated Decision-Making Safeguards
controls.description: Data subjects have the right to object to and contest decisions based solely on automated processing that produce legal or similarly significant effects.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer identifies automated decision-making processes and verifies a human-review/objection pathway exists.
controls.evidence_requirement: Automated decision-making inventory, human-review/escalation procedure, objection handling records.

controls.title: Cross-Border Data Transfer Controls
controls.description: Transfers of personal data outside Botswana are permitted only where the destination offers an adequate level of protection or appropriate safeguards (e.g., contractual clauses, consent) are in place.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews the transfer impact assessment and safeguard mechanism (contract/consent) for a sample of cross-border transfers.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cross-border transfer register, transfer impact assessments, data transfer agreements.

controls.title: Security Safeguards
controls.description: Controllers and processors must implement technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against loss, unauthorized access, and destruction.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews technical and organizational security measures against the sensitivity/volume of data processed.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security policy, technical control evidence (encryption, access control), security risk assessment.

controls.title: Data Breach Notification
controls.description: Qualifying personal data breaches must be notified to the Commission and, where required, to affected data subjects.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples a breach case to confirm timely notification to the Commission and affected individuals where thresholds were met.
controls.evidence_requirement: Breach register, Commission notification records, data subject notification records.

controls.title: Data Processor Obligations
controls.description: Processors must act only on documented instructions from the controller and implement security measures equivalent to those required of controllers.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews processor agreements for documented-instruction clauses and equivalent security obligations.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data processing agreements, processor security attestations/audit reports.

controls.title: Retention and Data Minimization
controls.description: Personal data must not be retained longer than necessary for the purpose for which it was collected.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews the retention schedule and samples records to confirm timely deletion/anonymization.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data retention and disposal schedule, deletion/anonymization logs.

controls.title: Record of Processing Activities
controls.description: Controllers must maintain records of processing activities sufficient to demonstrate accountability to the Commission.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews the record of processing activities for completeness and currency.
controls.evidence_requirement: Record of processing activities (RoPA).

controls.title: Commission Enforcement Powers
controls.description: The Information and Data Protection Commission holds powers of investigation, compliance assessment, and administrative sanctions/penalties for non-compliance.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer confirms the organization has a process to respond to Commission inquiries, audits, and enforcement notices.
controls.evidence_requirement: Correspondence with the Commission, internal escalation procedure for regulatory inquiries.

controls.title: Statutory Exemptions
controls.description: The Act defines limited exemptions from certain obligations (e.g., national security, journalism, research purposes) that must be documented and justified when relied upon.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews any claimed exemption for a documented legal basis and scope limitation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Exemption justification records, legal opinion where applicable.

name: US Data Privacy
description: A generic/umbrella baseline representing the common obligations shared across the comprehensive U.S. state consumer privacy laws in effect by 2026 (including the CCPA/CPRA, VCDPA, CPA, CTDPA, UCPA, and similar laws in roughly 19+ states); used by GRC platforms as a single composite control set in the absence of one comprehensive federal U.S. privacy law.
notes: There is no single statute named 'US Data Privacy' - the United States has no comprehensive federal consumer privacy law as of this writing (sector laws like HIPAA, GLBA, and COPPA address specific domains, and FTC Act Section 5 addresses unfair/deceptive practices generally). This framework is interpreted as a composite 'common denominator' control set drawn from the comprehensive state consumer privacy laws (California CCPA/CPRA, Virginia VCDPA, Colorado CPA, Connecticut CTDPA, Utah UCPA, and the materially similar laws enacted by other states through 2025-2026), reflecting how a GRC platform would realistically operationalize a generic 'US Data Privacy' framework for multi-state compliance tracking. Specific thresholds, exact right names, and opt-out mechanisms (e.g., Global Privacy Control recognition, cybersecurity audit/risk assessment requirements) vary by state; organizations must still map this composite back to each applicable state law for precise compliance.

controls.title: Privacy Notice and Transparency
controls.description: A public-facing privacy notice must disclose categories of personal data collected, processing purposes, third-party sharing/sale, and how consumers can exercise their rights.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer compares the published privacy notice against actual data practices and applicable state disclosure requirements.
controls.evidence_requirement: Published privacy notice, data inventory/mapping supporting the notice's accuracy.

controls.title: Right to Access
controls.description: Consumers have the right to request and receive confirmation of, and access to, the personal data an organization has collected about them.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples access requests to confirm identity verification and timely, complete fulfillment.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access request log, identity verification procedure, sample response packages.

controls.title: Right to Delete
controls.description: Consumers have the right to request deletion of their personal data, with the organization required to instruct service providers/processors to delete it as well.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples deletion requests to confirm deletion occurred across internal systems and downstream processors.
controls.evidence_requirement: Deletion request log, deletion confirmation records, processor deletion attestations.

controls.title: Right to Correct
controls.description: Consumers have the right to request correction of inaccurate personal data held about them.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples correction requests to confirm timely and accurate correction across systems of record.
controls.evidence_requirement: Correction request log, system update records.

controls.title: Right to Data Portability
controls.description: Consumers have the right to receive their personal data in a portable, readily usable format.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews a sample portability response for format usability and completeness.
controls.evidence_requirement: Portability request log, exported data sample/format specification.

controls.title: Right to Opt Out of Sale/Sharing
controls.description: Consumers must be able to opt out of the sale of personal data and sharing for cross-context behavioral advertising, including recognition of opt-out preference signals such as the Global Privacy Control where required.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer tests the 'Do Not Sell/Share My Personal Information' mechanism and verifies GPC signal recognition where applicable.
controls.evidence_requirement: Opt-out mechanism configuration, GPC signal-handling logs, opt-out request log.

controls.title: Right to Opt Out of Targeted Advertising
controls.description: Consumers must be able to opt out of the use of their personal data for targeted/behavioral advertising, distinct from a general sale opt-out where state law distinguishes the two.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer verifies the targeted-advertising opt-out mechanism operates independently where required by applicable state law.
controls.evidence_requirement: Advertising opt-out configuration, ad-tech vendor opt-out propagation records.

controls.title: Right to Opt Out of Profiling
controls.description: Consumers must be able to opt out of profiling in furtherance of decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer identifies profiling activities with significant effects and verifies an opt-out pathway exists and functions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Profiling activity inventory, opt-out mechanism records.

controls.title: Sensitive Data Consent
controls.description: Processing of sensitive personal data categories (health, precise geolocation, biometric data, children's data, etc.) requires prior opt-in consent.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples processing of sensitive data categories to confirm opt-in consent was captured before processing began.
controls.evidence_requirement: Sensitive data inventory, consent capture records/consent management platform logs.

controls.title: Data Minimization and Purpose Limitation
controls.description: Organizations must collect only personal data that is reasonably necessary and proportionate to the disclosed processing purposes.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer compares collected data fields against disclosed purposes for proportionality.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data inventory/mapping, purpose-limitation review documentation.

controls.title: Non-Discrimination
controls.description: Organizations must not deny goods/services, charge different prices, or provide a different quality of service to consumers who exercise their privacy rights.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews pricing/service terms and loyalty program rules for compliant treatment of rights-exercising consumers.
controls.evidence_requirement: Pricing/loyalty program policy, non-discrimination compliance review.

controls.title: Data Protection Assessments
controls.description: Organizations must conduct and document data protection/risk assessments for processing activities presenting heightened risk, such as targeted advertising, sale of data, profiling, or sensitive data processing.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews completed assessments for high-risk processing activities and confirms they predate the processing.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data protection impact assessment (DPIA) reports, high-risk processing inventory.

controls.title: Service Provider / Processor Contracts
controls.description: Contracts with service providers, processors, and third parties must flow down applicable privacy obligations and restrict use of personal data to specified purposes.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples vendor contracts for required privacy/data-processing clauses.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data processing agreements/addenda, vendor contract templates.

controls.title: Children's Privacy Protections
controls.description: Processing of known minors' personal data requires heightened consent (opt-in) protections, with parental consent required under applicable federal (COPPA) and state thresholds for younger children.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews age-verification/parental consent mechanisms for services directed to or known to be used by minors.
controls.evidence_requirement: Age-gating/verification records, parental consent records.

controls.title: Security Safeguards
controls.description: Organizations must implement reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards appropriate to the volume and sensitivity of personal data processed.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews the information security program and technical controls against the volume/sensitivity of data handled.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security policy, technical control evidence (encryption, access control, monitoring).

controls.title: Breach Notification
controls.description: Organizations must comply with applicable state breach notification laws, notifying affected residents (and, in some states, the state Attorney General) within specified timeframes following a qualifying breach.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples a breach event to confirm notification timing and content met applicable state-specific thresholds.
controls.evidence_requirement: Breach notification procedure, notification letters/filings, incident timeline documentation.

controls.title: Consumer Request Response Timelines and Appeals
controls.description: Organizations must respond to verified consumer rights requests within defined statutory timelines (commonly 45 days, extendable by 45 more days) and provide an internal appeal process for denied requests.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples requests to confirm response times met statutory deadlines and that denied requests offered an appeal path.
controls.evidence_requirement: Request tracking log with timestamps, appeal procedure and appeal case records.

controls.title: Record-Keeping and Risk Assessment Documentation
controls.description: Organizations must maintain records demonstrating their compliance posture, including periodic risk assessments and, where applicable, cybersecurity audits for high-risk processing.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews maintained compliance records and periodic risk assessment/audit documentation for completeness and recency.
controls.evidence_requirement: Compliance record repository, periodic risk assessment reports, cybersecurity audit reports where applicable.

name: HITRUST e1
description: HITRUST e1 ("Essentials, 1-year") is the lightest-weight assessment in the HITRUST Assurance Program, validating approximately 44 foundational cybersecurity requirement statements - drawn from the broader HITRUST CSF - that address common threats such as ransomware, phishing, brute-force attacks, and abuse of valid accounts, resulting in a one-year HITRUST e1 Certification.
notes: Figures for e1 (approximately 44 requirement statements, 1-year certificate validity, positioning as 'basic cyber hygiene') are consistently reported across secondary sources (Ampcus, Drata, Censinet) but no official HITRUST primary-source document was directly reviewed. Secondary sources also disagree on the validation model - most describe e1 as requiring assessment by a HITRUST Authorized External Assessor organization (consistent with HITRUST's general assurance model), while at least one source suggested self-attestation; this framework assumes assessor-validated certification, but that should be confirmed against current HITRUST program documentation. The 19 thematic domains used below reflect HITRUST CSF's traditional control-category structure, with e1's ~44 requirements distributed across them as a reduced subset relative to the full CSF or the i1 assessment (182 requirements).

controls.title: Information Protection Program
controls.description: Requires a documented, basic information security program with defined roles, responsibilities, and executive-level support.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews the information security program documentation and confirms assigned ownership.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security program document, role/responsibility assignment records.

controls.title: Endpoint Protection
controls.description: Requires anti-malware/endpoint protection deployed on workstations and servers to defend against ransomware and other malicious code.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews endpoint protection deployment coverage and recent detection/alert status.
controls.evidence_requirement: Endpoint protection console reports, deployment coverage report.

controls.title: Portable Media Security
controls.description: Requires controls restricting and/or encrypting the use of removable and portable media to prevent data loss.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews removable media policy and technical restriction/encryption configuration.
controls.evidence_requirement: Portable media policy, device control/encryption configuration.

controls.title: Mobile Device Security
controls.description: Requires baseline security configuration (passcode, encryption, remote wipe capability) for mobile devices accessing covered information.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews mobile device management (MDM) policy enforcement for a sample of enrolled devices.
controls.evidence_requirement: MDM policy configuration, enrolled device compliance report.

controls.title: Wireless Security
controls.description: Requires secure configuration of wireless networks, including strong encryption and authentication, to prevent unauthorized network access.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews wireless network configuration for encryption standard and authentication method.
controls.evidence_requirement: Wireless network configuration documentation, security assessment of wireless access points.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.description: Requires secure baseline configurations and hardening of systems handling covered information.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor compares a sample system configuration against the documented hardening baseline.
controls.evidence_requirement: System hardening baseline/standard, configuration compliance report.

controls.title: Vulnerability Management
controls.description: Requires regular vulnerability scanning and timely remediation of critical/high vulnerabilities.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews recent vulnerability scan results and remediation timelines for critical findings.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vulnerability scan reports, remediation tracking records.

controls.title: Network Protection
controls.description: Requires firewalls, network segmentation, and boundary protection controls to limit unauthorized network access.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews firewall rule sets and network segmentation diagrams.
controls.evidence_requirement: Firewall configuration/rule set, network diagram.

controls.title: Transmission Protection
controls.description: Requires encryption of covered data in transit over untrusted or public networks.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor verifies encryption protocol/configuration for data transmission paths.
controls.evidence_requirement: Transmission encryption configuration, TLS/VPN configuration documentation.

controls.title: Password Management
controls.description: Requires password complexity and management standards, with multi-factor authentication for privileged and remote access.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews password policy settings and MFA enforcement for privileged/remote accounts.
controls.evidence_requirement: Password policy configuration, MFA enrollment records.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Requires unique user identification, least-privilege access assignment, and timely deprovisioning of access upon role change or termination.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor samples user accounts to verify uniqueness, appropriate privilege level, and timely deprovisioning.
controls.evidence_requirement: User access listing, access provisioning/deprovisioning records.

controls.title: Audit Logging and Monitoring
controls.description: Requires basic logging of security-relevant events and periodic review of logs for anomalies.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews log configuration and sample log review records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Logging configuration, log review records.

controls.title: Education, Training and Awareness
controls.description: Requires annual security awareness training for personnel covering phishing and social engineering risks.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor samples training completion records across the workforce.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training completion records, training content/curriculum.

controls.title: Third-Party Assurance
controls.description: Requires basic due diligence and contractual security requirements for vendors with access to covered information.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews vendor due-diligence records and contract security clauses for a sample of vendors.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vendor risk assessment records, vendor contracts with security requirements.

controls.title: Incident Management
controls.description: Requires a documented incident response process for detecting, reporting, and responding to security incidents.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews the incident response plan and any incident records for the assessment period.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan/procedure, incident log.

controls.title: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
controls.description: Requires basic backup and recovery procedures sufficient to restore availability of covered information after a disruption.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews backup configuration and evidence of a successful restore test.
controls.evidence_requirement: Backup policy/configuration, restore test records.

controls.title: Risk Management
controls.description: Requires a periodic, lightweight risk assessment identifying key threats to covered information.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews the most recent risk assessment documentation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk assessment report/register.

controls.title: Physical and Environmental Security
controls.description: Requires physical access controls over facilities and equipment housing covered information.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews physical access control mechanisms and visitor logs for in-scope facilities.
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access control configuration, visitor/access logs.

controls.title: Data Protection and Privacy
controls.description: Requires baseline data classification and handling controls protecting the confidentiality of PII/PHI.
controls.test_criteria: Assessor reviews data classification scheme and handling controls applied to classified data.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data classification policy, data handling procedure, classification labeling evidence.

name: Indonesia PDPL
description: Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (Undang-Undang Pelindungan Data Pribadi, Law No. 27 of 2022, "UU PDP") is Indonesia's first comprehensive data protection statute, establishing obligations for personal data controllers and processors, data subject rights, and a dedicated supervisory authority.
notes: UU PDP (Law No. 27/2022) was enacted in October 2022 with a two-year transition period that ended 17 October 2024, after which enforcement became fully applicable. Article numbering in the control set below (e.g., controller obligations Art. 20-49, processor obligations Art. 51-52, cross-border transfer Art. 56) is drawn from secondary legal commentary rather than the primary statute text and should be verified against the official Indonesian-language law. One secondary source referenced an amendment ('Law No. 1 of 2026') and an implementing regulation; this could not be independently confirmed, so it is flagged as unverified and should be checked before being relied upon - the core control set below reflects the original, enacted UU PDP only.

controls.title: Lawful Basis for Processing
controls.description: Processing of personal data requires explicit consent from the data subject or reliance on another lawful basis such as contractual necessity, legal obligation, vital interest, or legitimate interest of the controller.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples processing activities and confirms a documented lawful basis for each.
controls.evidence_requirement: Record of processing activities, lawful-basis documentation, consent records.

controls.title: Data Protection Principles
controls.description: Controllers must uphold principles of purpose limitation, data accuracy, storage limitation, and appropriate security throughout the processing lifecycle.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer assesses processing activities against each principle using the data protection policy.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data protection policy, data lifecycle/retention documentation.

controls.title: Explicit Consent Standards
controls.description: Where consent is relied upon, it must be informed, specific, and freely given, with separate consent required for processing specific/sensitive categories of personal data.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews consent capture mechanisms for clarity, specificity, and separation for sensitive data.
controls.evidence_requirement: Consent management platform records, consent form/language samples.

controls.title: Specific (Sensitive) Personal Data Protections
controls.description: Enhanced requirements apply to processing of health, biometric, genetic, criminal record, financial, and children's personal data categories.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer confirms enhanced controls (explicit consent, restricted access) apply to sensitive data processing.
controls.evidence_requirement: Sensitive data inventory, enhanced consent and access control records.

controls.title: Children and Persons with Disabilities Data
controls.description: Processing of personal data belonging to minors or persons with disabilities requires parental or guardian consent.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples relevant processing to confirm parental/guardian consent was obtained.
controls.evidence_requirement: Parental/guardian consent records, age/capacity verification procedure.

controls.title: Data Subject Rights
controls.description: Data subjects have rights to obtain information about processing, access, correct, complete, delete/destroy their data, object to processing, restrict processing, withdraw consent, and claim compensation for violations.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples data subject requests to verify timely and complete fulfillment across each right.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data subject request log, response records, internal rights-handling procedure.

controls.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment
controls.description: Controllers must conduct a DPIA for processing activities that present a high risk to data subjects.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews completed DPIAs for high-risk processing activities identified in the data inventory.
controls.evidence_requirement: DPIA reports, high-risk processing inventory.

controls.title: Appointment of Data Protection Officer
controls.description: Certain controllers (public bodies, or those whose core activities involve large-scale/sensitive-data monitoring) must appoint a Data Protection Officer.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer confirms DPO appointment and independence where the applicability threshold is met.
controls.evidence_requirement: DPO appointment record, DPO job description/reporting line.

controls.title: Security of Processing
controls.description: Controllers and processors must implement technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against unlawful processing, loss, or disclosure.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews security controls proportionate to the data processed and the associated risk.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security policy, technical control evidence, risk assessment.

controls.title: Personal Data Breach Notification
controls.description: Controllers must notify affected data subjects and the data protection supervisory authority of a qualifying personal data breach within the statutory timeline.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer samples a breach case to confirm notification occurred within the required timeframe and contained required content.
controls.evidence_requirement: Breach register, breach notification records to subjects and the authority.

controls.title: Controller Accountability Obligations
controls.description: Controllers must maintain documented accountability measures, including record-keeping and demonstrable compliance, across the processing lifecycle.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews the controller's compliance documentation and record-keeping practices.
controls.evidence_requirement: Record of processing activities, internal compliance documentation.

controls.title: Processor Obligations
controls.description: Processors must process personal data only on documented instructions from the controller and apply security obligations equivalent to those required of controllers.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews data processing agreements for documented-instruction clauses and equivalent security obligations.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data processing agreements, processor security attestations.

controls.title: Cross-Border Data Transfer
