controls.description: Transfers of personal data outside Indonesia are permitted only where the destination country offers equivalent or higher protection, appropriate safeguards (e.g., binding corporate rules, contracts) are in place, or data subject consent has been obtained.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews the transfer mechanism and supporting documentation for a sample of cross-border transfers.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cross-border transfer register, transfer safeguard documentation (contracts/BCRs), consent records where relied upon.

controls.title: Retention and Destruction
controls.description: Personal data must be retained only for the period necessary to fulfill the processing purpose or satisfy legal requirements, with secure destruction thereafter.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews the retention schedule and samples records for timely, secure destruction.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data retention and disposal schedule, destruction/deletion logs.

controls.title: Internal Policies and Governance
controls.description: Organizations must implement internal personal data protection policies and standard operating procedures to operationalize UU PDP requirements.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews internal policy documentation for coverage of UU PDP requirements and evidence of operational use.
controls.evidence_requirement: Internal data protection policy/SOP documents.

controls.title: Administrative Sanctions and Enforcement
controls.description: The Personal Data Protection Authority may issue administrative sanctions for non-compliance, including written warnings, temporary processing suspension, fines, or deletion orders.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer confirms the organization has a process to respond to regulator inquiries and any sanctions issued.
controls.evidence_requirement: Correspondence with the supervisory authority, internal escalation procedure for regulatory actions.

controls.title: Criminal Provisions Awareness
controls.description: UU PDP criminalizes certain prohibited acts, including unlawful obtaining, disclosure, or falsification of personal data, carrying criminal penalties for responsible individuals.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer confirms workforce training and internal controls address prohibited acts carrying criminal liability.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training records covering prohibited acts, internal control documentation addressing unlawful data handling.

name: GovRAMP Moderate
description: GovRAMP (the successor program to StateRAMP) is a standardized cybersecurity authorization program for cloud service offerings used by U.S. state and local governments, higher education, and K-12 institutions; the Moderate baseline, part of the GovRAMP Core control set, is built on the NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 Moderate impact baseline and validated through a Third-Party Assessment Organization (3PAO).
notes: Public GovRAMP resources confirm the GovRAMP Core control set is aligned to NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 and that the prior Rev 4-based StateRAMP baseline controls document was retired effective 1 October 2024, with Rev 5 templates and baseline-by-impact-level documents now published on govramp.org. The exact current control/enhancement count for the GovRAMP Moderate baseline (and any GovRAMP-specific control tailoring versus the FedRAMP/NIST Moderate baseline, e.g., CJIS overlay variants referenced on GovRAMP's site) was not independently verified line-by-line; confirm against the current GovRAMP Core Moderate Impact Level package before using this for a specific authorization effort. Control families below mirror the same 20 NIST 800-53 Rev 5 families as the Low/High baseline frameworks in this batch, framed for the GovRAMP Moderate context, plus one GovRAMP-specific program control covering authorization and reciprocity.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Aligned to the NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 Moderate baseline, requiring account management, least privilege, and remote access controls for the cloud service offering (CSO).
controls.test_criteria: 3PAO tests account management, least-privilege enforcement, and remote access controls during the initial assessment and annually thereafter.
controls.evidence_requirement: SSP control narrative, access control configuration, Security Assessment Report (SAR) excerpt.

controls.title: Awareness and Training
controls.description: Requires security awareness training for all personnel and role-based training for those with significant security responsibilities supporting the CSO.
controls.test_criteria: 3PAO samples training completion records during assessment.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training records, SSP control narrative.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.description: Requires audit record generation, protection, and review sufficient to support monitoring and investigation of CSO activity at the Moderate impact level.
controls.test_criteria: 3PAO reviews log generation/retention configuration and sample log review records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Logging configuration, log review records, SAR excerpt.

controls.title: Assessment, Authorization, and Monitoring
controls.description: Governs the initial 3PAO security assessment, authorization decision by the GovRAMP PMO/authorizing body, and ongoing continuous monitoring deliverables.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer verifies the current authorization status, annual assessment completion, and continuous monitoring deliverable submission history.
controls.evidence_requirement: Security Assessment Report, POA&M, authorization letter, continuous monitoring submission history.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.description: Requires baseline configurations, change control, and least-functionality enforcement across the CSO's components.
controls.test_criteria: 3PAO compares deployed configuration against the documented baseline and reviews change records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Configuration baseline, change control records, component inventory.

controls.title: Contingency Planning
controls.description: Requires a tested contingency plan, backup strategy, and recovery capability appropriate to the Moderate impact level.
controls.test_criteria: 3PAO reviews the contingency plan and results of the required annual test/exercise.
controls.evidence_requirement: Contingency plan, backup logs, test/exercise after-action report.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.description: Requires unique identification and multi-factor authentication for users and devices accessing the CSO, including privileged and remote access.
controls.test_criteria: 3PAO tests MFA enforcement for privileged/remote access accounts.
controls.evidence_requirement: Authentication configuration, MFA enrollment records.

controls.title: Incident Response
controls.description: Requires an incident response capability including planning, training, testing, and reporting of incidents affecting the CSO to customers and the GovRAMP PMO as required.
controls.test_criteria: 3PAO reviews the incident response plan and any incident reports filed during the assessment period.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident response plan, incident log, GovRAMP PMO incident notification records.

controls.title: Maintenance
controls.description: Controls the performance of system maintenance on CSO components, including authorization of maintenance personnel and tools.
controls.test_criteria: 3PAO reviews maintenance records and authorized personnel/tool lists.
controls.evidence_requirement: Maintenance logs, authorized personnel/tool list.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.description: Requires protection, marking, storage, and sanitization/disposal controls for digital media containing CSO customer data.
controls.test_criteria: 3PAO reviews media handling and sanitization/disposal records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Media protection policy, sanitization/disposal logs.

controls.title: Physical and Environmental Protection
controls.description: Requires physical access authorization, monitoring, and environmental protections for facilities hosting the CSO.
controls.test_criteria: 3PAO reviews facility access control evidence and environmental safeguard records (often via data center SOC 2/physical audit reports).
controls.evidence_requirement: Physical access logs, data center audit reports, environmental control records.

controls.title: Planning
controls.description: Requires a System Security Plan, rules of behavior, and architecture documentation describing the CSO's authorization boundary.
controls.test_criteria: 3PAO reviews the SSP and authorization boundary diagram for completeness and currency.
controls.evidence_requirement: System Security Plan, authorization boundary diagram, rules of behavior.

controls.title: Program Management
controls.description: Establishes organization-wide security and privacy program activities supporting the CSP's overall risk management strategy across all offered services.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer reviews organization-level program documentation and risk management strategy.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security program plan, enterprise risk management strategy.

controls.title: Personnel Security
controls.description: Requires position risk designation, personnel screening, and termination/transfer procedures for personnel with access to the CSO.
controls.test_criteria: 3PAO samples personnel files to confirm screening and timely termination/transfer processing.
controls.evidence_requirement: Screening records, termination/transfer checklist.

controls.title: PII Processing and Transparency
controls.description: Requires an authority-to-process determination and privacy notice where the CSO processes personally identifiable information on behalf of government customers.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer confirms documented legal authority and privacy notice coverage for PII processed.
controls.evidence_requirement: Authority-to-process documentation, privacy notice, PII inventory.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: Requires risk assessments and vulnerability scanning of the CSO on an ongoing basis commensurate with the Moderate impact level.
controls.test_criteria: 3PAO reviews the risk assessment report and periodic vulnerability scan results.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk assessment report, vulnerability scan reports.

controls.title: System and Services Acquisition
controls.description: Integrates security requirements into acquisition and the CSO's development life cycle, including developer security testing.
controls.test_criteria: 3PAO reviews SDLC documentation and developer security test results.
controls.evidence_requirement: SDLC documentation, developer security test reports.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.description: Requires boundary protection, transmission encryption, and cryptographic protections for data processed by the CSO.
controls.test_criteria: 3PAO reviews boundary protection device configuration and encryption settings.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network architecture diagram, firewall/boundary configuration, encryption configuration.

controls.title: System and Information Integrity
controls.description: Requires flaw remediation (patching), malicious code protection, and system monitoring for the CSO.
controls.test_criteria: 3PAO reviews patch compliance reports and malicious code protection deployment status.
controls.evidence_requirement: Patch management reports, anti-malware/IDS status reports.

controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Management
controls.description: Requires a supply chain risk management plan and acquisition strategy addressing authenticity and integrity of CSO components and third-party dependencies.
controls.test_criteria: 3PAO reviews the supply chain risk management plan and component sourcing/authenticity records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Supply chain risk management plan, vendor/component sourcing documentation.

controls.title: GovRAMP Authorization and Reciprocity
controls.description: Requires completion of the formal GovRAMP PMO authorization process (e.g., Ready, Provisional, Authorized statuses) so that a single assessed security package can be reused (reciprocity) by multiple state/local government and education customers instead of repeated per-agency assessments.
controls.test_criteria: Reviewer confirms the CSO's current status and listing on the GovRAMP Authorized Vendor List/Marketplace and reviews the PMO authorization letter.
controls.evidence_requirement: GovRAMP Marketplace listing, PMO Letter of Authorization, authorization package status records.

name: DORA
description: EU Regulation 2022/2554 (Digital Operational Resilience Act), enforced by national competent authorities and the European Supervisory Authorities (EBA, ESMA, EIOPA), establishing ICT risk management, incident reporting, resilience testing, and third-party ICT risk requirements for banks, insurers, investment firms and other EU financial entities. Applicable from 17 January 2025.
notes: Scoped to the regulation's core chapters (ICT risk management, incident management, resilience testing, third-party risk, information sharing). Detailed Regulatory/Implementing Technical Standards (RTS/ITS) under each article add further granular sub-requirements not expanded here given top-level scope.

controls.title: ICT Risk Management Framework & Governance
controls.description: Financial entities must establish, maintain and keep updated a comprehensive, well-documented ICT risk management framework approved and periodically reviewed by the management body, which bears ultimate responsibility for ICT risk.
controls.test_criteria: Review board/management body minutes approving the ICT risk framework and evidence of periodic review; verify a named ICT risk owner.
controls.evidence_requirement: ICT risk management framework document, board approval minutes, review cycle log.

controls.title: ICT Asset Identification & Risk Classification
controls.description: Entities must identify, classify and document all ICT-supported business functions, roles, information assets and ICT assets, and assess the risks to which they are exposed, including dependency mapping.
controls.test_criteria: Inspect the asset inventory and risk classification register for completeness and currency.
controls.evidence_requirement: ICT asset inventory, business function/asset mapping, risk assessment register.

controls.title: Protection and Prevention
controls.description: Entities must implement ICT security policies, procedures, protocols and tools (network segmentation, encryption, access control) designed to minimize ICT risk and ensure resilience, confidentiality, integrity and availability of data.
controls.test_criteria: Review security architecture documentation and sample technical controls (encryption, segmentation) for implementation.
controls.evidence_requirement: ICT security policy, network diagrams, encryption standards, access control configurations.

controls.title: Detection Mechanisms
controls.description: Entities must have mechanisms to promptly detect anomalous activities, including ICT network performance issues and ICT-related incidents, with multiple layers of control and defined alert thresholds.
controls.test_criteria: Review monitoring/SIEM configuration and alert threshold documentation; sample detection events.
controls.evidence_requirement: Monitoring tool configurations, alert logs, detection procedure documentation.

controls.title: Response & Recovery / Business Continuity
controls.description: Entities must adopt a dedicated ICT business continuity policy and response/recovery plans, including for severe business disruption scenarios, with defined RTOs/RPOs for critical functions.
controls.test_criteria: Review BCP/DR plans and evidence of testing against defined RTO/RPO targets.
controls.evidence_requirement: ICT business continuity policy, disaster recovery plan, RTO/RPO documentation, test results.

controls.title: Backup Policies & Restoration Procedures
controls.description: Entities must maintain backup policies and restoration/recovery procedures, with redundant ICT capacity, and regularly test that backups can be restored without compromising production systems.
controls.test_criteria: Review backup policy and restoration test logs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Backup policy, restoration test reports, redundancy architecture documentation.

controls.title: Learning and Evolving (Post-Incident Review)
controls.description: Entities must analyze ICT-related incidents and cyber threats, conduct post-incident reviews, and feed lessons learned back into the ICT risk framework, including staff awareness training.
controls.test_criteria: Review post-incident review reports and evidence the framework was updated based on lessons learned.
controls.evidence_requirement: Post-incident review records, training logs, framework revision history.

controls.title: Communication
controls.description: Entities must have crisis communication plans enabling responsible disclosure of ICT-related incidents to clients, counterparts and the public as appropriate, and internal communication to staff and management.
controls.test_criteria: Review the crisis communication plan and a sample communication issued during a past incident.
controls.evidence_requirement: Crisis communication plan, incident communication records.

controls.title: ICT Incident Management & Classification
controls.description: Entities must establish an ICT-related incident management process to detect, manage, and notify incidents, classifying them per criteria (clients affected, duration, geographic spread, data losses, criticality, economic impact) set out in the RTS.
controls.test_criteria: Review the incident classification register and sample incident tickets against classification criteria.
controls.evidence_requirement: Incident management procedure, incident log/register, classification criteria mapping.

controls.title: Major Incident Reporting to Authorities
controls.description: Entities must report major ICT-related incidents to competent authorities within prescribed timelines using initial, intermediate and final reports in the standardized format.
controls.test_criteria: Review sample incident reports submitted to authorities and timestamps against regulatory deadlines.
controls.evidence_requirement: Submitted incident reports, regulatory correspondence, reporting timeline log.

controls.title: Digital Operational Resilience Testing Programme
controls.description: Entities must establish a risk-based digital operational resilience testing programme covering vulnerability assessments, scenario-based testing, network security assessments, and source code reviews on ICT systems and applications.
controls.test_criteria: Review the testing programme schedule and sample test reports for critical systems.
controls.evidence_requirement: Testing programme plan, vulnerability scan/pen test reports, remediation tracking.

controls.title: Threat-Led Penetration Testing (TLPT)
controls.description: Significant financial entities must perform advanced threat-led penetration testing at least every three years on live production systems supporting critical functions, using independent testers per the TIBER-EU methodology.
controls.test_criteria: Review the TLPT scope, tester independence attestation, and final report with remediation plan.
controls.evidence_requirement: TLPT scope document, tester accreditation, TLPT report, remediation plan.

controls.title: ICT Third-Party Risk Management Strategy
controls.description: Entities must adopt a strategy on ICT third-party risk, perform due diligence before contracting, and assess concentration risk across ICT third-party providers, including for critical/important functions.
controls.test_criteria: Review the third-party risk strategy and pre-contract due diligence files for a sample of ICT providers.
controls.evidence_requirement: Third-party risk strategy, due diligence assessments, concentration risk analysis.

controls.title: Register of Information on ICT Third-Party Arrangements
controls.description: Entities must maintain and update a register of information on all contractual arrangements with ICT third-party service providers, distinguishing those supporting critical/important functions, reportable to competent authorities.
controls.test_criteria: Review the register for completeness and reconciliation against active vendor contracts.
controls.evidence_requirement: Register of information, vendor contract list, reconciliation records.

controls.title: Key Contractual Provisions with ICT Providers
controls.description: Contracts with ICT third-party providers must include mandatory provisions covering service descriptions, locations of data processing, SLAs, audit/access rights, exit strategies, and sub-outsourcing conditions.
controls.test_criteria: Review sample vendor contracts for presence of mandated DORA clauses.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vendor contracts, contract review checklist, exit strategy documentation.

controls.title: Information-Sharing Arrangements
controls.description: Entities may participate in voluntary arrangements to exchange cyber threat information and intelligence with other financial entities within trusted communities, under agreed confidentiality protocols.
controls.test_criteria: Review participation agreements and evidence of threat intelligence exchanged.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information-sharing agreement, threat intelligence exchange records.

name: GDPR
description: Regulation (EU) 2016/679, the EU's comprehensive data protection law enforced by national Data Protection Authorities and the European Data Protection Board, governing the collection, use, storage and transfer of personal data of individuals in the EU/EEA.
notes: Scoped to the base EU GDPR only. The separate post-Brexit 'UK GDPR' (as retained under the Data Protection Act 2018, with its own ICO enforcement and divergences such as the age-of-consent default and post-Brexit transfer mechanisms) is a distinct framework handled elsewhere and intentionally excluded here.

controls.title: Principles of Processing
controls.description: Personal data must be processed lawfully, fairly and transparently, collected for specified legitimate purposes, limited to what is necessary (minimization), accurate, kept no longer than necessary, and protected with integrity/confidentiality, with the controller accountable for demonstrating compliance.
controls.test_criteria: Review the data processing register against a principle-by-principle checklist; interview data owners.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data protection policy, records of processing activities, data minimization assessments.

controls.title: Lawful Basis for Processing
controls.description: Processing of personal data is only lawful if at least one legal basis applies (consent, contract, legal obligation, vital interests, public task, or legitimate interests), which must be identified and documented before processing begins.
controls.test_criteria: Sample processing activities and verify a documented lawful basis exists for each.
controls.evidence_requirement: Records of processing activities (ROPA) with lawful basis field, legitimate interest assessments (LIAs).

controls.title: Conditions for Consent
controls.description: Where consent is relied upon, it must be freely given, specific, informed, unambiguous, as easy to withdraw as to give, and controllers must be able to demonstrate consent was obtained.
controls.test_criteria: Review the consent capture mechanism/UI and consent logs; test the withdrawal flow.
controls.evidence_requirement: Consent management platform logs, consent form text, withdrawal mechanism screenshots.

controls.title: Children's Consent for Information Society Services
controls.description: Where a child is below the age of 16 (or a lower national threshold, minimum 13), processing based on consent for online services requires consent/authorization from the holder of parental responsibility, with reasonable efforts to verify this.
controls.test_criteria: Review the age-verification and parental consent workflow for services targeting minors.
controls.evidence_requirement: Age-gating logic documentation, parental consent records.

controls.title: Special Categories of Personal Data
controls.description: Processing of special category data (health, biometric, genetic, racial/ethnic origin, religious/political beliefs, sexual orientation) is prohibited unless a specific Article 9(2) exemption applies, such as explicit consent or substantial public interest.
controls.test_criteria: Review ROPA entries tagged as special category and verify an Art.9(2) condition is documented for each.
controls.evidence_requirement: ROPA special-category entries, explicit consent records, applicable exemption documentation.

controls.title: Transparency & Information to Data Subjects
controls.description: Controllers must provide concise, transparent, intelligible privacy notices at the point of data collection, covering identity, purposes, lawful basis, recipients, retention, and data subject rights.
controls.test_criteria: Review the privacy notice(s) against the Art.13/14 content checklist and assess plain-language readability.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy notice/policy text, version history, readability review.

controls.title: Right of Access
controls.description: Data subjects have the right to obtain confirmation of whether their data is processed and a copy of that data plus supplementary information, normally within one month of request.
controls.test_criteria: Sample closed Subject Access Requests (SARs) and verify response timeliness and completeness.
controls.evidence_requirement: SAR log/tracker, sample SAR response packages, turnaround time metrics.

controls.title: Right to Rectification and Erasure
controls.description: Data subjects can request correction of inaccurate data and, under specified grounds, erasure of their personal data ('right to be forgotten'), including notification to third parties who received the data.
controls.test_criteria: Sample rectification/erasure requests and verify end-to-end fulfillment including downstream system/processor notification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Erasure/rectification request log, downstream notification records, deletion confirmations.

controls.title: Right to Restriction and Objection
controls.description: Data subjects may request restriction of processing in specified circumstances and object to processing based on legitimate interests or for direct marketing, which must be honored without further processing beyond storage.
controls.test_criteria: Review the restriction/objection request handling procedure and sample tickets.
controls.evidence_requirement: Request handling procedure, objection log, marketing suppression list.

controls.title: Right to Data Portability
controls.description: Where processing is based on consent or contract and carried out by automated means, data subjects can receive their data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format and transmit it to another controller.
controls.test_criteria: Test a sample data export for machine-readable format compliance.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data export tool output sample, portability request log.

controls.title: Automated Decision-Making and Profiling
controls.description: Data subjects have the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing, including profiling, that produces legal or similarly significant effects, unless an exemption applies with safeguards (human review, right to contest).
controls.test_criteria: Review the automated decision systems inventory and safeguards for human intervention.
controls.evidence_requirement: Automated decision-making inventory, human-review workflow documentation.

controls.title: Accountability & Data Protection by Design/Default
controls.description: Controllers must implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure and demonstrate compliance, and build data protection into processing systems and business practices by design and by default.
controls.test_criteria: Review the privacy-by-design checklist embedded in the SDLC/project intake process.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privacy-by-design checklist, system design documents showing default privacy settings.

controls.title: Processor Obligations & Data Processing Agreements
controls.description: Controllers may only use processors providing sufficient guarantees of compliance, governed by a binding contract (DPA) specifying processing scope, duration, nature, purpose, sub-processor conditions and security obligations.
controls.test_criteria: Review DPAs for a sample of processors against Art.28(3) mandatory clauses.
controls.evidence_requirement: Signed DPAs, sub-processor list, processor due diligence assessments.

controls.title: Records of Processing Activities
controls.description: Controllers and processors (above threshold or for certain processing) must maintain a written record of processing activities including purposes, categories of data/subjects, recipients, transfers and retention periods.
controls.test_criteria: Review the ROPA for completeness and currency against actual processing activities.
controls.evidence_requirement: Records of processing activities document, update log.

controls.title: Security of Processing
controls.description: Controllers and processors must implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures (encryption, pseudonymization, resilience, regular testing) proportionate to risk.
controls.test_criteria: Review security controls documentation and penetration test/vulnerability scan results.
controls.evidence_requirement: Security policy, encryption standards, penetration test reports, risk assessment.

controls.title: Personal Data Breach Notification
controls.description: Controllers must notify the supervisory authority of a personal data breach within 72 hours of becoming aware (unless unlikely to result in risk), and notify affected data subjects without undue delay when there is high risk.
controls.test_criteria: Review the breach log and sample breach notifications against the 72-hour requirement.
controls.evidence_requirement: Breach register, supervisory authority notifications, data subject communications, timeline documentation.

controls.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA)
controls.description: A DPIA is required prior to processing likely to result in high risk to individuals, assessing necessity, proportionality, and risks, with mitigation measures and, where residual risk remains high, prior consultation with the supervisory authority.
controls.test_criteria: Review the DPIA register and sample DPIAs for high-risk projects.
controls.evidence_requirement: DPIA register, completed DPIA documents, prior consultation correspondence if applicable.

controls.title: Data Protection Officer
controls.description: Organizations meeting specified criteria (public authority, large-scale systematic monitoring, large-scale special category processing) must designate a DPO with expert knowledge, operating independently and reporting to the highest management level.
controls.test_criteria: Verify the DPO appointment, independence, and reporting line; review DPO activity reports.
controls.evidence_requirement: DPO appointment letter, organizational chart, published DPO contact, DPO activity/annual reports.

controls.title: International Data Transfers
controls.description: Transfers of personal data outside the EEA require an adequacy decision, appropriate safeguards (Standard Contractual Clauses, Binding Corporate Rules), or a specific derogation, with transfer impact assessments for high-risk destinations.
controls.test_criteria: Review the transfer mapping and sample SCCs/transfer impact assessments.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data transfer map, SCCs/BCRs, transfer impact assessments (TIAs).

controls.title: Joint Controller Arrangements
controls.description: Where two or more controllers jointly determine the purposes and means of processing, they must transparently allocate responsibilities via an arrangement, the essence of which is made available to data subjects.
controls.test_criteria: Review joint controller agreements and the public-facing summary.
controls.evidence_requirement: Joint controller arrangement document, published summary.

controls.title: Administrative Fines Risk Management
controls.description: Organizations should monitor compliance against the two-tier administrative fine structure (up to EUR 20 million or 4% of global annual turnover for the most serious infringements) to prioritize remediation of highest-exposure gaps.
controls.test_criteria: Review the compliance risk register prioritization aligned to fine-tier exposure.
controls.evidence_requirement: Compliance risk register, remediation prioritization matrix.

name: DTAC
description: The Digital Technology Assessment Criteria, developed by NHS England (originally NHSX), provides a consistent baseline for assessing digital health and social care technologies (apps, platforms) before NHS procurement or deployment, covering clinical safety, data protection, technical security, interoperability, and usability/accessibility.
notes: Identification: 'DTAC' most precisely refers to NHS England's Digital Technology Assessment Criteria for Health and Social Care (first published Feb 2021, revised since, with a streamlined form circa 2026) rather than the Digital Therapeutics Alliance's (DTA) 'DTx Value Assessment & Integration Guide' -- the DTA's framework is never itself branded 'DTAC', while the acronym DTAC is the NHS document's own official name. Confidence is marked medium because DTAC is a UK NHS procurement assessment checklist (completed by suppliers, scored by commissioners) rather than a certifiable framework in the ISO/SOC2 sense, its exact question wording has changed across versions (most recently a ~25% question reduction), and current sub-question text should be verified against the live NHS England DTAC form before use as a literal audit script.

controls.title: Clinical Safety Officer
controls.description: Suppliers must have a named Clinical Safety Officer (CSO), registered with an appropriate professional body, responsible for clinical risk management of the product.
controls.test_criteria: Verify the CSO appointment record and professional registration.
controls.evidence_requirement: CSO appointment record, professional registration certificate.

controls.title: Clinical Risk Management File (DCB0129/DCB0160)
controls.description: Suppliers (DCB0129) and deploying health organizations (DCB0160) must maintain a clinical risk management file demonstrating hazard identification, risk evaluation and mitigation for the product throughout its lifecycle, per the NHS clinical risk management standards.
controls.test_criteria: Review the clinical risk management file and hazard log for completeness.
controls.evidence_requirement: Clinical safety case report, hazard log, clinical risk management plan.

controls.title: Clinical Safety Case Report
controls.description: A Clinical Safety Case Report must be produced and kept current, summarizing clinical safety evidence and outstanding risks, signed off by the CSO before go-live and after significant changes.
controls.test_criteria: Review the signed-off safety case report version history.
controls.evidence_requirement: Clinical safety case report (current and historical versions).

controls.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment
controls.description: A DPIA must be completed and kept up to date for the product/service, covering data flows, risks to individuals, and mitigations, in line with UK GDPR requirements.
controls.test_criteria: Review the DPIA document and its update history.
controls.evidence_requirement: DPIA document, sign-off record.

controls.title: Data Security and Protection Toolkit (DSPT) Compliance
controls.description: Suppliers handling NHS data must complete and maintain a satisfactory annual submission to the NHS Data Security and Protection Toolkit, demonstrating compliance with the National Data Guardian's 10 data security standards.
controls.test_criteria: Verify current DSPT status/rating via the published registry.
controls.evidence_requirement: DSPT submission confirmation, published compliance status.

controls.title: Data Processing Agreements & Controller/Processor Roles
controls.description: Roles of data controller and processor must be clearly defined and documented in a contract/data processing agreement consistent with UK GDPR Article 28.
controls.test_criteria: Review the signed DPA and role-allocation documentation.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data processing agreement, data flow/role mapping diagram.

controls.title: Records of Processing & Data Minimization
controls.description: The product must only collect and retain personal data necessary for its stated purpose, with documented retention schedules and records of processing activities.
controls.test_criteria: Review the data retention schedule and ROPA entry for the product.
controls.evidence_requirement: Retention schedule, ROPA extract.

controls.title: Cyber Essentials Plus Certification
controls.description: Suppliers must hold a current Cyber Essentials Plus certificate (or equivalent, e.g. ISO 27001) demonstrating baseline technical cyber security controls.
controls.test_criteria: Verify the current certificate and its scope against the assessed product.
controls.evidence_requirement: Cyber Essentials Plus certificate.

controls.title: Encryption of Data at Rest and in Transit
controls.description: Personal and sensitive data must be encrypted using industry-standard algorithms both at rest and in transit between system components and end users.
controls.test_criteria: Review the encryption standards documentation and sample configuration evidence (TLS versions, at-rest encryption).
controls.evidence_requirement: Encryption standard/policy, TLS configuration report, at-rest encryption evidence.

controls.title: Vulnerability Management & Penetration Testing
controls.description: Suppliers must conduct regular vulnerability scanning and independent penetration testing of the product, with timely remediation of identified findings.
controls.test_criteria: Review the latest penetration test report and remediation tracker.
controls.evidence_requirement: Penetration test report, vulnerability remediation log.

controls.title: Authentication, Access Control and Audit Logging
controls.description: The product must enforce role-based access control, strong authentication (MFA where appropriate) for staff/admin access, and maintain audit logs of access to personal data.
controls.test_criteria: Review the access control matrix and sample audit logs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy/matrix, audit log extracts, MFA configuration evidence.

controls.title: Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery
controls.description: Suppliers must maintain business continuity and disaster recovery plans with defined recovery time/point objectives for the hosted service, tested at a defined frequency.
controls.test_criteria: Review the BC/DR plan and the most recent test results.
controls.evidence_requirement: BC/DR plan, DR test report.

controls.title: Use of NHS Number as Primary Identifier
controls.description: Where the product manages patient records, it must use the NHS Number as the primary patient identifier in line with national information standards.
controls.test_criteria: Review the data model/schema confirming NHS Number field usage.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data model documentation, sample record extract (redacted).

controls.title: Open/National Interoperability Standards
controls.description: The product must support relevant open standards (e.g., HL7 FHIR UK Core, SNOMED CT, dm+d) to enable data exchange with other NHS systems rather than proprietary lock-in formats.
controls.test_criteria: Review the interoperability specification/API documentation against named standards.
controls.evidence_requirement: API/interoperability specification, standards conformance statement.

controls.title: Integration with National Services
controls.description: Where applicable, the product must demonstrate the ability to integrate with relevant national NHS services/registries (e.g., Personal Demographics Service, Summary Care Record) via approved interfaces.
controls.test_criteria: Review integration test evidence/connection agreements with national services.
controls.evidence_requirement: Integration test results, connection agreement documentation.

controls.title: Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA / Equality Act 2010)
controls.description: The product must meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility criteria and comply with the Equality Act 2010 and the Public Sector Bodies Accessibility Regulations where applicable.
controls.test_criteria: Review the accessibility audit report and sample assistive-technology testing results.
controls.evidence_requirement: Accessibility audit report, accessibility statement.

controls.title: Usability Testing with Representative Users
controls.description: The product must be usability-tested with a representative sample of intended users, including patients/service users with relevant health conditions, and iterated based on findings.
controls.test_criteria: Review the usability testing report and resulting design changes.
controls.evidence_requirement: Usability testing report, participant demographics summary, design change log.

name: ISO 13485:2016
description: International standard published by ISO specifying requirements for a quality management system for organizations involved in the design, production, installation and servicing of medical devices, used to demonstrate regulatory alignment (e.g., with EU MDR, FDA QSR) and maintained via third-party certification bodies.
notes: Mapped at clause/sub-clause level (4-8), which is the standard's natural top-level control granularity.

controls.title: Quality Management System - General Requirements
controls.description: The organization must establish, document, implement and maintain a QMS, determine the sequence and interaction of its processes, and apply a risk-based approach to QMS processes, including outsourced processes.
controls.test_criteria: Review the QMS process map and risk-based process control evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Quality manual, process interaction map, outsourced process control agreements.

controls.title: Documentation Requirements
controls.description: The QMS must include a quality manual, documented quality policy and objectives, required documented procedures, records, and documents needed to ensure effective planning, operation and control of processes, with controlled documents and records retained per device lifetime requirements.
controls.test_criteria: Review the document control procedure and a sample of controlled documents/records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Quality manual, document control procedure, master document list, retained records.

controls.title: Management Commitment
controls.description: Top management must provide evidence of commitment to the QMS by communicating the importance of regulatory/customer requirements, establishing the quality policy/objectives, conducting management reviews, and ensuring resource availability.
controls.test_criteria: Review management review minutes and resource allocation evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Management review records, resource planning documentation.

controls.title: Quality Objectives & Planning
controls.description: Top management must establish measurable quality objectives consistent with the quality policy at relevant functions/levels, and plan QMS changes in a controlled manner.
controls.test_criteria: Review quality objectives and tracking against targets.
controls.evidence_requirement: Quality objectives register, performance tracking reports.

controls.title: Responsibility, Authority & Management Review
controls.description: Roles, responsibilities and authorities must be defined and communicated, including a management representative, and management must review the QMS at planned intervals for suitability, adequacy and effectiveness with documented inputs/outputs.
controls.test_criteria: Review the organizational chart/responsibility matrix and management review records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Responsibility matrix, management review minutes with inputs and action items.

controls.title: Resource Management (Infrastructure, Work Environment, HR)
controls.description: The organization must determine and provide necessary resources including competent personnel (with documented training/competence records), infrastructure, and work environment/contamination control appropriate to the product.
controls.test_criteria: Review training records and infrastructure maintenance logs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training matrix/records, infrastructure maintenance records, work environment control documentation.

controls.title: Planning of Product Realization
controls.description: The organization must plan and develop processes needed for product realization including quality objectives, documentation, resources, verification/validation, and risk management activities per ISO 14971, consistent with other QMS processes.
controls.test_criteria: Review the product realization plan/risk management file for a sample product.
controls.evidence_requirement: Product realization plan, risk management file (ISO 14971).

controls.title: Customer-Related Processes
controls.description: The organization must determine requirements related to the product, including regulatory requirements, review these requirements before commitment, and maintain effective customer communication channels including complaint handling input.
controls.test_criteria: Review contract/order review records and customer communication logs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Contract review records, customer communication records.

controls.title: Design and Development Controls
controls.description: Design and development must be planned and controlled through defined stages with inputs, outputs, review, verification, validation, transfer to production, and change control, maintaining a design history file.
controls.test_criteria: Review the design history file for a sample device including V&V records and design reviews.
controls.evidence_requirement: Design history file, design review minutes, verification/validation reports, design change records.

controls.title: Purchasing & Supplier Controls
controls.description: The organization must evaluate and select suppliers based on their ability to supply product meeting requirements, verify purchased product, and maintain supplier performance monitoring and re-evaluation.
controls.test_criteria: Review the approved supplier list, supplier audits, and incoming inspection records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Approved supplier list, supplier evaluation/audit reports, incoming inspection records.

controls.title: Production and Service Provision Controls
controls.description: Production must be carried out under controlled conditions including documented procedures, validated processes where output cannot be verified by subsequent monitoring, product identification/traceability (including UDI), and preservation of product, plus installation/servicing records.
controls.test_criteria: Review production records, process validation reports, and traceability/UDI records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Batch/production records, process validation reports, traceability records, UDI assignment log.

controls.title: Control of Monitoring and Measuring Equipment
controls.description: Measuring equipment used to provide evidence of conformity must be calibrated or verified at specified intervals against traceable standards, with calibration status identified and records maintained.
controls.test_criteria: Review calibration records and calibration status labeling for a sample of equipment.
controls.evidence_requirement: Calibration records, equipment calibration schedule, traceability certificates.

controls.title: Feedback & Complaint Handling
controls.description: The organization must establish a feedback process as an early warning system for quality problems and a documented complaint handling procedure to review, investigate, and determine the need for corrective action or regulatory reporting for every complaint.
controls.test_criteria: Review the complaint log and sample complaint investigation files.
controls.evidence_requirement: Complaint handling procedure, complaint register, investigation records.

controls.title: Reporting to Regulatory Authorities (Vigilance)
controls.description: The organization must have documented procedures for reporting adverse events and corrective actions (e.g., field safety corrective actions/recalls) to applicable regulatory authorities within required timeframes.
controls.test_criteria: Review the vigilance reporting procedure and sample regulatory submissions/timelines.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vigilance/adverse event reporting procedure, submitted reports, FSCA records.

controls.title: Internal Audit
controls.description: The organization must conduct internal audits at planned intervals to determine QMS conformity and effectiveness, with documented audit procedures, findings, and follow-up verification of corrective action.
controls.test_criteria: Review the internal audit schedule, audit reports, and closure evidence for findings.
controls.evidence_requirement: Internal audit schedule, audit reports, CAPA closure records.

controls.title: Monitoring/Measurement of Processes and Product
controls.description: The organization must apply suitable methods to monitor/measure QMS processes and product characteristics at appropriate stages, retaining evidence of conformity and identification of who authorized product release.
controls.test_criteria: Review process monitoring data and product release records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Process performance data/KPIs, product release/inspection records.

controls.title: Control of Nonconforming Product
controls.description: Nonconforming product must be identified and controlled to prevent unintended use or delivery, with documented procedures for review, disposition (rework/scrap/concession), and, where relevant, notification to customers/regulators.
controls.test_criteria: Review the nonconforming product log and disposition records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Nonconforming material report (NCMR) log, disposition records, customer/regulator notifications.

controls.title: Analysis of Data
controls.description: The organization must determine, collect and analyze appropriate data (customer feedback, conformity to requirements, trends, supplier performance) to demonstrate QMS suitability/effectiveness and identify improvement opportunities.
controls.test_criteria: Review data analysis reports/trend analyses fed into management review.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data analysis reports, trend charts, management review inputs.

controls.title: Improvement (Corrective and Preventive Action)
controls.description: The organization must implement corrective actions to eliminate causes of nonconformities and preventive actions to eliminate causes of potential nonconformities, with documented investigation, root cause analysis and effectiveness verification (CAPA system).
controls.test_criteria: Review the CAPA log and sample CAPA records for root cause analysis and effectiveness checks.
controls.evidence_requirement: CAPA procedure, CAPA register, root cause analysis records, effectiveness verification evidence.

name: COPPA
description: The US Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (15 U.S.C. 6501-6506) and its implementing FTC Rule (16 CFR Part 312), enforced by the Federal Trade Commission, regulating the online collection of personal information from children under 13 by operators of child-directed websites/services or operators with actual knowledge of child users.
notes: Reflects the FTC's 2013 Rule amendments (expanded definition of personal information, persistent identifiers, plug-ins/ad networks) which remain current; the 2025 Rule amendments (further tightening third-party disclosure and retention provisions) should be checked against the FTC's current effective-date schedule for any live assessment.

controls.title: Applicability Determination (Child-Directed / Actual Knowledge)
controls.description: Operators must determine whether their website/service is 'directed to children under 13' (based on subject matter, visual content, use of child-oriented characters, etc.) or whether they have actual knowledge of collecting data from children, which triggers COPPA obligations.
controls.test_criteria: Review the documented applicability/audience assessment for the product.
controls.evidence_requirement: Audience determination assessment, content/marketing review documentation.

controls.title: Direct Notice to Parents
controls.description: Before collecting personal information from a child, operators must provide direct notice to parents describing the information collected, how it is used, and disclosure practices, obtained through a reasonable method given available technology.
controls.test_criteria: Review the parental notice content and delivery mechanism/logs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Parental notice template, delivery/send logs.

controls.title: Online Privacy Policy
controls.description: Operators must post a clear, understandable, and complete privacy policy describing practices for collecting, using and disclosing personal information from children, linked prominently on the homepage and at each area collecting information.
controls.test_criteria: Review the published privacy policy against the COPPA Rule's content requirements and check link placement.
controls.evidence_requirement: Published privacy policy, website screenshots showing link placement.

controls.title: Verifiable Parental Consent (VPC)
controls.description: Operators must obtain verifiable parental consent before collecting, using or disclosing personal information from a child, using an FTC-approved method (e.g., signed form, credit card transaction, video conference, knowledge-based authentication).
controls.test_criteria: Review the VPC method used and sample consent records.
controls.evidence_requirement: VPC mechanism documentation, consent records/logs.

controls.title: Parental Review and Deletion Rights
controls.description: Operators must, upon parental request, provide a description of the specific data collected, allow the parent to review the child's personal information, and allow the parent to refuse further collection/use and direct deletion of the data.
controls.test_criteria: Sample parental access/deletion requests and verify fulfillment timeliness.
controls.evidence_requirement: Parental request log, fulfillment records, deletion confirmations.

controls.title: Data Minimization / Collection Limitation
controls.description: Operators may not condition a child's participation in an activity on disclosing more personal information than reasonably necessary, and must collect no more information than needed for the activity.
controls.test_criteria: Review data collection forms/flows for the necessity of each field collected.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data collection form review, data minimization assessment.

controls.title: Confidentiality, Security and Integrity of Children's Data
controls.description: Operators must establish and maintain reasonable procedures to protect the confidentiality, security, and integrity of personal information collected from children, including vetting third-party service providers' security practices.
controls.test_criteria: Review the security policy and third-party processor security vetting records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Security policy/controls documentation, vendor security assessment records.

controls.title: Data Retention and Deletion Limitation
controls.description: Operators must retain children's personal information only as long as reasonably necessary to fulfill the purpose for which it was collected, and delete it using reasonable measures to protect against unauthorized access when no longer needed.
controls.test_criteria: Review the data retention schedule and deletion procedure/logs for children's data.
controls.evidence_requirement: Retention schedule, deletion logs, secure disposal records.

controls.title: Prohibition on Conditioning Participation on Excess Disclosure
controls.description: Operators cannot condition a child's participation in a game, prize offer, or other activity on the child disclosing more personal information than is reasonably necessary.
controls.test_criteria: Review activity/prize mechanics for mandatory data fields beyond necessity.
controls.evidence_requirement: Activity design documentation, form field requirement list.

controls.title: Third-Party Disclosure Controls
controls.description: Operators must not disclose children's personal information to third parties unless those third parties agree to maintain confidentiality/security consistent with COPPA, and must disclose in the privacy policy which third parties receive data and why.
controls.test_criteria: Review third-party data sharing agreements and privacy policy disclosures.
controls.evidence_requirement: Third-party data sharing contracts, privacy policy third-party disclosure section.

controls.title: Safe Harbor Program Participation (Optional)
controls.description: Operators may comply by participating in an FTC-approved COPPA Safe Harbor self-regulatory program, which subjects them to the program's guidelines and independent compliance review in lieu of direct FTC assessment.
controls.test_criteria: Verify current safe harbor program membership and the most recent compliance review outcome.
controls.evidence_requirement: Safe harbor program certificate, compliance review report.

controls.title: Support-for-Internal-Operations Exception Controls
controls.description: Operators relying on the 'support for internal operations' exception (e.g., for analytics, ad frequency capping, authentication) without parental consent must ensure the data is not used for any other purpose, including behavioral advertising.
controls.test_criteria: Review data use documentation for any internal-operations-exception data flows.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data use/purpose limitation documentation, analytics/ad vendor configuration review.

name: Essential Eight Level 2
description: A maturity-based set of eight baseline cyber security mitigation strategies published by the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC/ASD) to protect against common cyber threats; Maturity Level 2 reflects partial alignment with the intent of each strategy and resistance to adversaries using moderately sophisticated tradecraft.
notes: The Essential Eight's native top-level structure is the eight strategies themselves rather than numbered clauses; descriptions reflect the Maturity Level 2 (not Level 1 or Level 3) requirements per the ACSC Essential Eight Maturity Model.

controls.title: Patch Applications
controls.description: Internet-facing services and office productivity suites/browsers/PDF software/security products with known exploited vulnerabilities must be patched or mitigated within 48 hours, other applications within one month; vulnerability scanning occurs at least fortnightly, and applications no longer supported by vendors are removed.
controls.test_criteria: Review patch deployment records/vulnerability scan reports against the required timeframes for the applicable application tier.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vulnerability scan reports, patch deployment logs, application support-status inventory.

controls.title: Patch Operating Systems
controls.description: Operating systems on internet-facing servers/network devices with known exploited vulnerabilities are patched within 48 hours, workstations and other servers within one month; vulnerability scanning occurs at least fortnightly, and unsupported OS versions are upgraded or isolated.
controls.test_criteria: Review OS patch compliance reports and scan cadence evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: OS patch compliance dashboard, vulnerability scan schedule/reports, OS version inventory.

controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
controls.description: MFA is enforced for users accessing important data repositories, for all privileged users, and for remote access/VPN, using at least a 'something you know plus something you have' factor, with successful and failed MFA events centrally logged.
controls.test_criteria: Review MFA enforcement configuration and authentication logs for a sample of privileged/remote access accounts.
controls.evidence_requirement: MFA policy configuration export, authentication logs, privileged account list cross-check.

controls.title: Restrict Administrative Privileges
controls.description: Privileged access is restricted to verified need, privileged accounts are prevented from accessing the internet/email, privileged users use separate unprivileged accounts for non-admin tasks, and privileged account/group activity is centrally logged and reviewed.
controls.test_criteria: Review the privileged account inventory, access review records, and separation-of-duties configuration.
controls.evidence_requirement: Privileged access register, access review/recertification records, privileged account activity logs.

controls.title: Application Control
controls.description: Application control is implemented on workstations and servers restricting execution to an approved set of executables, scripts, installers and libraries (allow-listing), enforced on all storage locations, with the rule-set validated at least annually.
controls.test_criteria: Review the application control policy/rule-set and test attempted execution of a non-approved binary.
controls.evidence_requirement: Application control configuration/policy export, rule-set validation/testing records, blocked-execution logs.

controls.title: Restrict Microsoft Office Macros
controls.description: Office macros are disabled for users without a demonstrated business need; where needed, macros are only allowed from trusted locations with limited write access or digitally signed by a trusted publisher, and macro execution events are centrally logged.
controls.test_criteria: Review the macro security policy settings and macro execution/block logs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Macro security policy configuration, trusted publisher/location list, macro event logs.

controls.title: User Application Hardening
controls.description: Web browsers are configured to block or disable Flash, ads and Java from the internet as applicable, Office is blocked from creating child processes or injecting code into other processes, and browser/PDF/Office security settings are centrally managed, hardened and enforced, with events logged.
controls.test_criteria: Review hardening configuration baselines deployed via GPO/MDM and sample endpoint compliance.
controls.evidence_requirement: Hardening configuration baseline documentation, endpoint compliance scan results.

controls.title: Regular Backups
controls.description: Backups of important data, software and configuration settings are performed and retained in a coordinated, resilient manner per business continuity requirements; backup restoration is tested as part of disaster recovery exercises, and unprivileged/non-backup-administrator accounts cannot access or modify backups.
controls.test_criteria: Review the backup schedule, retention configuration, access restrictions, and restoration test results.
controls.evidence_requirement: Backup policy/schedule, access control configuration for backup systems, restoration test report.

name: FERPA
description: The US Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (20 U.S.C. 1232g; 34 CFR Part 99), a federal law enforced by the US Department of Education's Student Privacy Policy Office, that protects the privacy of student education records and governs their disclosure by schools and educational agencies receiving federal funding.
notes: Scoped to the statute and Part 99 regulations at the requirement-category level; state-level student privacy laws that layer on top of FERPA are out of scope.

controls.title: Definition & Scope of Education Records
controls.description: Education records are records directly related to a student and maintained by an educational agency/institution or a party acting for it, excluding specified categories such as sole-possession notes, law enforcement unit records, employment records, certain treatment records, and alumni records.
controls.test_criteria: Review the records classification policy distinguishing education records from excluded categories.
controls.evidence_requirement: Records classification/retention schedule, policy documentation.

controls.title: Annual Notification of Rights
controls.description: Institutions must annually notify parents (or eligible students at the postsecondary level) of their FERPA rights, including the right to inspect, request amendment, consent to disclosure, and file a complaint with the Department of Education.
controls.test_criteria: Review the annual notification content and distribution evidence (e.g., student handbook, mailing, portal posting).
controls.evidence_requirement: Annual FERPA notice text, distribution records (mailing list, portal publish date).

controls.title: Right to Inspect and Review Education Records
controls.description: Parents/eligible students have the right to inspect and review education records within 45 days of a request, and institutions must provide copies or other means of access if circumstances effectively prevent inspection.
controls.test_criteria: Sample record inspection requests and verify fulfillment within 45 days.
controls.evidence_requirement: Record request log, fulfillment timestamps, copies provided.

controls.title: Right to Request Amendment
controls.description: Parents/eligible students may request amendment of records believed to be inaccurate or misleading; the institution must decide within a reasonable time and, if it declines, inform the requester of the right to a hearing.
controls.test_criteria: Review the amendment request log and hearing procedure documentation for denied requests.
controls.evidence_requirement: Amendment request records, hearing procedure, hearing outcome letters.

controls.title: Consent Requirement for Disclosure
controls.description: Generally, written consent from the parent/eligible student is required before personally identifiable information from education records is disclosed to a third party, specifying the records, purpose, and recipient.
controls.test_criteria: Sample third-party disclosures and verify signed consent is on file absent an applicable exception.
controls.evidence_requirement: Consent forms, disclosure log cross-referenced to consent records.

controls.title: Directory Information Exception
controls.description: Institutions may disclose 'directory information' (name, address, honors, dates of attendance, etc.) without consent only if they have given public notice of the categories designated as directory information and an opportunity to opt out.
controls.test_criteria: Review the directory information notice and opt-out list enforcement.
controls.evidence_requirement: Directory information public notice, opt-out request log, system flag verification.

controls.title: School Official Exception
controls.description: Disclosure without consent is permitted to school officials with legitimate educational interests, including certain contractors/vendors, provided the institution has defined 'school official' and 'legitimate educational interest' in its annual notification and maintains direct control over the party's use of records.
controls.test_criteria: Review vendor/contractor agreements for FERPA school-official provisions and legitimate-interest definitions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Annual notice school-official definition, vendor data use agreements.

controls.title: Recordkeeping of Disclosures
controls.description: Institutions must maintain a record of each disclosure (and request for disclosure) of personally identifiable information, including the party and legitimate interest, for as long as the education record is maintained, with limited exceptions.
controls.test_criteria: Review the disclosure log for completeness against sampled disclosure events.
controls.evidence_requirement: Disclosure log/record, sampled disclosure correspondence.

controls.title: Health or Safety Emergency Exception
controls.description: Institutions may disclose education records without consent to appropriate parties in connection with an articulable and significant threat to the health or safety of the student or others, limited to the duration of the emergency.
controls.test_criteria: Review emergency disclosure records and documented justification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Emergency disclosure log, justification documentation.

controls.title: Data Security Safeguards for Education Records
controls.description: Institutions must use reasonable administrative, technical and physical safeguards to protect education records from unauthorized access, loss, or disclosure, particularly where records are maintained electronically or shared with third-party service providers.
controls.test_criteria: Review access control configuration and vendor security requirements for systems holding education records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, system security configuration, vendor data security agreements.

controls.title: Complaint Process & SPPO Escalation
controls.description: Institutions must establish a defined local process for resolving parent/eligible student disputes and must inform them of the right to file a complaint with the Student Privacy Policy Office (SPPO) if the institution fails to comply.
controls.test_criteria: Review the complaint handling procedure and sample complaint records.
controls.evidence_requirement: FERPA complaint procedure documentation, complaint log.

controls.title: Studies/Audit Exception Data-Sharing Controls
controls.description: Disclosure without consent to organizations conducting studies on behalf of the institution, or for audit/evaluation purposes, is permitted only under written agreements limiting use/redisclosure and generally requiring destruction or return of PII when no longer needed.
controls.test_criteria: Review research/study data-sharing agreements for required FERPA provisions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Research data-sharing agreements, data destruction confirmation records.

name: PCI DSS V4.0
description: The Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard version 4.0, published by the PCI Security Standards Council (founded by the major card brands) and enforced via acquiring banks/card brands, establishing technical and operational requirements for organizations that store, process, or transmit cardholder data.
notes: PCI DSS v4.0 was published March 2022. v4.0.1 (June 2024, handled elsewhere) is a limited revision of v4.0: it made wording/clarification and document-structure changes only, added no new or removed requirements, and did not change the phased effective dates (new v4.0 'future-dated' requirements became mandatory 31 March 2025). v4.0 itself was formally retired 31 December 2024, so v4.0.1 is now the only active version in practice -- this entry documents the 12 top-level requirements as introduced in v4.0, which remain structurally identical in v4.0.1.

controls.title: Install and Maintain Network Security Controls
controls.description: Organizations must implement and maintain network security controls (firewalls or equivalent) to protect the cardholder data environment (CDE), with documented network diagrams, restricted traffic rules reviewed every six months, and justification for all allowed services/ports.
controls.test_criteria: Review firewall/NSC rule sets, network diagrams, and rule review records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Network diagrams, NSC rule-base export, bi-annual rule review documentation.

controls.title: Apply Secure Configurations to All System Components
controls.description: Vendor-supplied defaults (passwords, SNMP community strings, etc.) must be changed or disabled before deployment, system hardening standards must be applied and documented, and unnecessary services/functions removed.
controls.test_criteria: Review hardening standards and sample configuration against CIS/vendor benchmarks; verify default credentials were changed.
controls.evidence_requirement: System hardening standards, configuration scan results, default-credential change records.

controls.title: Protect Stored Account Data
controls.description: Cardholder data storage must be minimized, sensitive authentication data must not be stored post-authorization, the primary account number (PAN) must be rendered unreadable wherever stored (encryption, truncation, tokenization, hashing), and cryptographic key management procedures must be documented.
controls.test_criteria: Review the data retention/disposal policy, PAN storage locations via a data discovery scan, and key management procedures.
controls.evidence_requirement: Data retention and disposal policy, cardholder data discovery scan results, key management procedure documentation.

controls.title: Protect Cardholder Data with Strong Cryptography During Transmission
controls.description: Strong cryptography and security protocols (e.g., TLS 1.2+) must protect PAN and sensitive authentication data during transmission over open, public networks, with certificates/keys managed appropriately.
controls.test_criteria: Review TLS configuration scans and the certificate inventory for transmission channels carrying cardholder data.
controls.evidence_requirement: TLS/SSL configuration scan reports, certificate management records.

controls.title: Protect All Systems and Networks from Malicious Software
controls.description: Anti-malware solutions must be deployed on applicable system components, kept current, configured to perform periodic/real-time scans, and (new in v4.0) a targeted risk analysis used to determine anti-malware needs for systems not commonly targeted by malware.
controls.test_criteria: Review anti-malware deployment coverage, signature update logs, and scan results.
controls.evidence_requirement: Anti-malware deployment inventory, update/scan logs, targeted-risk-analysis documentation.

controls.title: Develop and Maintain Secure Systems and Software
controls.description: Organizations must identify and manage security vulnerabilities via a formal process, apply critical patches timely, follow secure coding practices (including for bespoke/custom software), and deploy protections such as a WAF or equivalent for public-facing web applications.
controls.test_criteria: Review the vulnerability management process, patch timelines, secure SDLC documentation, and WAF configuration/logs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Vulnerability/patch management records, secure coding training records, WAF rule configuration and alert logs.

controls.title: Restrict Access to System Components and Cardholder Data by Business Need to Know
controls.description: Access to system components and cardholder data must be limited to only those individuals whose job requires it, based on least privilege and documented access control models/role definitions.
controls.test_criteria: Review the access control matrix/RBAC model and sample user access against job role justification.
controls.evidence_requirement: Access control policy, RBAC role definitions, access review/recertification records.

controls.title: Identify Users and Authenticate Access to System Components
controls.description: All users must be assigned a unique ID, strong authentication (including MFA for all access into the CDE) must be enforced, password/passphrase policies met, and shared/group/generic accounts restricted and controlled.
controls.test_criteria: Review authentication policy configuration, MFA enforcement, and the account inventory for unique-ID compliance.
controls.evidence_requirement: Authentication/password policy settings, MFA configuration, user account inventory.

controls.title: Restrict Physical Access to Cardholder Data
controls.description: Physical access to systems, media, and facilities housing cardholder data must be appropriately restricted and monitored (e.g., badge access, visitor logs, video surveillance), and media containing cardholder data must be securely stored, distributed and destroyed.
controls.test_criteria: Review physical access control logs, visitor logs, and media destruction records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Badge access logs, visitor log, media inventory and destruction certificates.

controls.title: Log and Monitor All Access to System Components and Cardholder Data
controls.description: Audit logs must be enabled and capture access to cardholder data and system components, logs must be protected from tampering, reviewed daily or via an automated mechanism for anomalies, and retained for at least 12 months with 3 months immediately available.
controls.test_criteria: Review logging configuration, log review records/automated alerting, and retention settings.
controls.evidence_requirement: Logging configuration export, daily log review records/SIEM alert history, log retention configuration.

controls.title: Test Security of Systems and Networks Regularly
controls.description: Organizations must perform quarterly internal/external vulnerability scans (external scans by an Approved Scanning Vendor), annual penetration testing of the CDE and segmentation controls, and deploy mechanisms to detect unauthorized wireless access points and unauthorized changes to critical files.
controls.test_criteria: Review ASV scan reports, penetration test reports, segmentation test results, and file-integrity monitoring alerts.
controls.evidence_requirement: ASV scan reports, internal/external penetration test reports, segmentation testing documentation, FIM/change-detection logs.

controls.title: Support Information Security with Organizational Policies and Programs
controls.description: An overarching information security policy must be established and reviewed annually, risk assessments performed, personnel security awareness training conducted, an incident response plan maintained and tested, and service provider relationships managed with documented responsibility matrices.
controls.test_criteria: Review the information security policy, risk assessment, training records, incident response test records, and service provider agreements.
controls.evidence_requirement: Information security policy, annual risk assessment, security awareness training completion records, incident response plan and test results, service provider PCI DSS responsibility matrices.

controls.title: Scoping and Segmentation Confirmation
