controls.description: Organizations must accurately define PCI DSS scope at least annually and upon significant change, confirming the accuracy of segmentation controls used to reduce scope through penetration testing, and documenting the cardholder data flow.
controls.test_criteria: Review the scoping methodology documentation, data flow diagrams, and segmentation test evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Scope definition/confirmation documentation, cardholder data flow diagrams, segmentation penetration test report.

name: ISO 9001:2015
description: International standard published by ISO specifying requirements for a quality management system, applicable to any organization seeking to demonstrate consistent ability to provide products/services meeting customer and applicable statutory/regulatory requirements, certified by accredited third-party certification bodies.
notes: Mapped at clause/sub-clause level (4-10) per the standard's High Level Structure (Annex SL), which is its natural top-level control granularity.

controls.title: Understanding the Organization and its Context
controls.description: The organization must determine external and internal issues relevant to its purpose and strategic direction that affect its ability to achieve intended QMS results, and monitor/review this information.
controls.test_criteria: Review the context analysis documentation (e.g., SWOT/PESTLE) and evidence of periodic review.
controls.evidence_requirement: Context of the organization analysis, review records.

controls.title: Understanding Needs and Expectations of Interested Parties
controls.description: The organization must determine relevant interested parties and their requirements relevant to the QMS, monitoring and reviewing this information.
controls.test_criteria: Review the interested parties register and requirement mapping.
controls.evidence_requirement: Interested parties register, requirements analysis.

controls.title: QMS Scope and Processes
controls.description: The organization must determine the boundaries/applicability of the QMS (documented scope statement) and establish, implement, maintain and continually improve the QMS including the process approach (inputs, outputs, sequence, interaction, criteria, resources, responsibilities, risks).
controls.test_criteria: Review the QMS scope statement and process map/turtle diagrams.
controls.evidence_requirement: QMS scope document, process map, process owner assignments.

controls.title: Leadership and Commitment
controls.description: Top management must demonstrate leadership and commitment to the QMS by taking accountability for its effectiveness, ensuring quality policy/objectives alignment with strategic direction, integrating QMS into business processes, and promoting process and risk-based thinking.
controls.test_criteria: Interview top management and review evidence of QMS integration into business planning.
controls.evidence_requirement: Strategic plan alignment documentation, management review minutes.

controls.title: Quality Policy
controls.description: Top management must establish, implement and maintain a quality policy appropriate to the organization's purpose/context, providing a framework for quality objectives, and communicate/make it available to relevant parties.
controls.test_criteria: Review the quality policy document and communication evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Quality policy document, communication records (intranet, notice boards).

controls.title: Organizational Roles, Responsibilities and Authorities
controls.description: Top management must assign and communicate responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles, including for ensuring QMS conformity and reporting on performance.
controls.test_criteria: Review the responsibility assignment matrix and job descriptions.
controls.evidence_requirement: Organizational chart, RACI matrix, role descriptions.

controls.title: Actions to Address Risks and Opportunities
controls.description: The organization must determine risks and opportunities affecting QMS conformity and the ability to enhance customer satisfaction, and plan proportionate actions integrated into QMS processes with effectiveness evaluation.
controls.test_criteria: Review the risk and opportunity register and evidence of integration into process plans.
controls.evidence_requirement: Risk and opportunity register, action plans and effectiveness evaluation records.

controls.title: Quality Objectives and Planning to Achieve Them
controls.description: Quality objectives must be established at relevant functions/levels, be measurable, monitored, communicated, and updated, with documented plans specifying what, resources, responsibility, timeframe and evaluation method.
controls.test_criteria: Review quality objectives and associated action plans/tracking.
controls.evidence_requirement: Quality objectives register, objective action plans, performance tracking.

controls.title: Planning of Changes
controls.description: Changes to the QMS must be carried out in a planned manner, considering the purpose/consequences, QMS integrity, resource availability, and allocation/reallocation of responsibilities.
controls.test_criteria: Review change management records for a sample QMS change.
controls.evidence_requirement: Change request/approval records, impact assessment documentation.

controls.title: Resources (People, Infrastructure, Environment, Monitoring/Measuring, Knowledge)
controls.description: The organization must determine and provide resources needed for the QMS including competent people, infrastructure, suitable process environment, calibrated monitoring/measuring resources, and maintain organizational knowledge.
controls.test_criteria: Review resource planning, infrastructure maintenance records, calibration records, and the knowledge management repository.
controls.evidence_requirement: Resource allocation plans, infrastructure maintenance logs, calibration certificates, knowledge base documentation.

controls.title: Competence
controls.description: The organization must determine necessary competence for persons affecting QMS performance, ensure competence through education/training/experience, and retain evidence of competence.
controls.test_criteria: Review the training needs analysis, training records and competence evaluation evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Training matrix, training records, competence assessment records.

controls.title: Awareness
controls.description: Persons doing work under the organization's control must be aware of the quality policy, relevant quality objectives, their contribution to QMS effectiveness, and the implications of not conforming.
controls.test_criteria: Interview a sample of staff and review awareness training records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Awareness training records, induction materials.

controls.title: Communication
controls.description: The organization must determine internal and external communications relevant to the QMS, including what, when, with whom, how, and who communicates.
controls.test_criteria: Review the communication plan and sample communications.
controls.evidence_requirement: Communication plan/matrix, sample internal/external communications.

controls.title: Documented Information
controls.description: The organization must maintain documented information required by the standard and determined necessary for QMS effectiveness, with controls for creation/update (identification, format, review/approval) and control (distribution, access, storage, retention, disposition).
controls.test_criteria: Review the document control procedure and sample controlled document history.
controls.evidence_requirement: Document control procedure, master document/record list, version history logs.

controls.title: Operational Planning and Control
controls.description: The organization must plan, implement and control processes needed to meet requirements for provision of products/services, including determining criteria, resources, and controlling planned changes/unintended consequences, plus controlling outsourced processes.
controls.test_criteria: Review operational planning documentation and outsourced process controls.
controls.evidence_requirement: Operational plans, outsourced process control agreements.

controls.title: Requirements for Products and Services
controls.description: The organization must establish customer communication processes, determine requirements (including statutory/regulatory), review requirements before commitment to supply, and manage changes to requirements.
controls.test_criteria: Review contract/order review records and customer communication logs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Order/contract review records, requirement change records.

controls.title: Design and Development of Products and Services
controls.description: Where applicable, a design and development process must be established with planning, inputs, controls (review, verification, validation), outputs, and change control.
controls.test_criteria: Review the design and development file including inputs/outputs/review/verification/validation records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Design and development plan, design review/verification/validation records, design change log.

controls.title: Control of Externally Provided Processes, Products and Services
controls.description: The organization must ensure externally provided processes/products/services conform to requirements, applying controls based on their potential impact, including evaluation/selection/monitoring/re-evaluation of external providers.
controls.test_criteria: Review supplier evaluation records and incoming inspection/verification evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Approved supplier list, supplier evaluation records, incoming inspection records.

controls.title: Production/Service Provision and Release
controls.description: Production and service provision must be carried out under controlled conditions (documented information, suitable monitoring/measuring resources, infrastructure, competent persons, validation of processes, traceability where required, preservation), with product/service release only after satisfactory completion of planned verification.
controls.test_criteria: Review production/service records, traceability records, and release/sign-off evidence.
controls.evidence_requirement: Production/service records, traceability logs, release authorization records.

controls.title: Control of Nonconforming Outputs
controls.description: Outputs that do not conform to requirements must be identified and controlled to prevent unintended use or delivery, with documented actions taken (correction, segregation, information to customer) and records retained.
controls.test_criteria: Review the nonconformance log and disposition/corrective records.
controls.evidence_requirement: Nonconformance register, disposition records, customer notification records.

controls.title: Monitoring, Measurement, Analysis and Evaluation
controls.description: The organization must determine what needs to be monitored/measured (including customer satisfaction), the methods and timing, and analyze/evaluate the results, including monitoring customer perception.
controls.test_criteria: Review the monitoring plan, customer satisfaction survey results, and data analysis reports.
controls.evidence_requirement: Monitoring and measurement plan, customer satisfaction data, performance analysis reports.

controls.title: Internal Audit
controls.description: The organization must conduct internal audits at planned intervals to determine QMS conformity to its own requirements and the standard, and effective implementation/maintenance, with an audit programme, defined criteria/scope, and management action on results.
controls.test_criteria: Review the internal audit programme, audit reports and evidence of management follow-up.
controls.evidence_requirement: Internal audit schedule, audit reports, CAPA/follow-up records.

controls.title: Management Review
controls.description: Top management must review the QMS at planned intervals considering defined inputs (audit results, customer feedback, process performance, nonconformities, resource adequacy, risk/opportunity status) and produce outputs including decisions on improvement and resource needs.
controls.test_criteria: Review management review minutes against required inputs/outputs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Management review agenda and minutes, action item tracker.

controls.title: Improvement and Nonconformity/Corrective Action
controls.description: The organization must determine and select improvement opportunities and implement actions to meet requirements/enhance satisfaction, and react to nonconformities by taking corrective action, evaluating the need to eliminate causes, and updating risks/the QMS as needed.
controls.test_criteria: Review corrective action records including root cause analysis and effectiveness review.
controls.evidence_requirement: Corrective action register, root cause analysis records, effectiveness verification.

controls.title: Continual Improvement
controls.description: The organization must continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the QMS, considering analysis/evaluation results and management review outputs.
controls.test_criteria: Review continual improvement initiatives tracked over time and their linkage to management review outputs.
controls.evidence_requirement: Continual improvement log/register, trend analysis reports.
